Specifically, PanTact captures, learns, and executes whole-body contact via: 1) a wearable, robot-free data collection interface that augments egocentric vision and bimanual UMI grippers with whole-body modular contact patches to record body contact locations and states; 2) a visuomotor policy that mitigates the egocentric observation gap and predicts whole-body contact goals; and 3) contact-aware whole-body control formulations that realize active contact goals using suitable robot surfaces. We deploy PanTact on a Unitree G1 humanoid without additional body contact sensors, demonstrating whole-body dexterity involving body support, pushing, sweeping, and load-sharing. Website: https://pantact.github.io
2610.12558.abstract_zh: 人形机器人拥有许多自由度和接触表面，但多数移动操作研究把操作限制在双手，并避免身体其他部位与环境接触。为把操作扩展到双手之外，我们提出 PanTact：直接从无需机器人的人类示范中学习人形机器人全身灵巧操作，即使用任何合适的身体表面操作。核心思想是把接触作为可跨具身迁移的、以操作为中心的信息：接触位置与时序指定完成任务所需的交互，机器人则在自身物理约束内协调身体实现这些交互。具体而言，PanTact 包括三部分：（1）无需机器人的可穿戴采集接口，在第一人称视觉和双手 UMI 夹爪之外加入全身模块化接触贴片，记录身体接触位置与状态；（2）缓解第一人称观察缺口并预测全身接触目标的视觉运动策略；（3）利用合适机器人表面实现主动接触目标的接触感知全身控制。我们在没有额外身体接触传感器的 Unitree G1 上部署 PanTact，展示身体支撑、推动、清扫和分担载荷等全身灵巧行为。网站见论文原文：https://pantact.github.io。

2610.13079.abstract_en: Third-person human videos offer a scalable alternative to task-specific reward engineering, teleoperation, and manually scripted demonstrations for humanoid loco-manipulation. Recent video-to-humanoid systems have shown that noisy human motion, object trajectories, and contacts can be extracted from unstructured videos and refined into deployable skills. However, a key gap remains for contact-rich imitation: the task is often defined by world-frame contacts whose poses, timing, and speed must survive embodiment mismatch and runtime scene changes. Towards this, we present VICAR (Video Imitation with Contact-Aware Retargeting), a pipeline for learning humanoid interactive skills from third-person human videos. The system first recovers human motion, reconstructs task-relevant obstacles from monocular video, and then retargets the motion to a humanoid while preserving global contact poses, motion speed, and collision clearance. Unlike retargeting methods that only remove penetration or preserve local interaction geometry, our formulation represents user-specified contact poses and collision clearance as high-priority Lagrangian penalty terms and optimizes the full motion to remain smooth through contact-rich transitions. The resulting motions are used to train a contact-conditioned motion generator whose inputs include movable contact points enabling runtime adaptation to new contact positions. We demonstrate the framework on ten diverse third-person video skills, including six table-tennis serves, three object-pickup tasks, and ladder climbing, and deploy the learned skills on hardware. These results suggest that contact-preserving retargeting is a practical step toward humanoids that learn useful interactive behavior by watching humans.
2610.13079.abstract_zh: 第三人称人类视频为人形机器人移动操作提供一种可扩展替代，减少针对任务的奖励设计、遥操作与手写示范。近期视频到人形机器人的系统已能从非结构化视频中提取带噪的人体运动、物体轨迹和接触，再细化为可部署技能；但接触丰富的模仿仍有关键缺口：任务常由世界坐标系中的接触定义，其位姿、时序和速度必须在具身差异和运行时场景变化下保留。我们提出 VICAR，从第三人称视频学习人形机器人交互技能。系统先恢复人体运动并从单目视频重建任务相关障碍物，再在保留全局接触位姿、运动速度和避碰裕量的条件下将运动重定向至人形机器人。与只消除穿透或保持局部交互几何的方法不同，我们把用户指定接触位姿与避碰裕量表示为高优先级拉格朗日惩罚，并优化整段运动，使接触丰富的过渡保持平滑。所得运动用于训练以接触为条件的运动生成器，其输入包含可移动接触点，支持运行时适应新接触位置。我们在十种第三人称视频技能上展示该框架，包括六种乒乓球发球、三种拾物任务和爬梯，并在硬件上部署所学技能。结果表明保留接触的重定向有助于人形机器人通过观察人类学习交互行为。

2610.12790.abstract_en: Reliable robotic manipulation requires maintaining a firm grasp while strictly avoiding both contact slip and structural damage to the object. Satisfying these inherent \textit{secure-and-gentle} grasping constraints is challenging for unknown objects. We present a novel online data-driven predictive control framework for safe dynamic robotic grasping of unknown objects. The proposed system features a pair of compact, single-channel tactile-sensing modules that characterize the gripper-object dynamic interaction in real time, entirely bypassing the need for prior knowledge or offline training. A finite-state-machine-based grasping force probing mechanism is developed to establish the initial grasping force and explicitly identify grasping force constraints. Through online dynamics learning, a Gaussian Process (GP) model captures gripper-object interaction dynamics. The model uncertainties are further used to form robust grasping constraints, which are embedded into a model predictive control scheme. We demonstrate error convergence in a probabilistic sense. The proposed control framework runs at 100~Hz in real time to dynamically manipulate and handle objects rather than static holding. Extensive experimental evaluations across diverse contact surface topologies and various types of objects validate superior performance and efficiency compared to baseline strategies. The proposed method is able to manipulate objects ranging from delicate items, such as raw tofu and marshmallows, to rough objects, such as rocks.
2610.12790.abstract_zh: 可靠机器人操作既要保持牢固抓取，又要严格避免接触滑移和物体结构损伤。对未知物体同时满足“牢固且轻柔”的抓取约束尤其困难。我们提出用于未知物体安全动态抓取的在线数据驱动预测控制框架。系统用一对紧凑的单通道触觉模块实时表征夹爪—物体动力学，无需先验知识或离线训练。基于有限状态机的抓取力探测机制确定初始夹持力，并显式识别夹持力约束。在线动力学学习用 Gaussian Process（GP）建模夹爪—物体交互，模型不确定性进一步形成鲁棒抓取约束，并嵌入模型预测控制。我们在概率意义下证明误差收敛。控制框架以 100 Hz 实时运行，执行物体动态操作与搬运，而不只是静态保持。跨不同接触表面拓扑与物体类型的实验表明，其性能和效率优于基线，能操作从生豆腐和棉花糖到岩石的物体。

2610.12567.abstract_en: Prior research on learning from humans often requires real human demonstrations. But advances in video generation models offer a new paradigm: we can now prompt these generators to make synthetic videos of the task. On the plus side, these synthetic videos take place in the robot's current environment, and do not require actual human teaching. However, while the generated videos appear to show plausible motions, they lack both physical consistency and robot grounding, and thus the robot cannot directly roll out the trajectory shown by the video. In this paper we seek to formalize the process of going from synthetic video generation to real-world robot trajectories for zero-shot manipulation tasks. We recognize that this problem is an instance of constrained optimization. The object trajectories extracted from the synthetic video provide an initial guess at the correct motion, and the robot must refine these trajectories (for instance, within a digital twin) while enforcing physical feasibility and semantic consistency. Our optimization-based formalism provides insights into the video generation properties necessary for success. Specifically, we show that the video generation must probabilistically seed the search within a semantic basin of attraction where the trajectory can be locally modified without losing its task alignment. Our analysis further reveals that state-of-the-art approaches can be viewed as instances of our unified formalism with key simplifications. In our experiments we remove these simplifications to more closely match the underlying optimization, leading to more robust zero-shot trajectories from synthetic videos and improving average task success by 34.1% compared to the best-performing baseline. See videos at our project website: https://collab.me.vt.edu/CASTER/
2610.12567.abstract_zh: 以往从人类学习常需真实人类示范，而视频生成模型使得通过提示生成任务合成视频成为可能。这些视频发生在机器人当前环境中，无需真人教学；但看似合理的运动缺乏物理一致性和机器人落地约束，机器人无法直接执行视频轨迹。本文形式化从合成视频到零样本操作真实机器人轨迹的过程，指出这是一类约束优化问题：从视频提取的物体轨迹提供运动初值，机器人须在例如数字孪生环境中修正轨迹，同时满足物理可行性与语义一致性。这一形式化揭示成功所需的视频生成性质：生成视频必须以一定概率把搜索初始化在语义吸引域中，使轨迹能局部修改而不失去任务对齐。分析还表明，已有先进方法可视为这一统一形式化的简化实例。实验中移除这些简化以更接近底层优化，使合成视频生成的零样本轨迹更稳健，平均任务成功率较最强基线提高 34.1%。视频见项目网站：https://collab.me.vt.edu/CASTER/。

2610.13665.abstract_en: This paper presents a dual-quadrotor hook- suspended transport system for cooperative aerial manipulation of a payload that is not rigidly attached to a fixed point along the cable. Two quadrotors are connected by a single inextensible cable that passes through a frictionless hook mounted on the payload, allowing the cable to slide between its two segments. This introduces a cable-distribution variable that couples the quadrotor motion, cable geometry, and payload dynamics. A feasible reference-generation framework is formulated using the desired payload pose, cable distribution, and system shape while satisfying the cable-length constraint and elliptical workspace. The quadrotors track the geometrically generated trajectories while maintaining positive cable tension and respecting actuator limits. The payload pose is estimated from the system geometry, and its measured position is used only to validate the desired trajectory. The approach is evaluated through experimental demonstrations.
2610.13665.abstract_zh: 本文提出用于协同空中操作的双四旋翼吊钩悬挂搬运系统，载荷并非沿缆绳刚性固定在某一点。两架四旋翼由一根不可伸长的缆绳相连，缆绳穿过载荷上的无摩擦吊钩，因而可在两段间滑动。这引入缆绳分配变量，使四旋翼运动、缆绳几何和载荷动力学相耦合。我们根据期望载荷位姿、缆绳分配和系统形状构造可行参考，同时满足缆长约束及椭圆工作空间限制。四旋翼跟踪几何生成的轨迹，并维持正的缆绳张力、遵守执行器限制。载荷位姿由系统几何估计，实测载荷位置只用于验证期望轨迹。方法通过实验演示评估。

2610.12972.abstract_en: Humanoid robots performing lifting and material-handling tasks must maintain balance despite unknown and varying payloads. However, payload uncertainty significantly affects whole-body dynamics and may destabilize conventional controllers. We propose an adaptive whole-body control architecture that integrates three components: (i) a centroidal model predictive controller (MPC) that generates dynamically feasible reference motions, (ii) an adaptive fuzzy balance controller that compensates for payload-induced model mismatch by generating corrective torques distributed across the supporting-leg joints, and (iii) a waypoint-based optimal posture planner built on a triple-integrator model that produces smooth sit-to-stand and stand-to-sit trajectories satisfying center-of-mass (CoM) stability constraints, joint limits, and whole-body feasibility requirements. Together, these components enable stable lowering, grasping, lifting, carrying, and placing behaviors under significant payload uncertainty. Extensive simulation and hardware experiments demonstrate that the proposed framework improves balance robustness and reduces tracking degradation during posture transitions and lifting tasks compared to non-adaptive baselines.
2610.12972.abstract_zh: 执行举升和物料搬运的人形机器人即使载荷未知且变化，也必须保持平衡；载荷不确定性会显著影响全身动力学，并可能使传统控制器失稳。我们提出自适应全身控制架构，集成三部分：（1）生成动力学可行参考运动的质心模型预测控制器（MPC）；（2）生成分配至支撑腿关节的修正力矩、补偿载荷引起的模型失配的自适应模糊平衡控制器；（3）基于三重积分器模型的航点式最优姿态规划器，生成平滑的坐下到站起及站起到坐下轨迹，同时满足质心（CoM）稳定、关节限制和全身可行性约束。三者共同支持在显著载荷不确定性下稳定地放低身体、抓取、举升、搬运与放置。广泛的仿真和硬件实验表明，相比非自适应基线，该框架提高了平衡鲁棒性，减轻姿态过渡与举升任务中的跟踪退化。

2610.12895.abstract_en: Scene flow estimation is essential for many autonomous driving (AD) and robotic applications, but obtaining ground-truth scene flow for non-rigid objects such as pedestrians is highly difficult. We present MeshBind, an automatic annotation method that uses mesh models to generate per-point scene flow for non-rigid objects. The novelty of this work is threefold: 1) developing a multi-view module that reconstructs an articulated mesh model from six surround cameras and registers it to the LiDAR frame; 2) developing a local-frame binding technique that attaches each point to the mesh via a per-triangle tangent-normal frame, invariant under rigid motion yet adaptive to articulated deformation; 3) developing a three-layer flow registration pipeline that combines ego-vehicle motion compensation, box binding, and mesh binding to produce full-scene per-point flow. We implement MeshBind in SF-Studio, an interactive annotation tool that visualises flow and allows human mesh corrections with automatic recomputation. We also release SFB (SUScape-Flow Benchmark), a large-scale benchmark built on the public SUScape dataset, covering 41k frames with per-point non-rigid pedestrian annotations and a Rigid/Semi-Rigid/Non-Rigid evaluation protocol. Experiments show that fine-tuning on SFB reduces three-way endpoint error (EPE) by 2-3x, and brings non-rigid EPE to the same level as rigid EPE.
2610.12895.abstract_zh: 场景流估计对自动驾驶和机器人应用很重要，但行人等非刚体的真值场景流极难获取。我们提出 MeshBind，用网格模型自动生成非刚体逐点场景流标注。创新有三点：（1）从六个环视摄像头重建关节网格并配准到 LiDAR 坐标系的多视图模块；（2）通过逐三角形切线—法线局部坐标系将点绑定到网格，使绑定对刚体运动不变、同时适应关节形变；（3）结合自车运动补偿、包围盒绑定和网格绑定的三层流配准流程，生成全场景逐点流。我们在交互式标注工具 SF-Studio 中实现 MeshBind，可可视化流、接受人工网格修正并自动重算。还基于公开 SUScape 数据集发布 SFB 基准，覆盖 41,000 帧及逐点非刚体行人标注，并提供刚体、半刚体、非刚体评测协议。在 SFB 微调使三类端点误差（EPE）降低 2–3 倍，非刚体 EPE 达到与刚体 EPE 相同水平。

2610.13849.abstract_en: We present HorizonNav, a video diffusion-based framework for anticipatory robot navigation that transforms a single RGB image and a text prompt into a geometrically aligned representation of plausible surrounding 3D space. Given the initial observation and a textual description of the reconstruction objective, a vision-language model, guided by designed instructions, interprets the scene and constructs structured prompts for a video diffusion model. The resulting video sequence provides plausible future observations of the environment, which are subsequently processed using monocular ORB-SLAM3 for camera pose estimation and Video Depth Anything for dense depth prediction. Our central contribution is a geometry-guided depth alignment stage that combines the estimated camera poses with triangulated visual landmarks to constrain dense depth predictions across multiple views. This alignment improves the geometric consistency of the reconstructed 3D environment, addressing inconsistencies that temporal coherence of the generated video alone cannot resolve. The experimental evaluation of navigation in imagined 3D environment shows that across a 19-scene horizon study, planning-feasible scenes increase from 13/19 at P20 to 15/19 at P81, while successful RRT trials increase from 62/90 to 75/90. In a separate corridor study, 6 of 25 evaluable generated-camera trajectories violate the reconstructed collision constraints; RRT planner recovers feasible alternatives in 5 of those 6 cases. A larger archive contains 58 usable reconstructions from 67 attempted cases, of which 36 support a downstream plan and 22 do not, exposing reconstruction and free-space failure modes rather than hiding them without lidar. Across 15 corridor reconstructions, the mean reconstruction error is approximately 0.30 m at matched structural landmarks.
2610.13849.abstract_zh: 我们提出 HorizonNav：一个用于前瞻式机器人导航的视频扩散框架，把单张 RGB 图像和文本提示转为对周围合理三维空间的几何对齐表示。给定初始观察与重建目标描述，视觉语言模型按设计好的指令理解场景，并为视频扩散模型生成结构化提示；所得视频序列提供环境的可能未来观察，再由单目 ORB-SLAM3 估计相机位姿、Video Depth Anything 预测稠密深度。核心贡献是几何引导深度对齐：结合估计相机位姿与三角化视觉地标来约束多视图深度，提高重建 3D 环境的几何一致性，解决仅靠视频时间连贯性无法消除的矛盾。在想象三维环境的导航评测中，19 个场景的 horizon 研究里，规划可行场景从 P20 的 13/19 增至 P81 的 15/19，成功 RRT 试验从 62/90 增至 75/90。另一项走廊研究中，25 条可评估的生成相机轨迹有 6 条违反重建的碰撞约束，RRT 为其中 5 条找到可行替代。更大的档案包含 67 次尝试中的 58 个可用重建，其中 36 个支持下游规划、22 个不支持，揭示了重建和自由空间失效模式，而非在无 LiDAR 时隐藏它们。15 个走廊重建在匹配结构地标处的平均重建误差约 0.30 m。

2610.13355.abstract_en: We show the convergence of a commonly used mesh-free discretization of a dynamic non-linear bond-based peridynamic model with irreversible damage implemented via a bond-breakage criterion for a fixed horizon $\delta >0$. The model chosen here is a mathematically well-posed regularization of a discontinuous peridynamic operator often found in the literature, which assumes that fracture results from strain in tension only. We explicitly include the one-point quadrature used in this scheme in the analysis. The convergence is with respect to the natural norm of the solution space given by $C^1([0,T],L^\infty(\Omega)^d)$, and therefore $L^\infty(\Omega)^d$ in the spatial coordinates. This result heavily constrains the spatial regularity of the continuous solution which we prove afterwards. More specifically, for locally $L$-Lipschitz continuous input data, local Lipschitz bounds are derived for the displacement, regardless of damage. This is consistent with interpreting the peridynamic model used here as an approximation to a truly discontinuous fracture model with a length-scale parameter given by the horizon $\delta>0$. We note that we do not deal with the limit of the solutions as $\delta \searrow 0$.
2610.13355.abstract_zh: 我们证明了对固定作用半径 δ>0，一种常用无网格离散对带键断裂判据、具有不可逆损伤的动态非线性键基周动力学模型收敛。所选模型是文献中常见非连续周动力学算子的一个数学适定正则化，假设裂纹只由拉伸应变引起。分析显式包含这一格式使用的单点求积。收敛所依据的是解空间的自然范数 C^1([0,T], L∞(Ω)^d)，因而空间坐标上采用 L∞(Ω)^d；这一结果对连续解的空间正则性提出很强限制，我们随后证明该性质。更具体地，对局部 L-Lipschitz 连续输入数据，我们推导位移的局部 Lipschitz 界，且不依赖损伤情况。这与把此周动力学模型解释为真实不连续断裂模型的近似相一致，近似长度尺度由 δ>0 给定。我们不研究 δ 趋近于 0 时解的极限。

2610.13860.abstract_en: Explicit 3D scene representations such as 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) have recently enabled high-quality, real-time novel view synthesis. However, these methods assume static scenes, limiting realism in the presence of dynamic phenomena ubiquitous in real-world environments. While coherent motion (e.g., humans or vehicles) can be captured and reconstructed, high-frequency effects such as flowing water remain intractable under casual capture conditions, where dense multi-view, high-speed acquisition is not feasible. We present a method to animate water in static 3DGS scenes, enabling visually plausible motion without requiring dynamic capture or physical simulation. Our approach estimates 2D optical flow from reference images or model renderings and lifts it into a consistent 3D Eulerian motion field. We propose a cinemagraph-inspired algorithm that applies this motion field to deform Gaussian primitives, producing temporally seamless looping animations. The resulting representation retains real-time rendering performance, significantly enhances perceptual realism, and preserves free-viewpoint navigation within the scene. We evaluate our method on a newly captured dataset of in-the-wild waterfall scenes and demonstrate clear improvements over prior work in dynamic Gaussian splatting and 3D cinemagraph generation in visual quality and computational efficiency.
2610.13860.abstract_zh: 3D Gaussian Splatting（3DGS）等显式三维场景表示已实现高质量、实时新视角合成，但这些方法假设场景静态，面对现实中常见的动态现象时真实感受限。虽然人或车辆等连贯运动可被捕获并重建，但在无法进行密集多视图高速采集的随手拍摄条件下，流水等高频效应仍难处理。我们提出在静态 3DGS 场景中为水体添加动画的方法，无需动态拍摄或物理仿真即可生成视觉上可信的运动。方法从参考图像或模型渲染估计 2D 光流，把它提升为一致的 3D 欧拉运动场；随后用受 cinemagraph 启发的算法，让这一运动场形变 Gaussian 基元，生成时间上无缝循环的动画。所得表示保持实时渲染，显著提高感知真实感并保留场景内自由视角导航。我们在新采集的野外瀑布数据集上评测，发现其视觉质量与计算效率优于先前的动态 Gaussian splatting 和 3D cinemagraph 方法。

2610.12696.abstract_en: Vision-language-action models (VLAs) offer a promising route toward general-purpose robotics by transferring semantic knowledge from large-scale vision-language pretraining into language-conditioned control. However, most VLA evaluations emphasize aggregate manipulation success under changes in objects, instructions, or environments, leaving unclear how reliably these policies ground spatial descriptions in the physical scenes where they act. We therefore ask a sharper question: how reliably can current VLAs translate spatial descriptions into appropriate real-robot behavior? To investigate this, we introduce Spa-Bench, a real-robot benchmark that evaluates spatial grounding across six tabletop tasks covering Object State, Relative Size, Referential Description, Relational Placement, Ordinal Position, and Counting. Our primary evaluation compares in-distribution (ID) and out-of-distribution (OOD) spatial configurations while retaining training support for the relevant objects, concepts, and actions, reducing object and motor unfamiliarity as alternative explanations for failure. Four diagnostic conditions further probe physical execution, sensitivity to wording, object-task associations, and recognition that no action is required. We release 4,092 episodes collected on the SO-101 robot arm: 1,200 human-teleoperated demonstrations and 2,892 real-robot evaluation rollouts from five state-of-the-art VLA policies. Across the three fully evaluated policies, success falls from 67.5-73.3% on ID spatial configurations to 40.7-52.0% on OOD spatial configurations, while matched direct instructions improve success by 28.3-40.0 percentage points. These results show that the evaluated VLAs can often execute the required manipulations but lack robust spatial grounding. Project materials, including videos, code, and benchmark data, are available at https://justintiensmith.github.io/Spa-Bench/.
2610.12696.abstract_zh: 视觉—语言—动作模型（VLA）通过把大规模视觉语言预训练中的语义知识迁移到语言条件控制，有望支持通用机器人。然而，多数 VLA 评测强调物体、指令或环境变化下的总体操作成功率，无法看清策略是否可靠地把空间描述落到实际物理场景中。我们提出更具体的问题：当前 VLA 能多可靠地把空间描述转化为恰当的真实机器人行为？为此提出真实机器人基准 Spa-Bench，覆盖物体状态、相对大小、指称描述、关系放置、序数位置和计数六类桌面任务。主要评测比较分布内（ID）与分布外（OOD）空间配置，同时保持相关物体、概念和动作在训练中有支持，以减少物体或运动陌生性等替代解释。另设四种诊断条件，检验物理执行、措辞敏感性、物体—任务关联及识别无需动作的情况。我们发布在 SO-101 机械臂上采集的 4,092 个 episode：1,200 条人工遥操作示范，以及来自五种先进 VLA 策略的 2,892 次真实机器人评测。三种完整评测策略在 ID 空间配置上的成功率为 67.5–73.3%，OOD 上降至 40.7–52.0%；匹配的直接指令使成功率提高 28.3–40.0 个百分点。结果表明，这些 VLA 往往能完成操作动作，但空间落地仍不稳健。项目资料、视频、代码和基准数据见原文链接：https://justintiensmith.github.io/Spa-Bench/。

2610.12772.abstract_en: Humans effortlessly react to the world; they adeptly return a tennis shot, catch a falling cup, step aside from a passing cart, or pass a box tossed during truck unloading. These everyday actions require anticipating a moving target and reflexively responding with the whole body within about a second. Such visual reactive whole-body control remains challenging for humanoids, which must (1) coordinate whole-body control, (2) react to object dynamics in real time, and (3) ground perception in egocentric vision. We study catching thrown boxes as a representative task that demands all three capabilities; existing systems cover only part of it, relying on end-effectors, motion capture, or marked objects. We present Reflex, a three-stage framework that learns these capabilities stage by stage while connecting them through a compact representation of object dynamics. First, a state-based policy learns whole-body catching with reinforcement learning. Second, the policy learns to infer the dynamics of a moving box from delayed and incomplete observations. Third, an egocentric RGB-D encoder learns to recover this dynamics representation directly from visual observations while keeping the whole-body controller fixed. This decomposition provides each capability with a direct training signal and makes visual learning substantially more scalable. In simulation, Reflex achieves 85.7% catch success from egocentric RGB-D, compared with 87.9% when given privileged box observations. Temporal visual history is critical: removing it reduces success by 35.6 and 39.8 points on centered and laterally offset throws. On a real Unitree G1, Reflex catches human-thrown boxes with 65% and 40% success at 2.5 and 5 m, reaching 76% and 59% of human catchers' success at the same distances.
2610.12772.abstract_zh: 人能够在约一秒内预判运动目标并以全身快速响应，例如回击网球、接住落杯、避让推车或接住搬运时抛来的箱子。对人形机器人，这种视觉反应式全身控制要求同时协调全身、实时响应物体动力学，并把第一人称视觉与控制联系起来。我们以接住抛来的箱子作为需要三种能力的代表任务；已有系统往往依赖末端执行器、动作捕捉或标记物体，只覆盖其中部分能力。我们提出三阶段框架 Reflex，通过紧凑物体动力学表示连接逐阶段学习的能力：先以强化学习训练状态输入的全身接箱策略；再让策略从延迟、不完整的观察推断运动箱子的动力学；最后在保持全身控制器冻结时，训练第一人称 RGB-D 编码器直接从视觉恢复这一动力学表示。这种分解为每种能力提供直接训练信号，使视觉学习更易扩展。在仿真中，第一人称 RGB-D 的接箱成功率为 85.7%，给定特权箱子观察时为 87.9%；去除视觉时间历史，在居中和横向偏移抛掷中成功率分别下降 35.6 和 39.8 个百分点。真实 Unitree G1 在 2.5 m 和 5 m 接人抛箱子的成功率分别为 65% 和 40%，达到相同距离人类接箱者成功率的 76% 和 59%。

2610.12734.abstract_en: Stereo vision is increasingly used for robotic manipulation, with a growing body of work incorporating it into Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models. However, the scarcity of large-scale, real-world stereo datasets remains a fundamental bottleneck for scaling such policies. Recent generative monocular-to-stereo methods target settings such as VR content and autonomous driving. No prior work produces realistic synthetic stereo data for robotic manipulation, where stereo supervision has come predominantly from simulation. We propose StereoEngine, which introduces two complementary methods to synthesize stereo data for robotic manipulation. In the first, we warp a monocular (left) video into the right view using estimated depth and inpaint the disoccluded regions with a video diffusion model, lifting monocular demonstrations into stereo pairs without training on real stereo. In the second, we render a stereo pair in simulation and jointly generate both photorealistic views, producing consistent left-right data without any real video as input. StereoEngine outperforms existing baselines in generated stereo quality, and using its synthetic data for policy mid-training or task-specific fine-tuning substantially improves downstream bimanual manipulation. Project website: https://stereoengine.github.io
2610.12734.abstract_zh: 立体视觉越来越多地用于机器人操作和视觉—语言—动作（VLA）模型，但大规模真实立体数据稀缺，成为扩展这类策略的主要瓶颈。近期单目到立体生成方法主要面向 VR 内容或自动驾驶；机器人操作的真实感合成立体数据过去主要来自仿真。我们提出 StereoEngine，用两种互补方法合成机器人操作立体数据。第一种用估计深度把单目左视角视频变形为右视角，再以视频扩散模型修补去遮挡区域，从而无需真实立体训练数据即可将单目示范提升为立体对。第二种在仿真中渲染立体对，再联合生成照片真实的双视角，不需真实视频输入。StereoEngine 生成的立体质量优于已有基线；把合成数据用于策略中期训练或任务专用微调，可显著改善下游双臂操作。项目网站见原文：https://stereoengine.github.io。

2610.12936.abstract_en: Vision-language-action (VLA) models provide a unified framework for visual understanding, language grounding, and robot control, yet anticipating how the scene will evolve beyond the current observation can provide additional information for control. Action supervision alone does not explicitly encourage such anticipation, while future-image prediction entangles task-relevant motion with largely static appearance. To address these limitations, we introduce Evo-World, a lightweight VLA model that augments policy learning with future motion prediction through optical-flow supervision, thereby providing a task-relevant predictive signal focused on motion rather than appearance. We further design the training procedure to preserve these predictive representations during policy learning, regulating representation diversity while decoupling representation learning from action optimization. Across simulation benchmarks, Evo-World demonstrates strong performance, achieving a tier-averaged success rate of 91.1% on Meta-World MT50 , with a 13.0% relative improvement over the non-predictive baseline. On real-world AgileX robots, Evo-World outperforms the evaluated baselines across single-arm and bimanual manipulation tasks while using only 0.87B parameters and delivering lower GPU memory usage and higher inference efficiency. These results demonstrate that future motion prediction through optical-flow supervision provides an effective and lightweight approach to enhancing the predictive capabilities of VLA models.
2610.12936.abstract_zh: 视觉—语言—动作（VLA）模型统一视觉理解、语言落地与机器人控制，但预测当前观察之后场景如何演化可为控制提供额外信息。单靠动作监督并不明确鼓励这种预判，而未来图像预测又把任务相关运动与大量静态外观混在一起。我们提出轻量 VLA 模型 Evo-World，通过光流监督加入未来运动预测，为策略提供集中于运动而非外观的任务相关预测信号。训练流程还在策略学习期间保留预测表征，调节表征多样性，并把表征学习与动作优化解耦。在仿真基准上，Evo-World 的 Meta-World MT50 分层平均成功率达 91.1%，比不带预测的基线相对提高 13.0%。在真实 AgileX 机器人上，它在单臂及双臂操作任务中优于所评基线，参数量仅 0.87B，GPU 显存占用更低、推理更高效。结果表明，光流监督的未来运动预测是一种提升 VLA 预测能力的有效轻量方法。

2610.13007.abstract_en: Learning-based methods have demonstrated strong performance in mapless robot navigation. However, a learned policy remains restricted to the embodiment on which it was trained. Many cross-embodiment navigation methods require time-consuming online training and can still underperform target-specific policies. In fact, demonstrations collected on a source embodiment already contain navigation experience that is potentially reusable for deriving a policy for each target embodiment, but the embodiment mismatch prevents these demonstrations from directly serving as valid supervision for the target. In this article, we present CeDR-Nav, a cross-embodiment demonstration recasting framework that trains a dedicated navigation policy for each target embodiment from existing source demonstrations without online data collection. Geometry-consistent scaling with per-demonstration validity assessment converts the source demonstrations into target training data, and a target-specific Gaussian mixture policy generates feasible avoidance maneuvers for each target embodiment. Extensive quantitative simulations and real-world deployments across multiple robot platforms demonstrate the effectiveness of CeDR-Nav, with an average success-rate gain of 13.8 percentage points over DRL-DCLP in cross-embodiment simulations and target-specific policy training completed within seconds.
2610.13007.abstract_zh: 基于学习的无地图机器人导航表现良好，但策略通常受限于训练时的机器人形态。许多跨具身导航方法需要耗时的在线训练，仍可能不及目标平台专用策略。源机器人示范已有可重用的导航经验，但具身差异使它们不能直接成为目标监督。我们提出 CeDR-Nav：一种跨具身示范重构框架，无需在线数据采集，就可用已有源示范为每个目标形态训练专用导航策略。带逐示范有效性评估的几何一致缩放把源示范转为目标训练数据；目标专用 Gaussian mixture 策略为每个形态生成可行避障机动。多平台的定量仿真与真实部署验证有效性：跨具身仿真中相对 DRL-DCLP 平均成功率提高 13.8 个百分点，目标专用策略训练在数秒内完成。

2610.13119.abstract_en: Collecting dexterous manipulation demonstrations for each robot hand requires repeated task-specific data acquisition. We ask whether one shared corpus of natural human demonstrations can instead serve as a reusable data interface for different dexterous hands, without collecting task demonstrations on each target robot. We present Human2Dex, a wrist-centric human demonstration interface that separates shared human observation and motion semantics from embodiment-specific execution. It aligns observations through local hand-appearance adaptation and a shared 21-point hand representation with consistent structural semantics across human and robot observations. It constructs executable supervision by retargeting fused human hand motion to each target hand, and introduces the Grasp-Pocket Interaction Representation (GPIR) to express tracked objects relative to a hand-centered Functional Grasp Pocket. The corpus is converted into separate training sets for Linker O6 and Wuji, while action labels, normalization, training, and diffusion-policy checkpoints remain hand-specific. Across six real-world tasks, Human2Dex achieves 109/120 (90.8%) successes on Linker O6 and 97/120 (80.8%) on Wuji. Across both hands, Human-Raw achieves 63/240 (26.3%) successes, whereas the complete Human2Dex configuration achieves 206/240 (85.8%). These results support the use of wrist-centric human demonstrations as a reusable interface across calibrated dexterous hands while retaining embodiment-specific policy learning. The project website is publicly available at https://human2dex.pages.dev/.
2610.13119.abstract_zh: 为每种灵巧机器人手采集操作示范，需要反复进行针对任务的数据获取。我们研究同一套自然人手示范能否成为不同灵巧手可重用的数据接口，而无需在每个目标机器人上采集任务示范。Human2Dex 是以手腕为中心的人类示范接口，把共享的人类观察与运动语义同特定具身执行分开。它通过局部手部外观适配，以及在人手和机器人手观察中保持结构语义一致的 21 点表示来对齐观察；通过把融合的人手运动重定向到各目标手来构造可执行监督，并提出 Grasp-Pocket Interaction Representation（GPIR），在以手为中心的 Functional Grasp Pocket 中表示跟踪物体。人类示范库被转换为 Linker O6 与 Wuji 各自的训练集，而动作标签、归一化、训练和扩散策略检查点仍按手型分别处理。六项真实任务中，Linker O6 成功 109/120（90.8%），Wuji 成功 97/120（80.8%）；两种手合计，Human-Raw 成功 63/240（26.3%），完整 Human2Dex 成功 206/240（85.8%）。结果支持以手腕为中心的人类示范作为经标定灵巧手之间的可重用接口，同时保留具身专用策略学习。项目网站见原文：https://human2dex.pages.dev/。

2610.13212.abstract_en: Actions specify what a robot should execute, but do not describe what those commands will achieve. Vision-language-action (VLA) policies nevertheless learn primarily by predicting action chunks from images, language, and state. We introduce Action--Future Coupled Effect Learning (AFCE), which makes a future-grounded physical Effect the policy's primary prediction target. An offline tokenizer constructs temporally ordered Effect tokens from demonstrated actions, realized robot responses, and sparse visual transitions. Reconstruction objectives encourage the representation to retain executable detail and observed physical change. A flow-matching VLA predicts Effects from current images, instruction, and robot state, while a state-conditioned decoder converts them into action chunks. Embodiment-specific interfaces allow single- and dual-arm tasks to share the Effect model. On DexJoCo, AFCE achieves $50.97\%$ overall success, improving over $\pi_{0.5}$ and UVT by 11.82 and 15.21 percentage points, respectively. It leads on all five bimanual tasks, highlighting the value of Effect supervision for coordinated dexterous manipulation. The project page is available at https://afceproject.github.io/AFCE-Web/.
2610.13212.abstract_zh: 动作说明机器人要执行什么，却不说明命令会造成什么结果；视觉—语言—动作（VLA）策略仍主要从图像、语言和状态预测动作块。我们提出 Action–Future Coupled Effect Learning（AFCE），让由未来落地的物理 Effect 成为策略的主要预测目标。离线 tokenizer 根据示范动作、实际机器人响应及稀疏视觉变化构造按时间排列的 Effect token；重建目标鼓励表示保留可执行细节和观察到的物理变化。流匹配 VLA 根据当前图像、指令和机器人状态预测 Effect，再由以状态为条件的解码器转为动作块。具身专用接口允许单臂与双臂任务共享 Effect 模型。在 DexJoCo 上，AFCE 总成功率为 50.97%，分别比 π_0.5 和 UVT 高 11.82 与 15.21 个百分点；它在全部五项双臂任务上领先，凸显 Effect 监督对协调灵巧操作的价值。项目页见原文：https://afceproject.github.io/AFCE-Web/。

2610.13354.abstract_en: The NIST Assembly Task Board #1 remains a challenging benchmark for learning-based methods in robotic manipulation. Over short horizons, it demands precise, contact-rich control of small, tight-fitting parts. Over long horizons, it requires recovery and coordination across extended action sequences. Demonstrations, task decomposition, and dense progress rewards have enabled research advances by providing guidance on how to assemble. But how much of the strategy must be specified? The progression from AlphaGo to AlphaGo Zero showed that RL at scale can discover superhuman strategies without prescribing how to win. AlphaNIST asks whether a sparse binary task reward and task diversity admitted by this task-agnostic reward can similarly let a robot discover how to assemble. In simulation, we train a single policy from scratch across all 20 assembly tasks on the NIST Assembly Task Board #1, reaching 98.2% overall training success without demonstrations, progress shaping, scripted primitives, or per-task tuning. The framework also trains policies to complete ten assembly pairs in a single episode without a prescribed order, with task success rewarded only when all ten pairs are simultaneously complete. The learned policies discover dexterous and planning-like behaviors: choosing grasps for later assembly, using surrounding geometry to reorient parts, and preparing one part, assembling another, then returning to finish the first without an explicit planner. For videos, see our website: https://alpha-nist.github.io/
2610.13354.abstract_zh: NIST Assembly Task Board #1 是机器人操作学习方法的困难基准：短时程要求对小型、紧配合部件做精准且接触丰富的控制，长时程要求在扩展动作序列中恢复和协调。示范、任务分解及稠密进度奖励通过指定如何装配推动了研究，但究竟需要预设多少策略？AlphaGo 到 AlphaGo Zero 的发展表明，大规模强化学习可在不规定取胜方式下发现高水平策略。AlphaNIST 研究稀疏二值任务奖励及其允许的任务多样性，能否类似地让机器人发现装配方式。在仿真中，我们从零开始为 NIST Assembly Task Board #1 的全部 20 项装配任务训练单一策略，总体训练成功率达 98.2%，无需示范、进度塑形、脚本原语或逐任务调参。框架还能训练策略在单个 episode 中完成十对装配，顺序不预设，只有十对同时完成才给予任务成功奖励。所学策略出现灵巧和类似规划的行为：为后续装配选择抓取、借助周围几何调整部件方向，以及先准备一件、装配另一件再返回完成前者，而无显式规划器。视频见网站：https://alpha-nist.github.io/。

2610.13516.abstract_en: Runtime failure monitors for robot policies are typically evaluated by how accurately they distinguish failed from successful executions. Yet an accurate alarm may arrive too late for recovery, while an unnecessary intervention may disrupt an execution that would otherwise succeed. We introduce RESCUE, a counterfactual framework for evaluating whether a monitor's alarms enable useful interventions. By restoring simulator and policy states at execution checkpoints, RESCUE compares alternative actions, identifies the latest checkpoint satisfying a specified recovery criterion, and evaluates whether acting on alarms reduces expected task-completion cost. We evaluate RESCUE with OpenVLA-OFT and $\pi_{0.5}$ over LIBERO-Spatial and LIBERO-Plus using 128,340 counterfactual branches. Recoverability depends on the state--intervention pair rather than on robot state alone: at $\tau=0.5$, 14 of 66 OpenVLA-OFT/LIBERO-Plus failures contain a recoverable checkpoint under continuation, compared with 34 of 66 under continuation or scripted recovery, while recovery reduces recoverability in other conditions. On the primary strong-policy conditions, favourable detection scores do not establish lower intervention cost. Under the evaluated stop-and-reset model, even an idealised detector can afford only a 2.0--3.3% false-alarm rate before unnecessary resets outweigh the savings from stopping failures early. These results show that monitor value depends jointly on the intervention available and the workload in which it is deployed.
2610.13516.abstract_zh: 机器人策略的运行时失败监测通常按区分成功与失败执行的准确性评估，但准确警报可能来得太晚而无法恢复，无谓干预也可能破坏本会成功的执行。我们提出反事实框架 RESCUE，评估监测警报是否支持有用的干预：在执行检查点恢复仿真器与策略状态，比较替代动作，找到满足指定恢复标准的最晚检查点，并衡量响应警报能否降低期望任务完成成本。我们用 OpenVLA-OFT 和 π₀.₅ 在 LIBERO-Spatial 与 LIBERO-Plus 上评估，产生 128,340 个反事实分支。可恢复性取决于状态—干预组合，而非单独机器人状态：在 τ=0.5 时，OpenVLA-OFT/LIBERO-Plus 的 66 次失败中，继续执行下有 14 次含可恢复检查点；若允许继续或脚本恢复则有 34 次；其他条件下恢复反而降低可恢复性。在主要强策略条件下，良好检测分数并不能证明干预成本更低。在所评停止并重置模型中，即使理想检测器，误报率也只能为 2.0–3.3%，再高时不必要重置的损失就超过早停失败的收益。结果表明监测器价值同时依赖可用干预与部署工作负载。

2610.13522.abstract_en: Action-conditioned world models offer a promising foundation for generalist robotic intelligence by predicting the consequences of actions. However, existing robotic datasets provide limited coverage of the diverse interaction dynamics required for generalizable world modeling. Large-scale egocentric human videos offer complementary interaction experience, yet the embodiment gap between human hands and robotic manipulators hinders effective cross-embodiment learning. Meanwhile, the predominance of successful demonstrations leaves failure dynamics substantially underrepresented, limiting the ability of world models to anticipate unsuccessful executions. To address these limitations, we introduce HF-WM, an action-conditioned world model that combines Human interaction learning with Failure-aware post-training. To bridge the embodiment gap, we develop a dual-branch framework that couples video generation with auxiliary pointflow prediction, using stabilized pointflow as a unified motion representation across human and robot interactions while suppressing egocentric camera motion. To improve failure modeling, we further perform Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) post-training on perturbed actions derived from successful demonstrations, guided by action alignment and physical plausibility rewards, enabling the model to learn plausible failure dynamics without paired ground-truth videos. Extensive experiments demonstrate that HF-WM achieves state-of-the-art performance in action-conditioned video generation and exhibits strong utility for policy evaluation in downstream robotic tasks.
2610.13522.abstract_zh: 动作条件世界模型通过预测动作后果，为通用机器人智能提供可能基础；但现有机器人数据覆盖的交互动力学有限。大规模第一人称人类视频可补充交互经验，然而人手与机器人机械臂的具身差异阻碍跨具身学习。成功示范占主导又使失败动力学严重不足，限制世界模型预判失败执行。我们提出 HF-WM：结合人类交互学习与失败感知后训练的动作条件世界模型。为弥合具身差异，双分支框架把视频生成和辅助点流预测耦合，以稳定化点流作为人机交互共享的运动表示，同时抑制第一人称相机运动。为改善失败建模，再对成功示范扰动得到的动作做 Group Relative Policy Optimization（GRPO）后训练，以动作对齐和物理合理性奖励引导，使模型无需配对的失败真值视频也能学习合理的失败动力学。大量实验显示，HF-WM 在动作条件视频生成上达到先进表现，并对下游机器人任务的策略评估有较强实用性。

2610.13643.abstract_en: Automating biological laboratories requires robots to perform dexterous tool interactions under realistic visual conditions while handling dynamic experimental phenomena, presenting significant challenges for robotic manipulation. To enable systematic evaluation under these conditions, we introduce AutoBio+, a simulation benchmark and framework for dexterous manipulation in realistic biological laboratory environments. AutoBio+ comprises 14 tasks across 4 robot embodiments, spanning functional tool use, precision manipulation, language-conditioned visual grounding, and instrument operation. We introduce controllable dynamic experimental phenomena, including flames, vapor, and bubbles, to capture the evolving visual conditions of laboratory procedures. To further enhance environmental realism, we develop a hybrid rendering pipeline that integrates interactive simulated foreground objects with Gaussian-splatting backgrounds reconstructed from 6 real laboratory scenes. For efficient large-scale data generation and evaluation, we further build a parallel simulation framework on top of mjlab, proposing Parallel Finite-State Machine (PFSM) and integrating batched rendering with decoupled trajectory replay for demonstration generation and model-independent closed-loop policy evaluation. Our evaluation reveals substantial variation in policy performance across tasks, exposing distinct strengths and weaknesses of current manipulation policies. Real-world experiments further demonstrate a reduced sim-to-real gap, supporting the validity of AutoBio+ for realistic manipulation evaluation. Supplementary materials are available at https://autobio-plus.github.io/AutoBioPlus.
2610.13643.abstract_zh: 生物实验室自动化要求机器人在真实视觉条件下进行灵巧工具交互，并处理动态实验现象，因而操作困难。我们提出 AutoBio+，一个面向真实感生物实验室灵巧操作的仿真基准与框架，含四种机器人形态上的 14 项任务，涵盖功能性工具使用、精密操作、语言条件视觉落地和仪器操作。为表现实验流程不断变化的视觉条件，引入可控的火焰、蒸汽和气泡等动态现象。为进一步提高环境真实感，混合渲染流程把可交互的仿真前景物体与从6 个真实实验室场景重建的 Gaussian splatting 背景结合。为高效大规模生成数据和评估，还基于 mjlab 构建并行仿真框架，提出 Parallel Finite-State Machine（PFSM），结合批量渲染与解耦轨迹重放，实现示范生成及独立于模型的闭环策略评估。评测发现现有操作策略在各任务上表现差异很大，暴露不同强弱项；真实实验进一步显示 sim-to-real 差距缩小，支持 AutoBio+ 用于真实感操作评测。补充材料见原文：https://autobio-plus.github.io/AutoBioPlus。

2610.13740.abstract_en: World-action models (WAMs) predict a robot's actions together with the observations those actions will produce. However, the strongest models rely on video diffusion transformers that are far too computationally expensive for resource-constrained edge devices. We present SmolWAM, a latent WAM that we derive from the 2B-parameter Cosmos Policy by keeping its pretrained trunk and rebuilding its inference interface: single-frame visual latents, cached text features that preserve the trunk's attention sinks, 12 of 28 transformer blocks, and 1,008 tokens from which actions and future visual latents are read out in one rectified-flow step. Trained in 3.6 GPU-hours, SmolWAM succeeds in 95.5% of 400 LIBERO episodes at 57 ms and 2.3 TFLOP per 16-action chunk with 2.4 GiB of GPU memory, 11x faster than its teacher with 18.5x fewer FLOPs and 3.2x less memory, and its world head still forecasts scene motion.
2610.13740.abstract_zh: 世界动作模型（WAM）联合预测机器人动作及这些动作将造成的观察，但最强模型依赖视频扩散 Transformer，对资源有限的边缘设备过于昂贵。我们提出 SmolWAM：保留 2B 参数 Cosmos Policy 的预训练主干，重建推理接口，使用单帧视觉潜变量、保留主干 attention sink 的缓存文本特征、28 个 Transformer 块中的 12 个，以及 1,008 个 token，并在一步 rectified flow 中读出动作和未来视觉潜变量。训练仅耗 3.6 GPU 小时；在 400 个 LIBERO episode 上，SmolWAM 成功率为 95.5%，每 16 动作块耗时 57 ms、2.3 TFLOP 和 2.4 GiB GPU 显存。相对教师模型，它快 11 倍、FLOPs 少 18.5 倍、显存少 3.2 倍，世界预测头仍能预测场景运动。

2610.13929.abstract_en: Robot policies often convert sensing and control into fixed-rate observation-action sequences, leaving physical time implicit in sequence position. This assumption breaks when observation rates or delays vary, or when inference latency changes. We introduce Chronos Policy, which makes physical time explicit by conditioning on observation capture times and desired action execution times. We study two ways to incorporate time into a diffusion transformer: adding timestamp embeddings to token features, or encoding physical time in positional encoding through time-aware rotary positional encodings (time-aware RoPE). We find that time-aware RoPE is more robust, allowing attention to depend directly on physical time while keeping token content unchanged. During training, we temporally randomize which observations are sampled and when the action chunk begins, exposing the policy to a wider range of sensing and execution schedules that may occur during deployments. This also enables learning from asynchronous, multi-rate data without forcing all measurements onto a fixed temporal grid. Across simulation and real-world experiments, Chronos Policy improves performance on dynamic tasks, where observation-to-action timing is critical, and on multisensory tasks, where the relative timing between observations matters. On standard quasi-static tasks, it preserves nominal performance while improving robustness to changes in sensing and inference timing.
2610.13929.abstract_zh: 机器人策略常把感测与控制转成固定频率的观察—动作序列，使物理时间隐含在序列位置中；当观察频率、延迟或推理时延变化时，这一假设失效。我们提出 Chronos Policy，以观察采集时间和期望动作执行时间为条件，把物理时间显式纳入策略。研究在扩散 Transformer 中加入时间的两种方式：给 token 特征加时间戳嵌入，或通过时间感知旋转位置编码（time-aware RoPE）在位置编码中表示物理时间。结果发现 time-aware RoPE 更鲁棒，使注意力直接依赖物理时间而保持 token 内容不变。训练时随机化采样哪些观察以及动作块何时开始，使策略见到部署中可能出现的不同感测与执行日程，也能从异步、多速率数据学习，而不必强行对齐到固定时间网格。仿真和真实实验中，Chronos Policy 改善了时间关系关键的动态任务及观察间相对时序重要的多传感任务；在标准准静态任务中维持标称表现，同时增强对感测与推理时序变化的鲁棒性。

2610.12568.abstract_en: Feed-forward 3D priors enable high-quality reconstruction from image streams but often lack reliable metric scale and suffer from long-term trajectory drift. In contrast, LiDAR--inertial estimation provides metrically accurate motion but lacks the image-space consistency needed for high-fidelity reconstruction. We propose $MIRAGE$, which anchors feed-forward visual geometry to LiDAR--IMU metric motion and regulates online pose corrections according to correspondence support and cross-modal agreement, jointly enabling accurate metric pose estimation and high-fidelity Gaussian reconstruction. Experiments on Oxford Spires, M2DGR and INS show that MIRAGE achieves accurate metric trajectory estimation, outperforming COLMAP, a widely used but computationally expensive reference for vision-only benchmarks. Motivated by the scarcity of long-horizon monocular benchmarks for large-scale indoor reconstruction, we further build a multimodal data-collection platform and use MIRAGE to establish accurate 6-DoF reference trajectories for a new vision-only benchmark. We benchmark recent monocular large-scale reconstruction methods on this dataset, providing a systematic evaluation of their performance in long-horizon indoor scenes.
2610.12568.abstract_zh: 前馈式 3D 先验能从图像流实现高质量重建，但往往缺乏可靠的度量尺度，且长期轨迹会漂移。相对地，LiDAR—惯性估计提供度量准确的运动，却缺少高保真重建所需的图像空间一致性。我们提出 MIRAGE：用 LiDAR—IMU 的度量运动锚定前馈视觉几何，并根据对应点支持度和跨模态一致性调节在线位姿修正，从而同时实现准确的度量位姿估计与高保真 Gaussian 重建。在 Oxford Spires、M2DGR 和 INS 上，MIRAGE 获得准确的度量轨迹估计，优于计算开销较高、常用于纯视觉基准的 COLMAP。鉴于大规模室内重建缺少长时程单目基准，我们还构建多模态数据采集平台，用 MIRAGE 为新的纯视觉基准建立准确的 6-DoF 参考轨迹，并在该数据集上系统评测近期单目大规模重建方法的长时程室内表现。

2610.12727.abstract_en: Feed-forward 3D foundation models reconstruct scenes from unposed images, but the quadratic cost of global attention limits their scalability to large view sets. We present Zebra3D, a layerwise sparse-linear hybrid attention framework that improves the efficiency of pretrained 3D foundation models without training from scratch. Across VGGT, HunyuanWorld-Mirror, and $\pi^3$, we observe a broadly consistent depth-wise pattern: early stages are relatively tolerant to linear replacement, while sensitive middle-to-late stages tend to exhibit more concentrated attention. Zebra3D exploits this structure by assigning linear-centered attention to tolerant stages and tile-sparse attention to sensitive stages, using landmark summaries to preserve unselected context. Closed-form affine fitting enables training-free conversion, while optional post-conversion training combines task supervision with output and relational feature distillation. Across all three backbones, Zebra3D achieves strong reconstruction and camera-pose accuracy at high attention sparsity, with training-free variants remaining close to their dense counterparts. End-to-end speedups increase with input view count, reaching up to $7.1\times$ at 1,024 views. After post-conversion training, Zebra3D-VGGT reaches 80.5\% RealEstate10K AUC@30 at 94\% mean attention sparsity, within 1.1 percentage points of dense VGGT fine-tuned on the same data and schedule.
2610.12727.abstract_zh: 前馈式 3D 基础模型能从无位姿图像重建场景，但全局注意力的二次复杂度限制其扩展到大量视图。我们提出 Zebra3D，一种逐层稀疏—线性混合注意力框架，无需从零训练就能提高预训练 3D 基础模型效率。在 VGGT、HunyuanWorld-Mirror 和 π³ 上，观察到基本一致的深度方向模式：早期层较能容忍线性替换，敏感的中后期层注意力更集中。Zebra3D 在容忍层分配以线性为主的注意力，在敏感层使用分块稀疏注意力，并用地标摘要保留未选中的上下文。闭式仿射拟合支持无需训练的转换；可选的转换后训练结合任务监督、输出蒸馏和关系特征蒸馏。三个骨干在高注意力稀疏度下均保持较强重建和相机位姿精度，无训练版本接近稠密模型。端到端加速随输入视图数增加，在 1,024 视图时最高达 7.1 倍。转换后训练的 Zebra3D-VGGT 在平均注意力稀疏度 94% 下取得 RealEstate10K AUC@30 80.5%，仅比相同数据和训练日程微调的稠密 VGGT 低 1.1 个百分点。

2610.13309.abstract_en: 6D pose estimation of novel objects without CAD models remains an open challenge: model-free methods must build the object representation from scratch during onboarding and have long trailed their model-based counterparts. We present NovaSplat, a model-free pipeline that closes this gap. From a short smartphone video captured at onboarding, we train a 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) model that serves both as a template source for detection and coarse pose estimation and as a differentiable backbone for pose refinement. Our refiner optimizes the object-to-camera pose with combined photometric and geometric losses under a continuous rotation parametrization free of gradient singularities. On a household-object benchmark, NovaSplat surpasses all model-based methods. On a challenging industrial benchmark with textureless and specular surfaces, it outperforms all model-free competitors while substantially narrowing the gap to model-based ones. We further introduce NovaSplat-Lite, an inference variant that is $3.1\times$ faster at negligible accuracy cost. Code will be made available at \href{https://github.com/POSE-Lab/novasplat}{https://github.com/POSE-Lab/novasplat}.
2610.13309.abstract_zh: 没有 CAD 模型的新物体 6D 位姿估计仍是难题：无模型方法必须在注册阶段从零构建物体表示，性能长期落后于有模型方法。我们提出 NovaSplat 无模型流程以缩小差距：从注册时拍摄的短手机视频训练 3D Gaussian Splatting（3DGS）模型，既用于生成检测与粗位姿估计模板，也作为位姿细化的可微骨干。细化器在无梯度奇异点的连续旋转参数化下，结合光度和几何损失优化物体到相机的位姿。在家居物体基准上，NovaSplat 超过所有有模型方法；在无纹理、镜面表面的困难工业基准上，它超过所有无模型对手，并明显缩小与有模型方法的差距。另提出推理版本 NovaSplat-Lite，以几乎不损失精度的代价加快 3.1 倍。代码将按原文链接发布：https://github.com/POSE-Lab/novasplat。

2610.13216.abstract_en: The rapid progress of 3D generative models has made 3D asset creation increasingly accessible. However, achieving intuitive, precise, and interactive user control, such as point-based drag editing, remains challenging. Existing 3D drag methods either rely on slow 2D diffusion priors, such as Score Distillation Sampling, or directly warp geometry, often causing multi-view inconsistency and topological artifacts. In this paper, we present 3DRAG, a training-free framework that executes precise drag editing natively within the explicit 3D latent space of large-scale generative models, without SDS-based optimization or iterative point tracking. To ensure geometrically plausible deformations, 3DRAG explicitly extends the drag displacement field into 3D space, incorporating an Occupancy-Aware Winner-Takes-All (OA-WTA) strategy to robustly handle sparse geometries. Furthermore, we introduce a generative editing pipeline that explicitly transforms latent representations via the 3D displacement field. By fully leveraging the model's generative capabilities, it achieves smooth geometric deformations while maintaining the object's identity. To further transfer original geometry and texture with high fidelity, we propose Logits-Level Token Fusion, which accurately injects source information into the destination region. To evaluate 3D point-based editing, we construct a novel dataset featuring diverse 3D assets and complex multi-point drag instructions. Quantitative and qualitative experiments demonstrate that 3DRAG achieves state-of-the-art performance, surpassing existing baselines in drag accuracy, geometric fidelity, and unedited region preservation.
2610.13216.abstract_zh: 3D 生成模型的进展降低了创建三维资产的门槛，但通过点拖拽实现直观、精确、交互式控制仍有挑战。现有 3D 拖拽方法或依赖缓慢的 2D 扩散先验（如 Score Distillation Sampling），或直接扭曲几何，常产生多视图不一致与拓扑伪影。我们提出无需训练的 3DRAG，在大规模生成模型显式 3D 潜空间中直接执行精确拖拽编辑，不依赖 SDS 优化或迭代点跟踪。为使形变在几何上合理，3DRAG 把拖拽位移场显式延展到三维空间，并以 Occupancy-Aware Winner-Takes-All（OA-WTA）策略稳健处理稀疏几何。生成式编辑流程再通过 3D 位移场显式变换潜表示，借助模型的生成能力得到平滑形变并保持物体身份。Logits-Level Token Fusion 把原始几何和纹理高保真地注入目标区域。我们还构建含多样 3D 资产和复杂多点拖拽指令的新数据集；定量与定性实验显示，3DRAG 在拖拽精度、几何保真和未编辑区域保持上超过已有基线。

2610.12624.abstract_en: Prior outdoor LiDAR registration works are commonly limited by the pair-wise input paradigm, which neglects temporal correlations inherent within streaming sequences. In this paper, we propose a novel multi-frame outdoor point cloud registration network for streaming LiDAR scans enhanced with pose-related memory buffers. The key observation is that long-term temporal LiDAR sequences can provide rich global contextual information to complete sparse measurements, filter outliers, and address low-overlap problems, thereby boosting registration performance. Specifically, two hybrid memory buffers are designed, including an implicit memory feature buffer and an explicit memory pose buffer, to store and dynamically update pose-related temporal features. Moreover, a novel dynamic history weighting module is developed to adaptively fuse current and history pose-related features. Extensive experiments on three outdoor datasets, including KITTI, nuScenes, and Apollo-Southbay, demonstrate state-of-the-art performance of MemReg, surpassing all previous pair-wise methods and also multi-frame SLAM systems. Our method also generalizes surprisingly well to multiview indoor registration scenarios with rather competitive performance on 3DMatch, 3DLoMatch, and ScanNet. Code will be released at https://github.com/IRMVLab/MemReg.
2610.12624.abstract_zh: 以往室外 LiDAR 配准通常仅输入一对扫描，忽略流式序列固有的时间相关性。我们提出以位姿相关记忆缓冲增强的多帧室外点云配准网络。长期 LiDAR 序列提供全局上下文，可补全稀疏测量、过滤离群点并缓解低重叠问题，从而提高配准表现。具体设计两个混合记忆缓冲：隐式记忆特征缓冲和显式记忆位姿缓冲，用于储存并动态更新位姿相关的时间特征；再用动态历史加权模块自适应融合当前与历史位姿特征。KITTI、nuScenes 和 Apollo-Southbay 三个室外数据集上的大量实验显示，MemReg 超过此前所有成对方法和多帧 SLAM 系统。它还较好地泛化到多视角室内配准，在 3DMatch、3DLoMatch 和 ScanNet 上具有竞争力。代码将按原文链接发布：https://github.com/IRMVLab/MemReg。

2610.13177.abstract_en: Reconstructing 3D scenes from sparse views without per-scene optimization remains highly challenging, especially for recovering accurate geometry and fine textures. While recent feedforward approaches leverage generalizable 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) for scene generation, they typically assign one or multiple Gaussians to each pixel. Such uniform allocation not only produces highly redundant representations by wasting primitives in homogeneous areas, but also fails to exploit the inherent geometric priors of planar surfaces, often resulting in sub-optimal structural modeling. To address these limitations, we present CompactSplat, a novel feedforward framework that enables a content-aware allocation of 3D Gaussians. By integrating texture-guided spatial partitioning with hierarchical sampling, CompactSplat adaptively distributes primitives - concentrating dense Gaussians in complex regions while tiling flat areas with expanded, scale-modulated primitives. Moreover, our framework inherently supports dynamic sparsity control at inference time, enabling seamless trade-offs between rendering fidelity and memory footprint without requiring network retraining. Extensive experiments on RealEstate10K, DL3DV, and ScanNet demonstrate that CompactSplat consistently outperforms prior methods on both standard metrics and high-resolution rendering consistency, achieving high-fidelity reconstructions with significantly fewer primitives.
2610.13177.abstract_zh: 从稀疏视图进行无需逐场景优化的 3D 场景重建仍具挑战，尤其是恢复准确几何和精细纹理。近期前馈方法利用可泛化 3D Gaussian Splatting（3DGS）生成场景，但通常给每个像素分配一个或多个 Gaussian；均匀分配既在同质区域浪费基元，也未充分利用平面表面的几何先验，结构建模因此可能欠佳。我们提出前馈框架 CompactSplat，根据内容自适应分配 3D Gaussian。纹理引导空间划分与层级采样相结合，在复杂区域集中密集 Gaussian，在平坦区域则用扩展、尺度调节的基元平铺。框架还天然支持推理时动态控制稀疏度，无需重训网络即可在渲染质量与显存占用间切换。RealEstate10K、DL3DV 和 ScanNet 上的实验显示，CompactSplat 在标准指标和高分辨率渲染一致性上持续优于先前方法，并以显著更少的基元获得高保真重建。

2610.17591.abstract_en: Estimating simulation-ready material parameters from visual observations is crucial for deformable-object manipulation but challenging because material properties are only indirectly revealed through physical responses. We introduce physical-field-bridged material inference, a single-pass framework that uses dense physical responses to connect multi-view RGB deformation videos with constitutive-type classification and continuous parameter regression. Unlike inverse-physics methods requiring per-scene reconstruction, online tuning, or simulation-in-the-loop optimization, our model predicts force/contact masks, projected motion-flow fields, and projected stress-response maps, then conditions material inference on these fields to reduce reliance on appearance or category shortcuts. We construct DeformFieldBench, a 3DGS MPM learning environment comprising 5,000 simulations across 100 object shapes and five mechanically informative loading modes, with dense pixel-aligned physical supervision. Our method achieves the best median errors on all four continuous parameters, improves stress-hotspot recall from 0.0762 to 0.5121, and attains 0.8676 SSIM/36.82 dB PSNR in same-simulator replay on unseen objects. Under a protocol-matched GSO evaluation, inference and future-state prediction take approximately 30 seconds, compared with 15-120 minutes for per-scene optimization. The method also yields measurable replay agreement on five real-world sequences. These results support dense physical fields as an effective bridge for fast material inference, while cross-simulator and real-world tests reveal remaining domain and identifiability gaps.
2610.17591.abstract_zh: 从视觉观测估计可直接用于仿真的材料参数，对可变形物体操作至关重要，但材料性质只能由物理响应间接显现，因此仍很困难。我们提出“物理场桥接”的单次前向材料推断框架，以稠密物理响应连接多视角 RGB 形变视频、材料本构类型分类和连续参数回归。与需要逐场景重建、在线调整或在优化循环中调用仿真的逆物理方法不同，本模型先预测力/接触掩码、投影运动流场与投影应力响应图，再以这些场作为材料推断条件，以减少对外观或物体类别捷径的依赖。我们构建 DeformFieldBench：一个 3DGS–MPM 学习环境，含 100 种物体形状、五种能揭示力学性质的加载方式下的 5,000 次仿真，并提供像素对齐的稠密物理监督。方法在四个连续参数上均取得最低的中位误差，把应力热点召回率从 0.0762 提升到 0.5121，并在未见物体的同一仿真器重放中达到 0.8676 SSIM / 36.82 dB PSNR。在协议匹配的 GSO 评测中，推断和未来状态预测约需 30 秒，而逐场景优化需 15–120 分钟；在五段真实视频上也取得可测量的重放一致性。结果支持稠密物理场可作为快速材料推断的有效桥梁，同时跨仿真器与真实世界测试也暴露出尚存的领域差异和参数可辨识性问题。

2610.17260.abstract_en: To reconstruct a predictive 4D representation of the physical world from monocular video captured by a moving camera, we jointly reconstruct dynamic Gaussian radiance fields and infer their underlying physical dynamics. This paper proposes \emph{Physical SLAM}, a physics-aware method for constructing 4D Gaussian fields of deformable objects and predicting their future state when subjected to external actions, given a sequence of RGB-D images. Our method separates the scene into a static background Gaussian field for camera localization and a dynamic object Gaussian field driven by a spring--mass physical model of elastic deformation, inertia, and damping. To integrate visual observations with physical dynamics, we introduce virtual observation forces that gradually pull simulated surface nodes toward observed depth points, avoiding abrupt replacement of simulated node positions. Meanwhile, the physical parameters of the spring--mass model are updated from simulation errors aggregated over the full reconstruction observation window, enabling the reconstructed dynamics to align with observations. To couple appearance, geometry, and physics, we further design a physics-aware Gaussian transformation and surface alignment strategy, where dynamic Gaussians are transformed along the deforming physical surface of the spring--mass model and constrained to remain aligned with the surface during rendering-based optimization. The resulting representation supports observed-frame rendering and action-conditioned simulation, extending SLAM maps to describe how deformable objects respond to manipulation. On the PhysTwin benchmark, our method improves reconstruction and prediction PSNR over PhysTwin by 10.4\% and 11.0\%, respectively. On the TUM RGB-D benchmark, it reduces average camera tracking error by 20.6\%, improves SSIM by 3.6\%, and reduces LPIPS by 8.3\% compared with 4DGS-SLAM.
2610.17260.abstract_zh: 为从移动相机拍摄的单目视频重建具有预测能力的物理世界 4D 表示，我们联合重建动态高斯辐射场并推断其底层物理动力学。本文提出 Physical SLAM：给定一段 RGB-D 图像，构建可变形物体的 4D 高斯场，并预测其受到外部动作后的未来状态。方法将场景分成用于相机定位的静态背景高斯场，以及由弹性形变、惯性和阻尼的弹簧—质量模型驱动的动态物体高斯场。为融合视觉观测与动力学，我们引入虚拟观测力，将仿真表面节点逐步拉向观测深度点，避免直接突变式替换节点位置；同时根据整个重建观测窗口汇总的仿真误差更新弹簧—质量模型参数，使动力学与观测一致。为耦合外观、几何与物理，方法沿形变物理表面变换动态高斯，并在基于渲染的优化中约束其与表面对齐。所得表示既支持已观测帧渲染，也支持动作条件仿真，使 SLAM 地图描述可变形物体受操作后的响应。在 PhysTwin 基准上，相较 PhysTwin 的重建与预测 PSNR 分别提高 10.4% 和 11.0%；在 TUM RGB-D 基准上，相较 4DGS-SLAM，平均相机跟踪误差降低 20.6%，SSIM 提高 3.6%，LPIPS 降低 8.3%。

2610.14142.abstract_en: Deformable-object manipulation requires accurate modeling of highly localized contact while maintaining simulation speeds suitable for interactive use. Uniformly fine tetrahedral meshes can resolve these interactions, but they introduce unnecessary degrees of freedom throughout the object. Coarse meshes are more efficient, yet they may under-resolve contact-induced deformation. We present a contact-adaptive mesh refinement framework that introduces spatial resolution only where it is most useful. The method uses geometric, elastic, and contact quantities already available from the deformable-body solver to score candidate edges. A fully GPU-parallel procedure then selects a conflict-free subset and updates both mesh topology and physical state directly within the simulation loop. We evaluate the approach on real deformable-object manipulation sequences. Adaptive refinement reduces simulation-to-real error, improves agreement with a fine-mesh reference, and remains substantially more efficient than uniformly fine simulation. These results show that local refinement can improve physical fidelity without incurring the cost of a globally fine discretization. The framework provides a practical basis for contact-rich simulation in interactive manipulation, sim-to-real modeling, and online physical digital twins.
2610.14142.abstract_zh: 可变形物体操作既需要准确刻画高度局部化的接触，也需要适合交互使用的仿真速度。均匀细化的四面体网格能够分辨这些相互作用，却在整个物体中引入不必要的自由度；粗网格效率更高，但可能无法分辨接触引起的形变。我们提出接触自适应网格细化框架，只在最有用的位置增加空间分辨率。方法利用可变形体求解器已有的几何、弹性和接触量对候选边评分，再以完全 GPU 并行的过程选出互不冲突的边集，并在仿真循环内直接更新网格拓扑和物理状态。我们在真实可变形物体操作序列上评估该方法。自适应细化降低仿真与真实之间的误差，提高与细网格参考结果的一致性，同时比全局均匀细网格仿真高效得多。结果表明，局部细化能在不承担全局细离散代价的情况下提高物理保真度，并为交互操作、sim-to-real 建模及在线物理数字孪生中的富接触仿真提供基础。

2610.16160.abstract_en: Recent advances in 3D reconstruction enable the extraction of temporally consistent 3D motion from RGB observations; however, current Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models still predominantly rely on 2D image-text priors. Therefore, they do not accurately represent the fundamental dynamics of the 3D world associated with physical actions. This over-reliance on static 2D visual cues limits the capacity of VLA models in achieving robust robot manipulation. To address these limitations, we introduce FlowVLA, a reconstruction-guided, pluggable 3D flow learning framework aimed at empowering VLA models with an inherent understanding of action-relevant dynamics. Instead of requiring explicit 3D sensor inputs or altering the inference-time architecture, our method is designed to utilize temporally aligned 3D flow only during training. This allows the model to learn the dynamic evolution of the physical scene while preserving the computational efficiency of conventional 2D VLA backbones. To bridge scene-level dynamics with robotic manipulation, we propose a modular 3D flow learning framework with dual-level flow supervision. Specifically, point-level flow guides the model to forecast the future displacements of task-critical 3D points, while TCP-level flow aggregates these motions to align with the robot's TCP trajectories. This dual-level flow supervision encourages the model to focus on semantically meaningful dynamic regions, effectively coupling scene-level motion with precise control signals. Extensive evaluations across simulation and real-world experiments demonstrate that FlowVLA consistently improves manipulation performance, zero-shot robustness, and optimizes data efficiency. FlowVLA adds only lightweight auxiliary heads during training and discards them at inference. Therefore, FlowVLA introduces no additional 3D sensor inputs, architectural modifications, or inference-time computation.
2610.16160.abstract_zh: 近期 3D 重建进展使人们能够从 RGB 观测中提取时间一致的三维运动，但现有视觉—语言—动作（VLA）模型仍主要依赖 2D 图文先验，因而不能准确表示与物理动作相关的三维世界基本动力学；对静态 2D 视觉线索的过度依赖限制了机器人操作的稳健性。我们提出 FlowVLA：一种由重建引导、可插拔的 3D 流学习框架，旨在让 VLA 学会与动作有关的动力学。它只在训练时使用时间对齐的 3D 流，无需显式 3D 传感器输入，也不改变推理阶段架构，从而保留常规 2D VLA 主干的计算效率。为连接场景动力学和操作，我们设计双层流监督：点级流引导模型预测任务关键 3D 点的未来位移，TCP 级流汇聚这些运动，使其与机器人工具中心点轨迹对齐。双层监督促使模型关注语义相关的动态区域，将场景运动与精确控制信号耦合。仿真和真实实验表明，FlowVLA 持续改善操作性能、零样本稳健性及数据效率。训练时仅增加轻量辅助头，并在推理时移除，因此不增加 3D 传感器输入、架构改动或推理计算。

2610.17630.abstract_en: In outdoor environments, varying terrain and contact conditions can cause identical action commands to produce different motion outcomes for quadruped robots. Predicting these outcomes is essential for reliable navigation and informed path selection. Existing video world models can generate visually plausible futures, yet often struggle to capture robot dynamics and terrain interactions, leading to overly optimistic predictions of action outcomes. We present DR-WM, a physically consistent world model that incorporates robot-terrain contact dynamics to predict the consequences of quadruped actions. Starting from an initial RGB image, our method reconstructs scene geometry and integrates dense, dimensionless priors over terrain contact properties, calibrated using real-world action-response data. The resulting terrain model supports the simulation of physics with spatially varying contact properties such as friction. Given the initial state of the robot and candidate action sequences, we simulate its future motion and use the resulting camera trajectories and rendered geometry to guide the training of a video world model. The generated future observations are then used to update the terrain reconstruction, enabling iterative model rollouts without additional real-world images. Extensive experiments demonstrate that DR-WM substantially outperforms geometry-only baselines and baselines with uniform physical parameters on key physical metrics characterizing action outcomes, while achieving the best performance among the evaluated baselines. These physically grounded predictions support more informed action selection: across 90 challenging scenarios, an 8B vision-language model augmented with DR-WM outperforms an unassisted 32B vision-language model on five of six evaluation metrics.
2610.17630.abstract_zh: 在室外环境中，地形和接触条件变化会让四足机器人执行相同动作指令时得到不同运动结果。预测这些结果对可靠导航和路径选择至关重要。现有视频世界模型虽能生成视觉可信的未来，却常难刻画机器人动力学与地形交互，因而过度乐观地预测动作结果。我们提出 DR-WM，一种纳入机器人—地形接触动力学的物理一致世界模型。方法从初始 RGB 图像重建场景几何，并融合由真实动作—响应数据校准的稠密、无量纲地形接触属性先验；所得地形模型可仿真摩擦等空间变化的接触属性。给定机器人初始状态和候选动作序列，我们仿真其未来运动，并用生成的相机轨迹与渲染几何指导视频世界模型训练。生成的未来观测又用于更新地形重建，使模型无需额外真实图像即可迭代展开。大量实验显示，DR-WM 在刻画动作结果的关键物理指标上明显优于仅用几何或统一物理参数的基线，并在被评基线中取得最佳表现。这种有物理依据的预测支持更知情的动作选择：在 90 个困难场景中，加入 DR-WM 的 8B 视觉语言模型在六项指标中的五项优于未获得辅助的 32B 模型。

2610.17936.abstract_en: Dynamic 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) provides an efficient framework for dynamic scene reconstruction. Most existing approaches model scene dynamics with deterministic deformation fields, assuming each Gaussian follows a distinct geometric trajectory over time. This assumption breaks down underwater, where light scattering, refraction, marine snow and low visibility create substantial physical ambiguity in captured images. We present PUGS, a physics-guided uncertainty model for underwater dynamic 3DGS. PUGS learns inherent uncertainty induced by underwater image formation and leverages it as a physical signal for dynamic scene modeling. Rather than estimating a single deterministic displacement, it parameterizes each Gaussian's motion as a probability distribution with expected deformation and physical uncertainty. We adopt stochastic deformation optimization to sample Gaussian trajectories via local reparameterization, exploring multiple physically plausible solutions during training. We further propose uncertainty stochastic annealing and a dual-path self-consistency distillation objective, converting stochastic exploration to deterministic reconstruction while preserving temporal coherence. Extensive experiments on underwater dynamic datasets and physics-aware benchmarks demonstrate superior rendering quality, temporal consistency and reconstruction robustness. Our method achieves 1.16 dB PSNR gain over the strongest baseline on UVEB and 3.99 dB on DRUVA.
2610.17936.abstract_zh: 动态 3D Gaussian Splatting（3DGS）提供了高效的动态场景重建框架。多数现有方法用确定性形变场建模场景动力学，假设每个高斯随时间遵循一条明确的几何轨迹；但在水下，光散射、折射、海雪和低能见度会给采集图像带来显著的物理歧义，因而这一假设失效。我们提出 PUGS，用于水下动态 3DGS 的物理引导不确定性模型。PUGS 学习由水下成像过程引发的固有不确定性，并把它作为动态场景建模的物理信号；它不估计单一确定位移，而将每个高斯的运动参数化为包含期望形变和物理不确定性的概率分布。我们通过局部重参数化采样高斯轨迹并进行随机形变优化，在训练中探索多种物理上合理的解；随后用不确定性随机退火及双路径自一致蒸馏目标，将随机探索转成保持时间一致性的确定性重建。水下动态数据集和物理感知基准上的大量实验显示，更好的渲染质量、时间一致性和重建稳健性；相对最强基线，UVEB 的 PSNR 提高 1.16 dB，DRUVA 提高 3.99 dB。

2610.17462.abstract_en: Precise control of movement across various robotic embodiments is a longstanding challenge. Modeling complex robotic structures requires significant time, dedicated sensors, and manual labeling. Recent advancements in 4D representation learning offer an interesting alternative: can we leverage 4D features lifted from 2D observations to densely map a robot's spatial movement based on the action signal? To this end, we propose Act4R, a framework that builds on 3D foundation model to predict a robot's 3D scene flow with any given action. Act4R introduces a Spatial-Action Encoder, which encodes the current 2D robot state and its action signals into embeddings that represent future robot state in 3D. Then, both the current and future spatial embeddings are decoded into point maps to estimate action-conditioned scene flow. To effectively learn the mapping between action and future state, Act4R introduces spatial-action fusion in its transformer-based encoder, and a spatial alignment loss that guides the encoder for future flow prediction. After training on some samples of a given embodiment, Act4R can perform inverse control by optimizing the signal to achieve the desired scene flow. We evaluate Act4R on a public real-world dataset and synthetic data collected in simulator. Experiments on various robotic platforms show that Act4R outperforms the previous SoTA in scene flow prediction. Our method also performs better in inverse control, both on the action accuracy metric and in closed-loop control in simulation.
2610.17462.abstract_zh: 跨不同机器人形态精确控制运动一直是难题；建模复杂结构需要大量时间、专用传感器和人工标注。近期 4D 表示学习带来另一种可能：能否从 2D 观测提升的 4D 特征出发，依据动作信号稠密映射机器人空间运动？我们提出 Act4R，建立在 3D 基础模型之上，对任意给定动作预测机器人 3D 场景流。其 Spatial-Action Encoder 将当前 2D 机器人状态与动作信号编码为代表未来 3D 状态的嵌入；再把当前和未来空间嵌入解码为点图，以估计动作条件场景流。为了学习动作与未来状态的映射，Act4R 在 Transformer 编码器中融合空间与动作信息，并以空间对齐损失引导未来流预测。在某种机器人形态的少量样本上训练后，Act4R 可通过优化动作信号来实现目标场景流的逆向控制。我们在公开真实数据集及仿真合成数据上评估；多个机器人平台的实验显示，Act4R 的场景流预测优于此前最佳方法，逆向控制在动作精度指标及仿真闭环控制中也更好。

2610.14200.abstract_en: We introduce ClothCode, a unified generative framework for garment state estimation and action-conditioned dynamics prediction in a shared discrete configuration space. A material-aligned tokenizer encodes garment configuration as residual vector-quantized patch tokens, while task-specific Masked Generative Transformers predict these tokens through parallel confidence-guided refinement. Across three garment templates, ClothCode reduces mean displacement error by 26.6% for state estimation and 37.0% for dynamics prediction relative to the strongest baselines. Dynamics prediction requires only 16.7 ms per window, compared with 556.2 ms for diffusion. Integrated into the same model-predictive controller, ClothCode improves real-world folding and flattening success from 56.7% to 78.9%. Further results and videos are available at: this https URL
2610.14200.abstract_zh: 我们提出 ClothCode：在共享的离散构型空间中统一进行服装状态估计和动作条件动力学预测的生成框架。与材料对齐的 tokenizer 把服装构型编码为残差向量量化的 patch token，任务专用 Masked Generative Transformer 再通过并行、由置信度引导的细化预测这些 token。在三种服装模板上，相对最强基线，ClothCode 的状态估计平均位移误差降低 26.6%，动力学预测误差降低 37.0%。每个窗口的动力学预测只需 16.7 ms，而扩散方法需 556.2 ms。集成进同一模型预测控制器后，真实世界折叠和铺平成功率从 56.7% 提升至 78.9%。更多结果和视频见论文链接。

2610.17843.abstract_en: Proactive dynamic grasping requires robots to predict the future state at which physical contact will occur, rather than reacting to the currently observed object pose. But what future must the robot predict, and at what level of abstraction? We argue that contact-relevant rigid-body state in SE(3) is a compact task-sufficient abstraction for this problem: it directly determines where and when the robot should establish contact, without requiring visually complete future scenes. This insight leads to a lightweight object-centric forecast-then-select framework that predicts future rigid-body trajectories from short pose histories and uses a reachability-aware interception selector to choose feasible contact states under kinematic and timing constraints. Trained with randomized physics simulation over primitive shapes, the forecaster transfers to real objects once their metric geometry and SE(3) state histories are recovered. Experiments across simulation and real-world dynamic grasping tasks show that our framework improves the average success rate from \(24.5\%\) to \(62.0\%\) in simulation, and from \(15.3\%\) to \(67.3\%\) in real-world catching, conveyor, and turntable interception. The SE(3) forecaster runs in \(15\,\mathrm{ms}\), orders of magnitude faster than dense visual future prediction, enabling real-time contact decision making. Our results suggest that effective proactive grasping does not require imagining the entire future scene. Instead, predicting the compact physical future that determines contact provides an effective and practical abstraction for real-time dynamic grasping.
2610.17843.abstract_zh: 主动抓取运动物体需要机器人预测物理接触发生时的未来状态，而非只对当前观测姿态作反应。但应预测哪一种未来、采用何种抽象层级？我们认为，SE(3) 中与接触有关的刚体状态是紧凑且足以完成任务的抽象：它直接决定何时何处建立接触，无需生成视觉完整的未来场景。由此，我们提出轻量的“先预测后选择”物体中心框架：根据短时姿态历史预测未来刚体轨迹，再以考虑可达性的拦截选择器，在运动学和时间约束下选择可行接触状态。预测器通过基元形状上的随机物理仿真训练；只要恢复真实物体的度量几何和 SE(3) 状态历史，就能迁移到真实物体。仿真和真实动态抓取实验中，平均成功率分别由 24.5% 提升到 62.0%、由 15.3% 提升到 67.3%，后者涵盖接球、传送带和转盘拦截。SE(3) 预测器运行只需 15 ms，比稠密视觉未来预测快数个数量级，支持实时接触决策。结果表明，主动抓取不必想象完整未来场景；预测决定接触的紧凑物理未来是有效且实用的抽象。

2610.16667.abstract_en: Accurate modelling of soft tactile sensors remains difficult because finite element methods (FEM) are computa- tionally expensive, while real-time simulators often lack fidelity for hyperelastic deformation. Large physical datasets are also impractical to collect because repeated testing can damage fragile sensors. We present a data-efficient framework that combines limited real-world validation, high-fidelity FEM, and graph neural networks (GNNs) for accurate real-time prediction of two-dimensional tactile deformation in a planar soft tactile structure. The key idea is to decouple validation from training: 82 camera-tracked contact configurations are used only to tune and validate an ANSYS FEM model, which then generates 768 synthetic contact scenarios for GNN training. We evaluate both forward prediction from marker deformation to contact localisation and inverse inference from contact configuration to marker deformation. The validated FEM achieves sub-0.5 mm error in more than 90% of validation cases, while the learned GNN surrogate reaches a mean absolute error of 0.32 mm with millisecond-scale inference, compared with minute-scale FEM simulation. Models trained entirely on synthetic FEM data retain sub-millimetre accuracy on real measurements from the 2D tactile structure, demonstrating strong sim-to-real transfer within the tested planar setting. We further integrate the learned model into a real-time visualisation pipeline, enabling rapid deformation prediction for virtual prototyping and simulator-based design exploration without extensive physical testing.
2610.16667.abstract_zh: 准确建模软触觉传感器仍很困难：有限元方法（FEM）计算昂贵，而实时仿真器通常不足以忠实描述超弹性形变；重复物理测试还可能损坏脆弱传感器，使大规模真实数据难以采集。我们提出数据高效框架，结合有限真实验证、高保真 FEM 和图神经网络（GNN），实时预测平面软触觉结构的二维形变。关键是将验证与训练分开：82 种相机跟踪的接触构型只用于调校和验证 ANSYS FEM 模型，后者再生成 768 个合成接触场景用于 GNN 训练。我们评估从标记点形变到接触位置的正向预测，以及从接触构型到标记点形变的逆向推断。验证过的 FEM 在超过 90% 的验证案例中误差低于 0.5 mm；学习的 GNN 替代模型平均绝对误差为 0.32 mm，推理耗时毫秒级，FEM 则需分钟级。完全由合成 FEM 数据训练的模型，在该二维触觉结构的真实测量上仍保持亚毫米精度，显示所测平面设置内较强的 sim-to-real 迁移。我们还将模型接入实时可视化流程，以在无需大量实物测试的情况下快速预测形变，服务虚拟原型和仿真设计探索。

2610.15769.abstract_en: Human demonstrations can capture task-relevant manipulation without using the target robot, but the recorded hand motions cannot directly serve as robot action supervision. Hand reconstruction and motion retargeting provide a direct route to such supervision, yet recovering hand motion alone does not ensure physically consistent hand-object interactions. To address this issue, we introduce Hand2Robot, an object-centric 4D hand reconstruction framework for robot policy post-training. Given videos of humans performing the target task, Hand2Robot extracts interaction clips, reconstructs object geometry, and generates robot action supervision through hand-object interaction optimization and motion retargeting. For object tracking, we combine observation confidence with temporal motion constraints to select a globally consistent object pose trajectory from per-frame pose candidates. For hand refinement, we use object geometry and motion as a reference and combine staged 2D alignment with object-local contact constraints to refine hand trajectories and finger joint configurations. Experiments on DexYCB and HO3D-v3 show improved object pose accuracy and hand-object interaction quality. Experiments on three real-robot dexterous manipulation tasks further show that reconstructed and retargeted human demonstrations can effectively supplement limited robot data for target-task policy post-training.
2610.15769.abstract_zh: 人类示范能在不用目标机器人的情况下记录与任务相关的操作，但所录手部运动不能直接作为机器人动作监督。手部重建和运动重定向提供了一条路径，不过单独恢复手部运动并不能保证手—物交互在物理上自洽。我们提出 Hand2Robot，一种面向机器人策略后训练、以物体为中心的 4D 手部重建框架。给定人执行目标任务的视频，方法提取交互片段、重建物体几何，并通过手—物交互优化与运动重定向产生机器人动作监督。对于物体跟踪，它结合观测置信度和时间运动约束，从逐帧候选姿态中选出全局一致的物体姿态轨迹；对于手部细化，它以物体几何与运动为参考，结合分阶段 2D 对齐及物体局部接触约束，优化手部轨迹与手指关节构型。在 DexYCB 和 HO3D-v3 上，方法提高了物体姿态精度和手—物交互质量；在三个真实机器人灵巧操作任务中，实验进一步表明，重建并重定向的人类示范可有效补充有限的机器人数据，用于目标任务策略后训练。

2610.18822.abstract_en: Egocentric human videos offer a scalable alternative to robot teleoperation for collecting dexterous manipulation data. However, two challenges limit their use as reliable training data: accurate hand-object interaction (HOI) reconstruction from monocular RGB and high-quality robot demonstrations, especially visual observations. We present EgoMatrix, an end-to-end data engine that converts monocular egocentric human videos into bimanual dexterous trajectories and paired robot observation videos, with the trajectories directly replayable on real robots. It reconstructs HOI with emphasis on relative geometry and contact rather than exact metric scene recovery, then uses retargeting and reinforcement learning (RL) to reproduce the demonstrated tasks in simulation. We jointly render robot hands and objects from these simulated trajectories to produce physically faithful observations synchronized with state and control records. Rendering the same trajectories in diverse, task-compatible backgrounds expands paired training data while preserving robot-object motion and contact. Across TACO, OakInk2, and self-collected data, EgoMatrix achieves 54.84% end-to-end success in simulation versus 14.52% for the strongest baseline. Reconstruction reaches state-of-the-art performance on most metrics of the two public benchmarks. Qualitative results show more faithful hand-object interactions than prior methods, while feature-space analysis shows closer alignment with real-robot observations than GPT-6 Astra. Our project page is available at this https URL .
2610.18822.abstract_zh: 第一视角人类视频可作为机器人遥操作之外可扩展的灵巧操作数据来源，但单目 RGB 的准确手—物交互（HOI）重建，以及高质量机器人示范、尤其视觉观测的生成，仍是两大障碍。我们提出 EgoMatrix，一条端到端数据管线，将单目第一视角人类视频转换为双手灵巧轨迹和配对的机器人观测视频，且轨迹能直接在真实机器人上重放。它重建 HOI 时强调相对几何和接触，而非精确的度量场景恢复，再通过重定向和强化学习在仿真中重现任务。方法根据这些仿真轨迹联合渲染机器人手和物体，得到与状态、控制记录同步的物理可信观测；同一轨迹还可在多样、与任务相容的背景中渲染，以在保持机器人—物体运动和接触的同时扩充配对训练数据。在 TACO、OakInk2 和自采数据上，EgoMatrix 的仿真端到端成功率为 54.84%，最强基线为 14.52%；在两个公开基准的大多数重建指标上取得当时最佳表现。定性结果显示手—物交互比先前方法更忠实，特征空间分析显示其观测比 GPT-6 Astra 生成的结果更接近真实机器人观测。项目页见论文。

2610.17572.abstract_en: While expert demonstrations on real robots are difficult to collect, human ego-centric videos are easy to collect and abundant on the internet. However, learning dexterous manipulation policies from human videos remains challenging---one of the most important challenges being the difficulty of reconstructing physically grounded robot trajectories due to the large embodiment gap. In this paper, we propose EgoCPT, a novel paradigm for learning high-quality retargeted dexterous hand trajectories directly from an ego-centric video, which can then be deployed directly on real robots.
