The only inputs to our method are an ego-centric RGB video and a reference hand pose trajectory, which can be easily obtained through off-the-shelf software or specialized cameras during recording. Our method is particularly robust to noisy hand poses attributed to our novel contact-aware optimization framework, which iteratively optimizes the contact points between the robot hands and objects. Across five manipulation tasks, our method achieves overall success rates of 67.3% on noisy EgoDex hand-pose reconstructions and 92.0% on high-quality TACO reconstructions collected using motion-capture hardware, outperforming multiple baselines on both benchmarks.
2610.17572.abstract_zh: 真实机器人的专家示范难以收集，而人类第一视角视频容易采集且网络上大量存在。不过，从人类视频学习灵巧操作策略仍很困难，重要障碍之一是形态差异巨大，难以重建具有物理依据的机器人轨迹。本文提出 EgoCPT，一种直接从单段第一视角视频学习高质量重定向灵巧手轨迹的新范式，所得轨迹随后可直接部署于真实机器人。方法仅需第一视角 RGB 视频和参考手部姿态轨迹；后者可由现成软件或录制时的专用相机获取。其新的接触感知优化框架反复优化机器人手与物体之间的接触点，因此对噪声手姿态尤其稳健。在五项操作任务中，面对带噪声的 EgoDex 手姿态重建，方法总体成功率达 67.3%；面对用动作捕捉硬件采集的高质量 TACO 重建，达 92.0%；两个基准上均优于多种基线。

2610.14854.abstract_en: Contact-rich manipulation poses a stage-dependent sensory conflict: vision and proprioception are essential for localization and approach, when force is largely uninformative and potentially distracting, whereas force becomes critical after contact, when irrelevant visual details and correlated robot states may become shortcuts. We propose DEFT-VLA (Dual-Expert Force-specialized Training for Vision-Language-Action Manipulation), which retains the task-adapted base expert for vision-dominated non-contact behavior and introduces a force-aware contact expert for critical contact stages, localizing force-conditioned adaptation to where it is needed. We further introduce a contact-localized force-attending curriculum that applies force-attending post-training only to the contact expert, progressively restoring vision and masking state tokens to suppress shortcuts. Real-robot experiments on pipette tip attachment, bimanual pipette aspiration, and whiteboard wiping show that DEFT-VLA effectively exploits force feedback to improve contact-stage performance while maintaining strong non-contact behavior and robustness to held-out grasp heights. It improves overall task success by 20-40 percentage points over the strongest baseline on each task.
2610.14854.abstract_zh: 富接触操作存在随阶段变化的感知冲突：定位和接近阶段需要视觉与本体感觉，力信号大多无信息且可能干扰；接触后力信号变得关键，而无关视觉细节和相关的机器人状态可能成为捷径。我们提出 DEFT-VLA（面向视觉—语言—动作操作的双专家力专门化训练）：保留任务适配的基础专家负责视觉主导的非接触行为，并为关键接触阶段引入感知力的接触专家，将力条件适配限制在需要它的位置。我们还提出接触局部化的力注意课程，仅对接触专家进行力注意后训练，逐步恢复视觉并掩蔽状态 token，以抑制捷径。真实机器人上的移液枪枪头安装、双手移液吸取和擦白板实验表明，DEFT-VLA 能利用力反馈提高接触阶段表现，同时保持较强的非接触行为和对未见抓取高度的稳健性。相对每个任务的最强基线，总体任务成功率提高 20–40 个百分点。

2610.17161.abstract_en: Teleoperation is widely used to collect high-quality demonstrations for robot learning. Dexterous manipulation, however, requires coordinated control of motion and contact forces. Operators can specify motion, but struggle to reproduce the subtle force adjustments of human manipulation without feeling the robot's contacts. We introduce Force-Modulated Dexterity (FOMO-Dex), a unified compliance formulation for contact-rich manipulation. FOMO-Dex expresses nominal actions in coordinates defined by task geometry and contact structure. It applies force-driven motion corrections along selected directions while leaving the remaining command components unchanged. Across card picking, paper cutting, screwdriving, and nut-and-bolt assembly, FOMO-Dex reduces excessive contact forces compared with stiff control. A user study shows that operators collect more successful demonstration data per hour after brief practice. For policy learning, imitating the corrected actions improves card-picking success over imitating raw operator commands. Policies trained on FOMO-Dex demonstrations also achieve more rotation in nut-and-bolt manipulation and screwdriving than those trained on demonstrations collected with the stiff controller. Videos are shown on this https URL .
2610.17161.abstract_zh: 遥操作常用于收集高质量机器人学习示范，但灵巧操作需要协调运动与接触力。操作者可以指定运动，却难以在没有感知机器人接触的情况下复现人类操作中的细微力调整。我们提出 Force-Modulated Dexterity（FOMO-Dex），一种统一的富接触操作柔顺性表述。它在由任务几何和接触结构定义的坐标系中表示名义动作，沿选定方向施加由力驱动的运动修正，其余指令分量保持不变。在取卡片、剪纸、拧螺丝和螺母—螺栓装配任务中，FOMO-Dex 相较刚性控制减少过量接触力。用户研究显示，短暂练习后操作者每小时可收集更多成功示范。对于策略学习，模仿修正后的动作比模仿原始操作者指令更能提高取卡片成功率；用 FOMO-Dex 示范训练的策略，在螺母—螺栓操作和拧螺丝中也比用刚性控制器示范训练的策略实现更多旋转。视频见论文。

2610.18118.abstract_en: Visually similar actions can produce contact loss, jamming, slippage, or irreversible damage, while tactile feedback may arrive after a critical transition. Contact-rich manipulation therefore requires generative policies to anticipate and evaluate whether candidate actions will produce desirable contact outcomes, then adjust action generation before execution. We present ForeTac, a predictive contact-guidance framework organized as a represent-predict-evaluate-guide loop. ForeTac encodes the current tactile state, predicts the tactile consequences of a candidate action sequence, and evaluates the predicted trajectory using a contact-quality objective learned from successful and failed physical interactions. At deployment, its gradient propagates through the tactile predictor to guide action generation while the pretrained model parameters remain frozen. We evaluate ForeTac on four real-robot tasks (planar and curved-surface wiping, card swiping, and fragile-object grasping) with diffusion and flow-matching policies. Across these tasks, ForeTac raises the average task success rate from 36.3% to 71.3% and the average contact success rate (CSR) from 20.0% to 66.3% compared with vision-only Diffusion Policy. Component analyses support the tactile representation and action-conditioned foresight, and show that predicted touch preserves contact-quality ordering. Project page: this https URL .
2610.18118.abstract_zh: 视觉上相似的动作可能造成接触丢失、卡滞、滑移或不可逆损坏，而触觉反馈可能在关键状态转变之后才到来。因此，富接触操作需要生成式策略预先评估候选动作能否产生理想接触结果，并在执行前调整动作生成。我们提出 ForeTac，一种按“表示—预测—评估—引导”循环组织的预测式接触引导框架。ForeTac 编码当前触觉状态，预测候选动作序列的触觉后果，并用从成功与失败的物理交互中学到的接触质量目标评估预测轨迹。部署时，目标函数梯度穿过触觉预测器，引导动作生成，而预训练模型参数保持冻结。我们用扩散及流匹配策略，在四项真实机器人任务上评估：平面与曲面擦拭、刷卡和易碎物抓取。与纯视觉 Diffusion Policy 相比，平均任务成功率由 36.3% 提高到 71.3%，平均接触成功率（CSR）由 20.0% 提高到 66.3%。组件分析支持触觉表示和动作条件预见性的作用，也表明预测触觉保留了接触质量的排序。项目页见论文。

2610.18855.abstract_en: Contact-rich manipulation requires robots to coordinate not only where to move, but also how contact and force should evolve throughout an interaction. Yet most robot policies represent actions primarily as motion trajectories, using tactile signals as inputs or auxiliary prediction targets without explicitly encoding contact dynamics in the action representation. We propose ILA (Interaction Latents as Actions), which uses decodable interaction latents that jointly capture the evolution of motion, contact, and force application as policy action units, providing a shared representation for action generation, evaluation, and offline improvement. We learn these latents through visually conditioned joint action-tactile reconstruction with a time-conditioned implicit decoder. Using them as flow-matching generation targets supports post-training of pretrained vision-language-action models (VLAs) and world action models (WAMs), as well as training flow-matching policies from scratch. A shared decoder maps generated latents to executable actions. For offline improvement, we learn a tactile-conditioned expert reference model from interaction latents encoded from expert demonstrations. The resulting expert-consistency rewards guide weighted learning from successful rollouts, while observation-compatible expert references guide correction of low-reward predictions from failed rollouts. Across three policy families, ILA improves success rates averaged over four real-world tasks by 21.0-36.5 percentage points relative to tactile-conditioned direct-action baselines. Ablations highlight the benefit of encoding contact evolution in action targets beyond tactile conditioning, while the same latent space supports expert-guided offline improvement. Project website: this https URL .
2610.18855.abstract_zh: 富接触操作不仅要协调机器人向哪里移动，还要协调交互过程中的接触和施力如何变化。但多数策略主要用运动轨迹表示动作，把触觉作为输入或辅助预测目标，未在动作表示中明确编码接触动力学。我们提出 ILA（Interaction Latents as Actions），把运动、接触和施力的联合演变编码为可解码的交互潜变量，作为策略动作单元，并为动作生成、评估和离线改进提供共享表示。方法通过视觉条件的动作—触觉联合重建及时间条件隐式解码器学习潜变量；以其作为流匹配生成目标，可对预训练 VLA 和世界动作模型（WAM）后训练，也可从零训练流匹配策略，最后由共享解码器还原可执行动作。为了离线改进，我们从专家示范编码的交互潜变量学习触觉条件专家参考模型：专家一致性奖励指导从成功展开中加权学习，与观测相容的专家参考则用于修正失败展开中的低奖励预测。在三类策略、四项真实任务中，相比以触觉为条件的直接动作基线，ILA 的平均成功率高出 21.0–36.5 个百分点。消融支持将接触演变纳入动作目标的额外收益，同一潜空间也支持专家引导的离线改进。项目页见论文。

2610.18852.abstract_en: Expert demonstrations show how to complete contact-rich tasks, but provide limited coverage of how interaction forces respond to different actions. Task-agnostic play provides broader experience of contact dynamics without specifying task goals. To fully leverage these two types of data, we introduce ForceWAM, a force world action model that decouples knowledge of task-compatible interaction outcomes from knowledge of how local actions change contact. A world model learns from successful demonstrations to jointly predict future video and six-axis force/torque trajectories. Together, these futures describe the expected evolution of motion and contact during the task. A separate inverse dynamics model (IDM) learns from both task and play, mapping current observations and recorded visual-wrench futures to their associated robot actions. Play data thus provide knowledge of force responses for goal-directed execution. At deployment, the IDM reactively translates generated futures into actions, reusing them with fresh wrench feedback between world-model updates. Across real-robot force-regulated sliding, box flipping with and without disturbances, and ring placement, ForceWAM achieves $85$-$95\%$ mean success, surpassing world-modeling and reactive baselines. Our experiments further show that adding task-agnostic play data improves success by $15$-$45$ percentage points, demonstrating its value for learning contact-rich execution. Project page and code are available at this https URL .
2610.18852.abstract_zh: 专家示范说明如何完成富接触任务，却较少覆盖不同动作会引起怎样的交互力响应；与任务无关的自由交互（play）则提供更广泛的接触动力学经验，却没有目标。为了结合两类数据，我们提出 ForceWAM，一种力感知世界动作模型，将与任务相容的交互结果知识和局部动作如何改变接触的知识分开学习。世界模型从成功示范中联合预测未来视频与六轴力/力矩轨迹，以描述任务期间运动和接触的预期演变；独立逆动力学模型（IDM）从任务数据与 play 数据中学习，将当前观测和记录的视觉—力矩未来映射为对应机器人动作。因此，play 数据为目标驱动的执行提供力响应知识。部署时，IDM 将生成的未来响应式转换为动作，并在世界模型更新间利用新的力/力矩反馈复用未来预测。在真实机器人的力调节滑动、受扰和无扰翻盒以及放环任务上，ForceWAM 平均成功率达到 85%–95%，超过世界模型与响应式基线；加入与任务无关的 play 数据又使成功率提高 15–45 个百分点，说明其有助于学习富接触执行。项目页与代码见论文。

2610.17521.abstract_en: Evaluating VLA policies on real robots is costly, time-consuming, and difficult to reproduce, making real-to-sim simulation essential for scalable evaluation. While 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) enables rapid real-to-sim scene generation, the reconstruction quality required for reliable policy evaluation remains unquantified. In particular, policies relying on wrist-mounted fisheye cameras (e.g., YUBI handheld gripper data) are heavily exposed to visual artifacts (holes, floaters) in wide-angle views, directly degrading task performance. To address this, we present YUBI-Real2Sim, a unified framework for 3DGS-based scene reconstruction and real-to-sim policy evaluation under dual fisheye wrist views. We develop an integrated pipeline combining 200-degree fisheye camera capture, 3DGS training, 3D foundation models for object modeling, and MuJoCo-based physical simulation, reproducing the observed real-world policy ordering in eight of nine scene-task comparisons. Using this framework, we construct a benchmark across two bimanual robot platforms, three scenes, three tasks, and dual pi0.5-based policies. This systematically measures real-to-sim rank agreement and evaluates policy sensitivity against counterfactual 3DGS artifacts (ceiling holes, floaters, warping) and capture disturbances. We further analyze whether novel-view quality scores can indicate policy-ranking reliability under a scene-held-out evaluation protocol. The results show task-dependent performance and limitations of quality-based reliability prediction, highlighting the need to assess reconstruction quality when using Real2Sim for policy evaluation. These results do not yet establish a generally reliable scene-acceptance rule. Project Page: this https URL .
2610.17521.abstract_zh: 真实机器人上的 VLA 策略评估昂贵、耗时且难复现，因此真实到仿真的场景构建对规模化评估很重要。3D Gaussian Splatting（3DGS）虽能快速生成仿真场景，但可靠评估策略所需的重建质量仍未量化。依赖腕部鱼眼相机的策略尤其容易在广角视野中受到空洞、浮点等视觉伪影干扰，直接损害任务表现。我们提出 YUBI-Real2Sim，在双腕鱼眼视角下统一进行基于 3DGS 的场景重建和真实到仿真策略评估。流程结合 200 度鱼眼相机采集、3DGS 训练、用于物体建模的 3D 基础模型及 MuJoCo 物理仿真；在九组场景—任务比较中，有八组复现了真实世界策略排序。基于该流程，我们构建涵盖两个双手机器人平台、三个场景、三个任务及两种基于 π0.5 的策略的基准，系统测量 real-to-sim 排序一致性，并评估策略对反事实 3DGS 伪影（天花板空洞、浮点、扭曲）及采集干扰的敏感性。我们还在留出场景的协议下分析新视角质量分数能否预示策略排序可靠性。结果显示质量预测可靠性随任务而异且存在局限，凸显 real-to-sim 评估须检验重建质量；这些结果尚未确立普适可靠的场景验收规则。项目页见论文。

2610.14586.abstract_en: This paper proposes a novel soft robot model named piece-wise constant 7D deformation (PC7) model that can represent expanding and contracting deformation of, for example, artificial muscle actuator. In the proposed model, we newly define the 7D deformation vector based on SIM(3) - 3D similarity transformation group - whereas a 6D deformation vector was defined for Cosserat rod based on SE(3) - the special Euclid group - in the piece-wise constant strain (PCS) model proposed in the previous study. The additional dimension of the 7D deformation vector represents expanding and contracting deformation, which comes from the scaling parameter in SIM(3). Common mathematical properties between SE(3) and SIM(3) allow us to directly extend the kinematics and dynamics of the PCS model to those of the PC7 model. In particular, we derive the dynamical equation of the PC7 model based on Euler-Poincare equation in a mathematically precise manner. We validate the proposed model through dynamical simulations assuming a thin cylinder structure or McKibben-type artificial muscle actuator.
2610.14586.abstract_zh: 本文提出软体机器人模型 PC7（分段常数七维形变），可表示人工肌肉执行器等结构的伸长和收缩形变。方法在 3D 相似变换群 SIM(3) 上重新定义七维形变向量；先前基于特殊欧氏群 SE(3) 的 Cosserat 杆分段常数应变（PCS）模型使用六维向量。新增的一维来自 SIM(3) 的尺度参数，用来表示伸缩形变。SE(3) 与 SIM(3) 的共同数学性质，使 PCS 模型的运动学和动力学可直接扩展至 PC7。特别地，我们基于 Euler–Poincaré 方程，以数学上精确的方式推导 PC7 动力学方程。最后通过假设细圆柱结构或 McKibben 型人工肌肉执行器的动力学仿真验证该模型。

2610.14596.abstract_en: Navigating cluttered environments while carrying objects remains a challenging problem for quadruped robots. Compared with works that focused on load-aware locomotion adaptation to maintain gait stability, existing autonomous navigation systems generally ignore the influence of carried objects' geometries and use fixed footprint inflation, leading to overly conservative navigation. To fill this knowledge gap, we propose a two-phase load-aware navigation learning framework. In Phase 1, we train LOADNav, a load-aware navigation policy via reinforcement learning, enabling the robot to adapt its trajectory and clearance behavior according to the geometric size of the carried object. In Phase 2, we train CoGE, an online geometry predictor via imitation learning, which estimates unknown payload geometry from occasional contact events. We evaluate the framework in cluttered environments with loads of varying sizes and shapes. The results show that our navigation policy exhibits clear load-aware behaviors, and the online geometry predictor estimates object geometry from occasional contact events, refining its estimate and adapting the navigation behavior accordingly. Without requiring any prior knowledge of the payload, it narrows the gap to geometry-aware policies.
2610.14596.abstract_zh: 四足机器人携带物体穿越拥挤环境仍很困难。与侧重负载感知步态适配、维持行走稳定性的工作相比，现有自主导航系统通常忽略所携物体的几何，使用固定的足迹膨胀，因此过于保守。为弥补这一缺口，我们提出两阶段负载感知导航学习框架。第一阶段以强化学习训练 LOADNav，使机器人根据所携物体的几何尺寸调整路线和通行间隙；第二阶段以模仿学习训练在线几何预测器 CoGE，使其由偶发接触事件估计未知负载的几何。我们在携带不同大小和形状负载的拥挤环境中评估。结果显示，导航策略表现出明显的负载感知行为，在线预测器也能由偶发接触逐步修正物体几何估计，并据此调整导航。即便事先不知道负载信息，该方法仍缩小了与直接掌握几何的策略之间的差距。

2610.18045.abstract_en: High-fidelity three-dimensional turbulent flow fields are essential for scientific and engineering analyses, yet obtaining them through direct numerical simulation or high-resolution measurements remains expensive. Super-resolution reconstruction from coarse-grained data therefore offers a promising alternative, but remains fundamentally challenging because fine-scale structures are intrinsically three-dimensional and dynamically coupled across scales. Existing data-driven approaches still struggle to recover multiscale volumetric structures and their coherent temporal evolution. To address these limitations, we propose a turbulence-aware framework for time-resolved three-dimensional flow reconstruction. The framework couples a multiscale neural operator, designed to recover volumetric structures, with a state space model to promote temporal consistency in the reconstructed dynamics. In addition, Navier-Stokes residuals are incorporated as soft constraints to regularize the reconstruction toward physically plausible dynamics. A mixture-of-experts mechanism is also introduced to support unsupervised adaptation to unknown coarse-graining. Across evaluations on canonical turbulent systems and atmospheric reanalysis data, the proposed framework reduces reconstruction errors relative to learning-based and classical baselines, while better preserving multiscale spatial structure and coherent temporal evolution. These results validate the effectiveness of the proposed framework in reconstructing high-fidelity three-dimensional flow fields from coarse-grained data.
2610.18045.abstract_zh: 高保真三维湍流流场对科学和工程分析十分重要，但直接数值仿真或高分辨率测量都很昂贵。因此，从粗粒度数据进行超分辨率重建是一条有前景的路径；不过，精细尺度结构本质上是三维的，并跨尺度动态耦合，使问题仍然困难。现有数据驱动方法也难同时恢复多尺度体积结构及其连贯的时间演变。我们提出面向时间分辨三维流场重建的湍流感知框架：用多尺度神经算子恢复体积结构，并与状态空间模型耦合，以促进重建动力学的时间一致性；同时将 Navier–Stokes 残差作为软约束，使重建趋向物理上合理的动力学；还引入混合专家机制，以无监督方式适配未知粗粒化过程。在典型湍流系统和大气再分析数据的评估中，相对学习式及经典基线，方法降低了重建误差，更好地保留多尺度空间结构和连贯时间演变。结果支持该框架从粗粒度数据恢复高保真三维流场的有效性。

2610.14412.abstract_en: Characterizing subsurface fracture networks is challenging because geometry and connectivity are sparsely observed and uncertain away from measurements. We develop a latent diffusion framework for unconditional and observation-conditioned generation of two-dimensional (2D) and three-dimensional (3D) fracture networks. Fractures and the surrounding matrix are represented as binary fields and compressed by a variational autoencoder into compact spatial latent representations, where an Elucidated Diffusion Model learns their distribution. The 3D model operates on native volumetric fields, with a reconstruction objective designed to preserve sparse, thin fracture structures. Sparse borehole observations are incorporated through a conditioning encoder, classifier-free guidance, and diffusion posterior sampling. Generated ensembles reproduce key fracture-network statistics, including fracture area/volume fraction, two-point correlation, and chord-length distributions. Reconstructed fracture counts and gas-production responses are comparable to those of the reference networks under the considered multiphase flow scenarios. Conditional generation satisfies 99.6% of prescribed well observations in 2D. In 3D, where vertical boreholes constrain full voxel columns, conditional realizations satisfy 84.2% of observed well voxels while maintaining fracture volume and geometry comparable to the reference ensemble. These results demonstrate the potential of latent diffusion models as compact probabilistic representations for fracture-network characterization, ensemble generation, and sparse-observation conditioning.
2610.14412.abstract_zh: 由于地下裂隙的几何和连通性只在少量测点被观测，远离测量位置时存在显著不确定性，因此刻画裂隙网络很困难。我们开发潜空间扩散框架，可无条件或以观测为条件生成二维（2D）与三维（3D）裂隙网络。方法把裂隙及周围基质表示为二值场，用变分自编码器压缩成紧凑的空间潜表示，再由 Elucidated Diffusion Model 学习其分布。3D 模型直接处理原生体素场，并设计重建目标以保留稀疏、细薄的裂隙结构；稀疏井孔观测则通过条件编码器、无分类器引导与扩散后验采样纳入。生成的样本集合复现了裂隙面积/体积分数、两点相关和弦长分布等关键统计量；在所考虑的多相流情景下，重建裂隙数量和气体产出响应与参考网络相当。二维条件生成满足 99.6% 的指定井观测；在垂直井孔约束整列体素的三维情形中，条件样本满足 84.2% 的观测井体素，同时保持与参考集合相当的裂隙体积和几何。结果显示潜空间扩散可作为裂隙网络表征、样本集合生成和稀疏观测条件化的紧凑概率方法。

2610.17082.abstract_en: We present DeboRheo v2.0, an unstructured, geometrically unsplit Volume-of-Fluid framework implemented in OpenFOAM for viscoelastic two-phase flows. Version 2.0 improves numerical robustness when large viscosity contrasts coincide with strongly deformed interfaces and thin viscoelastic lamellae or filaments. The revised interfacial viscosity treatment retains a sharp geometric interface while regularizing the viscous contribution to the momentum equation. The solver combines mass-momentum-consistent phase advection, optional SIMPLEC pressure-velocity coupling, and a modular rheological framework with conformation-tensor stabilization. We assess the method using two-dimensional, axisymmetric, and three-dimensional benchmarks governed by the Oldroyd-B and exponential Phan-Thien-Tanner models. The results agree well with published numerical and experimental data and demonstrate improved robustness for demanding viscoelastic free-surface configurations on unstructured meshes.
2610.17082.abstract_zh: 我们提出 DeboRheo v2.0：在 OpenFOAM 中实现、用于黏弹性两相流的非结构、几何非分裂体积分数（Volume-of-Fluid）框架。第 2 版提高了在巨大黏度差与强烈形变界面、薄黏弹性液片或细丝同时出现时的数值稳健性。修订后的界面黏度处理保留尖锐的几何界面，同时对动量方程中的黏性贡献作正则化。求解器结合质量—动量一致的相输运、可选的 SIMPLEC 压力—速度耦合，以及带构象张量稳定化的模块化流变框架。我们使用由 Oldroyd-B 和指数型 Phan-Thien-Tanner 模型支配的二维、轴对称及三维基准评估方法。结果与已发表的数值和实验数据吻合，并显示在非结构网格上的高难度黏弹性自由表面配置中稳健性提高。

2610.15722.abstract_en: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) are good at video understanding and code generation, but it remains unclear whether they can recover the physical laws underlying videos, a capability essential for converting videos into executable simulations and for providing structured physical supervision in robotics. Captioning motion video does not imply that a model has inferred its governing dynamics, estimated quantitative parameters, or can regenerate the observed scene from code. Existing video-physics benchmarks evaluate plausibility, property estimation, or future-state prediction, but offer limited insight into whether models can translate visual dynamics into runnable simulation code. We introduce PhySimCode, a benchmark for physics video-to-code generation: given only a raw video, a model must infer the relevant physics, recover parameter values, and generate runnable Python that reproduces the input video. The dataset contains 160.6K procedurally generated samples spanning 162 physics phenomena across analytic SciPy simulations and PyBullet-rendered rigid-body, articulated, fluid, and contact-rich scenes; each sample bundles the simulation code, physical parameters, rendered video, and a structured chain-of-thought covering observations, laws, ODEs, numerical methods, and validation checks. We evaluate ten state-of-the-art closed- and open-source MLLMs along physical-law correctness, simulation equivalence, code executability, and parameter recovery. Models reliably state physics laws (4.27-4.93/5) yet score only 1.51-2.47/5 on inferring them from video, and the best system (Claude Sonnet 4.6) recovers just 7.7% of ground-truth parameters within $\pm 20\%$, exposing a substantial video-to-simulation gap. The 2,430-video evaluation set is available at this https URL and the evaluation code at this https URL
2610.15722.abstract_zh: 多模态大语言模型（MLLM）擅长视频理解和代码生成，但能否恢复视频背后的物理规律仍不清楚；这一能力对于把视频转为可执行仿真、以及为机器人提供结构化物理监督至关重要。给运动视频写描述，并不意味着模型推断出支配动力学、估计出定量参数，或能用代码重现观测场景。已有视频物理基准测试合理性、属性估计或未来状态预测，却难揭示模型能否把视觉动力学转成可运行的仿真代码。我们提出 PhySimCode 视频到物理代码生成基准：只给原始视频，模型须推断相关物理、恢复参数值，并生成可重现输入视频的可运行 Python。数据集包含 160.6K 个程序生成样本，跨越 162 种物理现象，涵盖解析 SciPy 仿真以及 PyBullet 渲染的刚体、关节、流体和富接触场景；每个样本都含仿真代码、物理参数、渲染视频，以及覆盖观测、规律、常微分方程、数值方法和验证检查的结构化思维链。我们从物理规律正确性、仿真等价性、代码可执行性和参数恢复四方面评估十个最先进的闭源与开源 MLLM。模型通常能陈述物理规律（4.27–4.93/5），但从视频推断规律仅得 1.51–2.47/5；最好的 Claude Sonnet 4.6 也只有 7.7% 的真值参数落在 ±20% 误差内，暴露出显著的视频到仿真鸿沟。2,430 段视频的评估集及评估代码见论文链接。

2610.15166.abstract_en: Coding agents are increasingly evolving beyond reproducing what a world looks like toward constructing executable worlds that capture how a world works. This shift calls for executable world modeling, which integrates two core capabilities: world understanding, reasoning about the underlying structural, mechanical, and causal principles of a world, and executable realization, translating that understanding into a code-based system whose behavior emerges from physical interactions. However, existing benchmarks provide only fragmented evaluations centered on physical reasoning, visual fidelity, or behavioral correctness, leaving the integration of these capabilities insufficiently assessed. To bridge this gap, we introduce ExeWorldBench, to our knowledge the first benchmark to comprehensively evaluate world understanding and executable realization through code-based 3D world construction. ExeWorldBench comprises three progressively challenging tasks: Mechanism Executability, which evaluates the realization of individual mechanisms from visual observations; Compositional Executability, which extends to multi-stage systems with spatial, mechanical, and causal dependencies; and Intent-Driven Executable World Synthesis, which requires constructing executable worlds from high-level goals and physical requirements. Extensive experiments on frontier models reveal substantial limitations in executable world modeling, offering insights into the development of more physically grounded and causally coherent world construction systems.
2610.15166.abstract_zh: 编码智能体正逐步从复现世界的外观，走向构建能体现世界运行机制的可执行世界。这要求把两种核心能力合在一起：世界理解，即推理世界底层的结构、力学和因果原理；以及可执行实现，即把这种理解转换为由物理交互涌现行为的代码系统。但现有基准往往分别评估物理推理、视觉保真度或行为正确性，尚未充分检验这些能力的整合。为弥补缺口，我们提出 ExeWorldBench；据我们所知，这是首个通过基于代码的 3D 世界构建，综合评估世界理解与可执行实现的基准。它有三项难度递增的任务：从视觉观测实现单个机制的“机制可执行性”；扩展到具有空间、力学和因果依赖的多阶段系统的“组合可执行性”；以及根据高层目标与物理要求构建可执行世界的“意图驱动世界合成”。对前沿模型的大量实验揭示了其可执行世界建模的显著局限，并为开发更有物理依据、因果更连贯的世界构建系统提供见解。

2610.14293.abstract_en: Video diffusion models increasingly serve as priors for 4D generation, but the generated videos often lack geometric consistency. Recent approaches address this through post-training by designing geometric rewards, yet this can degrade texture and fine detail, requiring auxiliary appearance rewards and careful reward balancing. To address this challenge, we propose GeoFix, a unified framework that improves geometric consistency and visual quality with a single geometric reward, applicable to both training and inference-time reward alignment. Our reward measures cross-view depth consistency in static scene regions, targeting structural inconsistencies without directly constraining appearance or penalizing valid object motion. Crucially, depth agreement increases with camera field-of-view overlap even in real videos and 4D datasets, allowing a smaller camera movement to be mistaken for better geometry. We account for this effect by calibrating the reward against the overlap-dependent trend. GeoFix achieves a 39% improvement in WorldScore 3D consistency and a 4% increase in VBench Quality Score.
2610.14293.abstract_zh: 视频扩散模型越来越常被用作 4D 生成的先验，但生成视频常缺乏几何一致性。近期方法通过后训练设计几何奖励来改善这一点，却可能损害纹理和细节，因此需要额外外观奖励及谨慎的奖励平衡。我们提出 GeoFix：仅用一个几何奖励，同时改善几何一致性和视觉质量的统一框架，既适用于训练，也适用于推理时的奖励对齐。奖励衡量静态场景区域跨视角的深度一致性，针对结构不一致，而不直接限制外观，也不惩罚合理的物体运动。关键在于，即使对真实视频和 4D 数据集，深度一致性也会随相机视野重叠增加；若不校正，较小的相机移动会被误判为较好的几何。我们依据重叠量相关趋势校准奖励。GeoFix 使 WorldScore 3D 一致性提高 39%，VBench Quality Score 提高 4%。

2610.14685.abstract_en: Recent advances in video diffusion enable novel-view video synthesis from a single input video, supporting world modeling, embodied intelligence, and robotic simulation. However, existing methods process camera trajectories independently, lacking the cross-trajectory consistency needed for coherent, navigable 4D worlds. We introduce Demiurge, an autoregressive video rerendering pipeline built on a dynamic 4D point-cloud memory cache. It promotes cross-trajectory consistency through four components: (1) an appearance video diffusion model that synthesizes photorealistic novel-view videos conditioned on the 4D memory; (2) a memory-consistent video depth completion model that aligns known-region depths with cached geometry and completes missing regions, mitigating scale ambiguity and discontinuities during memory updates; (3) memory-aware dual-stream warping that provides high-fidelity visual guidance and occlusion cues for novel-view synthesis; and (4) geometry-aware video refinement that enhances perceptual quality. Extensive experiments demonstrate state-of-the-art performance and three key capabilities: coherent spatiotemporal lattice construction over dense multi-view trajectories; large-parallax video rerendering under challenging camera motions, including 180-degree rotations with no input-view overlap; and geometry-faithful outputs that can be directly optimized into high-quality 3D Gaussian Splatting representations with minimal artifacts. Project page: this https URL .
2610.14685.abstract_zh: 近期视频扩散技术可以从单段输入视频合成新视角视频，支持世界建模、具身智能和机器人仿真。但现有方法独立处理相机轨迹，缺乏构建连贯、可导航 4D 世界所需的跨轨迹一致性。我们提出 Demiurge：以动态 4D 点云记忆缓存为基础的自回归视频重渲染流程。它通过四个组件促进跨轨迹一致性：（1）以 4D 记忆为条件合成照片级新视角视频的外观视频扩散模型；（2）把已知区域深度与缓存几何对齐、补全缺失区域的记忆一致视频深度补全模型，以缓解记忆更新中的尺度歧义和断裂；（3）感知记忆的双流扭曲，提供高保真视觉指引与遮挡线索；（4）提升感知质量的几何感知视频细化。大量实验显示了当时最佳表现和三种能力：在密集多视角轨迹上构建连贯时空格点；在困难相机运动下、包括与输入视角无重叠的 180 度旋转，进行大视差视频重渲染；以及产生几何忠实的输出，可直接优化成伪影很少的高质量 3D Gaussian Splatting 表示。项目页见论文。

2610.17625.abstract_en: For video generation in dynamic world modeling, observed static and dynamic content should be efficiently reused to provide conditions for repeated generation at different times and viewpoints. We introduce 4LC, a 4D latent cache with composite visual representations and a flexible spatiotemporal access interface. As a latent cache, 4LC directly reuses visual representations of static and dynamic content to provide generation conditions, avoiding per-request RGB rendering and re-encoding. As a composite cache, 4LC binds visual representations from multiple visual encoders (e.g., VAE, DINO, V-JEPA, VGGT) to shared geometry and motion, allowing the composite representations to describe the dynamic world with rich information. Besides, we design a flexible spatiotemporal interface, which directly reads the cache at independently specified times and viewpoints and combines readouts across observations, providing a common conditioning format for diverse downstream tasks. Building on 4LC, we develop 4LC-Video to address multiple video generation tasks through different configurations of source observations, spatiotemporal requests, and historical reuse, including camera control, temporal control, novel-view synthesis, scene revisits, and long-term generation. Our experiments show more efficient condition acquisition, effective spatiotemporal controllability, and scene consistency across tasks using a single 4LC-Video model without task-specific fine-tuning.
2610.17625.abstract_zh: 动态世界建模的视频生成应高效复用已观测的静态和动态内容，以在不同时间和视角的重复生成中提供条件。我们提出 4LC：带复合视觉表示和灵活时空访问接口的 4D 潜缓存。作为潜缓存，它直接复用静态与动态内容的视觉表示，避免每次请求都进行 RGB 渲染与重新编码；作为复合缓存，它把多个视觉编码器（例如 VAE、DINO、V-JEPA、VGGT）的表示绑定到共享几何和运动，使缓存以丰富信息描述动态世界。我们还设计可独立指定时间和视角、直接读取缓存并合并不同观测读出结果的时空接口，为多种下游任务提供统一条件格式。基于 4LC，我们开发 4LC-Video，通过改变源观测、时空请求和历史复用配置，处理相机控制、时间控制、新视角合成、场景重访及长时生成等任务。实验表明，单个无需任务专用微调的 4LC-Video 模型，能更高效地获取条件，并在各任务上实现有效的时空可控性与场景一致性。

2610.14544.abstract_en: Roadside 4D occupancy forecasting predicts future semantic occupancy in a fixed infrastructure coordinate system. Roadside scenes are globally structured yet locally evolving, requiring comprehensive scene-level context while precisely modeling sparse localized motion. However, existing forecasting paradigms struggle to tackle both requirements. To address this limitation, we propose InfraWorld, a world model formulating roadside occupancy forecasting as selective state evolution. InfraWorld maintains a dense BEV state for the complete scene and persistent motion queries for moving regions, assigning complementary states to global context and local dynamics. Specifically, we propose Dynamic Query Initiation (DQI) to initialize queries in regions supported by motion in the observed history. During rollout, the dense state is updated through Long--Short Temporal Fusion (LST), which combines short-term adjacent-frame continuity with long-term motion trends to preserve stable context while capturing scene evolution. Motion-Aware Query Injection (MAQI) then refines the queries and injects confidence-weighted query information into corresponding BEV tokens, enabling targeted dynamic updates without perturbing global context. Together, InfraWorld concentrates predictive capacity on evolving traffic regions. Extensive experiments on the InfraOcc and Occ3D--nus datasets demonstrate that InfraWorld achieves state-of-the-art performance for roadside 4D occupancy forecasting while retaining its effectiveness under ego-centric settings. Code will be released.
2610.14544.abstract_zh: 路侧 4D 占据预测要在固定的基础设施坐标系中预测未来语义占据。路侧场景整体结构稳定、局部却持续变化，因此既需完整场景级上下文，也需精细建模稀疏的局部运动；现有预测范式难同时满足。我们提出 InfraWorld，把路侧占据预测表述为选择性的状态演变。模型为完整场景维护稠密鸟瞰图（BEV）状态，并为运动区域维护持久运动查询，分别承担全局上下文和局部动力学。Dynamic Query Initiation（DQI）在观测历史有运动证据的区域初始化查询；展开时，Long–Short Temporal Fusion（LST）结合邻帧短期连续性与长期运动趋势，更新稠密状态，以保持稳定上下文并捕获场景变化；Motion-Aware Query Injection（MAQI）进一步细化查询，并以置信度加权将查询信息注入对应 BEV token，使动态区域被定向更新而不扰动全局上下文。因此，InfraWorld 将预测能力集中在变化的交通区域。InfraOcc 和 Occ3D--nus 上的大量实验显示，方法在路侧 4D 占据预测中达到当时最佳表现，在自车视角设置中也保持有效。代码将发布。

2610.16308.abstract_en: Contact-rich insertion requires robots to combine visual alignment with tactile adjustment. However, existing visuotactile chunk-based policies collapse tactile feedback into a single generation-time fusion pathway, leaving persistent contact states, abrupt contact events, and future contact consequences implicitly modeled in a single representation. We present PACE (Phase-Aware Contact-Event Conditioning), a temporal-role tactile conditioning framework for chunk-based insertion policies. PACE organizes a shared tactile stream into three temporal roles: persistent contact states condition action-chunk generation, abrupt contact events correct the generated chunk, and contact-consequence prediction shapes action representations during training. This design preserves chunk-level action continuity while assigning distinct pathways to different temporal roles of contact feedback. Across five real-robot insertion tasks, PACE achieves an average success rate of 90.7%, outperforming vision-only and generation-time tactile-fusion baselines by over 44 percentage points; on the ManipulationNet benchmark, PACE maintains 88.7% success across six geometry-clearance configurations, including an industrial-grade 0.1-mm clearance. Ablations confirm the complementary contributions of the three temporal roles, mechanistic analyses show that PACE separates normal insertion progress from contact events requiring immediate correction, and cross-signal and cross-architecture experiments indicate that this temporal-role principle extends across different physical feedback signals and policy backbones. Videos and materials are available at this https URL .
2610.16308.abstract_zh: 富接触插入要求机器人结合视觉对准与触觉调整。但现有视觉—触觉动作块策略通常把触觉反馈压入单一的生成时融合路径，使持续接触状态、突发接触事件和未来接触后果都隐式混在一个表示中。我们提出 PACE（Phase-Aware Contact-Event Conditioning），一种为动作块插入策略区分触觉时间角色的条件化框架。它将同一触觉流分为三种时间角色：持续接触状态为动作块生成提供条件；突发接触事件修正已生成的动作块；接触后果预测在训练时塑造动作表示。这样既保留动作块层面的连续性，又让不同时间角色的接触反馈走不同路径。在五项真实机器人插入任务上，PACE 平均成功率达到 90.7%，比纯视觉及生成时触觉融合基线高出超过 44 个百分点；在 ManipulationNet 基准的六种几何—间隙配置上保持 88.7% 成功率，其中包括工业级 0.1 mm 间隙。消融确认三种时间角色具有互补贡献；机制分析显示，PACE 能区分正常插入进展与需要立即修正的接触事件；跨信号、跨架构实验表明，该原则可推广到不同物理反馈信号与策略主干。视频和材料见论文。

2610.16457.abstract_en: Humans expand their locomotion capability by wearing appropriate footwear, such as hiking boots for mountains or skates for ice. Footwear changes the ground-contact interface and enables traversal of otherwise difficult terrain. In contrast, locomotion controllers are typically trained for a fixed morphology, and their performance can degrade when shoes alter foot geometry, mass, and friction. We propose SHOES, a sample-efficient framework for adapting locomotion policies to footwear-induced morphology changes. SHOES freezes a simulation-trained nominal policy and fine-tunes only lightweight, identity-initialized modulation modules on the robot, preserving the initial behavior while enabling efficient hardware adaptation. We also introduce SafeBox, a workspace-aware waypoint sampler that constrains online adaptation within a user-defined workspace. The simulation results with a shoe-equipped Unitree Go2 show that SHOES substantially recovers locomotion performance after footwear-induced morphology changes using limited additional adaptation. Under the same adaptation budget, SHOES outperforms FiLM-only, Linear Adapter-only, and residual-RL baselines. Real-world experiments on a Unitree Go2 fitted with human shoes further evaluate the effectiveness of SHOES for hardware deployment.
2610.16457.abstract_zh: 人会穿适合环境的鞋来扩展移动能力，例如登山靴或冰鞋；鞋改变与地面的接触界面，使原本困难的地形可通行。相比之下，运动控制器通常为固定形态训练，鞋改变足部几何、质量和摩擦后，性能可能下降。我们提出 SHOES，一种样本高效的框架，使运动策略适配鞋带来的形态变化。方法冻结仿真训练的名义策略，仅在真实机器人上微调轻量、以恒等映射初始化的调制模块，保留初始行为，同时支持高效硬件适配。我们还提出 SafeBox，一种感知工作空间的航点采样器，把在线适配限制在用户定义的范围内。为 Unitree Go2 装鞋的仿真实验显示，SHOES 仅用有限追加适配便显著恢复了形态变化后的运动性能；在相同适配预算下优于仅用 FiLM、仅用线性适配器及残差强化学习基线。给 Unitree Go2 穿人类鞋的真实实验进一步评估了其硬件部署效果。

2610.18194.abstract_en: Robotic manipulation systems commonly learn object affordances from human-annotated datasets, which reflect interaction possibilities for a human hand rather than the physical constraints of a specific robot. For example, a surface region of an object identified as graspable by a human annotator may be geometrically unreachable or mechanically infeasible for a robot, yet this mismatch is rarely addressed explicitly. To tackle this challenge, we proposed a framework that translates human affordance annotations into robot-executable affordance predictions conditioned on the physical properties of the robot. The network predicts which surface regions of an object are physically executable by the robot, given a 3D point cloud of an object and a descriptor encoding the robot's geometry and constraints. The model was trained using human-annotated affordances together with robotic execution outcomes from multiple sampled approach trials in simulation, where execution outcomes determined which regions are executable for the robot. The evaluation was performed on a household objects dataset using two parallel-jaw gripper configurations on a UR5e robot arm. The framework outperformed a model that does not receive information about the robot. The experimental results demonstrated that affordance prediction must be conditioned on the robot and that human annotations alone are insufficient for learning robot-executable affordance representations.
2610.18194.abstract_zh: 机器人操作系统常从人工标注数据学习物体 affordance，但这些标注反映的是人手可交互的区域，而非特定机器人的物理约束。例如，人标为可抓的表面区域，对机器人可能在几何上不可达或在力学上不可行，这种差异却很少被明确处理。我们提出将人类 affordance 标注转化为以机器人物理性质为条件的可执行 affordance 预测框架。给定物体 3D 点云及编码机器人几何与约束的描述符，网络预测哪些物体表面区域可由该机器人实际执行。模型以人工标注 affordance 和仿真中多次采样接近试验的机器人执行结果共同训练，后者决定哪些区域对机器人可执行。我们在家庭物体数据集上，用 UR5e 机械臂的两种平行夹爪配置评估；框架优于不接收机器人信息的模型。实验表明，affordance 预测必须以机器人为条件，单靠人类标注不足以学习机器人可执行的 affordance 表示。

2610.17922.abstract_en: Action-conditioned world models can reduce costly real-robot interaction in reinforcement learning for Vision-Language-Action models (VLA-RL), but hallucinations can mislead policy optimization. Extending them to richer VLA interfaces and long-horizon tasks raises challenges in spatiotemporal and cross-modal consistency, exploration-reliability balance in RL, and compounding rollout errors. We present WoVR+, extending WoVR's hallucination-aware WM-RL framework by redesigning the learned environment and imagined interaction protocol: A VLA-interface-aligned world model provides multi-view prediction and proprioceptive updates while mitigating hallucinations. Chunk-wise noise preserves flow-based policy exploration while limiting prediction-degrading action jitter. For long-horizon tasks, stage-local imagined training combines stage-entry resets, stage-specific rewards, local horizons, and controllable sampling to shorten generated prefixes and balance training across stages. WoVR+ improves success over SFT by 21.09% and 16.7% on RoboTwin and 6 real-robot tasks. Long-horizon phone-packaging success rises from 30% to 75%. Videos are available at this https URL .
2610.17922.abstract_zh: 动作条件世界模型能减少视觉—语言—动作模型强化学习（VLA-RL）中昂贵的真实机器人交互，但世界模型的幻觉会误导策略优化。将其扩展到更丰富的 VLA 接口和长时程任务，还要处理时空与跨模态一致性、强化学习中探索和可靠性的平衡，以及展开误差累积。我们提出 WoVR+，在 WoVR 的幻觉感知世界模型强化学习框架上，重设计学习的环境与想象交互协议：与 VLA 接口对齐的世界模型提供多视角预测和本体感觉更新，同时缓解幻觉；按动作块加入噪声，保留基于流的策略探索，同时限制会破坏预测的动作抖动。对于长时程任务，局部阶段想象训练结合阶段入口重置、阶段专用奖励、局部时间范围和可控采样，以缩短生成前缀、平衡各阶段训练。相对监督微调（SFT），WoVR+ 在 RoboTwin 及六项真实机器人任务上的成功率分别提高 21.09% 和 16.7%；长时程手机包装任务成功率由 30% 升至 75%。视频见论文。

2610.18373.abstract_en: Quadruped robots performing outdoor deliveries must interpret complex scenes, anticipate changes, and navigate in socially compliant ways. Robot demonstrations are costly to collect at the scale needed for generalization. Egocentric web videos offer abundant human navigation experience, but differences in viewpoint and motion make this experience difficult to transfer to robots. We introduce DR-VLA, a Mixture-of-Transformers framework that transfers human navigation experience through a domain-invariant scene representation (DISR). The framework combines vision-language understanding and latent world modeling with a flow-matching action expert. We introduce EgoLynx, comprising 10,000 hours of curated egocentric web video (EgoLynx-Web) and 2,000 clips of teleoperated robot navigation collected during real-world deliveries (EgoLynx-Robot). We pretrain the understanding and world experts on EgoLynx-Web without action labels, then adapt the model to robot observations and train the action expert on EgoLynx-Robot to predict executable trajectories. We also propose the Quadruped Navigation Score (QNS), a pseudo-closed-loop metric combining safety, instruction compliance, comfort, and progress. On the held-out EgoLynx-Robot test split, DR-VLA improves QNS by approximately 5% and reduces open-loop final heading error (FHE) by 14.6%, each relative to the best competing result for that metric. Ablations show that web-video pretraining improves generalization and that the model's key components contribute to performance. As a future-prediction target, DISR outperforms five generic visual representations and yields performance close to task-specific 3D perception without dedicated geometric labels or point clouds for target construction. Trained separately on NAVSIM v1 without web pretraining, DR-VLA achieves 92.1 PDMS, suggesting that the framework also applies to autonomous driving.
2610.18373.abstract_zh: 执行室外配送的四足机器人须理解复杂场景、预判变化并以符合社会规范的方式导航，但足够规模的机器人示范昂贵。第一视角网络视频提供丰富的人类导航经验，却因视角和运动差异而难以迁移。我们提出 DR-VLA，一种混合 Transformer 框架，通过领域不变场景表示（DISR）迁移人类导航经验，并结合视觉语言理解、潜世界建模及流匹配动作专家。我们构建 EgoLynx：包含 10,000 小时筛选的第一视角网络视频（EgoLynx-Web）和真实配送中遥操作采集的 2,000 段机器人导航视频（EgoLynx-Robot）。理解专家和世界专家先在没有动作标签的网络视频上预训练，再将模型适配机器人观测，并在机器人视频上训练动作专家预测可执行轨迹。我们还提出 Quadruped Navigation Score（QNS），一种结合安全、指令遵从、舒适性和进展的伪闭环指标。在留出的 EgoLynx-Robot 测试集上，相较各指标的最强竞争结果，DR-VLA 的 QNS 提高约 5%，开环最终朝向误差（FHE）降低 14.6%。消融显示网络视频预训练有助于泛化，关键组件也各有贡献。作为未来预测目标，DISR 优于五种通用视觉表示；即使构建目标时不用专用几何标注或点云，其表现仍接近任务专用 3D 感知。另在 NAVSIM v1 上从头单独训练且不使用网络视频预训练时，DR-VLA 取得 92.1 PDMS，说明框架也可能适用于自动驾驶。

2610.18846.abstract_en: Reconstructing complete, high-quality meshes of large-scale scenes from unposed multi-view images requires faithful geometric grounding while plausibly completing surfaces that are unobserved or only sparsely captured. We present WorldRecon, a generative multi-view reconstruction framework for recovering complete, large-scale 3D scene meshes from unposed RGB images. WorldRecon uses a coarse, noisy global point cloud and camera poses estimated from the input images by a reconstruction model as a global scaffold for whole-scene generation and partitions it into overlapping spatial blocks. To robustly leverage these imperfect geometric priors, we equip the native 3D generative model TRELLIS.2 with a dedicated reconstruction-based conditioning architecture that generates each block from its local point-cloud crop and block-relevant image observations, producing sparse structure, detailed geometry, and PBR materials. To maintain scene-level coherence, we introduce neighbour-aware latent inpainting and a causal world-generation procedure that propagates structural, geometric, and material context across overlapping blocks. Together, these designs scale multi-view generative reconstruction to large-scale scenes, yielding coherent, unified meshes. Extensive experiments demonstrate that WorldRecon achieves state-of-the-art reconstruction performance, reducing Chamfer distance by 14.9% and 43.1% while improving F-score by 17.3% and 12.0% over the strongest baselines on synthetic and real-world indoor scenes, respectively, thereby demonstrating faithful and complete generative reconstruction as well as strong sim-to-real generalization. Project page: this https URL .
2610.18846.abstract_zh: 从未标定姿态的多视角图像重建完整、高质量的大尺度场景网格，既要忠实于观测几何，也要合理补全未观测或稀疏采集的表面。我们提出 WorldRecon，一种从无位姿 RGB 图像恢复完整大尺度 3D 场景网格的生成式多视角重建框架。它先用重建模型从输入估计相机位姿和粗糙、带噪的全局点云，以之作为全场景生成骨架，再划分为重叠空间块。为稳健利用不完美几何先验，我们给原生 3D 生成模型 TRELLIS.2 加入专门的重建条件架构：依据每块的局部点云和相关图像观测，生成稀疏结构、细致几何和 PBR 材料。为维持场景级连贯性，方法还采用邻块感知潜空间修补和因果世界生成流程，在重叠块间传播结构、几何与材料上下文。这些设计让多视角生成重建扩展到大场景，产出统一、连贯的网格。大量实验表明，在合成及真实室内场景上，相比最强基线，Chamfer 距离分别降低 14.9% 与 43.1%，F-score 分别提高 17.3% 与 12.0%，显示出忠实且完整的生成重建以及较强的 sim-to-real 泛化。项目页见论文。

2610.15854.abstract_en: Grounded spatial reasoning about indoor scenes rests on a geometric reconstruction that the multimodal system does not itself produce. Feed-forward multi-view reconstruction models operate under a fixed view budget, making frame selection a critical upstream decision. We show that under this setting the conventional preference for sharp frames can be actively harmful. Across nine handheld room scans, selecting the sharpest 16 of 200 candidate frames is the worst strategy we test, reaching 48\% room dimension error where uniform temporal sampling reaches 3\%. We trace this failure to a coupling between image quality and camera motion: sharp frames tend to occur during slow motion and therefore concentrate the selection in a narrow angular region, leaving $192^\circ$ of the room unobserved in the case we illustrate and over $300^\circ$ in the worst cells. A $2\times2$ factorial experiment that independently manipulates viewpoint spread and per-frame sharpness shows that spread has roughly three times the main effect of quality, and that blurry but well spread selections outperform sharp but clustered selections in 8 of 9 captures. The advantage also diminishes as the frame budget increases and angular coverage saturates, consistent with this mechanism. Finally, we ask whether the failure is detectable at inference: the reconstruction model's multi-view consistency score increases with reconstruction error, while a vision-language model given the same frames reports confidence unrelated to its own spatial estimation error. Under small view budgets, viewpoint coverage is a more important constraint than per-frame image quality, and neither uncertainty signal available at inference reveals this upstream failure.
2610.15854.abstract_zh: 室内场景的空间推理依赖几何重建，而多模态系统通常并不亲自生成该重建。前馈式多视角重建模型受固定视角预算约束，因此如何选帧很关键。我们表明，在这一设置下，偏爱清晰帧可能反而有害：在九段手持室内扫描中，从 200 个候选帧选最清晰的 16 帧，是受测策略中最差的，房间尺寸误差达到 48%，而均匀时间采样仅为 3%。原因在于图像质量与相机运动耦合：清晰帧倾向于出现在缓慢运动时，因而聚集于狭窄角度；在一个示例中留下 192 度房间视角未观测，在最差单元中超过 300 度。独立操纵视角分布和逐帧清晰度的 2×2 因子实验显示，分布范围的主效应约为质量的三倍；在九次采集中，有八次模糊但分散的选帧胜过清晰但聚集的选帧。随着帧预算增加、角覆盖饱和，这一优势减弱，与上述机制一致。最后，我们检验推理时能否发现失败：重建模型的多视角一致性分数反而随重建误差升高，而看同一组帧的视觉语言模型所报置信度与自身空间估计误差无关。视角预算较小时，视角覆盖比单帧质量更重要，现有两种推理时不确定性信号都未揭示这项上游失败。

2610.16945.abstract_en: Recent advances in multimodal foundation models, exemplified by GPT-6 Astra, raise the prospect of general-purpose embodied reasoning and planning. Using Internet videos for embodied pretraining calls for reliable physical-scale annotations. Yet visual geometry foundation models often recover scene structure and camera motion without reliable metric scale. We show that uncertain size priors of familiar objects can jointly constrain a reconstruction's shared scale. Building on this insight, we present UniMetric, a universal and training-free metric scale recovery framework for geometry foundation models, without additional sensors or task-specific metric supervision. Specifically, Metric Prior Acquisition elicits object height intervals from a vision-language model. Semantic-Geometric Alignment measures reconstructed object heights along the estimated support-surface normal in each frame and converts the priors into scale intervals. Global Scale Recovery reconciles these intervals through a convex objective, yielding a jointly feasible scale when they overlap and a unique compromise otherwise. The estimated sequence-level scale is applied uniformly to reconstructed points and camera translations. Controlled experiments with real VLM priors show that combining observations improves scale accuracy with exact relative object heights. To evaluate metric accuracy on GFM reconstructions without ground-truth scale alignment, we introduce MetricBench, covering twelve embodied, driving, and roadside subsets with sensor-derived ground truth. Across nine geometry foundation models, UniMetric reduces mean depth Abs Rel, reconstruction Chamfer distance, and trajectory error by 54.2%, 83.8%, and 65.6%, respectively, improving every model on all three tasks at the suite level. We release the UniMetric code and MetricBench data.
2610.16945.abstract_zh: 近期多模态基础模型（以 GPT-6 Astra 为例）的进展，增加了通用具身推理与规划的可能性；用互联网视频进行具身预训练，需要可靠的物理尺度标注。但视觉几何基础模型常能恢复场景结构与相机运动，却不能可靠恢复度量尺度。我们表明，熟悉物体的不确定尺寸先验可联合约束整段重建的共享尺度。由此提出 UniMetric：无需训练、额外传感器或任务专用度量监督，便能为几何基础模型恢复尺度的通用框架。其 Metric Prior Acquisition 从视觉语言模型获取物体高度区间；Semantic-Geometric Alignment 沿估计的支撑表面法向测量逐帧重建物体高度，把先验换算为尺度区间；Global Scale Recovery 再用凸目标调和这些区间，重叠时得到共同可行尺度，否则给出唯一折中值。所得序列级尺度统一施加到重建点和相机平移。采用真实 VLM 先验的受控实验显示，合并多次观测可提高尺度精度，且相对物体高度保持精确。为不依赖真值尺度对齐而评估几何基础模型重建的度量精度，我们提出 MetricBench，含具身、驾驶和路侧的十二个带传感器真值的子集。对九个几何基础模型，UniMetric 在整个基准组上把平均深度 Abs Rel、重建 Chamfer 距离和轨迹误差分别降低 54.2%、83.8% 和 65.6%，并在三项任务上改善所有模型。我们发布 UniMetric 代码和 MetricBench 数据。

2610.16330.abstract_en: Feed-forward transformer models have driven remarkable progress in 3D vision,yet their quadratic complexity renders them impractical for long video sequences. Streaming 3D reconstruction addresses this bottleneck by processing frames sequen?tially with constant memory. However, existing recurrent architectures inevitably suffer from progressive degradation over long sequences, as they fail to account for the intrinsic reliability of observations and the accumulated confidence of the historical state, leading to severe error accumulation. To address these issues, we introduce BAT3R, a training-free Bayesian adaptation framework comprising two synergistic modules: State Innovation Gating (SIG) and Bayesian-guided Adaptive State Updating (BASU). SIG acts as a distributional regularizer that anchors state evolution to its geometric initialization, effectively arresting representational drift during long-term inference. Building on this, BASU reformulates state update as a recursive Bayesian inference process within a Kalman filtering framework. By jointly modeling the temporal reliability of observations via information-theoretic gain and spatial relevance via cross-attention maps, BASU achieves an asymmetric spatio-temporal state fusion: well-consolidated historical regions are protected from redundant updates, while genuinely novel scene content is aggressively incor?porated. Extensive experiments on standard benchmarks (7-Scenes, TUM, ScanNet, KITTI, etc.) demonstrate that BAT3R consistently outperforms state-of-the-art online 3D reconstruction methods, with the most significant gains observed on long sequences and complex scenes.
2610.16330.abstract_zh: 前馈式 Transformer 推动了 3D 视觉进展，但平方级复杂度使其难处理长视频。流式 3D 重建通过逐帧处理并维持常数内存缓解这一瓶颈；然而现有循环架构忽视观测本身的可靠性和历史状态累积置信度，长序列中会逐渐退化、误差累积。我们提出无需训练的贝叶斯自适应框架 BAT3R，含协同的 State Innovation Gating（SIG）与 Bayesian-guided Adaptive State Updating（BASU）。SIG 作为分布正则器，将状态演变锚定在几何初始化上，以遏止长时推理的表示漂移；BASU 则在卡尔曼滤波框架中，把状态更新改写为递归贝叶斯推断。它用信息论增益刻画观测的时间可靠性，用交叉注意力图刻画空间相关性，从而实现非对称时空状态融合：保护已充分建立的历史区域，避免重复更新，同时积极纳入真正新的场景内容。在 7-Scenes、TUM、ScanNet、KITTI 等标准基准上的大量实验显示，BAT3R 持续优于当时最佳在线 3D 重建方法，长序列和复杂场景的增益尤其明显。

2610.16146.abstract_en: We present Unravel, a training-free framework that turns a single image into an interactive 3D scene, where every object is an independent and movable asset. Existing generators either produce one entangled geometry in which no object can be moved, or predict all objects in one feed-forward pass, where a wrong guess cannot be detected or repaired. Unravel instead takes a different approach: it first takes the scene apart, and then puts it back together. Starting from the input image, an agentic harness that iteratively peels the image layer by layer, and adopts point cloud as major modality for spatial relationship recovery. Specifically, a vision-language model plans which objects are fully visible, an image editor removes them and restores the occluded regions. Every edit is verified before being incorporated into the reconstruction. This process gradually turns occluded parts of the scene into direct observation, allowing objects to be reconstructed when they are best exposed rather than hallucinated from the original image alone. The scene is then rebuilt in reverse removal order, so that the supporting objects are naturally placed before the objects they support. Since a single-view image only reveals part of an object, we treat the observed points as a lower bound on its size: an asset may grow to cover its points, but can not shrink away from them. Finally, we physically settle the reconstructed scene to remove floating objects and interpenetrations, followed by an agentic audit that corrects remaining placement errors. Extensive experiments on diverse indoor scenes show that Unravel recovers more objects, places them more faithfully, and produces scenes that are more physically-plausible than existing methods.
2610.16146.abstract_zh: 我们提出 Unravel：一种无需训练的框架，可把单张图像变成每个物体都是独立可移动资产的交互式 3D 场景。现有生成器要么生成物体无法单独移动的纠缠几何，要么一次前馈预测所有物体，使错误猜测难以检测和修复。Unravel 采取“先拆后装”的方式：从输入图像开始，由智能体流程逐层剥离图像，并主要利用点云恢复空间关系。具体而言，视觉语言模型规划哪些物体完全可见，图像编辑器移除这些物体并补全遮挡区域；每次编辑都先验证，再纳入重建。这一过程把原先被遮挡的场景部分逐步变为直接观测，让物体在暴露最充分时被重建，而不是仅从原图幻想。随后按移除的逆序重建场景，使支撑物先于其上物体摆放。鉴于单视角只显示物体的一部分，我们把已观测点视为尺寸下界：资产可以扩展覆盖这些点，但不能缩小到漏掉它们。最后让重建场景经过物理静置，消除悬浮物和相互穿透，并用智能体审查修正剩余放置错误。多种室内场景的大量实验表明，相比现有方法，Unravel 可恢复更多物体，摆放更忠实，场景也更符合物理直觉。

2610.19091.abstract_en: Contact-rich inverse problems require efficient gradients and reliable enforcement of non-penetration. Existing differentiable methods provide fast simulation and rigid-deformable coupling, but contact treatments based on penalties or velocity-level constraints can permit penetration or positional drift. Incremental Potential Contact (IPC) maintains non-penetration through geometric barriers and {continuous collision detection (CCD)}. However, repeated forward and backward evaluations remain costly in full-space finite-element (FEM) implementations, particularly when nearly rigid components retain many vertex {degrees of freedom (DoFs)}. We present DiffGIPC, a GPU-accelerated differentiable IPC framework for optimizing interacting deformable and nearly rigid bodies. Our affine-body derivatives enable {rest-shape} design, initial-state optimization, and articulated control while retaining only twelve motion DoFs per affine body. These gradients account for how changes in geometry, placement, and actuation affect other objects through collision and friction. We preserve these interactions in one coupled FEM-affine adjoint system per frame, reducing the backward-system size without discarding the dependencies that drive the inverse problem. GPU-optimized backward computation further reduces the cost of repeated gradient evaluations. A reusable PyTorch interface connects supported physical parameters to user-defined parameter maps and losses across design, identification, motion, placement, and articulated control. Experiments demonstrate peak speedups over DiffIPC of approximately 150.0x with full-space FEM and 4133.3x with affine bodies for combined forward simulation and backward differentiation.
2610.19091.abstract_zh: 富接触逆问题需要高效梯度和可靠的非穿透约束。现有可微方法虽可快速仿真并耦合刚体与可变形体，但基于惩罚或速度级约束的接触处理可能允许穿透或位置漂移。增量势接触（IPC）通过几何障碍函数与连续碰撞检测（CCD）保持非穿透；然而，在全空间有限元（FEM）实现中，反复前向和反向计算仍昂贵，尤其是近刚体部件保留大量顶点自由度时。我们提出 DiffGIPC：用于优化相互作用的可变形体与近刚体的 GPU 加速可微 IPC 框架。仿射体导数在每个仿射体仅保留 12 个运动自由度的同时，支持静止形状设计、初始状态优化和关节控制。这些梯度计入几何、放置和驱动的变化如何经碰撞与摩擦影响其他物体。我们在每帧的单个耦合 FEM–仿射伴随系统中保留这些相互作用，缩小反向系统规模而不丢弃驱动逆问题的依赖。GPU 优化的反向计算进一步降低重复求梯度成本。可复用的 PyTorch 接口把受支持的物理参数接到用户定义的参数映射和损失，覆盖设计、辨识、运动、放置和关节控制。实验表明，前向仿真加反向微分相对 DiffIPC 的峰值加速，在全空间 FEM 下约为 150.0 倍，在仿射体下约为 4133.3 倍。

2610.20330.abstract_en: Synthetic active surfaces are usually designed to attain a prescribed static configuration, with dynamic shape changes typically requiring modulation of the actuation. We show that thin active shells can instead sustain dynamic morphing under a steady stimulus by harnessing flutter instability. We focus on polyelectrolyte hydrogel shells immersed in a viscous fluid and subjected to a constant and uniform electric field, and specialize the non-Euclidean framework for thin structures to account for field-induced activity through a spontaneous curvature evolving in time with the system configuration. Examining elliptic plates and cylindrical shells as test cases, we integrate linear stability analyses with nonlinear simulations to first locate the onset of flutter and then unveil the resulting dynamics, characterized by thrust-generating shape changes. In all cases, the emergent behavior stems from the interplay between active reconfiguration and elasticity in the fluid environment. For plates, the problem is purely flexural in the linear regime, while the competition between bending and stretching becomes crucial in selecting the ensuing shapes and swimming trajectories at large deformations. Conversely, for cylindrical shells bending and stretching are coupled at all levels, with the latter becoming essential to sustain flutter. Experiments on millimeter-sized hydrogel plates provide tangible support for our theoretical findings through shape reconstructions performed by combining digital image correlation with optical stereo microscopy. Flutter thus offers a route to untethered soft robotic and microfluidic devices based on active shells and operating under a stimulus carrying neither an intrinsic frequency nor a characteristic length scale.
2610.20330.abstract_zh: 合成主动表面通常被设计为达到指定静态构型，而动态形状变化一般需要调制驱动。我们表明，薄主动壳体可利用颤振失稳，在恒定刺激下维持动态形变。研究对象是浸于黏性流体、受到恒定均匀电场作用的聚电解质水凝胶壳体；我们扩展薄结构的非欧几何框架，以随系统构型和时间演化的自发曲率描述电场诱导的活动。以椭圆板和圆柱壳为例，我们结合线性稳定性分析与非线性仿真，先确定颤振起点，再揭示由产生推力的形状变化表征的后续动力学。所有情况下，涌现行为都源于流体环境中主动重构与弹性的相互作用。对板而言，线性阶段的问题是纯弯曲的，而大形变下弯曲与拉伸的竞争决定后续形状和游动轨迹；对圆柱壳，弯曲与拉伸在所有层级都耦合，且拉伸是维持颤振的关键。毫米尺度水凝胶板实验通过结合数字图像相关与光学体视显微镜的形状重建，为理论结果提供实验证据。因此，颤振为基于主动壳体、在没有固有频率或特征长度尺度的刺激下工作的无系绳软机器人和微流体器件提供了路径。

2610.20560.abstract_en: 3D object composition is pivotal to digital content creation and robot simulation, while also serving as a critical testbed for physical intelligence in foundation models. Previous methods either leverage large language models to directly predict object coordinates, or utilize generative diffusion priors to synthesize composite images for visual alignment, both of which rely on static priors in digital spaces. However, these methods consistently struggle with complex compositions such as precise hanging, gravity-driven settling and hidden containment, as these tasks require interactive construction processes involving global planning, fine-grained alignment, and physical simulation. To address these challenges, we propose PhySGA, a Physics-Space Grounded Agentic Framework for 3D composition via agent exploration and physical simulation, enabling the universal interactive assembly of rigid, articulated, and deformable objects. Directly applying vanilla LLMs or VLMs to this task proves insufficient, as current models inherently lack grounded physical understanding and interactive construction experience. To overcome this limitation, we design a collaborative feedforward-feedback architecture: an Assembly Agent focuses on geometric and kinematic reasoning for global step planning and coarse adjustment, while a Critic Agent reasons over contact dynamics for simulator state diagnosis and fine-grained closed-loop correction. Furthermore, Action Routers map semantic planning and analysis onto executable physical primitives within the simulator, while a task-specific Self-Evolving Skill Library distills historical trial-and-error feedback into reusable experiences, boosting success rates and minimizing exploration attempts. Extensive experiments within Isaac Sim demonstrate that PhySGA significantly surpasses existing methods in relation fidelity, physical plausibility, and visual quality.
2610.20560.abstract_zh: 3D 物体组合既是数字内容创作和机器人仿真的关键，也可检验基础模型的物理智能。以往方法或让大语言模型直接预测物体坐标，或依赖生成扩散先验合成组合图像用于视觉对齐；两者都依赖数字空间中的静态先验，因此在精确悬挂、重力沉降和隐蔽容纳等复杂组合中遇到困难。这些任务需要全局规划、精细对齐和物理仿真构成的交互式搭建过程。为此，我们提出 PhySGA，一种通过智能体探索和物理仿真进行 3D 组合的物理空间锚定框架，支持刚体、关节体和可变形体的通用交互式装配。直接使用普通 LLM 或 VLM 不足以完成该任务，因为当前模型缺乏扎根于物理的理解和交互搭建经验。我们设计前馈与反馈协作架构：Assembly Agent 负责几何和运动学推理、全局步骤规划及粗调整；Critic Agent 推理接触动力学，以诊断仿真器状态并作细粒度闭环修正。Action Routers 将语义规划和分析映射为仿真器内可执行的物理基元；任务专用的自演化技能库把历史试错反馈提炼为可复用经验，以提高成功率并减少探索次数。Isaac Sim 中的大量实验显示，PhySGA 在关系保真度、物理合理性和视觉质量上显著优于现有方法。

2610.19336.abstract_en: Digital twins are increasingly used in robotics to simulate interactions, predict action outcomes, and support planning. However, constructing accurate digital twins requires precise estimates of physical properties such as mass, friction, and center of mass, which are often difficult to obtain in real-world environments. We propose probabilistic digital twins, which represent uncertain physical properties as probability distributions rather than fixed values. By simulating actions across these distributions, the twin predicts a range of possible outcomes and their likelihoods. These probabilistic simulations can guide both human and robot actions by identifying actions that are effective despite physical uncertainty. We demonstrate this framework through human-robot interaction scenarios, including interfaces that communicate simulated outcomes to users and robot planning strategies that explicitly account for uncertainty.
2610.19336.abstract_zh: 数字孪生越来越多地用于机器人交互仿真、动作结果预测和规划，但构建准确孪生体需要精确估计质量、摩擦和质心等物理属性，而这些量在真实环境中往往难以取得。我们提出概率式数字孪生：把不确定的物理属性表示为概率分布，而非固定数值。通过在这些分布上仿真动作，孪生体预测可能结果的范围及其发生概率。概率仿真可识别在物理不确定性下仍有效的动作，从而指导人和机器人。我们通过人机交互场景展示该框架，包括向用户传达仿真结果的界面，以及显式考虑不确定性的机器人规划策略。

2610.19627.abstract_en: Differentiable reinforcement learning shows strong promise for robot policy learning, but its application to legged locomotion has remained limited to blind walking or simulated 2D tasks. Extending it to end-to-end visual obstacle avoidance is challenging because hard collision constraints and early termination upon contact corrupt first-order gradients, trapping optimizers in local minima. We present E2DRL, which addresses this with a soft differentiable obstacle-interaction formulation: penetration penalties across multiple body keypoints with velocity-conditioned stop-gradient shaping to provide the first-order training signals for 3D obstacle avoidance. To realize a deployable perception-control system, a privileged teacher trained via Soft Analytic Policy Optimization (SAPO) in a differentiable simulator is distilled into a recurrent depth-based student via DAgger, then blended with a base locomotion policy using a terrain-aware gating module for deployment. In simulation, E2DRL achieves higher sample efficiency than PPO and demonstrates superior velocity-tracking performance and 3D obstacle-avoidance capability compared with both PPO and Duality-based DCBF NMPC. We present the first sim-to-real validation of end-to-end differentiable RL for 3D obstacle avoidance on a Unitree Go2 in static and dynamic environments.
2610.19627.abstract_zh: 可微强化学习在机器人策略学习中前景可观，但此前在足式运动中的应用仍限于盲行或仿真的 2D 任务。把它扩展到端到端视觉避障很难：硬碰撞约束和接触后的提前终止会破坏一阶梯度，使优化器陷入局部极小。我们提出 E2DRL，以软性的可微障碍物交互形式解决该问题：对多个机体关键点施加穿透惩罚，并用以速度为条件的 stop-gradient 塑形，为 3D 避障提供一阶训练信号。为得到可部署的感知控制系统，我们在可微仿真器中用 Soft Analytic Policy Optimization（SAPO）训练特权教师，经 DAgger 蒸馏成基于深度的循环学生策略，再以地形感知门控模块把它与基础运动策略融合部署。在仿真中，E2DRL 比 PPO 有更高样本效率，且速度跟踪和 3D 避障能力优于 PPO 与基于对偶的 DCBF NMPC。我们还在静态和动态环境中的 Unitree Go2 上，给出端到端可微强化学习用于 3D 避障的首次 sim-to-real 验证。

2610.18991.abstract_en: Humanoid policies trained in simulation can transfer qualitatively to hardware while failing to transfer the force interactions learned during training, compromising torque efficiency, load regulation, and robustness to impacts. This failure can arise from actuator sim-to-real gaps because forces depend on actuator torques. We introduce Contact-UAN, a residual world model that preserves a simulator's physics priors while correcting actuator dynamics to align simulated rollouts with recorded hardware rollouts. For humanoid motion with contact, this requires contact-consistent replay: if hardware playback in simulation begins with misaligned contact wrenches, the residual model learns to correct reset artifacts rather than actuator discrepancies. Using only onboard proprioception, Contact-UAN infers the simulator-side stance-foot pose needed to initialize replay with consistent contact forces. We show that a UAN trained on 6.5 minutes of real-world walking data generalizes to tasks that benefit from accurate force and impulse regulation and produces policies that transfer seamlessly to the real world, yielding 20% lower running torque, 43% lower force-tracking error, extreme compliance, accurate impedance control, and dynamic, robust jumps.
2610.18991.abstract_zh: 在仿真中训练的人形机器人策略可能看似转移到了硬件，却未能转移训练时学到的力交互，从而损害力矩效率、负载调节和抗冲击能力。原因之一是执行器的 sim-to-real 差异，因为力取决于执行器力矩。我们提出 Contact-UAN：一种保留仿真器物理先验、同时修正执行器动力学的残差世界模型，使仿真轨迹与硬件记录对齐。对有接触的人形运动，这需要接触一致的重放：如果仿真中的硬件轨迹回放从错误对齐的接触力矩开始，残差模型就会学习修正重置伪影，而不是执行器差异。Contact-UAN 仅用机载本体感觉推断仿真器一侧的支撑脚姿态，以一致的接触力初始化重放。我们表明，用 6.5 分钟真实步行数据训练的 UAN 可泛化到依赖准确力和冲量调节的任务，使策略顺利转移到真实世界，带来跑步力矩降低 20%、力跟踪误差降低 43%，以及高度柔顺性、准确阻抗控制和动态稳健跳跃。

2610.19541.abstract_en: Image-goal navigation requires a global planner that connects visually specified endpoints while providing observations that a local policy can follow. Three-dimensional Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) provides map-registered RGB, opacity, and depth renderings, but does not explicitly encode navigable topology. We introduce GS-PRM, a Gaussian visual roadmap whose milestones, local connections, and visual references are constructed directly through 3DGS rendering without deriving an occupancy grid or signed distance field. We define render-based collision-free (RC-free) configurations and paths. Panoramic depth supplies conservative clearance for milestone validation and adaptive coverage, while edge-aligned orthographic rendering tests the robot's swept volume. We establish conditional soundness and sufficient conditions for deterministic query completeness and probabilistic construction completeness of GS-PRM. To validate the performance of GS-PRM, we conduct experiments in both simulated and real-world environments, demonstrating long-horizon navigation using goal-conditioned policies guided by GS-PRM. Compared with a state-of-the-art 3DGS-based navigation system, our GS-PRM-based navigation system achieves up to a twice higher average success rate and reduces travel time by up to 57.2% when both systems complete the navigation task.
2610.19541.abstract_zh: 图像目标导航需要能连接视觉指定终点的全局规划器，同时为局部策略提供可跟随的观测。3D Gaussian Splatting（3DGS）提供与地图配准的 RGB、不透明度和深度渲染，却不显式编码可通行拓扑。我们提出 GS-PRM：直接通过 3DGS 渲染建立里程碑、局部连接和视觉参考的高斯视觉路图，无需导出占据栅格或有符号距离场。我们定义基于渲染的无碰撞（RC-free）构型和路径。全景深度为里程碑验证和自适应覆盖提供保守的净空估计，而沿边对齐的正交渲染检查机器人扫掠体积。我们给出条件可靠性，以及确定性查询完备性和概率构图完备性的充分条件。仿真与真实环境实验展示了由 GS-PRM 引导目标条件策略的长时程导航。与先进的 3DGS 导航系统相比，在两个系统都完成任务的情况下，GS-PRM 系统的平均成功率最高可达到其两倍，行进时间最多降低 57.2%。

2610.19847.abstract_en: We address inverse rendering with 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) by introducing explicit visibility modeling for relighting as well as material and light decomposition. Our approach augments the standard rasterized 3DGS pipeline with a sparse visibility oracle that estimates transmittance-weighted occlusion for Gaussian primitives from sampled lighting directions. This oracle is implemented using a point-based ray tracer accelerated by a bounding volume hierarchy (BVH) and queried sparsely within the inverse-rendering objectives, while the original 3DGS loop is retained for training efficiency, interactive visualization, and tooling compatibility. Shading follows a physically based rendering (PBR) formulation with a principled microfacet bidirectional reflectance distribution function (BRDF) and low-resolution high-dynamic-range (HDR) environment maps. We evaluate our method on the TensoIR synthetic dataset against baselines based on neural radiance fields (NeRFs), tensor representations, and 3DGS. The results show competitive performance and improvements over several earlier baselines for novel-view synthesis (NVS), albedo reconstruction, and relighting. Ablations indicate that explicit visibility modeling is an important contributor to relighting and material-illumination disentanglement, while pure PBR supervision can favor appearance fitting in NVS. Overall, the findings suggest that sparse, point-based visibility queries effectively complement rasterized splatting for inverse rendering while preserving the practical advantages of the 3DGS ecosystem.
2610.19847.abstract_zh: 我们在 3D Gaussian Splatting（3DGS）逆渲染中引入显式可见性建模，用于重光照以及材质和光照分解。方法在标准光栅化 3DGS 流程中加入稀疏可见性查询器，从采样光照方向估计高斯基元的透射率加权遮挡。查询器由包围体层次结构（BVH）加速的点式光线追踪器实现，并在逆渲染目标中稀疏调用；原有 3DGS 循环得以保留，以维持训练效率、交互可视化和工具兼容性。着色采用物理渲染（PBR）形式，包括有原理依据的微表面双向反射分布函数（BRDF）和低分辨率高动态范围（HDR）环境图。我们在 TensoIR 合成数据集上，与基于 NeRF、张量表示和 3DGS 的基线比较。结果在新视角合成（NVS）、反照率重建和重光照上具有竞争力，并优于若干较早基线。消融表明显式可见性是重光照及材质—照明解耦的重要因素，而单纯 PBR 监督可能偏向在 NVS 中拟合外观。总体上，稀疏点式可见性查询可有效补充光栅化 splatting 逆渲染，同时保留 3DGS 生态的实用优势。

2610.19681.abstract_en: Accurate 3D reconstruction in real-world environments remains a significant challenge due to the coexistence of reflective and non-reflective surfaces, which pose distinct modeling demands. Existing methods often treat these surface types separately, limiting their generalizability and physical plausibility. To bridge this gap, we propose MicroSDF, a novel neural implicit framework that facilitates geometry and reflectance modeling through microfacet theory. Our approach incorporates three core innovations: (i) a microfacet-guided geometry model that extracts multi-scale surface normals (macroscopic and microfacet) from a signed distance field (SDF), regularized by a proposed microfacet normal consistency loss to enforce physically plausible surface orientations; (ii) an enhanced dual-branch color model, where the specular branch leverages the microfacet normals to model high-frequency reflectance, and the vanilla branch, unlike prior works, uses reflection direction (instead of viewing direction) to better model diffuse and low-frequency specular components; and (iii) a detection-guided color blending strategy that adaptively fuses the color outputs based on reflection priors, providing more physically intuitive blending than implicitly learned blending weights. Combined with a tailored multi-stage optimization scheme, the proposed MicroSDF achieves robust and high-fidelity reconstruction across reflective and non-reflective surfaces. Extensive experiments on DTU, Shiny Blender, Ref-NeRF, and DeepVoxels datasets demonstrate state-of-the-art performance, establishing a new direction for physically grounded neural reconstruction.
2610.19681.abstract_zh: 真实环境中，反光和非反光表面并存，对 3D 重建提出不同建模需求。现有方法通常分别处理这两类表面，限制泛化性和物理合理性。我们提出 MicroSDF：通过微表面理论联合建模几何与反射率的神经隐式框架。方法有三项核心设计：（i）微表面引导的几何模型从有符号距离场（SDF）提取宏观和微表面多尺度法线，并用提出的微表面法线一致性损失正则化，以约束物理合理的表面朝向；（ii）增强的双分支颜色模型中，镜面分支用微表面法线建模高频反射，基础分支则不同于以往工作，使用反射方向而非观察方向建模漫反射和低频镜面成分；（iii）检测引导的颜色混合依据反射先验自适应融合颜色输出，比隐式学习的混合权重更符合物理直觉。结合专门的多阶段优化方案，MicroSDF 对反光和非反光表面均实现稳健、高保真重建。在 DTU、Shiny Blender、Ref-NeRF 和 DeepVoxels 上的大量实验显示达到当前最佳表现，为有物理依据的神经重建提供了新方向。

2610.20336.abstract_en: Scaling embodied robot learning requires large and diverse manipulation datasets, but collecting real-world demonstrations remains expensive in human effort and robot time. Simulation provides a scalable alternative, yet converting a real workspace into a robot-learning-ready environment still requires substantial manual effort for object extraction, asset processing, coordinate calibration, and trajectory specification. We present AutoRSR, a highly automated real-to-sim-to real framework that converts scanned real-world workspaces into reusable embodied simulation assets and scalable manipulation data. Given multi-view observations, robot states, and open-vocabulary semantic queries, AutoRSR reconstructs the workspace, extracts individual object assets, and automatically registers the reconstructed scene to the robot base frame at metric scale. Starting from a small number of reference motions, AutoRSR then generates executable manipulation trajectories and scales them through trajectory interpolation and domain randomization. After workspace scanning and semantic queries, the remaining pipeline requires no manual object annotation, scene-to-robot calibration, or robot teleoperation. Across three real-world manipulation tasks, policies trained on 1K automatically generated episodes per task achieve 73.3--86.7% real-world success rates, comparable to pi 0.5 trained from 150 human teleoperated demonstrations, while reducing the human time required for data generation by an order of magnitude. These results demonstrate that real-world observations can be converted into metrically aligned, executable, and scalable simulation data with substantially reduced human effort.
2610.20336.abstract_zh: 大规模具身机器人学习需要多样的操作数据，但真实示教耗费人力和机器人时间。仿真虽能扩展数据，仍需大量人工完成真实工作空间到可用于机器人学习环境的物体提取、资产处理、坐标校准和轨迹指定。我们提出 AutoRSR：把扫描得到的真实工作空间转换成可复用具身仿真资产和可扩展操作数据的高度自动化 real-to-sim-to-real 框架。给定多视角观测、机器人状态和开放词汇语义查询，AutoRSR 重建工作空间、提取单个物体资产，并自动将重建场景以米制尺度配准到机器人基坐标系。从少量参考运动出发，它生成可执行操作轨迹，再通过轨迹插值和领域随机化扩展数据。在工作空间扫描和语义查询后，其余流程无需人工物体标注、场景到机器人的校准或机器人遥操作。在三项真实操作任务中，每项使用 1K 个自动生成 episode 训练的策略取得 73.3%–86.7% 的真实成功率，与使用 150 条人工遥操作示教训练的 pi 0.5 相当，同时使数据生成所需人工时间降低一个数量级。结果表明，真实观测可用大幅降低的人力成本转为米制对齐、可执行且可扩展的仿真数据。

2610.20552.abstract_en: We present KinoGen, a framework that synthesizes customizable humanoid loco-manipulation references through kinematically grounded video generation. KinoGen conditions a pretrained video generator on calibrated renders of the target robot and object in a simulated task instance and recovers the reference by fitting the same models to the generated two-view video, so that the reference lies in the robot configuration space by construction without a human body proxy or retargeting. Body, hand, and object priors initialize the reconstruction, and direct optimization against cross-view evidence refines it. Since an edited keyframe is simply another rendered state, a user can prescribe a goal object pose, regenerate the video around the edited keyframe, and obtain a reference that satisfies the pose exactly. Across eight loco-manipulation tasks, KinoGen yields lower penetration and foot skating than video-based baselines and preserves over 90% of annotated contacts, and its customized references satisfy every prescribed target with substantially less penetration than direct interpolation. Tracking policies trained on the synthesized references are deployed on a Unitree G1 humanoid with dexterous hands. Project webpage:  this https URL .
2610.20552.abstract_zh: 我们提出 KinoGen：通过运动学约束的视频生成来合成可定制的人形机器人移动操作参考。KinoGen 以仿真任务实例中目标机器人和物体的校准渲染为条件驱动预训练视频生成器，再把同一模型拟合到生成的双视角视频以恢复参考；由此参考在构造上位于机器人的构型空间中，不需要人体代理或重定向。身体、手和物体先验初始化重建，针对跨视角证据的直接优化进一步细化结果。由于编辑后的关键帧也只是另一种渲染状态，用户可以指定目标物体姿态，在该关键帧附近重新生成视频，得到精确满足姿态的参考。在八项移动操作任务中，KinoGen 相比视频基线产生更少穿透和足部打滑，保留了超过 90% 的标注接触；定制参考满足全部指定目标，且穿透显著少于直接插值。用合成参考训练的跟踪策略部署在配有灵巧手的 Unitree G1 人形机器人上。 项目页见原摘要所附链接。

2610.19604.abstract_en: Force feedback provides vision-language-action (VLA) policies with physical observations that can guide action selection and execution. However, differences in tasks, demonstrations, and control settings across existing systems hinder reliable comparisons of force integration designs. We introduce ForceBench, a simulation benchmark for evaluating six-axis wrist-force integration under a unified protocol. ForceBench combines eight tasks spanning physical-property inference, resistance-dependent interaction, and contact-rich assembly with 1,600 synchronized demonstrations and task-specific success criteria. We compare one no-force baseline and six force integration designs on a shared $\pi_{0.5}$ backbone. Prompt Fusion achieves the highest observed mean simulation success of 35.31%, compared with 23.25% for the baseline, and improves success rates across all three task categories. Predictive and temporal gains in simulation concentrate on physical-property inference, while both temporal designs underperform the baseline on assembly. Real-world evaluation of eight systems across five tasks supports the main qualitative trends: Prompt Fusion and Dual-Path Fusion achieve 63.00% mean success, compared with 40.00% for the baseline, but only Prompt Fusion improves every task. These findings support ForceBench's practical value for identifying the benefits and limitations of force integration across manipulation demands. The project page is available at  this https URL .
2610.19604.abstract_zh: 力反馈可向视觉—语言—动作（VLA）策略提供物理观测，引导动作选择和执行；但不同系统在任务、示教和控制设置上的差异妨碍了可靠比较。我们提出 ForceBench，在统一协议下评估六轴腕部力信息融合的仿真基准。它包含横跨物理属性推断、依赖阻力的交互和富接触装配的八项任务、1,600 条同步示教及任务专属成功标准。我们在共同的 $\pi_{0.5}$ 主干上比较一个无力基线和六种融合设计。Prompt Fusion 在仿真中的平均成功率最高，为 35.31%，无力基线为 23.25%，且在三个任务类别都提高成功率。仿真中的预测和时序收益集中于物理属性推断，而两种时序设计在装配上均低于基线。对五项任务、八个系统的真实评测支持主要定性趋势：Prompt Fusion 和 Dual-Path Fusion 平均成功率均为 63.00%，基线为 40.00%，但只有 Prompt Fusion 在每项任务上都有提升。这些结果支持 ForceBench 用于识别不同操作需求下力信息融合的收益与局限。 项目页见原摘要所附链接。

2610.19155.abstract_en: Human demonstrations offer a scalable alternative to costly robot data collection for dexterous manipulation, but most human datasets lack force measurements. Dexterous manipulation requires not only visual and proprioceptive understanding but also the ability to anticipate and regulate interaction forces. To scale force-aware human-robot co-training, we introduce EgoForce, a large-scale human tactile dataset capturing force-rich manipulation experience, and combine it with robot demonstrations for pretraining. We present FACT, a robot foundation model that cascades from prospective visual planning to force-aware refinement for dexterous manipulation. FACT comprises two jointly trained components. A Track-Guided Coarse Planner jointly predicts actions, future video, and visual tracks. Future video and visual tracks also provide a shared task representation that facilitates cross-embodiment knowledge transfer and coarse action generation. Building on this coarse plan, a Force-Action Joint Refiner jointly predicts future force and refines the coarse action, allowing anticipated force and action to shape each other during refinement. We evaluate the model on ten tasks requiring fine-grained coordination and force feedback, including tool use, musical instruments, and precision laboratory procedures. Using as few as 10 robot trajectories with 90 human trajectories for fine-tuning, FACT outperforms both baselines, with success-rate gains of up to 60 percentage points over T-Rex. Ablations show that force supervision in human pretraining data is crucial for downstream robot performance after fine-tuning, while visual track prediction and training with future-force prediction improve dexterous execution.
