Experiments varying the human-robot data ratio during fine-tuning further suggest that FACT learns from human demonstrations nearly as effectively as from robot demonstrations.
2610.19155.abstract_zh: 人类示教为昂贵的机器人数据采集提供了可扩展替代，但多数人类数据集缺乏力测量。灵巧操作不仅需要视觉和本体感觉理解，还需要预测并调节交互力。为扩展有力感知的人机联合训练，我们提出记录富力操作经验的大规模人类触觉数据集 EgoForce，并结合机器人示教预训练。我们提出 FACT：从前瞻视觉规划逐级走向力感知细化的灵巧操作机器人基础模型。FACT 包含两个联合训练的组件。轨迹引导的粗规划器联合预测动作、未来视频和视觉轨迹；未来视频与视觉轨迹还提供共享任务表示，以促进跨形态知识转移和粗动作生成。在此基础上，力—动作联合细化器联合预测未来力并细化粗动作，使预期力和动作在细化中相互影响。我们在十项需要精细协调和力反馈的任务上评估，包括工具使用、乐器演奏和精密实验室操作。微调仅用 10 条机器人轨迹和 90 条人类轨迹时，FACT 优于两个基线，相比 T-Rex 的成功率最高提升 60 个百分点。消融表明，人类预训练数据中的力监督对微调后的机器人表现至关重要，视觉轨迹预测和未来力预测训练也改善灵巧执行。改变微调时人机数据比例的实验进一步表明，FACT 利用人类示教的效果接近利用机器人示教。

2610.19839.abstract_en: Robot-free collection with handheld interfaces enables scalable acquisition of human demonstrations for policy learning. However, existing handheld interfaces often provide limited intuitive force feedback, making contact-rich demonstration collection challenging for human operators. To address this, we present FOMI, a force-feedback manipulation interface with a scissor-shaped mechanism, which transmits object interaction forces directly to the operator's hands through actuation links without force sensors. This intuitive force feedback supports real-time action adjustment during robot-free collection of contact-rich demonstrations. Around FOMI, we build a demonstration collection system that integrates sensor calibration, data acquisition, and synchronization for robot-free collection. By further mapping pose changes and gripper opening of FOMI to robot end-effector poses and gripper commands, the system also supports teleoperation. Across four contact-rich tasks, FOMI improves collection efficiency by approximately 29% and 18% over the best baselines in robot-free collection and teleoperation, respectively. Demonstrations collected with FOMI in both modes enable policies to perform challenging contact-rich manipulation tasks with high success rates.
2610.19839.abstract_zh: 使用手持接口、不依赖机器人采集人类示教，可扩展策略学习数据；但现有接口通常缺乏直观的力反馈，使富接触示教采集对操作者很困难。为此，我们提出 FOMI：一种剪刀形机构的力反馈操作接口，无需力传感器，而是通过驱动连杆把物体交互力直接传到操作者双手。这种直观的力反馈支持人在无机器人采集时实时调整动作。围绕 FOMI，我们构建集成传感器校准、数据采集和同步的示教系统。进一步将 FOMI 的姿态变化和夹爪开合映射为机器人末端姿态与夹爪指令后，系统也支持遥操作。在四项富接触任务中，相比最强基线，FOMI 在无机器人采集和遥操作下的采集效率分别提高约 29% 和 18%。两种模式下采得的示教使策略能以较高成功率完成困难的富接触操作任务。

2610.19518.abstract_en: While multi-fingered dexterous robot hands have the potential to provide human-level dexterity, using them for functional manipulation remains difficult because task success depends on precise contact, coordinated arm-hand motion, and reactive recovery from execution errors. Precise contact depends on complex contact dynamics that are difficult to model accurately in simulation, motivating real-world learning. However, real-world demonstrations in the full arm-hand control space are costly and noisy because each trajectory must coordinate arm motion with high-DoF multi-finger contact. Small execution deviations can further cause slipped contact or premature force application, making recovery from off-nominal contact states important for robust execution. To deal with these challenges, we propose HiFun, a hierarchical real-world RL framework for functional dexterous manipulation tasks. Our key insight is to decouple the control complexity into a functional hand skill for precise contact execution and an arm-hand coordination policy for arm control and hand-skill activation. This design enables effective real-time human intervention for reactive recovery learning and efficient data collection with Dynamic Movement Primitive (DMP) augmentation. Across six real-world tasks on two dexterous hands, HiFun achieves 98.3% average success within one hour of online training and remains robust to dynamic disturbances. The project page is available at  this https URL .
2610.19518.abstract_zh: 多指灵巧手有望实现接近人类的灵巧性，但功能性操作仍很困难，因为任务成功依赖精确接触、协调的手臂—手部运动，以及执行出错后的反应式恢复。精确接触涉及难以在仿真中准确建模的复杂接触动力学，因此需要真实世界学习；但在完整手臂—手部控制空间中采集真实示教昂贵且噪声大，因为每条轨迹都要协调手臂运动与高自由度多指接触。微小的执行偏差还可能使接触滑脱或过早施力，因此从非标准接触状态中恢复很重要。我们提出 HiFun：面向功能性灵巧操作的分层真实世界强化学习框架。核心是把控制复杂性拆为执行精确接触的功能性手部技能，以及负责手臂控制和手部技能激活的协调策略。这使实时人工干预可用于学习反应式恢复，并借助动态运动基元（DMP）增强高效采集数据。在两种灵巧手的六项真实任务上，HiFun 在一小时在线训练内达到 98.3% 平均成功率，对动态扰动保持稳健。 项目页见原摘要所附链接。

2610.19479.abstract_en: Sim-and-real co-training is an effective way to scale robot learning by augmenting limited real-world demonstrations with simulation data. However, existing approaches typically treat simulators as fixed data sources, relying on uniform generation, offline retrieval, or manual parameter alignment by domain experts. We formulate \textit{Active Generative Simulation}: optimizing a simulator's data-generation distribution to maximize downstream real-world performance. To solve this problem, we propose MetaGenSim, a meta-learning framework that trains an auxiliary rater network via meta-gradients to automatically discover high-utility data-generation distributions within a user-specified simulation parameter space, without manual parameter alignment. Across simulation and real-world manipulation tasks, MetaGenSim outperforms uniform generation and retrieval baselines, achieves a 150% relative improvement in real-world full-task success over uniform generation, and matches expert manual alignment. We further show that distributions curated with a lightweight proxy policy transfer to VLA fine-tuning, and that MetaGenSim can exploit partial alignment through atomic skill stitching and object-receptacle composition when exact sim-and-real task alignment is unavailable. Project website:  this https URL
2610.19479.abstract_zh: 真实与仿真联合训练可用仿真数据扩充有限的真实示教，以扩展机器人学习。但现有做法多将仿真器视为固定数据源，依赖均匀生成、离线检索或专家手工对齐参数。我们提出“主动生成式仿真”：优化仿真器的数据生成分布，使下游真实表现最大化。为此，我们提出 MetaGenSim，一种元学习框架，通过元梯度训练辅助评分网络，在用户指定的仿真参数空间中自动寻找高效用的数据生成分布，无需人工参数对齐。在仿真和真实操作任务中，MetaGenSim 优于均匀生成与检索基线；相比均匀生成，真实全任务成功率相对提高 150%，并达到专家手工对齐的水平。我们还表明，轻量代理策略筛选出的分布可转移到 VLA 微调；当真实与仿真任务无法精确对齐时，MetaGenSim 可通过原子技能拼接和物体—容器组合利用部分对齐。 项目页见原摘要所附链接。

2610.19201.abstract_en: We present LidarVerse, a real-time unified LiDAR world model for sensor simulation across tasks and sensors. Existing LiDAR simulators largely follow one of two complementary paradigms: reconstruction-based methods preserve the geometry of a captured scene but require lengthy per-scene optimization, whereas generative methods amortize learning across data but lack the consistency needed for long-horizon rollouts. LidarVerse brings both paradigms into a single, unified conditional generative framework. A universal tokenizer maps LiDAR range sequences into a shared latent space, where a bidirectional teacher learns a common interface for conditioning on a LiDAR prefix, an HD-Map, a persistent spatial cache, and optionally, text. Varying the available scene evidence turns the same model into a generator of new worlds, a point-cloud forecaster, or a generalizable resimulator of observed scenes without per-scene optimization. We distill the teacher into a four-step autoregressive causal student and maintain both a rolling temporal K/V cache and a world-aligned spatial cache, enabling persistent long-horizon rollouts with real-time inference at 11 FPS on a single H100 GPU. LidarVerse achieves state-of-the-art performance on most reported metrics across all three evaluation protocols, while its tokenizer supports 32-, 64-, and 128-beam LiDAR and generalizes to an unseen scanning pattern. These results demonstrate that generative and reconstruction-grounded LiDAR simulation can be realized within one model, providing the core capabilities for future closed-loop sensor simulation.
2610.19201.abstract_zh: 我们提出 LidarVerse：一个跨任务和传感器、实时运行的统一 LiDAR 世界模型，用于传感器仿真。现有 LiDAR 仿真器主要有两类互补范式：基于重建的方法保留已采场景几何，却要逐场景长时间优化；生成式方法能跨数据摊销学习成本，但缺少长时程展开所需的一致性。LidarVerse 将两者纳入统一的条件生成框架。通用 tokenizer 把 LiDAR 距离序列映射到共享潜空间，双向教师学习以 LiDAR 前缀、高精地图、持久空间缓存以及可选文本为条件的共同接口。依场景证据的可用程度，同一模型可生成新世界、预测点云，或在不逐场景优化的情况下对已观测场景进行可泛化的再仿真。我们把教师蒸馏为四步自回归因果学生，并同时维持滚动时间 K/V 缓存和世界坐标对齐的空间缓存，使其可在单张 H100 GPU 上以 11 FPS 实时进行持久长时程展开。LidarVerse 在三项评测协议的大多数报告指标上达到当前最佳；其 tokenizer 支持 32、64 和 128 线 LiDAR，并泛化到未见过的扫描模式。结果表明，生成式与重建锚定的 LiDAR 仿真可在同一模型中实现，为未来闭环传感器仿真提供核心能力。

2610.19623.abstract_en: Single-image 3D reconstruction has advanced rapidly, yet standalone garments remain challenging due to thin-shell geometry, open boundaries, and layered structures. Existing datasets and evaluation protocols provide limited support for systematic evaluation in this setting. We introduce MagicGarment, a benchmark for single-image standalone 3D garment reconstruction with 1,518 professionally constructed assets across 17 composite garment types, aligned multimodal annotations, and a unified evaluation protocol. We further establish a garment-aware reference baseline by adapting a pretrained image-to-3D backbone at two levels: Grounded Semantic Refinement (GSR) provides garment-focused visual conditioning, while Flow-Time-Route LoRA (FTR-LoRA) adapts the frozen 3D generative backbone using flow-timestep, token-routing, and expert-load information. Experiments demonstrate MagicGarment's benchmark utility and the effectiveness of garment-aware adaptation. Project page:  this https URL .
2610.19623.abstract_zh: 单图像 3D 重建进展很快，但独立衣物仍因薄壳几何、开放边界和分层结构而困难。现有数据集与评测协议不足以系统评估这一情形。我们提出 MagicGarment：单图像独立衣物 3D 重建基准，包含 17 类复合衣物中的 1,518 个专业构建资产、对齐的多模态标注和统一评测协议。我们还通过两级适配预训练图像到 3D 主干，建立衣物感知的参考基线：Grounded Semantic Refinement（GSR）提供面向衣物的视觉条件；Flow-Time-Route LoRA（FTR-LoRA）利用流时间步、token 路由和专家负载信息，适配冻结的 3D 生成主干。实验展示了 MagicGarment 的基准用途及衣物感知适配的效果。 项目页见原摘要所附链接。

2610.20351.abstract_en: Human demonstrations are today used largely for pretraining vision-language-action models, with little ability to use the same data for target-embodiment or task-oriented training, which scalable deployment of robots in industrial and general environments depends on. A human demonstration recorded on a simple and scalable device such as a mobile phone can serve as post-training data for a robot whose body differs in structure and capability from the human who recorded it. This is made possible not by retargeting the hand's motion but the object's. A capture yields a body-free record: the object's pose over time, its contact intervals, and a reconstructed 3D object with provenance. Any robot, given as a URDF and a short descriptor, is solved against that record and scored in simulation against the demonstrated object motion as ground truth: the human-to-simulation leg of human-to-simulation-to-robot transfer, measured per robot. Each (robot, episode) pair gets one outcome: pass, failure with a named mode, or refusal, with its reason, before any motion. The method runs as a working system over a growing collection; the set analysed here is a sample of it: 42 captures solved on 8 robots, 157 pairs, of which 31.2% pass, 52.2% fail, 14.0% are refused and 2.5% are unauditable (kinematic feasibility, +/-50 mm / +/-15 deg, in simulation). Refusals held up: every pair the checks refuse on stored evidence yet ran anyway failed (13 of 13; 5 on a body whose public model welds its hand). A description file could not be shown to screen a robot: its outcomes were barely more predictable than guessing. No policy has yet been trained on the record. The record decides what a robot may post-train on; whether the policy then works on the real robot is the simulation-to-robot question, answered downstream.
2610.20351.abstract_zh: 人类示教目前主要用于视觉—语言—动作模型预训练，难以把同一数据用于目标机器人形态或任务定向的训练，而机器人在工业及一般环境中的规模部署需要这种能力。用手机等简单、可扩展设备记录的人类示教，即使目标机器人的身体结构和能力不同，也可能成为其后训练数据。关键是重定向物体而非手部运动。一次采集产生与身体无关的记录：物体随时间的姿态、接触区间，以及有来源记录的重建 3D 物体。给定任意机器人的 URDF 和简短描述，系统依据该记录求解，并在仿真中以示教物体运动为真值逐机器人评分；这是 human-to-simulation-to-robot 转移中按机器人测量的 human-to-simulation 阶段。每个“机器人、episode”配对在动作前得到一种结果：通过、带命名失败模式的失败，或附原因的拒绝。方法在持续增长的采集库上运行；本文分析其中样本：42 次采集、8 个机器人、157 个配对，31.2% 通过、52.2% 失败、14.0% 被拒绝、2.5% 无法审计（在仿真中按运动学可行性和 ±50 mm／±15° 判定）。拒绝检查得到验证：在存储证据上被拒却仍运行的 13 个配对全部失败，其中 5 个来自公开模型把手焊接固定的机器人。仅凭描述文件无法筛查机器人，其结果的可预测性几乎不高于猜测。尚未利用该记录训练任何策略；记录只决定机器人可以用哪些数据后训练，策略能否在真实机器人上工作仍是后续 simulation-to-robot 问题。

2610.20320.abstract_en: Large-scale robot learning increasingly relies on diverse human demonstrations, yet tactile manipulation data remain difficult to scale, and existing multimodal datasets often lack consistent quality control and structured supervision. We present TacClaw-Infinity, a large-scale structured Vision-Tactile-Language-Action (VTLA) dataset for contact-rich manipulation, collected with TacClaw, a tactile-enabled UMI-style handheld interface that records synchronized visual observations, fingertip tactile signals, and end-effector trajectories without requiring a target robot during data collection. TacClaw-Infinity is built through a distributed worldwide collection across homes, laboratories, industrial workplaces, retail stores, and outdoor environments including tasks contributed by academic and industrial collaborators. Together, these efforts yield over 10,000 hours, 1 million episodes, and 1 billion frames spanning more than 1,000 task types. We develop a scalable pipeline for trajectory reconstruction, multimodal quality control, embodiment-aware filtering, and structured annotation, covering contact-centric segmentation, subtask description, and spatial grounding. We validate TacClaw-Infinity at both the data and model levels: At the data level, we assess the collection interface, the action-space compatibility of the curated demonstrations, and the structured annotations, while for the model level, we demonstrate cross-embodiment transfer across three heterogeneous robots without robot-specific demonstrations.
2610.20320.abstract_zh: 大规模机器人学习越来越依赖多样的人类示教，但触觉操作数据难以大规模采集，现有多模态数据集也常缺乏统一质控和结构化监督。我们提出 TacClaw-Infinity：一个面向富接触操作的大规模结构化视觉—触觉—语言—动作（VTLA）数据集。它由 TacClaw 采集；这是一种带触觉的 UMI 式手持接口，可同步记录视觉观测、指尖触觉信号和末端轨迹，采集时不需要目标机器人。数据集通过全球分布式采集建立，覆盖住宅、实验室、工业场所、零售店及户外环境，并包含学术和工业合作者提供的任务。最终得到超过 10,000 小时、100 万个 episode、10 亿帧、超过 1,000 类任务。我们开发可扩展的轨迹重建、多模态质控、形态感知过滤和结构化标注流水线，标注涵盖以接触为中心的分段、子任务描述和空间定位。我们从数据与模型两个层面验证数据集：数据层面评估采集接口、筛选后示教与动作空间的兼容性及结构化标注；模型层面展示在没有机器人专用示教的情况下，跨三种异构机器人的形态转移。

2610.19089.abstract_en: Achieving human-like dexterous manipulation remains a central challenge in robotics. Learning from human hand-object interaction (HOI) datasets offers a promising pathway to diverse dexterous skills, yet existing physics-based approaches train specialist policies for individual trajectories, thereby limiting skill reuse at scale. We introduce DexMimic, a generalist dexterous hand-object tracking policy jointly trained across diverse HOI trajectories. Efficient joint training requires allocating each rollout to both an undertrained phase and a starting state that supports continued tracking. DexMimic realizes this insight through Value-Guided Reset Allocation, which adapts the initialization distribution online to prioritize difficult phases and select reset states with higher expected tracking returns. We further introduce a benchmark spanning training, fine-tuning, and generalization. Experiments show improved tracking success and training efficiency, faster fine-tuning, and the potential for zero-shot generalization to unseen trajectories and objects; larger training sets further improve efficiency and generalization. Finally, we validate DexMimic on a real-world dexterous manipulation platform.
2610.19089.abstract_zh: 实现类人的灵巧操作仍是机器人学核心挑战。人类手物交互（HOI）数据为学习多样灵巧技能提供路径，但现有基于物理的方法通常逐轨迹训练专门策略，限制了大规模技能复用。我们提出 DexMimic：跨多样 HOI 轨迹联合训练的通用灵巧手物跟踪策略。高效联合训练需要把每次 rollout 同时分配到训练不足的阶段和支持继续跟踪的起始状态。DexMimic 以 Value-Guided Reset Allocation 实现这一点：在线调整初始化分布，优先选择困难阶段，并选取预期跟踪回报较高的重置状态。我们还提出覆盖训练、微调和泛化的基准。实验显示更高的跟踪成功率和训练效率、更快的微调，以及对未见轨迹和物体零样本泛化的潜力；更大的训练集进一步提高效率和泛化。最后，我们在真实灵巧操作平台上验证 DexMimic。

2610.19753.abstract_en: Vision-language-action (VLA) models have shown strong potential for general-purpose robotic manipulation, but extending them to bimanual dexterous manipulation introduces a high-dimensional and structured action space. Existing bimanual VLA policies commonly concatenate right- and left-side arm--hand actions at each control timestep, leaving cross-hand interactions implicit within a single action vector. We introduce Coordi-$\pi$, a structured action representation for bimanual dexterous manipulation. Coordi-$\pi$ represents the right- and left-side arm--hand actions as individual action tokens and organizes them into an interleaved sequence, explicitly exposing the two sides within the action sequence. To explicitly encode hand identity and temporal synchronization in this interleaved representation, a learnable hand-identity embedding distinguishes the two sides, while sequence--control-timestep factorized rotary positional encoding (RoPE) separates sequence position from control timestep, allowing actions at the same control timestep to share a temporal coordinate while retaining distinct sequence positions. Across all five bimanual dexterous manipulation tasks in DexJoCo, Coordi-$\pi$ achieves state-of-the-art performance under both \textit{rand-obj} and \textit{rand-full}, improving the average success rate over $\pi_{0.5}$ from 31.9\% to 51.3\% and from 18.3\% to 32.3\%, respectively. Coordi-$\pi$ also consistently outperforms $\pi_{0.5}$ across four real-world bimanual dexterous manipulation tasks.
2610.19753.abstract_zh: 视觉—语言—动作（VLA）模型在通用机器人操作上很有潜力，但扩展到双手灵巧操作时会遇到高维且有结构的动作空间。现有双手 VLA 策略常在每个控制时刻拼接左右手臂和手部动作，把跨手相互作用隐含在单个动作向量中。我们提出 Coordi-$\pi$：一种结构化双手灵巧操作动作表示。它把左右手臂—手部动作分别表示为动作 token，并组织成交错序列，从而在动作序列中显式呈现两侧。为在该表示中编码手的身份和时间同步，可学习的手身份嵌入区分左右侧；将序列位置与控制时刻分解的旋转位置编码（RoPE），使同一控制时刻的动作共享时间坐标，同时保有不同序列位置。在 DexJoCo 的五项双手灵巧操作任务中，Coordi-$\pi$ 在 rand-obj 和 rand-full 两种设置下均达到当前最佳，相比 $\pi_{0.5}$，平均成功率分别从 31.9% 提高到 51.3%、从 18.3% 提高到 32.3%。在四项真实双手灵巧操作任务中，Coordi-$\pi$ 也持续优于 $\pi_{0.5}$。

2610.19993.abstract_en: Reconstruction of 3D structures using under-ice AUV video footage has been inaccurate, although it is not certain whether this is due to shortcomings in the methods or an inherent deficiency of the capture system. We test four different models for reconstruction on the same Antarctic under-ice AUV video (Icefin, Kamb Ice Stream): classical feature matching SfM, differentiable photometric splatting, volumetric depth fusion, and a pose-free feed-forward foundation model. All four fail, each in a distinct way: near-total registration yielding almost no structure, geometrically broken output despite healthy photometric metrics, a persistent coverage artifact, and unstable cross-chunk scale. We show that all four are consistent with the same capture regime, a small camera-baseline-to-scene-depth ratio. Following our analysis, we propose a detection system that flags this type of failure in minutes, rather than hours of wasted compute.
2610.19993.abstract_zh: 用冰下自主水下航行器（AUV）视频重建 3D 结构一直不准确，但尚不清楚原因是方法不足还是采集系统本身的局限。我们在同一段南极冰下 AUV 视频（Icefin、Kamb Ice Stream）上测试四类重建模型：经典特征匹配 SfM、可微光度 splatting、体积深度融合以及无位姿的前馈基础模型。四者都失败，但方式不同：几乎无法配准、结构近乎不存在；光度指标看似正常但几何破碎；持续的覆盖伪影；跨片段尺度不稳定。我们表明，这四种失败都符合相同采集情形：相机基线相对于场景深度很小。基于此分析，我们提出检测系统，可在几分钟内标记这类失败，而不必先浪费数小时计算。

2610.19674.abstract_en: Geometry foundation models estimate camera poses and 3D scene structure from video sequences, but maintaining consistent reconstructions over long horizons remains challenging. Feed-forward models process long sequences as independent, fixed-length frame windows and align their predictions, causing pose and reconstruction errors to accumulate across windows. Streaming models retain information from past frames to inform future predictions, but cannot revise earlier estimates when later observations reveal errors. To address this, we introduce Scaffold MemOry for Revision (SMORE), a framework equipping frozen geometry foundation models with a revisable external memory for long-horizon inference. Inspired by hippocampal associative memory in biological brains, which links spatial context with sensory experience, SMORE associates where an observer is with what it observes, enabling past observations to be stored, retrieved, verified against new evidence, and revised when inconsistencies are detected. We evaluate SMORE with eight competitive geometry models on five datasets spanning camera pose estimation, multi-view depth estimation, 3D point-cloud reconstruction, simultaneous localization and mapping (SLAM), and novel view synthesis. Across all evaluated models, SMORE consistently improves long-sequence pose estimation, reduces multi-view depth error by up to 58%, reduces Chamfer distance for 3D point-cloud reconstruction by up to 43%, and achieves average trajectory error as low as 2.9 cm in long-horizon SLAM. By retaining corrected poses and observations, SMORE further improves the fidelity and spatial consistency of large-scale 3D scene reconstruction. These results establish revisable external memory as a flexible interface for extending pretrained geometry models beyond fixed-context prediction toward iterative, error-correcting inference over long visual sequences.
2610.19674.abstract_zh: 几何基础模型从视频序列估计相机位姿和 3D 场景结构，但保持长时程重建一致性仍很难。前馈模型把长序列分成独立、固定长度的帧窗口，再对齐预测，造成位姿和重建误差逐窗累积；流式模型保留过去帧信息，却无法在后续观测揭示错误时修正早先估计。我们提出 SMORE：为冻结的几何基础模型配备可修订外部记忆，以支持长时程推理。受生物大脑海马体联想记忆启发，该记忆关联观察者的位置与所见内容，使过去观测可被存储、检索、与新证据核验，并在不一致时修订。我们用八个有竞争力的几何模型、五个数据集评估，涵盖相机位姿、多视角深度、3D 点云重建、同步定位与建图（SLAM）及新视角合成。对所有受评模型，SMORE 均改进长序列位姿估计，使多视角深度误差最多降低 58%、3D 点云重建的 Chamfer 距离最多降低 43%，并在长时程 SLAM 中达到低至 2.9 cm 的平均轨迹误差。通过保留修正后的位姿和观测，它还提高大规模 3D 场景重建的保真度与空间一致性。这些结果表明，可修订外部记忆是把预训练几何模型从固定上下文预测扩展到长序列迭代纠错推理的灵活接口。

2610.19708.abstract_en:
Recent video world models have increasingly adopted 3D memory mechanisms to integrate historical observations into a lightweight and persistent scene representation. This naturally raises a complementary question: if 3D representations can serve as an effective mechanism for memorizing observed scenes, can they also be directly used as the latent space for reconstructing and generating scenes? Motivated by this idea, we represent a scene as a compact and unstructured 3D-anchored latent space (\textbf{SceneAE}). Each latent combines an
 explicit 3D position with an implicit content feature and is spatially grounded to describe its local scene region, forming a
 sparse latent point cloud. Unlike conventional video-VAE latents that describe how a scene appears from particular viewpoints, our
 representation directly describes the scene itself, making it naturally applicable to both reconstruction and generation. For
 reconstruction, once the scene has been generated, our persistent 3D representation can be projected and decoded into RGB-D observations by different target cameras, without the need to regenerate a video for each new camera trajectory.
 For generation, we leverage the geometry-content separation to first generate camera-controlled 3D geometry and
 then synthesize content conditioned on it, reducing camera-appearance entanglement and improving camera
 controllability. Experiments show that this 3D latent achieves superior generation quality, computational cost, and camera controllability.
2610.19708.abstract_zh: 近期视频世界模型越来越多地使用 3D 记忆，把历史观测整合进轻量而持久的场景表示。这引出另一个问题：若 3D 表示可有效记忆已观测场景，能否直接作为重建与生成场景的潜空间？我们据此把场景表示为紧凑、无结构的 3D 锚定潜空间 SceneAE。每个潜变量结合显式 3D 位置与隐式内容特征，并在空间上锚定于局部场景区域，组成稀疏潜点云。传统视频 VAE 潜变量描述场景从特定视角看起来如何；我们的表示直接描述场景本身，因此天然适用于重建和生成。对重建而言，场景生成后，持久的 3D 表示可投影并解码成不同目标相机的 RGB-D 观测，而无需为每条新相机轨迹重新生成视频。对生成而言，我们利用几何与内容分离，先生成可控相机的 3D 几何，再以此为条件合成内容，减少相机与外观的纠缠，增强相机可控性。实验显示，该 3D 潜表示在生成质量、计算成本和相机可控性上表现更好。

2610.19777.abstract_en: Autoregressive models have proven effective for triangular mesh generation by transforming it into predicting the next face, converting the non-differentiable connectivity prediction into a sequence of token predictions. However, generating quad-only meshes remains challenging because quad faces impose stricter topological constraints than triangles. The model must not only serialize quad faces into a valid token sequence, but also support unambiguous connectivity reconstruction during de-serialization. To address this, we propose Q-MAGIC, a novel autoregressive model for quad mesh generation. We first introduce a tailored serialization scheme for quad meshes, which requires at least two new vertices for the next face and is less flexible than triangles due to strict wiring constraints. To meet these requirements and reduce serialization length, we propose a singularity-aware serialization that prioritizes wiring from singular points, leading to more coherent traversals. Additionally, we propose a circular relative offset tokenization that encodes geometry mainly via local relative offsets. Built upon this representation, an autoregressive Transformer learns the underlying distribution of quad meshes via next-token prediction, enabling effective quad mesh generation. Extensive experiments demonstrate that Q-MAGIC produces more compact sequences while consistently improving geometric fidelity and mesh quality compared to state-of-the-art methods.
2610.19777.abstract_zh: 自回归模型可把三角网格生成转换为逐面预测，把不可微的连通关系预测变为 token 序列预测。但纯四边形网格更难生成，因为四边形面对拓扑的约束比三角形更严格：模型既要把面序列化为有效 token 序列，也要支持反序列化时无歧义地重建连通关系。我们提出 Q-MAGIC，一种四边形网格自回归生成模型。首先设计专门的四边形网格序列化方案：下一面至少需要两个新顶点，严格的接线约束使其灵活性低于三角网格。为满足这些要求并缩短序列，我们提出奇点感知序列化，优先从奇点接线，得到更连贯的遍历。另提出环形相对偏移 token 化，主要以局部相对偏移编码几何。基于此表示，自回归 Transformer 通过下一个 token 预测学习四边形网格分布，从而有效生成网格。大量实验显示，Q-MAGIC 产生更紧凑的序列，同时相较现有最佳方法持续提高几何保真度和网格质量。

2610.23156.abstract_en: World models provide robots with a predictive mechanism for reasoning about how actions change object states in manipulation tasks. However, existing image-based and dense 3D world models do not explicitly impose object-level rigid motion, leaving rigid-object geometry preservation to be learned implicitly and making multi-step rollouts susceptible to shape drift or object-level motion inconsistency. To address this, we propose ORD-WM, a 3D world model that learns object-centric rigid dynamics for robotic manipulation. ORD-WM learns a vector-neuron variational autoencoder supervised by signed distance fields, which encodes each object point cloud as a geometry-aware latent representation composed of 3D vector features, and uses an action-conditioned dynamics model to predict object-wise SE(3) motion increments. Rather than generating unconstrained next latent states, ORD-WM analytically applies predicted object-wise rigid transformations to the current latent states, separating persistent object geometry from pose changes. Experiments show that ORD-WM enables stable, geometry-preserving multi-step prediction and supports efficient real-time replanning for closed-loop model predictive control in simulated and real-world manipulation scenarios.
2610.23156.abstract_zh: 世界模型为机器人提供预测机制，以推理操作动作如何改变物体状态。然而，现有基于图像和稠密 3D 的世界模型未显式施加物体级刚体运动约束，把刚体几何保持交由模型隐式学习，使多步推演容易出现形状漂移或物体运动不一致。为此，我们提出 ORD-WM，一种学习物体中心刚体动力学的机器人操作 3D 世界模型。ORD-WM 学习受有符号距离场监督的向量神经元变分自编码器，将各物体点云编码为由 3D 向量特征组成的几何感知潜表示，并以动作条件动力学模型预测逐物体的 SE(3) 运动增量。它不直接生成无约束的下一潜状态，而是解析地将预测的逐物体刚体变换作用于当前潜状态，从而分离持续不变的物体几何与位姿变化。实验表明，ORD-WM 能进行稳定、保持几何形状的多步预测，并在仿真和真实机器人操作场景中支持闭环模型预测控制的高效实时重规划。

2610.22827.abstract_en: Manipulating deformable objects toward desired 3D configurations is a fundamental capability for robots operating in unstructured physical environments. However, as the range of possible initial and target configurations grows, goal-conditioned deformable manipulation requires a robot to infer increasingly diverse manipulation behaviors in addition to precise continuous actions. We introduce DefFlow, a framework for goal-conditioned manipulation of deformable objects toward a broad range of 3D configurations. DefFlow learns from demonstrations by jointly predicting the goal-conditioned 3D point flow of the robot and deformable object. We show that this formulation better captures both the manipulation decisions, such as when and where to grasp, release, or re-grasp, and the precise continuous motions required for goal reaching, rather than predicting only the robot flow. Across rope, granular-media, and cloth manipulation settings with diverse initial and target configurations, DefFlow substantially outperforms goal-conditioned action-prediction and robot-flow-only baselines on success rates and goal-distance metrics. We further demonstrate deployment of our framework on a real robot using real point-cloud observations and unseen goal configurations.
2610.22827.abstract_zh: 将可变形物体操纵到目标 3D 构型，是机器人在非结构化物理环境中工作的一项基本能力。但随着初始构型和目标构型的范围扩大，目标条件可变形操作不仅要求精确连续动作，也要求推断日益多样的操作行为。我们提出 DefFlow，面向广泛 3D 目标构型的可变形物体目标条件操作框架。DefFlow 从示范中学习，同时预测机器人和可变形物体的目标条件 3D 点流。与仅预测机器人流相比，我们表明这一表述更能同时捕捉何时、何处抓取、释放或重新抓取等操作决策，以及到达目标所需的精确连续运动。在具有多样初始和目标构型的绳索、颗粒介质与布料操作场景中，DefFlow 在成功率和目标距离指标上显著优于目标条件动作预测及仅机器人流的基线。我们还使用真实点云观测和未见过的目标构型，在真实机器人上部署了该框架。

2610.22762.abstract_en: Rigid-body motion planning is fundamental to robotic transport and manipulation, where both object position and orientation determine whether a body can move through cluttered environments. This coupling makes planning chal- lenging because translation and rotation can be constrained very differently by surrounding geometry. We propose Shape- Aware Neural Time Fields, a physics-informed neural motion planning framework that learns a reusable travel-time, or cost- to-go, representation for rigid-body motion while explicitly accounting for these distinct geometric restrictions. The learned field captures local motion difficulty in translation and rotation and is paired with a sampling-based planner that balances progress toward the goal with the cost of reaching nearby poses. We evaluate the framework across 2D and 3D rigid- body planning tasks and non-prehensile manipulation through object pushing in diverse environments. Results show substantial improvements in planning success and inference efficiency over physics-informed neural planning baselines, while remaining competitive with classical sampling-based planners at significantly lower planning times. Ablation studies further validate the contributions of both the learned representation and the proposed planning strategy. Finally, closed-loop pushing experiments under execution deviations and external disturbances demonstrate that fast replanning enables reactive and adaptive task execution.
2610.22762.abstract_zh: 刚体运动规划是机器人运输和操作的基础；在杂乱环境中，物体能否通过取决于位置和朝向。周围几何对平移与旋转的约束可能很不相同，使两者耦合后的规划变得困难。我们提出 Shape-Aware Neural Time Fields：一种物理信息神经运动规划框架，学习可复用的行程时间或到目标代价表示，并显式考虑这些不同的几何限制。所学场刻画平移和旋转的局部运动难度，配合采样式规划器，在朝目标推进和到达附近位姿的代价之间取得平衡。我们在多种环境下的 2D、3D 刚体规划任务及物体推动这一非抓取操作任务中评估该框架。与物理信息神经规划基线相比，它显著提高规划成功率和推理效率；与经典采样式规划器相比，性能保持竞争力，同时规划时间显著更短。消融实验进一步验证了所学表示和规划策略各自的贡献。最后，在执行偏差和外部扰动下的闭环推动实验表明，快速重规划使任务执行能够作出反应和适应。

2610.22932.abstract_en: Contact locations and interaction forces are critical for contact-rich robot manipulation but are often ambiguous from vision alone. Measuring them on robots requires specialized tactile hardware and platform-specific data collection, which keeps robot tactile data scarce. Human egocentric video is far easier to scale but lacks touch. Recent predictors trained on egocentric recordings paired with tactile-glove measurements can predict this missing signal from video alone. These predictors, however, remain confined to human hands, which differ from robot hands in appearance and tactile layout. We present Ego2Contact, which learns a visual-tactile prior from human interactions and transfers it to robot hands. Its predictor fuses temporal scene context with hand-local visual features to infer bimanual tactile fields from the RGB video. Anatomical region correspondences align varying robot tactile layouts with the predictor's canonical grid, turning robot measurements into fine-tuning targets and predictions into policy inputs. Ego2Contact outperforms prior tactile predictors on human data, including unseen objects, and on robot data after adaptation. The adapted predictor provides tactile inputs for both simulated reinforcement learning and real-robot policy post-training. In simulation, policies using predicted touch outperform non-tactile baselines and recover part of the benefit of ground-truth tactile sensing. These results show that human-learned tactile priors can supply touch when direct tactile sensing is limited.
2610.22932.abstract_zh: 接触位置和交互力对富接触机器人操作至关重要，却往往难以单凭视觉判断。在机器人上测量它们需要专门的触觉硬件和平台特定的数据采集，因此机器人触觉数据稀缺。人类第一视角视频更容易大规模获取，但缺少触觉；近期以同步触觉手套记录训练的预测器可以从视频预测该信号，不过仍局限于外观和触觉布局均不同于机器人的人手。我们提出 Ego2Contact，从人类交互中学习视觉—触觉先验，再迁移到机器人手。预测器融合场景的时间上下文和手部局部视觉特征，从 RGB 视频推断双手触觉场。解剖区域对应关系将不同的机器人触觉布局对齐到预测器的规范网格，使机器人测量既能作为微调目标，也能使预测结果成为策略输入。Ego2Contact 在包含未见物体的人类数据上优于既有触觉预测器，适配后在机器人数据上也优于它们。适配后的预测器为仿真强化学习和真实机器人策略后训练提供触觉输入。在仿真中，使用预测触觉的策略优于无触觉基线，并恢复了真实触觉传感带来的部分收益。结果表明，当直接触觉感知受限时，人类数据学习到的触觉先验可以提供触觉信息。

2610.23849.abstract_en: Every robot already carries high-resolution contact sensors: its own joints. Legged robots and humanoids exploit them to walk, run, and track whole-body motions without vision, but there the contacts are large and forceful. Is joint sensing also enough for precise, contact-rich assembly, where the robot must find a millimeter-scale opening, mesh gear teeth, or catch a thread through light contact? We study this question by training blind assembly policies that observe only a short history of joint positions, velocities, and their own actions, without visual, force, torque, or tactile sensing. The poses of both the fixture and the part are unknown to the policy, and the grasp is randomized substantially. The policy must therefore assemble the parts through contact, sensed exclusively through its own proprioception. Trained with reinforcement learning entirely in simulation over randomized parts, grasps, and contacts, such policies learn peg insertion, gear meshing, and nut threading. The peg insertion policy transfers zero-shot to the real world and inserts pegs of different shapes and sizes in 73% of trials. Controlled comparisons with matched visual policies in simulation show that blind policies generalize far better to unseen part shapes and sizes, though they can be slower. Training such policies needs thousands of different assemblies, each simulated with its clearance intact, so we also release an open-source generator that builds them procedurally from exact convex pieces for MuJoCo; it is more accurate and faster than convex decomposition or MuJoCo's signed-distance collision. Videos and interactive simulations are at this https URL.
2610.23849.abstract_zh: 每台机器人都自带高分辨率的接触传感器：自身关节。足式机器人和人形机器人利用关节感知，在没有视觉的情况下行走、奔跑并跟踪全身动作，但这些任务的接触较大、力较强。对于需要通过轻微接触寻找毫米级孔位、啮合齿轮或挂住螺纹的精密装配，关节感知是否也足够？我们训练“盲”装配策略，仅观察短时间内的关节位置、速度和自身动作历史，不使用视觉、力、力矩或触觉传感。夹具和零件的位姿对策略均未知，抓取也有大幅随机化，因此策略只能通过自身本体感知到的接触完成装配。策略完全在仿真中使用随机化的零件、抓取和接触进行强化学习，学会插销、齿轮啮合及螺母旋入。插销策略零样本迁移到真实世界，在 73% 的试验中插入不同形状和尺寸的销。与匹配的视觉策略在仿真中的受控比较表明，盲策略对未见零件形状和尺寸的泛化明显更好，但可能更慢。训练需要数千种保留原有间隙的不同装配仿真，因此我们还开源了一个基于精确凸形部件为 MuJoCo 程序化生成装配任务的工具；它比凸分解或 MuJoCo 的有符号距离碰撞方法更准确、更快。视频和交互式仿真见论文所链资源。

2610.22813.abstract_en: Robot manipulators often come into contact with rigid objects when performing work. This imposes physical constraints on their motion. Simultaneous force & motion control was developed to regulate contact forces commensurate with these constraints, whilst projecting motion control in to the orthogonal, unconstrained directions. This is typically formulated in the task coordinates, i.e. operational space, then mapped to joint torques to command the robot. However, most constraints on the robot control, such as joint limits, collision avoidance, singularity avoidance, etc. are naturally expressed in generalised coordinates (joint space). Thus, formulating the control problem in task space makes it difficult to guarantee control feasibility. In this paper Gauss' principle of least constraint is used to solve the control as a quadratic programming (QP) problem in generalised coordinates. It is shown that the theoretical solution to this problem produces the correct constrained dynamics for accurate contact force control. Moreover, inequality constraints may be appended to ensure feasibility and safety. Simulation results were conducted in MuJoCo and compared to the operational space formulation. The proposed method is able to simultaneously maintain a desired contact force, minimise trajectory tracking error, and adhere to practical inequality constraints.
2610.22813.abstract_zh: 机器人操作臂作业时常与刚体接触，从而对运动施加物理约束。同步力—运动控制旨在按照这些约束调节接触力，同时把运动控制投影到正交的无约束方向。传统方法通常先在任务坐标即操作空间中表述，再映射为机器人关节力矩；但关节限位、避碰、奇异位形规避等大多数控制约束本来就在广义坐标即关节空间中表示，因此任务空间表述难以保证控制可行性。本文用高斯最小约束原理，将控制求解表述为广义坐标中的二次规划（QP）问题。理论分析表明，该解能够给出正确的受约束动力学，实现准确接触力控制；还可加入不等式约束以保证可行性与安全性。作者在 MuJoCo 中做仿真，并与操作空间表述比较。所提方法能够同时维持期望接触力、减小轨迹跟踪误差，并满足实际不等式约束。

2610.23123.abstract_en: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models that directly regress joint-space actions avoid the deployment-time cost of inverse kinematics. However, their training objectives remain misaligned with task success, as joint-space losses ignore the unequal physical consequences of joint errors and visual conditioning lacks explicit focus on hand-object interaction regions. To address these issues, we propose a training-phase prior injection framework for fine-grained bimanual manipulation. First, a physics-grounded flow-matching loss maps the implicit clean-action estimate at every noise level through differentiable forward kinematics (FK) and supervises the resulting Tool Center Point (TCP) pose and inter-arm relative pose, with a bounded noise-level weighting that compensates gradient decay. Second, we introduce a global prediction query group distilled from a frozen DINOv3 teacher through future-frame feature prediction, together with a local interaction query supervised by Grounding DINO at the attention level. Both teachers are removed at inference, and the deployment pipeline is that of a standard joint-space flow policy, adding only the learned query pathway. Simulation and real-robot experiments on long-horizon bimanual tasks show that the two priors are complementary across different deployment settings. The full model excels in in-distribution deployment, while the distilled query branch is preferable under strong visual randomization.
2610.23123.abstract_zh: 直接回归关节空间动作的视觉—语言—动作（VLA）模型可以省去部署时逆运动学的开销，但其训练目标仍与任务成功错位：关节空间损失忽略不同关节误差的物理后果差异，视觉条件也未显式关注手—物交互区域。为解决这些问题，我们提出面向精细双臂操作、在训练阶段注入先验的框架。首先，物理锚定的流匹配损失将每个噪声水平下隐式的干净动作估计经可微前向运动学（FK）映射，监督工具中心点（TCP）位姿和双臂相对位姿，并以有界的噪声级权重补偿梯度衰减。其次，我们引入由冻结的 DINOv3 教师通过未来帧特征预测蒸馏的全局预测查询组，以及在注意力层面由 Grounding DINO 监督的局部交互查询。推理时移除两个教师，部署流程仍是标准的关节空间流策略，仅增加学到的查询路径。在长时双臂任务的仿真和真实机器人实验中，两种先验在不同部署条件下互补：完整模型在分布内部署表现最好，而强视觉随机化时蒸馏后的查询分支更合适。

2610.22812.abstract_en: Reliable vision-and-language navigation (VLN) requires not only understanding instructions but also determining whether and how a robot can physically execute them. However, existing VLN benchmarks typically assume executable instructions and focus on long-horizon tasks. This leaves body-dependent local execution, including passability and collision-free execution, largely unexamined. Evaluating these factors within long-horizon tasks would entangle local physical execution with task planning and long-term spatial memory, making navigation failures difficult to attribute. We therefore focus on grounding local navigation commands in executable motion under environmental and robot body constraints. We present PASS-VLN, a passability-aware local-command VLN benchmark and model. The benchmark holds the scene, instruction, start pose, and reference route fixed while varying robot body width, requiring target completion when the instructed passage is feasible and stopping before blockage otherwise. Our model encodes body width through obstacle inflation in a depth-derived local bird's-eye view, fuses geometry with visual and linguistic context, and predicts discrete latent action codes for continuous closed-loop execution. Experiments show that PASS-VLN improves collision-free success by approximately 12 percentage points over a strong VLN model fine-tuned on our benchmark, while adapting reach-versus-stop behavior to body constraints and generalizing to unseen body widths. When integrated with a high-level planner, PASS-VLN achieves higher success with fewer local commands, while real-world deployment further demonstrates its effectiveness as a low-level executor. The benchmark and model will be released.
2610.22812.abstract_zh: 可靠的视觉—语言导航（VLN）既要理解指令，也要判断机器人能否及如何实际执行。然而，既有 VLN 基准通常默认指令可执行，并关注长时任务，使依赖机体尺寸的局部执行、可通行性和无碰撞执行缺乏研究。若在长时任务中评估这些因素，局部物理执行会与任务规划及长期空间记忆混杂，难以归因导航失败。因此，我们聚焦在环境和机器人机体约束下，把局部导航命令落实为可执行运动。我们提出 PASS-VLN，一个可通行性感知的局部命令 VLN 基准和模型。基准固定场景、指令、起始位姿和参考路线，只改变机器人机体宽度；通道可行时要求到达目标，否则要求在障碍前停下。模型通过对深度导出的局部鸟瞰图作障碍膨胀来编码机体宽度，融合几何、视觉和语言上下文，预测离散潜动作码以进行连续闭环执行。实验显示，相比在该基准上微调的强 VLN 模型，PASS-VLN 将无碰撞成功率提高约 12 个百分点，同时能随机体约束调整“到达或停止”行为，并泛化到未见的机体宽度。与高层规划器结合后，PASS-VLN 以更少的局部命令取得更高成功率；真实部署也显示其作为低层执行器的有效性。基准和模型将会发布。

2610.22977.abstract_en: Low-cost passive leader arms enable scalable data collection for imitation learning, but their lack of restoring forces leaves redundant joints unconstrained, yielding highly inconsistent joint-space trajectories. We address this with a low-cost passive joint module (an adjustable mechanical clutch and a 3D-printed spiral spring) that pulls each joint toward a user-defined neutral posture. This passive restoring force acts as a physical prior equivalent to joint-space $L_2$ regularization (``Hardware-as-Regularization''), improving kinematic consistency with shorter completion time than an unregularized arm and preserved movement smoothness. Experiments show substantial variance reduction over a naive passive arm, trajectory consistency on par with an active virtual spring of the same actuator class, and substantially higher downstream success rates (e.g., 73.3% vs. 36.7% on Block Stacking); a stiffness sweep shows consistency degrading monotonically as stiffness decreases, confirming that mechanical stiffness behaves like a regularization weight.
2610.22977.abstract_zh: 低成本被动示教臂便于大规模采集模仿学习数据，但由于缺少回复力，冗余关节不受约束，导致关节空间轨迹很不一致。为此，我们设计了低成本被动关节模块，包括可调机械离合器和 3D 打印螺旋弹簧，把各关节拉向用户设定的中性姿态。该被动回复力充当等价于关节空间 $L_2$ 正则化的物理先验，即“硬件即正则化”，在保持运动平滑性的同时，相比无正则示教臂提高运动学一致性并缩短任务完成时间。实验表明，相比普通被动臂，其轨迹方差明显降低；轨迹一致性与同类执行器的主动虚拟弹簧相当；下游成功率也明显提高，例如积木堆叠任务为 73.3%，对照为 36.7%。刚度扫描显示，刚度减小时一致性单调下降，印证机械刚度发挥着类似正则化权重的作用。

2610.23396.abstract_en: Rapid progress in embodied intelligence has enabled increasingly capable robots to follow language instructions and manipulate diverse objects. However, strong results in structured environments do not automatically transfer to open-world conditions, where clutter, occlusion, and changing viewpoints can obscure the spatial relationships required for action. To address this perceptual gap, a virtual active-perception paradigm is introduced. AWAM, an Active World-Action Model actively plans where to observe and imagines what will be seen along the planned trajectory before acting. Task-related virtual camera motion is predicted and used as a structured query into a geometry-conditioned world model, producing a reusable spatial prior for manipulation, which is later compressed into a fixed memory and fused with live observations through cross-attention for diffusion-based action prediction. AWAM achieves competitive success rates with 75.9% on LIBERO-Occ, 62.4% on LIBERO-Plus, 76.5% on RLBench-OG Occlusion1, and 94.4% in real-robot trials. These results support improved robustness to the evaluated occlusions and distribution shifts, addressing part of the gap between structured manipulation and less controlled environments.
2610.23396.abstract_zh: 具身智能的快速进步让机器人愈发能够遵循语言指令并操作不同物体，但结构化环境中的良好结果未必能迁移到杂乱、遮挡和视角变化会掩盖动作所需空间关系的开放环境。为弥合这一感知缺口，我们引入虚拟主动感知范式。AWAM 是一种主动世界—动作模型，在行动前主动规划观察位置，并想象沿规划轨迹所见的内容。模型预测与任务相关的虚拟相机运动，将其作为对几何条件世界模型的结构化查询，为操作生成可复用的空间先验；随后把先验压缩为固定记忆，并通过交叉注意力与实时观测融合，供基于扩散的动作预测使用。AWAM 在 LIBERO-Occ、LIBERO-Plus、RLBench-OG Occlusion1 上分别取得 75.9%、62.4%、76.5% 的成功率，真实机器人试验为 94.4%。这些结果支持它对所评估遮挡和分布变化具有更强稳健性，部分缩小了结构化操作与较不受控环境之间的差距。

2610.22558.abstract_en: Motion of a robotic manipulator mounted on a free-floating spacecraft induces base translation and rotation, creating a dynamic coupling that affects end-effector motion. This paper characterizes that coupling in a planar three-link space manipulator. Using momentum conservation, velocity mappings are developed between manipulator joints, the end effector, and the spacecraft base. Singular value decomposition is then used to examine coupling strength, directional anisotropy, and the orientation of the coupled motions. Numerical maps show that coupling strength is invariant to the first joint angle but depends strongly on the relative configuration of the remaining joints. Increasing the spacecraft base mass reduces joint-to-base and end-effector-to-base coupling, while its effect on the joint-to-end-effector mapping is smaller and more dependent on configuration. The translational end-effector-to-base mapping is highly anisotropic in some configurations: its base-velocity ellipse becomes increasingly flattened as the weak coupling mode approaches zero. The principal end-effector and base velocity directions also change their relative alignment across the configuration space, producing predominantly opposing responses in some regions and transverse or approximately codirectional responses in others. Together, these results provide a geometric description of how coupling magnitude and direction vary with manipulator configuration and spacecraft mass.
2610.22558.abstract_zh: 自由漂浮航天器上机械臂的运动会引起基座平移和旋转，产生影响末端执行器运动的动力学耦合。本文研究平面三连杆空间机械臂中的这种耦合。作者利用动量守恒，建立机械臂关节、末端执行器和航天器基座之间的速度映射，再通过奇异值分解分析耦合强度、方向各向异性及耦合运动的方向。数值图显示，耦合强度与第一关节角无关，却强烈依赖其余关节的相对构型。增大航天器基座质量会减小关节到基座及末端到基座的耦合；对关节到末端映射的影响较小，也更依赖构型。在部分构型中，末端到基座的平移映射高度各向异性：随着弱耦合模态趋近零，基座速度椭圆越来越扁。末端与基座速度主方向的相对对齐也随构型改变，在某些区域主要反向，在另一些区域则横向或近似同向。总体上，这些结果给出了耦合大小和方向如何随机械臂构型与航天器质量变化的几何描述。

2610.23178.abstract_en: The impact of droplets, such as rain and sea sprays, on wind turbine blade surfaces can cause severe damage through leading-edge erosion (LEE). Current industrial practice has largely relied on empirical fatigue models to predict damage progression and guide maintenance. However, an important limitation of existing models is the assumption on ideal impact conditions, including perfectly spherical droplet and normal incidence, which rarely occur in reality. This study develops a fluid-structure interaction (FSI) model that couples incompressible multiphase flow simulations with finite element (FE) analysis of blade materials. Using this framework, we investigate the impact dynamics of droplets with arbitrary shapes and orientations. The results reveal a positive correlation between the peak impact pressure, the influential area at the pressure peak, and the peak impact force. In contrast, the time of peak force scales inversely due to momentum conservation. From these findings, we propose a $\textit{universal scaling law}$ that relates all key impact loadings to the simple parameter of the droplet $\textit{projection area}$, which can be determined solely from the initial droplet geometry and orientation. This law provides a predictive framework for impact loading dynamics of non-ideal shapes, offering new insights into the mechanisms of LEE and improving the accuracy of erosion predictions for wind turbine blades.
2610.23178.abstract_zh: 雨滴和海浪飞沫等液滴冲击风机叶片表面，可通过前缘侵蚀（LEE）造成严重损伤。现行工业实践主要依赖经验疲劳模型预测损伤发展和指导维护，但这类模型常假设液滴完全球形、正向撞击等理想条件，现实中却很少成立。本文建立流固耦合（FSI）模型，将不可压缩多相流仿真与叶片材料的有限元（FE）分析结合，以研究任意形状和朝向的液滴撞击动力学。结果发现，峰值冲击压力、压力峰值时的作用面积和峰值冲击力正相关；相反，由于动量守恒，峰值力出现时间呈反向缩放。基于这些结果，我们提出一条将所有关键冲击载荷与液滴投影面积这一简单参数联系起来的普适缩放律；该面积只需从液滴初始几何和朝向即可确定。该规律为非理想形状的撞击载荷动力学提供预测框架，并有助于理解 LEE 机制、提高风机叶片侵蚀预测精度。

2610.22505.abstract_en: Gaussian-splatting Simultaneous Localization and Mapping (SLAM) augments conventional SLAM with a dense, renderable 3D scene representation, enabling high-quality reconstruction and novel-view synthesis. However, its localization, reconstruction, and rendering performance depends strongly on which observations are retained for mapping. Existing systems commonly rely on fixed temporal intervals or simple pose- and overlap-based criteria for keyframe selection. In colonoscopy, non-uniform camera motion, repetitive anatomy, specularities, and visual artifacts can make these criteria unreliable, leading to either redundant keyframes or missed informative viewpoints. We present KFS$^4$LAM (KeyFrame Selection with Structure-aware mapping for endoscopic Gaussian Splatting SLAM), which couples motion-guided adaptive keyframe selection with structurally supervised mapping and restricted temporal deformation. Accumulated motion guides adaptive keyframe selection, with complementary cues suppressing redundant or unreliable candidates. Density-aware mapping with anatomical contour supervision (colon folds) emphasizes structurally informative regions, while restricted temporal deformation accommodates local tissue dynamics without unconstrained geometric drift. We evaluate KFS$^4$LAM against Gaussian-SLAM baselines on C3VD and C3VD-v2, together with cross-backbone and component ablations. KFS$^4$LAM achieves strong overall performance across trajectory, rendering, and depth metrics, with pronounced gains on more challenging C3VD-v2 dataset. In the matched comparison with SplaTAM on C3VD-v2, it reduces rotational relative pose error by 20.3% and depth RMSE by 38.4%, while improving PSNR by 0.78 dB. Cross-backbone experiments further show that the framework is not tied to a single underlying SLAM architecture. Code and visualization results are available at this https URL.
2610.22505.abstract_zh: 高斯泼溅同步定位与建图（SLAM）为传统 SLAM 加入稠密、可渲染的 3D 场景表示，支持高质量重建和新视角合成；但定位、重建与渲染效果高度依赖保留哪些观测用于建图。既有系统常按固定时间间隔，或简单按位姿和重叠度选择关键帧。结肠镜场景中的非均匀相机运动、重复解剖结构、镜面反射和视觉伪影会使这些准则失效，导致冗余帧或漏掉有信息量的视角。我们提出 KFS$^4$LAM，将运动引导的自适应关键帧选择、结构监督建图和受限时间形变相结合。累积运动引导关键帧选择，补充线索抑制冗余或不可靠候选；带解剖轮廓即结肠褶皱监督的密度感知建图突出结构信息丰富的区域，受限时间形变则容纳局部组织运动且避免无约束的几何漂移。我们在 C3VD 和 C3VD-v2 上对比高斯 SLAM 基线，并进行跨骨干和组件消融。方法在轨迹、渲染和深度指标上整体表现强，较难的 C3VD-v2 上收益尤为明显；在 C3VD-v2 与 SplaTAM 的匹配比较中，旋转相对位姿误差降低 20.3%，深度 RMSE 降低 38.4%，PSNR 提高 0.78 dB。跨骨干实验还显示该框架不依赖单一 SLAM 架构。代码和可视化结果见论文所链资源。

2610.23121.abstract_en: Generating complete, coherent, and usable 3D indoor scenes from natural language requires strong \textbf{design intelligence}: the ability to design high-quality scenes and critique their quality. However, existing approaches either rely on general-purpose models lacking domain-specific design experience or learn from static scenes. In this work, we introduce \textbf{Scene-Designer}, an agentic framework that learns design intelligence through complementary design and critique experiences. We construct two datasets: \textbf{Scene-OTA-35K}, which provides Observation--Thought--Action supervision for learning scene design and efficient error correction, and \textbf{Scene-OTC-15K}, which provides Observation--Thought--Critic supervision for learning scene quality critique across physical validity, functional correctness, and layout coherence. Based on these experiences, we propose \textbf{Scene-GRPO}, a Critic-guided GRPO framework that improves design decisions and reduces unnecessary trial-and-error corrections. Extensive experiments demonstrate that Scene-Designer achieves superior performance in physical validity, functional correctness, and layout coherence, while the learned Scene-Critic significantly outperforms general-purpose models in scene critique. Moreover, test-time Critic guidance further improves scene generation, showing that the Critic can provide useful guidance beyond training. Additional analysis suggests a trend of mutual enhancement between scene design and critique abilities.
2610.23121.abstract_zh: 从自然语言生成完整、连贯、可用的 3D 室内场景，需要能够设计高质量场景并批评其质量的“设计智能”。既有方法要么依赖缺乏领域设计经验的通用模型，要么只从静态场景学习。我们提出 Scene-Designer，通过互补的设计和批评经验学习设计智能。我们构建了两个数据集：Scene-OTA-35K 以“观察—思考—动作”监督场景设计与高效纠错，Scene-OTC-15K 以“观察—思考—批评”监督物理有效性、功能正确性和布局连贯性的质量评判。在此基础上，我们提出由 Critic 引导的 Scene-GRPO 框架，以改进设计决策并减少不必要的试错修正。大量实验表明，Scene-Designer 在物理有效性、功能正确性和布局连贯性上表现更优；学到的 Scene-Critic 在场景批评中显著优于通用模型。测试时 Critic 引导还进一步改善场景生成，表明该 Critic 在训练之外也有用。额外分析提示，场景设计和批评能力存在相互促进的趋势。

2610.23622.abstract_en: Geometric and Semantic Foundation models are becoming increasingly popular tools for generating spatial maps for robots. Recent work (e.g., FOUND-IT) has leveraged these tools to construct real-time, task-driven, and open-set 3D scene graphs from a single uncalibrated camera. However, while classical robot mapping techniques have undergone extensive system demonstrations, limited work has been done to develop both the fundamental and the systems wide advancements needed to integrate these new types of robot spatial memory into a full, useable autonomy pipeline. In this paper, we bridge this gap, and in doing so we also evaluate the effectiveness and limitations of this type of 3D memory. Towards this end, we integrate FOUND-IT into a mobile manipulator platform and demonstrate it is well-suited to support multiple objectives such as object change detection, support for multiple mapping sessions, determination of navigable paths, and directly support object grasping for the task of scene re-arrangement. Furthermore, we provide nuanced insights into the effectiveness and limitations of a monocular, foundation-model-driven 3D scene graph construction system using observations from rigorous on-robot experiments. Code is available at https://github. com/MIT-SPARK/FOUND-IT.
2610.23622.abstract_zh: 几何与语义基础模型正愈来愈多地用于机器人空间建图。FOUND-IT 等近期工作利用这些工具，从单个未标定相机实时构建任务驱动、开放集的 3D 场景图。但相比经历大量系统演示的传统机器人建图方法，将这类新空间记忆集成到完整可用的自主流程所需的基础与系统进展仍有限。本文试图弥合这一缺口，并评估此类 3D 记忆的有效性和局限。我们把 FOUND-IT 集成到移动操作机器人平台，展示它适用于物体变化检测、多次建图会话、可通行路径确定，以及为场景重新布置任务直接支持物体抓取等多种目标。此外，基于严格的实体机器人实验观测，我们分析了单目、基础模型驱动的 3D 场景图构建系统的效用与限制。代码见论文提供的链接。

2610.22619.abstract_en: Quadruped parkour policies handle canonical obstacles well, but their training curricula often miss the irregular, compound geometry of industrial and disaster-response sites, where agile locomotion matters most. Such environments pose a hard generalization problem: even training directly on reconstructed geometry from the target site does not reliably yield policies that traverse it. Hand-designed curricula span only a few terrain families, and recent LLM-generated curricula offer little control over which policy weaknesses they target. We propose FCTS, a failure-conditioned terrain curriculum framework that uses localized traversal failures to automatically generate the terrains a policy should train on next. Each failure's location, termination mode, robot state, and surrounding terrain geometry condition this generation, and Monte Carlo Tree Search explores alternative curriculum trajectories under a fixed training budget. On terrains built from scanned real-world construction sites, FCTS raises success rate from 28.4% to 85.8% on a medium-difficulty course and from 14.9% to 44.7% on a hard course relative to the strongest parkour or LLM-curriculum baselines, and maintains higher progress on extreme terrains where full traversal is rare. Hardware experiments on a quadruped robot confirm that the learned FCTS policies transfer to the real world.
2610.22619.abstract_zh: 四足跑酷策略能处理典型障碍，但训练课程常漏掉工业和救灾现场不规则、复合的地形几何，而敏捷运动在这些地方最重要。这类环境带来困难的泛化问题：即使直接在目标现场重建几何上训练，也无法可靠获得能穿越它的策略。手工课程仅覆盖少数地形族，近期 LLM 生成课程也难以控制其针对哪些策略弱点。我们提出 FCTS，一种以失败为条件的地形课程框架，根据局部穿越失败自动生成策略接下来应训练的地形。每次失败的位置、终止模式、机器人状态及周围地形几何共同作为生成条件，蒙特卡洛树搜索在固定训练预算内探索不同课程路径。在用真实建筑工地扫描数据构建的地形上，相比最强跑酷或 LLM 课程基线，FCTS 将中等难度路线成功率从 28.4% 提高到 85.8%，困难路线从 14.9% 提高到 44.7%；在很少能完整穿越的极难地形上也保持更高进度。四足机器人硬件实验确认所学 FCTS 策略可迁移到真实世界。

2610.23127.abstract_en: Humanoid control requires coordinating whole-body posture with position and heading in the world frame. Mainstream controllers imitate trajectories in the root frame, but struggle to regain the target world pose after displacement. We introduce BeJEPA, a goal-conditioned Behavior World Model learned through unsupervised reinforcement learning from human motion priors and robot interaction. BeJEPA learns a shared representation of body configuration and world placement through a joint-embedding predictive architecture (JEPA). A Dynamic Predictor predicts the next state embedding under an action, while a Successor Predictor summarizes a goal-conditioned policy's expected discounted future state embeddings in a single vector. During joint training, Dynamic grounds the initial representation in observed physical transitions, while Successor increasingly organizes it around long-term behavior. Their composition guides policy improvement through one physical prediction and one behavioral summary, without long imagined rollouts. In 20-second motion-tracking experiments, BeJEPA with online action refinement using Dynamic outperforms all evaluated baselines in global body-position error, reducing it on AMASS by 61.7% relative to BFM-Zero with world-pose inputs and 58.7% relative to SONIC. Physical deployment on a Unitree G1 demonstrates joint attainment of posture, world position, and heading goals, recovery from the ground, and closed-loop return after disturbances and goal changes. Project page: this https URL.
2610.23127.abstract_zh: 人形机器人控制需要在世界坐标中协调全身姿态、位置和朝向。主流控制器在根坐标系中模仿轨迹，但被外力推离后难以恢复目标世界位姿。我们提出 BeJEPA，一个通过人类运动先验与机器人交互的无监督强化学习获得的目标条件行为世界模型。它用联合嵌入预测架构（JEPA）学习身体构型与世界位置的共享表示。Dynamic Predictor 预测给定动作后的下一状态嵌入；Successor Predictor 则用单个向量概括目标条件策略在未来的期望折扣状态嵌入。联合训练中，Dynamic 将初始表示锚定到观测到的物理转移，Successor 逐步使其围绕长期行为组织。两者结合，通过一次物理预测和一次行为概括指导策略改进，无须长距离想象推演。在 20 秒动作跟踪实验中，带 Dynamic 在线动作精炼的 BeJEPA 在全局身体位置误差上优于所有受测基线：相对带世界位姿输入的 BFM-Zero，在 AMASS 上降低 61.7%；相对 SONIC 降低 58.7%。在 Unitree G1 上的实体部署展示了同时到达姿态、世界位置和朝向目标、从地面起身，以及扰动和目标变化后的闭环返回。项目页见论文所链资源。

2610.23438.abstract_en: Humans manipulate objects within their hands through touch alone with remarkable ease, but for robots, achieving sustained real-world manipulation without vision remains an open challenge. Although reinforcement learning (RL) can generate sophisticated blind manipulation policies in simulation, transferring them to a real dexterous hand remains hindered by continuously changing contacts, motion-induced tactile information drift, and the gap between simulated and physical dynamics. We study this problem through Baoding ball rotation on the Shadow Dexterous Hand Lite, using only proprioception and binary tactile feedback as observations. We achieve successful zero-shot transfer through a combination of a sensor-aligned, coupling-aware embodiment in simulation, tactile calibration, and two novel episodic domain randomisations: slew-rate action limits and STuck-AT Taxels. On the physical hand, the policy achieves sustained blind Baoding rotation, completing 225 consecutive $\mathbf{180^\circ}$ rotations (112.5 full rotations) at $\sim0.36 \;\text{rot/s}$ in a single continuous trial without any vision or object-state information. Furthermore, we evaluate the contribution of tactile sensing relative to proprioception alone and identify the hand regions where tactile information is most important. This is the strongest reported hardware result for Baoding ball manipulation in both rotation count and speed, irrespective of the sensing modality used. By effectively bridging the sim-to-real gap, our framework sets a new benchmark for sustained tactile-driven dexterous manipulation on physical hardware.
2610.23438.abstract_zh: 人类仅凭触觉就能轻松在手中操纵物体，但机器人要在无视觉条件下持续完成真实操作仍是开放挑战。强化学习虽能在仿真中得到复杂的盲操作策略，迁移到真实灵巧手仍受不断变化的接触、运动引起的触觉信息漂移，以及仿真与物理动力学差距阻碍。我们在 Shadow Dexterous Hand Lite 上研究保定球旋转，观测仅含本体感知和二值触觉反馈。通过传感器对齐、考虑耦合的仿真机体模型、触觉校准，以及两种新的回合级域随机化——动作变化率限制与 STuck-AT Taxels——我们实现成功的零样本迁移。在实体手上，策略无需视觉或物体状态信息，单次连续实验中持续盲转保定球，完成连续 225 次 $\mathbf{180^\circ}$ 旋转，即 112.5 圈，速度约 $0.36\;\text{rot/s}$。此外，我们比较触觉感知相对于仅本体感知的贡献，并找出触觉信息最重要的手部区域。作者称，无论使用何种感知模态，这都是已报告的保定球实体操作中旋转次数和速度最强结果。通过缩小 sim-to-real 差距，该框架为真实硬件上的持续触觉驱动灵巧操作建立了新基准。

2610.23496.abstract_en: Monocular simultaneous localization and mapping (SLAM) remains challenging in dynamic environments. Real-time dynamic object identification in such environments is a critical problem. Recent approaches estimate per-pixel uncertainty from rendering residuals or multiview feature inconsistency to identify dynamic regions. These methods lack direct motion evidence, and their accuracy may degrade when reconstruction is inaccurate or features are ambiguous. In addition, such uncertainty merely downweights pixels in bundle adjustment (BA), so inaccurate uncertainty estimates can still impair camera pose estimation and 3D reconstruction. Accordingly, we present a monocular RGB SLAM system for dynamic scenes. Specifically, a motion uncertainty estimation method is proposed to derive uncertainty from the residual between optical flow and camera motion induced flow, directly reflecting object motion. The estimation varies with frame alignment accuracy, reducing false detections and yielding accurate pixel-level masks of dynamic regions. To make BA more robust, we estimate camera poses from high confidence pixels. These poses are then used to reproject dynamic pixels during joint refinement of poses and depth, reducing the influence of object motion on both pose and depth updates. Moreover, we provide a quantitative evaluation of dynamic masks and analyze how these masks affect the downstream tracking and reconstruction of dynamic objects. Our approach improves the mean dynamic mask IoU by 35\% over a state-of-the-art baseline on DAVIS, and reduces the average ATE by 59\% on Bonn and 19\% on TUM relative to the SLAM backbone used in our system. The source code will be made publicly available.
2610.23496.abstract_zh: 单目同步定位与建图（SLAM）在动态环境中仍很困难，实时识别动态物体是关键。近期方法从渲染残差或多视角特征不一致估计逐像素不确定性来找动态区域，但缺少直接运动证据；重建不准或特征模糊时精度可能下降。此外，这类不确定性只在束调整（BA）中降低像素权重，估计失准仍会损害相机位姿和 3D 重建。因此，我们提出面向动态场景的单目 RGB SLAM 系统：由光流与相机运动诱导光流之间的残差估计运动不确定性，直接反映物体运动；估计随帧对齐精度变化，减少误检并得到准确的逐像素动态掩码。为使 BA 更稳健，我们先用高置信度像素估计相机位姿，再用这些位姿在联合精炼位姿与深度时重投影动态像素，降低物体运动对两类更新的影响。我们还量化评估动态掩码，分析其对下游动态物体跟踪与重建的影响。相对先进基线，该方法在 DAVIS 上将平均动态掩码 IoU 提高 35%；相对其 SLAM 骨干，在 Bonn 和 TUM 上分别将平均绝对轨迹误差（ATE）降低 59% 和 19%。源代码将公开。

2610.23548.abstract_en: Legged robots equipped with manipulators offer promising capabilities for loco-manipulation tasks in unstructured environments. However, achieving task-consistent end-effector behavior during locomotion remains challenging due to terrain-induced disturbances and the strong coupling between locomotion and manipulation, particularly for small-scale quadruped platforms. A reinforcement-learning based whole-body control framework is proposed for quadruped loco-manipulation on complex terrain. The proposed framework combines a hybrid task representation with task-prioritized whole-body learning to coordinate locomotion and manipulation while preserving task-consistent end-effector behavior. A lightweight quadruped manipulator platform is further developed to validate the proposed framework on a small-scale quadruped system. Real-world experiments demonstrate successful deployment on complex terrains such as slopes up to 30 degrees, stairs, and deformable terrain. These results demonstrate the feasibility of deploying learned whole-body control policy for quadruped loco-manipulation in real-world environments and highlight the importance of task-consistent whole-body coordination for terrain-adaptive loco-manipulation.
2610.23548.abstract_zh: 带机械臂的足式机器人有望在非结构化环境中完成移动操作，但行走期间保持末端执行器的任务一致行为仍很难，原因是地形扰动及行走与操作的强耦合，对小型四足平台尤其如此。我们提出面向复杂地形四足移动操作的强化学习全身控制框架，将混合任务表示和按任务优先级的全身学习结合，以协调行走和操作并维持末端执行器的任务一致行为。我们还开发轻量四足操作平台，在小型四足系统上验证框架。真实实验展示了在坡度最高 30 度、楼梯和可变形地形等复杂环境中的成功部署。结果表明，学习式全身控制策略在真实复杂地形移动操作中可行，也强调了任务一致的全身协调对地形自适应移动操作的重要性。

2610.23018.abstract_en: Vision-language-action (VLA) models are rapidly expanding what individual robots can accomplish, yet many real-world manipulation settings require multiple arms to operate as a coordinated system. Existing approaches organize multi-arm coordination in different ways, including centralized joint policies, high-level task or role assignment, and locally executed policies that react to teammates. However, how complete action-producing VLAs should explicitly interact with one another during action generation remains largely unexplored. We introduce VLA-Fabric, which organizes one complete VLA per arm while preserving local perception and action ownership, and enables coordination through learned interaction across policy boundaries. We first systematically study where such interaction should occur, how peer information should be aggregated, and how the interaction should be learned, revealing complementary coordination functions spanning shared context, peer-specific latent information, and action-stage interaction. We then re-instantiate these functions in a structurally different VLA architecture, showing that the coordination principle is not tied to a particular tensor layout or backbone implementation. Finally, we compose teams of three and four arms and evaluate them in simulation and physical experiments. On all four physical tasks, Full interaction improves success over independently trained local policies by 16--40 percentage points. Together, these results suggest that explicit interaction among complete VLA policies offers a scalable path toward networked embodied intelligence.
2610.23018.abstract_zh: 视觉—语言—动作（VLA）模型正扩展单个机器人能完成的任务，但许多真实操作场景需要多条机械臂作为协调系统工作。现有多臂协作形式包括集中式联合策略、高层任务或角色分配，以及会对队友作出反应的本地策略；然而，完整的、能输出动作的 VLA 应如何在动作生成过程中显式交互，仍缺乏研究。我们提出 VLA-Fabric：每条臂保留一个完整 VLA 及其本地感知和动作归属，同时通过跨策略边界的学习式交互协调。我们系统研究交互应发生的位置、如何聚合同伴信息以及如何学习交互，发现共享上下文、同伴特有潜信息和动作阶段交互承担互补的协调功能。随后，我们在结构不同的 VLA 架构中重新实现这些功能，表明协调原则不依赖特定张量布局或骨干实现。最后，我们组合三臂和四臂团队，并在仿真和实体实验中评估；在全部四个实体任务上，完整交互相比独立训练的本地策略使成功率提高 16–40 个百分点。结果提示，完整 VLA 策略之间的显式交互可成为可扩展的网络化具身智能路径。

2610.23203.abstract_en: Vision-and-Language Navigation (VLN) requires embodied agents to ground language in visual observations and make long-horizon decisions. Existing methods often address these demands through task-specific architectures. As multimodal large language models (MLLMs) become increasingly capable, an important question remains: Have we truly unlocked the potential of native MLLMs for VLN before introducing task-specific architecture? We present SimpleVLN, an architecture-preserving framework developed through studies of navigation formulation, data construction, and optimization. At the formulation level, SimpleVLN combines single-turn decision inputs with fixed-budget global-local memory to efficiently use navigation history without unbounded context growth, while action chunks enable efficient output of multiple primitive actions per model invocation. For data construction, we combine expert demonstrations with policy-dependent DAgger experience and develop a scalable synthesis pipeline that generates large-scale tasks for reinforcement learning. At the optimization level, a progressive IL-DAgger-RL pipeline advances from action imitation to task-level outcome optimization. Comprehensive experiments validate the effectiveness of these three aspects. We instantiate SimpleVLN across multiple MLLM backbones and model sizes, demonstrating its generality. SimpleVLN achieves 76.7% and 80.1% success rates on the R2R-CE and RxR-CE splits, respectively, substantially outperforming existing methods. These results show that the navigation capabilities of native MLLMs can be effectively unlocked without task-specific architectural designs.
2610.23203.abstract_zh: 视觉—语言导航（VLN）要求具身智能体把语言落实到视觉观测，并作出长时决策。现有方法常用任务特定架构；随着多模态大语言模型（MLLM）能力增强，一个问题是：在引入任务特定架构之前，原生 MLLM 的 VLN 潜力是否已充分释放？我们提出 SimpleVLN，一种通过研究导航形式、数据构造和优化而建立的、保留原有架构的框架。形式上，它以单轮决策输入配合固定预算的全局—局部记忆来高效使用导航历史，避免上下文无限增长，并用动作块让每次模型调用输出多个基本动作。数据方面，它结合专家示范和依赖当前策略的 DAgger 经验，并构建可扩展的任务合成流程，为强化学习生成大规模任务。优化方面，渐进的 IL–DAgger–RL 流程从动作模仿推进到任务结果优化。全面实验验证这三方面的有效性；在多个 MLLM 骨干与规模上的实例化也显示其通用性。SimpleVLN 在 R2R-CE 和 RxR-CE 划分上的成功率分别为 76.7% 和 80.1%，显著优于既有方法。结果表明，无须任务特定架构设计，也能有效释放原生 MLLM 的导航能力。

2610.22496.abstract_en: Robot learning has advanced by scaling demonstration datasets and model capacity; however, deploying a new robot embodiment or task typically necessitates a dedicated teleoperation corpus. The resulting policies remain bounded by their imitation distributions, limiting generalization and continual self-improvement. We introduce RAX (Robot Agent eXploration), an open-source framework for robot agents centered on scaling exploration: enabling agents to improve by acquiring online experience and synthesizing executable programs. In RAX, a general-purpose coding agent generates robot control code, operating without action demonstration data, hand-engineered action primitives, or value-function guidance. Through online exploration, the agent identifies decision sequences that achieve task goals and compiles them into modular programs encapsulating the full perception-planning-control loop. Using RAX, we present a systematic multi-embodiment study on scaling online exploration across precision and long-horizon manipulation tasks using single-arm, bimanual, dexterous, mobile, and humanoid systems in simulation and on real robots. Generalization performance on unseen environments improves consistently as exploration scales. In simulation, RAX outperforms top baseline models by +37.4% on average. On real robots, RAX autonomously learns memory-dependent, articulated, high-precision, deformable, and long-horizon mobile manipulation tasks without human demonstrations, continually improving performance by composing verified skills from prior exploration sessions. As exploration scales, we observe emergent capabilities including active perception, error recovery, safety guardrails, and human-robot collaboration. We open-source RAX as a generalist robot-agent platform in which new robot embodiments are integrated through their APIs alone, without teleoperated data collection or policy training.
2610.22496.abstract_zh: 通过扩大示范数据集和模型容量，机器人学习取得了进展；但部署新的机器人形态或任务通常仍需专门的遥操作数据集，所得策略也受模仿分布限制，妨碍泛化与持续自我改进。我们提出 RAX（Robot Agent eXploration），一个以扩大在线探索为中心的开源机器人智能体框架，使智能体能通过获取在线经验并合成可执行程序来改进。RAX 中的通用编码智能体生成机器人控制代码，无须动作示范数据、手工设计的动作基元或价值函数引导。通过在线探索，智能体找出达成目标的决策序列，并把它们编译成封装完整感知—规划—控制闭环的模块化程序。基于 RAX，我们在仿真和真实机器人上，对单臂、双臂、灵巧、移动和人形系统的精密及长时操作任务开展多形态在线探索扩展研究。随着探索扩展，未见环境的泛化性能持续改善；在仿真中，RAX 平均比领先基线高 37.4%。在真实机器人上，RAX 不依赖人类示范，自主学习依赖记忆、关节交互、高精度、可变形和长时移动操作任务，并通过组合先前探索会话中已验证的技能持续改进。随着探索扩展，还观察到主动感知、错误恢复、安全护栏和人机协作等涌现能力。我们将 RAX 开源为通用机器人智能体平台，使新的机器人形态仅通过 API 即可接入，无须遥操作采集或策略训练。

2610.22951.abstract_en: Vision-language-action (VLA) models have shown strong promise for generalist robotic manipulation, but their inference cost remains a major bottleneck for real-time control. This limitation is especially pronounced in flow-matching VLAs such as $\pi_{0.5}$, where the action expert is evaluated repeatedly during iterative denoising. We introduce MambaAct, an efficient Mamba action expert for flow-matching VLA policies. MambaAct retains the pretrained visual-language prefix encoder of $\pi_{0.5}$, while replacing its transformer-based action expert with a compact Mamba-based action expert. Within this expert, Mamba serves as the action mixer that models dependencies across the noisy continuous-action sequence. To preserve visual-language conditioning without repeated token-level cross-attention, MambaAct uses a lightweight Context Compressor to map Vision-language model (VLM) prefix tokens into a compact conditioning signal that gates and modulates each Mamba action block. MambaAct uses a $10\times$ smaller action expert and reduces flow-matching denoising latency by $64.8\%$ on LIBERO and $58.8\%$ in real-world deployment, while improving mean LIBERO success by $1.08$ percentage points across three independent fine-tuning seeds and maintaining gains on LIBERO-Plus and real-world benchmarks. Our code and model weights are publicly available at this https URL.
2610.22951.abstract_zh: 视觉—语言—动作（VLA）模型在通用机器人操作方面有潜力，但推理开销仍是实时控制的主要瓶颈；对 $\pi_{0.5}$ 等流匹配 VLA 尤其如此，因为迭代去噪需反复调用动作专家。我们提出 MambaAct，一种用于流匹配 VLA 策略的高效 Mamba 动作专家。它保留 $\pi_{0.5}$ 预训练的视觉—语言前缀编码器，用紧凑的 Mamba 动作专家替换原 Transformer 动作专家。专家内部，Mamba 充当动作混合器，建模带噪连续动作序列的依赖关系。为在不反复进行 token 级交叉注意力的情况下保留视觉—语言条件，MambaAct 用轻量 Context Compressor 将 VLM 前缀 token 映射为紧凑条件信号，对每个 Mamba 动作块作门控和调制。其动作专家小 10 倍，在 LIBERO 上把流匹配去噪延迟降低 64.8%，真实部署降低 58.8%；同时，在三个独立微调种子上使 LIBERO 平均成功率提高 1.08 个百分点，并在 LIBERO-Plus 和真实基准上保持收益。代码和模型权重已公开，见论文所链资源。

2610.22997.abstract_en: Achieving precise terminal position and heading alignment remains a significant challenge for learning-based mobile robot control. Recent vision-based learning methods have shown promise for precise target-relative control and generalization to unseen environments with pretrained visual encoders, but general-purpose visual representations are not specifically designed to capture the fine-grained spatial differences between current and goal views required for precise control, and real-world demonstrations combining millimeter-scale terminal accuracy with zero-shot transfer across environments remain limited. To address these challenges, we propose Geometric Representation Conditioning for Precise Visuomotor Policy (GR-VIP), a goal-conditioned visuomotor policy that leverages a visual encoder pretrained for relative camera pose estimation. Rather than using the final relative-pose estimate, GR-VIP conditions action prediction on the dense relational features produced before pose regression, preserving fine-grained cross-view information for learning corrective actions from demonstrations. We evaluate GR-VIP on a real-world docking task and demonstrate high docking success rates and millimeter-scale terminal accuracy in both the training and unseen environments, without additional training for transfer. Furthermore, supplementary experiments illustrate the policy's ability to align with non-docking targets and complete docking under a tested low-light condition.
2610.22997.abstract_zh: 学习式移动机器人控制仍难以实现精确的终点位置和航向对齐。近期视觉学习方法借助预训练视觉编码器，在精确目标相对控制和未见环境泛化上有进展，但通用视觉表示并非专为捕捉当前视图与目标视图间的细微空间差别而设计；同时，兼具毫米级终点精度与跨环境零样本迁移的真实实验仍有限。为此，我们提出 GR-VIP，一种目标条件视觉运动策略，利用为相对相机位姿估计而预训练的视觉编码器。GR-VIP 不使用最终的相对位姿估计，而以位姿回归前产生的稠密关系特征作为动作预测条件，保留跨视图的细粒度信息，以便从示范中学习纠正动作。我们在真实停靠任务上评估 GR-VIP，展示它在训练环境和未见环境中均有较高停靠成功率与毫米级终点精度，迁移无须额外训练。补充实验还表明，该策略能够对齐非停靠目标，并在所测试的弱光条件下完成停靠。

2610.22576.abstract_en: Flow-based policies such as $\pi_0$ are trained on a fixed set of embodiments, and transferring them to new ones is an open problem. To adapt a frozen $\pi_0$ to a new embodiment without additional demonstrations or parameter updates, we train a lightweight embodiment classifier to distinguish successful action chunks on the source body from those on the target body, using a few calibration tasks. On transfer tasks that $\pi_0$ saw on its source body but the classifier was never trained on, we nudge each denoising step of $\pi_0$ with the classifier's gradient, which estimates the direction from the distribution of successful actions on the source body toward that on the target body. On the LIBERO simulation benchmark with four modified controllers, embodiment-classifier guidance raises $\pi_0$'s average success on the target bodies from 72% to 80% across 12 suite-controller pairs, with a 31% relative reduction in failures (11 of 12 gain; 5 significant after Holm correction). In simulation, guidance is data-efficient, needing few target-body rollouts per task, which makes it promising for sim-to-real transfer, where rollouts are costly. Guidance is mixed on weak wrists and harmful on a locked wrist, when the classifier lacks data or favors infeasible motions. Collecting more target-body data with guided $\pi_0$ can fill such gaps: on one weak-wrist arm, guided $\pi_0$ solved a task on which unguided $\pi_0$ had zero successes in the original data, and retraining the classifier on the guided successes raised success from 52.5% to 70.7%.
2610.22576.abstract_zh: 基于流的 $\pi_0$ 等策略在固定的机器人形态集合上训练，向新形态迁移仍是开放问题。为在无需额外示范或参数更新的情况下把冻结的 $\pi_0$ 适配到新形态，我们利用少量校准任务训练轻量形态分类器，区分源机体和目标机体上的成功动作块。对于 $\pi_0$ 曾在源机体见过、分类器却未接受训练的迁移任务，我们在 $\pi_0$ 的每个去噪步骤用分类器梯度作引导；该梯度估计从源机体成功动作分布走向目标机体成功动作分布的方向。在采用四种修改控制器的 LIBERO 仿真基准上，跨 12 组任务集—控制器组合，该引导将目标机体平均成功率从 72% 提高到 80%，失败相对减少 31%；12 组中有 11 组改善，Holm 校正后 5 组显著。仿真中只需每项任务少量目标机体轨迹，因此对轨迹成本高的 sim-to-real 迁移有潜力。但在弱手腕上结果有好有坏，在锁定手腕上有害，因为分类器缺数据或偏好不可行动作。利用被引导的 $\pi_0$ 再采集目标机体数据可弥补缺口：一条弱手腕机械臂上，引导后解决了原始数据中未引导 $\pi_0$ 从未成功的任务；用新增成功样本重训分类器，使成功率从 52.5% 升至 70.7%。

2610.22765.abstract_en: Precise pedicel-targeted grasping in strawberry harvesting remains a critical bottleneck due to the pedicel's small diameter (1.3-3 mm), color similarity with surrounding foliage, and precise force control required for clean abscission zone detachment. As a market-grade crop, strawberry aesthetic value makes bruise-free pedicel detachment essential over direct fruit grasping. Classical approaches struggle to unify vision models, motion planning, and contact manipulation into a robust framework, particularly in occluded canopy environments. Therefore, this work presents a visuomotor imitation learning pipeline for pedicel-targeted strawberry harvesting that unifies perception, motion planning, and contact manipulation from collecting human teleoperation demonstrations, training an Action Chunking with Transformers (ACT) policy with a ResNet-50 visual backbone, and deploying the learned policy autonomously on a Jetson AGX Orin edge platform at 15 Hz. The trained policy achieved consistent loss convergence from 2.84 to 0.091 over 100K gradient steps on 130 demonstrations. We have also established a reproducible open-source pipeline with publicly released dataset and model weights for the agricultural robotics community. Full dataset is available at, this https URL and trained policy at, this https URL. To replicate this work, all code, configurations, and deployment instructions are publicly available at, this https URL.
2610.22765.abstract_zh: 草莓采收中精准抓取果梗仍是关键瓶颈：果梗直径仅 1.3–3 mm，与周围叶片颜色相近，而从离层干净分离还需精确力控制。草莓作为按外观分级的作物，应避免直接抓果造成碰伤，因而无损果梗分离尤为重要。经典方法难以在遮挡冠层中将视觉、运动规划和接触操作统一为稳健框架。本文提出面向果梗的视觉运动模仿学习流程：采集人类遥操作示范，用 ResNet-50 视觉骨干训练 Transformer 动作分块（ACT）策略，并在 Jetson AGX Orin 边缘平台以 15 Hz 自主部署。基于 130 条示范训练 10 万梯度步后，训练损失从 2.84 稳定收敛至 0.091。作者还建立了可复现的开源流程，公开农业机器人数据集和模型权重；完整数据集、训练策略、代码、配置及部署说明见论文所链资源。

2610.23271.abstract_en: Vision--Language--Action (VLA) models promise generalist robotic agents, yet consolidating skills learned across heterogeneous tasks and environments remains difficult: training data is fragmented across platforms, joint multi-task training suffers from interference, and model merging tends to introduce parameter conflicts or require architectural changes. We instead advocate a paradigm in which skills are first learned independently and then consolidated post hoc. To this end, we propose NestedVLA, which replaces parameter aggregation with parameter generation: a nested hypernetwork, conditioned on the target task, synthesizes task-adaptive action-expert parameters that compose with a frozen base VLA. Task-specific compressed VLM residuals are retained separately. This formulation enables flexible task-conditioned skill reuse while mitigating interference. Across three RL benchmarks (MetaWorld, ManiSkill, CALVIN), NestedVLA outperforms the strongest model-merging baseline by 41 pp on average, matches per-task fine-tuning within 1 pp on ManiSkill, and substantially closes the gap on CALVIN, pointing toward a storage-efficient route to skill consolidation. Code is available at this https URL.
2610.23271.abstract_zh: 视觉—语言—动作（VLA）模型有望成为通用机器人智能体，但异构任务和环境中学到的技能难以整合：训练数据分散于不同平台，联合多任务训练会互相干扰，模型合并会引入参数冲突或要求改架构。我们主张先独立学习技能，再事后整合。为此，我们提出 NestedVLA，以参数生成替代参数聚合：一个由目标任务条件化的嵌套超网络合成任务自适应动作专家参数，再与冻结的基础 VLA 组合；任务特定的压缩 VLM 残差单独保留。这种表述在减轻干扰的同时支持灵活的任务条件技能复用。在 MetaWorld、ManiSkill、CALVIN 三个强化学习基准上，NestedVLA 平均比最强模型合并基线高 41 个百分点；在 ManiSkill 上距逐任务微调不到 1 个百分点，并显著缩小 CALVIN 上的差距，提示一种存储效率较高的技能整合路径。代码见论文所链资源。

2610.23372.abstract_en: When we say that a robot uses memory, does that memory actually play a role? Success-rate ablations alone cannot establish the use of task-relevant facts: they change information and computation together, while aggregate rates can hide offsetting gains and losses. We propose an Interventional Memory Evaluation Protocol (IMEP) for vision-language-action (VLA) systems to address four questions: (1) Does memory provide a net benefit?
