(2) Under what conditions does memory help? (3) Do changes to memory alter task outcomes? (4) Are these effects specific to task-relevant facts? At the retrieval interface, we compare target-fact substitutions with fact-preserving replacements, minimal numerical perturbations, and exact replicas, while assessing decision correctness separately from motor execution success. We evaluate within-episode, cross-episode, and agentic memory. In cross-episode learned-bank experiments, a one-unit-in-the-last-place (ULP) intervention, including its installation procedure, changes 11.9% of seed-paired outcomes, while changing key facts produces no clear additional effect over fact-preserving replacements. To examine when memory helps, we introduce ChainBench, where correct decisions require historical information unavailable in current observations. The full memory configuration raises task success from 39.1% to 74.3%, matching the oracle-decision condition under shared recorded executions. These results show that correct history can support robot decisions, but establishing whether a memory system realizes this benefit requires fact-specific evidence beyond aggregate success rates.
2610.23372.abstract_zh: 当我们说机器人“使用记忆”时，记忆是否真的发挥作用？仅比较成功率的消融不能证明模型使用了任务相关事实：它同时改变信息和计算，汇总成功率还可能掩盖相互抵消的收益与损失。我们提出针对视觉—语言—动作（VLA）系统的干预式记忆评估协议 IMEP，回答四个问题：记忆是否带来净收益；在什么条件下有益；改变记忆是否改变任务结果；这些影响是否特指任务相关事实。在检索接口，协议比较目标事实替换、保留事实的替换、最小数值扰动和完全复制，并把决策正确性与运动执行成功分开评估。我们考察回合内、跨回合及智能体式记忆。在跨回合学习记忆库实验中，一个最低有效位（ULP）干预连同其安装过程改变了 11.9% 的配对随机种子结果，而改变关键事实相对保留事实的替换没有明确额外效果。为考察记忆何时有益，我们引入 ChainBench；其正确决策需要当前观测中没有的历史信息。完整记忆配置把任务成功率从 39.1% 提升至 74.3%，在共享记录执行条件下与 oracle 决策相当。结果说明正确历史能支持机器人决策，但要证明记忆系统真正实现这一收益，需要超越汇总成功率的事实特定证据。

2610.23551.abstract_en: Many manipulation tasks that are effortless for dexterous human hands remain challenging for robotic systems equipped with simple, task-specialized grippers. Industrial platforms commonly rely on end-effectors such as suction cups or parallel-jaw grippers, yet no single mode can reliably satisfy the diverse constraints encountered across different phases of complex manipulation tasks, including pickup, reorientation, insertion, and constrained placement. In this work, we investigate whether complementary simple grippers within a heterogeneous bimanual setup can collectively realize tasks that exceed the capability of any individual gripper alone. Given a single human demonstration specifying the desired object motion, we formulate embodiment-aware execution as a finite-horizon optimization over arm-trajectory assignments. At each segment, the planner determines whether single-arm manipulation or a coordinated dual arm handover is required, jointly reasoning over heterogeneous grasp feasibility, motion constraints, manipulability, and cross-gripper compatibility. Exploiting this formulation, we compute globally consistent assignments with explicit switching regularization. Experiments on a dual Franka FR3 platform equipped with suction and parallel-jaw grippers demonstrate improved feasibility and reliability in tasks that are infeasible under single-gripper execution.
2610.23551.abstract_zh: 许多人手轻松完成的操作，对只装有简单专用夹爪的机器人仍很困难。工业平台常用吸盘或平行夹爪，但单一末端执行器难以可靠满足复杂任务不同阶段的抓取、重新定向、插入和受约束放置要求。我们研究异构双臂系统中互补的简单夹爪能否共同完成单个夹爪无法完成的任务。给定一条指定目标物体运动的人类示范，我们把形态感知执行表述为臂—轨迹分配上的有限时域优化。每个阶段，规划器决定采用单臂操作还是协调双臂交接，同时推理异构抓取可行性、运动约束、可操作性和跨夹爪兼容性。利用这一形式，我们计算具有显式切换正则化的全局一致分配。配备吸盘和平行夹爪的双 Franka FR3 平台实验显示，对单夹爪执行不可行的任务，该方法提高了可行性和可靠性。

2610.22509.abstract_en: Reliable 3D person detection is important for rescue robotics to give first responders situational awareness. Yet most multimodal 3D detection research targets automotive scenarios in which pedestrians mostly appear in a narrow range of upright, near-road poses. It is therefore unclear how much of the reported performance transfers to rescue settings, as a person may be lying, partially occluded, or in unstructured indoor and outdoor environments. To investigate this gap, we introduce TriSAR-3D, a multimodal person detection dataset recorded with a high-resolution 128-channel LiDAR, an RGB camera, and a thermal camera. It captures varied poses in indoor as well as outdoor locations at different times of day to study their influence on 3D object detector performance. Furthermore, we propose a novel trimodal 3D detection pipeline, PaintFusion, that fuses PointPainting-based evidence using a simple MLP. We show that the derived method reaches 65.4 AP@50 and thereby outperforms strong LiDAR-only (CenterPoint, 53.4), RGB+LiDAR (BEVFusion, 60.5), and adapted trimodal (Tri-BEVFusion, 60.7) baselines on the dataset. At the same time, it is substantially faster than other fusion-based methods such as BEVFusion, with a per-frame latency of 51.6 ms compared to 101 ms. Additionally, we test how the performance of different 3D object detectors generalizes to unseen pose categories. Removing lying instances from training data collapses the lying-pose AP@50 to near zero across all evaluated detectors. The results indicate that dataset diversity exerts a large effect on 3D object detection performance. The dataset and code are available at this https URL.
2610.22509.abstract_zh: 可靠的 3D 人员检测可帮助救援机器人为一线人员提供态势感知。然而，多模态 3D 检测研究大多面向行人通常直立、靠近道路的自动驾驶场景，因此不清楚其性能有多少能迁移到人员可能躺卧、部分遮挡，且场地内外都无结构的救援场景。为研究这一差距，我们提出 TriSAR-3D 多模态人员检测数据集，由高分辨率 128 线 LiDAR、RGB 相机和热成像相机采集，覆盖不同时间、室内外位置与多样姿势，以研究其对 3D 检测器表现的影响。我们还提出 PaintFusion，一种用简单 MLP 融合基于 PointPainting 证据的三模态 3D 检测流程。该方法在数据集上达到 65.4 AP@50，优于仅 LiDAR 的 CenterPoint（53.4）、RGB+LiDAR 的 BEVFusion（60.5）和改造后的三模态 Tri-BEVFusion（60.7）；每帧延迟为 51.6 ms，也快于 BEVFusion 的 101 ms。我们还测试不同 3D 检测器向未见姿势类别的泛化。若从训练数据去掉躺卧样本，所有受测检测器的躺卧姿势 AP@50 都跌至近零。结果说明数据多样性对 3D 检测性能影响很大。数据集和代码见论文所链资源。

2610.23039.abstract_en: Feed-forward Gaussian models have made novel view synthesis almost instantaneous. Feed-forward methods predict Gaussians directly, either in two stages or in a single merged pass. Using two separately trained models is attractive because each can specialize in its own objective: one for accurate pose estimation and the other for high-quality reconstruction, rather than forcing a single jointly trained network to compromise between the two. A natural instantiation pairs a frozen pose estimator, VGGT, with a frozen reconstruction backbone, TokenGS. Prior work, such as VGGT-X and 3R-GS, also adopts a two-stage design, but attributes the resulting quality degradation to noisy pose estimates and introduces learned refinement. We show that this is not the primary source of the problem. Through per-camera analysis across 107 scenes from two datasets, DL3DV and MipNeRF360, using COLMAP poses as the reference, we find that the rotation error after alignment is small (median 1.6 degrees), whereas the translation scale is offset by a large, dataset-consistent factor. Controlled ablations over 140 DL3DV scenes show that the primary obstacles are two integration failures rather than pose error: a coordinate-frame inconsistency and a translation-scale mismatch, both of which can be corrected deterministically. With these fixes, a frozen VGGT driving a frozen TokenGS achieves 22.47 PSNR, within 0.51 dB of the COLMAP reference, with no additional training, when poses are estimated from all scene views. In the sparse setting, where reconstruction uses only four context images under the standard pose-free protocol, the same pipeline matches this all-view quality, yielding a fully COLMAP-free pipeline without any refinement step.
2610.23039.abstract_zh: 前馈高斯模型让新视角合成几乎即时完成。它们可以分两阶段或一次合并前向直接预测高斯。分别训练的两阶段模型很有吸引力，因为一个可专注准确位姿估计，另一个专注高质量重建，无须单个联合模型在两项目标间折中；自然的搭配是冻结位姿估计器 VGGT 与冻结重建骨干 TokenGS。VGGT-X、3R-GS 等先前两阶段工作把质量下降归因于位姿噪声，并引入学习式精炼。我们表明这并非主要问题。在 DL3DV 和 MipNeRF360 两个数据集的 107 个场景中，以 COLMAP 位姿为参考做逐相机分析，发现对齐后的旋转误差很小，中位数为 1.6 度，但平移尺度存在较大且在数据集内一致的偏移。对 140 个 DL3DV 场景的受控消融表明，主要障碍是坐标系不一致和平移尺度不匹配这两个集成问题，而非位姿误差；两者都可确定性地修正。修正后，当从场景所有视角估计位姿时，冻结 VGGT 驱动冻结 TokenGS 可达到 22.47 PSNR，距 COLMAP 参考仅 0.51 dB，且无须额外训练。在标准无位姿协议下仅用四张上下文图像重建的稀疏设置中，同一管线达到与全视角设置相当的质量，实现无需 COLMAP 或精炼步骤的完整管线。

2610.23237.abstract_en: Jointly reconstructing RGB and X-ray provides new insights by connecting external appearance with internal structure, enabling a more complete understanding of real-world objects than single modality. Yet existing methods train separate models per modality and suffer from redundant geometry, alignment artifacts, and loose coupling that limits cross-modal insight discovery. We propose a unified representation in which all Gaussian primitives share a single set of geometric parameters, with only surface-proximal primitives additionally carrying appearance attributes. We perform cross-modal registration through clean multi-view stereo and X-ray geometric proxies instead of aligning two sets of optimized Gaussians, improving alignment stability. We then jointly optimize the unified representation via supervision from both modalities, complemented by a surface-depth consistency loss derived from X-ray geometry to guide RGB reconstruction. Experiments on the InsideOut dataset and our Flower & Insect dataset show that our framework achieves more robust cross-modal alignment, higher RGB rendering quality without compromising X-ray reconstruction, and a more compact representation than maintaining two independent geometries.
2610.23237.abstract_zh: 联合重建 RGB 和 X 射线可把外部外观与内部结构联系起来，比单一模态更全面地理解真实物体。但既有方法为各模态分别训练模型，造成冗余几何、对齐伪影以及限制跨模态信息发现的松散耦合。我们提出统一表示：所有高斯基元共享同一套几何参数，仅靠近表面的基元额外携带外观属性。跨模态配准使用干净的多视角立体视觉和 X 射线几何代理，而不是对齐两组已优化的高斯，以提升对齐稳定性。随后我们用两种模态的监督联合优化统一表示，并加入由 X 射线几何导出的表面—深度一致性损失来指导 RGB 重建。在 InsideOut 和我们的 Flower & Insect 数据集上的实验显示，相比维护两套独立几何，该框架能实现更稳健的跨模态对齐、更高的 RGB 渲染质量，同时不损害 X 射线重建，并使用更紧凑的表示。

2610.23050.abstract_en: Recent progress in 3D generation has motivated growing interest in compact generative representations of complex 3D scenes. For native 3D Gaussian scenes, however, learning such representations remains challenging due to widely varying primitive counts, nonuniform spatial density, and differences in geometry and appearance even among spatially neighboring primitives. In this work, we introduce TriFold, a native 3D Gaussian VAE that encodes Gaussian scenes into a fixed-layout triplane latent and jointly reconstructs their geometry and appearance. The key insight is to impose structural regularity on the latent space while preserving the spatial adaptivity of the underlying Gaussians. During encoding, we use cell-wise learned queries to aggregate projected Gaussians into multiple slots per cell, reducing the information loss caused by single-feature pooling. During decoding, occupancy prediction identifies active regions, where query-based set prediction and candidate selection reconstruct local Gaussian sets with spatially varying primitive counts. Building on this representation, we train a latent flow-matching model for conditional scene-level 3DGS generation, enabling point-cloud-conditioned synthesis and single-image-conditioned amodal generation. Experiments demonstrate that TriFold achieves high-fidelity reconstruction and generation from a single image that provides only a partial observation of the scene, validating its effectiveness for native 3D Gaussian representation learning. this https URL
2610.23050.abstract_zh: 3D 生成的发展推动了对复杂 3D 场景紧凑生成表示的兴趣；但原生 3D 高斯场景的基元数量差异大、空间密度不均，即使相邻基元在几何和外观上也可能不同，使这种表示难以学习。我们提出 TriFold，一种原生 3D 高斯变分自编码器，把高斯场景编码到固定布局的三平面潜空间，同时重建几何和外观。关键是在潜空间加入结构规则性，同时保留底层高斯的空间自适应性。编码时，逐单元的学习查询将投影后的高斯聚合进每个单元的多个槽，减少单特征池化造成的信息损失；解码时，占据预测找出活跃区域，再由基于查询的集合预测和候选选择重建局部高斯集合，使基元数量随空间变化。基于这一表示，我们训练条件场景级 3DGS 生成的潜空间流匹配模型，支持点云条件合成和单图条件的补全式生成。实验表明，TriFold 可由只提供场景部分观测的单张图像实现高保真重建与生成，支持其原生 3D 高斯表示学习的有效性。相关资源见论文所链页面。

2610.23856.abstract_en: Generated videos often lose geometric consistency under camera motion: structures warp under viewpoint change, parallax becomes inconsistent, and smooth camera movement may collapse into shot-like transitions. We argue that this failure is largely a data problem. In web-scale video corpora, most visible motion comes from dynamic objects captured by static or weakly moving cameras, leaving only sparse supervision for viewpoint-induced appearance changes. To address this, we propose Video Geometry Corrector (VGC), a post-hoc video-to-video model trained on synthetic paired supervision. Starting from real videos with diverse camera motion and pose annotations, we construct VG-Pairs with a synthetic paired-supervision data generation pipeline. Each video clip is treated as a geometry-consistent target and paired with a distorted counterpart synthesized by a pretrained image-to-video inpainting model using trajectory-adaptive keyframes. VGC learns to map the distorted input to the geometry-consistent target without modifying the source generator, and uses optical flow as an auxiliary cue to help disentangle camera motion from object motion. Experiments on pose-conditioned and prompt-driven benchmarks show that VGC improves geometric consistency across multiple source generators, and scaling to a larger backbone further extends the framework toward more general video refinement.
2610.23856.abstract_zh: 生成视频在相机运动下常丧失几何一致性：结构随视角变化而扭曲，视差不一致，平滑相机运动也可能坍缩成类似切镜的转场。我们认为，这主要是数据问题：网络规模视频语料中，大多数可见运动来自静止或微动相机拍摄的动态物体，因视角变化引起的外观变化监督很少。为此，我们提出 Video Geometry Corrector（VGC），一种利用合成配对监督训练的后处理视频到视频模型。从带有多样相机运动和位姿标注的真实视频出发，我们用合成配对监督数据生成流程构造 VG-Pairs：把每段视频视为几何一致的目标，再用预训练图像到视频修复模型和轨迹自适应关键帧生成其扭曲对应样本。VGC 学习将扭曲输入映射回几何一致的目标，无须修改源生成器，并用光流作辅助线索来分离相机运动与物体运动。位姿条件与提示词驱动基准实验表明，VGC 能改善多个源生成器的几何一致性；扩大骨干模型规模还使框架更趋向通用视频精炼。

2610.24534.abstract_en: Reliable long-horizon prediction remains a central challenge for embodied world models. Although recent generative models can synthesize visually plausible action-conditioned futures, their latent dynamics are typically learned through unconstrained transition modules, which may gradually deviate from coherent physical evolution as predictions are recursively rolled forward. We investigate whether explicitly structuring latent state evolution can improve the stability and utility of such imagined trajectories. To this end, we introduce HWM, a structured dynamics framework that represents backbone latents in a learned phase space consisting of generalized coordinates and momenta. Future states are propagated through dissipative Hamiltonian dynamics and mapped back to the original latent representation through a learnable inverse interface. The resulting formulation can be integrated into existing world-model architectures without redesigning their perception or decoding components, while multi-step transition supervision encourages the structured rollout to remain aligned with the latent trajectories induced by real observations. Controlled simulation experiments show that HWM produces more accurate estimates of velocity, acceleration, and jerk and substantially reduces long-horizon energy drift relative to unstructured latent dynamics. We further evaluate the approach across three distinct embodied world-model settings, covering single-arm multi-view prediction with Ctrl-World, dual-arm single-view prediction with EVAC, and task-oriented single-arm prediction with Cosmos-Predict2.5-2B. On RoboCasa, incorporating HWM into Cosmos-Predict2.5-2B yields a 2.7% relative improvement in task success. On real-world AgiBot World trajectories, it improves nDTW by 9.7% with Ctrl-World and Logic by 8.4% with EVAC.
2610.24534.abstract_zh: 可靠的长时预测仍是具身世界模型的核心挑战。近期生成模型虽能合成视觉上可信的动作条件未来，其潜在动力学通常由无约束的转移模块学习，在递归推演中可能逐渐偏离连贯的物理演化。我们研究显式构造潜状态演化是否能提升想象轨迹的稳定性与用途。为此，提出 HWM：将主干网络的潜表示映射到由广义坐标与动量组成的学习相空间，经耗散哈密顿动力学传播未来状态，再通过可学习的逆接口映回原潜表示。该形式无需重做感知或解码部件，即可接入现有世界模型；多步转移监督促使结构化推演与真实观测诱导的潜轨迹对齐。受控仿真表明，相比无结构潜动力学，HWM 对速度、加速度和加加速度的估计更准确，并显著降低长时能量漂移。作者还在三种具身世界模型设置中评估：Ctrl-World 的单臂多视角预测、EVAC 的双臂单视角预测，以及 Cosmos-Predict2.5-2B 的任务导向单臂预测。在 RoboCasa 上，接入 HWM 后 Cosmos-Predict2.5-2B 的任务成功率相对提高 2.7%；在真实 AgiBot World 轨迹上，Ctrl-World 的 nDTW 提高 9.7%，EVAC 的 Logic 指标提高 8.4%。

2610.26067.abstract_en: Generalizing real-time physics-based animation across diverse 3D shapes and spatial discretizations remains challenging. In this paper, we introduce PhysSkin++, a physics-informed framework that learns continuous neural skinning fields from static geometries to construct compact deformation subspaces. Specifically, we propose a Neural Skinning Fields Autoencoder that predicts shape-dependent deformation subspaces without per-object network training. To learn these subspaces without simulation trajectories, we develop a Physics-Informed Self-Supervised Learning strategy that combines skinning-field normalization with conflict-aware gradient correction, stabilizing joint optimization under physical and orthogonality constraints. The learned representation supports efficient reduced dynamics with user control and contact interactions, together with direct animation binding to meshes, point clouds, and 3D Gaussians. For prescribed rig animation, we further introduce a self-supervised complementarity objective to learn complementary elastic responses without enforcing complementarity constraints at runtime. Experiments demonstrate cross-shape generalization of the learned skinning fields, real-time reduced simulation, and applications to controllable, collision-aware, and rig-complementary animation.
2610.26067.abstract_zh: 在不同 3D 形状和空间离散方式之间泛化实时物理动画仍有难度。本文提出 PhysSkin++：从静态几何学习连续神经蒙皮场，以构造紧凑形变子空间的物理信息框架。其神经蒙皮场自编码器能够预测形状相关的形变子空间，无需为每个物体单独训练网络。为不依赖仿真轨迹学习这些子空间，作者提出物理信息自监督学习，结合蒙皮场归一化和感知冲突的梯度修正，在物理约束与正交约束下稳定联合优化。所得表示支持带用户控制和接触交互的高效降阶动力学，并可直接绑定到网格、点云和 3D Gaussian。针对预设骨架动画，作者进一步提出自监督互补性目标，学习补充性的弹性响应，而在运行时无需施加互补性约束。实验展示了蒙皮场的跨形状泛化、实时降阶仿真，以及可控制、考虑碰撞和补充骨架动画的应用。

2610.23887.abstract_en: Contact-rich insertion requires precise geometric alignment despite uncertainty in perception, geometry, and con- trol. When this uncertainty causes unintended contact, the re- sulting contact provides local information that can guide correc- tive motion. Sampling-based Model Predictive Control (SMPC) is well suited to this setting because it optimizes through forward simulation without requiring gradients through contact dynamics. However, standard SMPC methods typically use generic proposal distributions that do not exploit observed contact to determine where to search next. We introduce ContactKernels, a contact-adaptive proposal kernel that uses geometry-conditioned wrench measurements to estimate contact location and local contact geometry. The estimated contact state directly adapts the proposal distribution: contact location biases the search toward corrective motions, while the contact normal shapes the sampling covariance. We evaluate ContactKernels with Predictive Sampling (PS) and Model Predictive Path Integral (MPPI) control across multiple insertion geometries in simulation and on a real robot. In simulation, ContactKernels improves mean insertion success by over 50 % points across both controllers. On the real robot, it increases insertion success from 53.3 % to 90.0 % and reduces mean time to insertion by 33 %. These results show that contact information can improve sampling-based control not only as feedback, but also by directly determining where the controller searches
2610.23887.abstract_zh: 富接触插入任务即使存在感知、几何和控制的不确定性，也要求精确的几何对齐。意外接触发生时，接触本身会提供可指导修正运动的局部信息。基于采样的模型预测控制（SMPC）通过前向仿真优化，不必穿过接触动力学求梯度，适合此场景；但标准 SMPC 通常使用通用提议分布，未利用已观测接触决定下一步搜索位置。我们提出 ContactKernels：用几何条件化的力矩测量估计接触位置及局部接触几何的自适应提议核。估计的接触状态直接调整提议分布：接触位置使搜索偏向修正运动，接触法向决定采样协方差的形状。作者将其与 Predictive Sampling（PS）和模型预测路径积分（MPPI）控制结合，在多种插入几何的仿真和真实机器人上评估。仿真中，两种控制器的平均插入成功率均提高超过 50 个百分点；实机成功率由 53.3% 升至 90.0%，平均插入时间降低 33%。结果表明，接触信息除了用作反馈，也能直接决定控制器搜索的位置。

2610.26495.abstract_en: High-accuracy computation of nonsmooth dynamics is a challenging problem in systems with multiple frictional contacts. This study proposes a general physics-informed neural network framework, termed the mixed leading variable physics-informed neural network (MLV-PINN). By using the governing equations and contact-friction laws as physical constraints, this framework provides common solution approaches for computing nonsmooth dynamics not only in discrete systems but also in continuum systems. Specifically, the network represents accelerations, normal contact forces and friction margins as independent outputs and determines them simultaneously, without first reducing the dynamics to discrete velocity-impulse complementary subproblems. A composite physics-informed loss is constructed from the equations of motion in their original form, contact-friction complementary conditions and a friction-margin consistency relation. To improve stick-slip state identification during PINN optimisation, a mixed leading variable combining relative tangential velocity and acceleration is introduced to reformulate the tangential complementary conditions. Four benchmark simulations cover one-dimensional (1-D) nonsmooth dynamics involving single-contact stick-slip, 1-D nonsmooth dynamics involving multi-contact stick-slip, two-dimensional (2-D) nonsmooth dynamics with coupled normal contact-separation and tangential stick-slip, and 2-D nonsmooth dynamics in a continuum system involving moving contact on an elastic beam. Benchmark comparisons show substantial reductions in displacement and velocity errors relative to the corresponding conventional methods at large time steps. These results, together with an ablation study and tests involving friction-velocity slopes, long-time integration and loss weights, illustrate the computational accuracy and support the broad applicability of the proposed framework.
2610.26495.abstract_zh: 多摩擦接触系统中的非光滑动力学很难高精度计算。本文提出通用的混合主导变量物理信息神经网络（MLV-PINN），把控制方程与接触摩擦定律用作物理约束，为离散系统和连续体系统的非光滑动力学提供共同求解方式。网络将加速度、法向接触力与摩擦裕度作为独立输出并同时求解，而非先将动力学化为离散速度—冲量互补子问题。复合物理信息损失包含原始形式的运动方程、接触摩擦互补条件及摩擦裕度一致性关系。为改善 PINN 优化中的黏滑状态识别，作者引入结合相对切向速度与加速度的混合主导变量，重写切向互补条件。四组基准仿真包括单接触及多接触黏滑的一维非光滑动力学、耦合法向接触分离与切向黏滑的二维动力学，以及弹性梁移动接触的二维连续体动力学。大时间步下，与相应常规方法相比，位移与速度误差显著下降；消融及摩擦—速度斜率、长时积分和损失权重测试也支持所提框架的计算精度和广泛适用性。

2610.24619.abstract_en: Visual accuracy leaves open whether predicted motion obeys dynamics. We introduce a framework for measuring and diagnosing mechanical consistency in visual dynamics. An independent SI audit of rigid closed chains separates geometric admissibility, reaction-free actuator effort, and work--energy balance. Continuous scoring measures progress against fixed engineering targets, while reference replay quantifies measurement error. With three seeds per setting, we evaluate KeyCLD and CON across 343 planar assemblies at 64/256 pixels and V-JEPA + AC and LingBot-VA on 100 shared spatial test assemblies. CON reduces image MSE by 37.6%/37.2% relative to persistence, yet neither planar model attains valid native geometry. At 256 pixels, calibrated RGB replay places forecast errors far above measurement error. With exact states, KeyCLD preserves geometry and RK4 training raises its score from 52.65 to 64.30. In both spatial pathways, CAD/IK reconstruction restores geometry while mean actuator residuals exceed five times the engineering targets. The interventions distinguish gains in visual prediction and geometric admissibility from remaining force and energy errors.
2610.24619.abstract_zh: 视觉准确并不能回答预测运动是否遵循动力学。本文提出测量和诊断视觉动力学机械一致性的框架：对刚性闭链进行独立的国际单位制审计，分别评估几何可容许性、无反力的驱动器出力和功—能平衡。连续评分衡量与固定工程目标的差距，参考轨迹重放则量化测量误差。每种设置使用三个随机种子，作者在 64/256 像素下的 343 个平面装配体上评估 KeyCLD 和 CON，并在 100 个共享空间测试装配体上评估 V-JEPA + AC 和 LingBot-VA。相对持久性基线，CON 将图像 MSE 分别降低 37.6%/37.2%，但两种平面模型均未达到有效的原生几何。在 256 像素下，经校准的 RGB 重放显示预测误差远高于测量误差。给定精确状态时，KeyCLD 保持几何，RK4 训练使评分从 52.65 升至 64.30。两条空间评估路径中，CAD/IK 重建恢复了几何，但平均驱动器残差仍超过工程目标的五倍。干预实验区分了视觉预测和几何可容许性的改进与尚存的力和能量误差。

2610.24459.abstract_en: Lattice inverse-design methods can generate cells that match prescribed effective properties, but property feasibility does not imply material efficiency. Removing redundant material from an existing lattice while preserving its homogenized elasticity ordinarily requires solving a separate constrained topology optimization problem for each cell, making large-scale refinement computationally expensive. We introduce SLIM (Structural Lightweighting via Implicit Mapping), a neural lattice-refinement model that replaces this per-instance iterative optimization with a single forward prediction. SLIM uses a dual-octree implicit network to predict the signed-distance field of a lightweight lattice and is trained on input--output pairs generated by property-constrained topology optimization. To improve stiffness preservation, we use homogenization sensitivities computed on the optimized target to estimate how residual voxel errors in a prediction affect its homogenized stiffness, and penalize this estimated change during training. Once trained, SLIM requires no topology optimization, homogenization analysis, or sensitivity evaluation during prediction. On the held-out test set of 906 lattices, SLIM achieves a mean relative volume-fraction reduction of 15.90%, a lightweighting success rate of 90.51%, and a mean normalized aggregate TO-target error of 0.636%, while reducing the average per-lattice generation time from 2516.0 s with direct TO to approximately 0.5 s. These results show that SLIM provides a fast neural surrogate for repeated topology-optimization-based refinement of 3D lattices.
2610.24459.abstract_zh: 晶格逆设计能生成满足指定有效属性的单元，但属性可行不等于材料使用高效。在保持均匀化弹性的同时移除现有晶格中的冗余材料，通常需要为每个单元单独求解带约束的拓扑优化，因而大规模精简计算昂贵。本文提出 SLIM（Structural Lightweighting via Implicit Mapping）：用一次前向预测代替逐实例迭代优化的神经晶格精简模型。SLIM 使用双八叉树隐式网络预测轻量晶格的有符号距离场，以属性约束拓扑优化生成的输入—输出对训练。为更好保持刚度，作者在优化目标上计算均匀化灵敏度，估计预测中残余体素误差对均匀化刚度的影响，并在训练时惩罚这一估计变化。训练后预测无需拓扑优化、均匀化分析或灵敏度评估。在 906 个留出晶格的测试集上，SLIM 平均使体积分数降低 15.90%，轻量化成功率为 90.51%，与拓扑优化目标相比的平均归一化综合误差为 0.636%；单晶格平均生成时间由直接拓扑优化的 2516.0 秒降至约 0.5 秒。这些结果表明，SLIM 可作为重复进行 3D 晶格拓扑优化精简的快速神经代理。

2610.24285.abstract_en: Abstract Action-conditioned world models for contact-rich manipulation require data that captures how contact forms, slides, and releases under varying force. Such data are slow to collect through robot teleoperation, which often lacks force feedback and is constrained by gripper geometry. We ask whether these dynamics can instead be learned from human physical interaction and transferred to a robot. We present ACTS, a visuo-tactile world model trained only on human interaction data. Operators manipulate handheld GelSight sensors while we record third-person and wrist video, tactile images, 6-DoF sensor motion, and tactile-derived normal force, yielding React, a 4.9-hour bimanual dataset across three objects. We represent actions at the tactile sensor as motion augmented by force change, providing a shared action space for human collection and robot execution. ACTS jointly predicts future scene, wrist, and tactile observations. On held-out human data, ACTS improves scene-view prediction by 0.7-2.0 dB PSNR over the stronger of two visuo-tactile world models trained from scratch on React. Without fine-tuning, in the robot teleoperation rollouts we inspected, predicted tactile imprints still appear and disappear with recorded contact. Visual transfer is less robust: camera predictions exceed frame copying on PushT, are mixed on Rope, and fall below it on Motherboard, while wrist views can blur or hallucinate structure. These results suggest that contact dynamics transfer more reliably than visual appearance from human to robot.
2610.24285.abstract_zh: 面向富接触操作的动作条件世界模型需要描述接触如何在不同作用力下形成、滑动和释放的数据。通过机器人遥操作收集此类数据较慢，而且遥操作往往缺少力反馈并受夹爪几何限制。作者研究这些动力学能否从人类物理交互中学习并迁移到机器人，提出只用人类交互数据训练的视觉—触觉世界模型 ACTS。操作者使用手持 GelSight 传感器操作物体，系统记录第三人称和腕部视频、触觉图像、传感器 6-DoF 运动及由触觉推导的法向力，构成覆盖三个物体、时长 4.9 小时的双手 React 数据集。作者把传感器处的动作表示为附加力变化的运动，建立人类采集与机器人执行共享的动作空间；ACTS 联合预测未来场景、腕部和触觉观测。在留出的人类数据上，ACTS 的场景视图预测 PSNR 比两种从头在 React 上训练的视觉—触觉世界模型中较强者高 0.7–2.0 dB。未经微调，在作者检查的机器人遥操作轨迹中，预测触觉压痕仍会随记录的接触出现和消失。视觉迁移较不稳定：PushT 的相机预测优于复制帧，Rope 上结果混合，Motherboard 上低于复制帧；腕部视图还可能模糊或幻觉出结构。结果提示，人到机器人的接触动力学迁移比视觉外观迁移更可靠。

2610.25660.abstract_en: Video generation models produce visually compelling motion but systematically fail on fluid phenomena, including smoke, fire, and explosion debris, where outputs lack coherent vortical structure and collapse to bland dynamics that violate the physics of real fluids. Classical solvers achieve high physical fidelity but require detailed 3D scenes and carefully tuned parameters, making them impractical for in-the-wild imagery and video generation. We address this gap by injecting a data-driven fluid prior into a pre-trained video model, trained on a mixture of high-fidelity Houdini simulation data with paired velocity-field ground truth and curated in-the-wild fluid video data for appearance diversity. The core of our approach is a dual stream architecture that predicts per-frame velocity fields alongside RGB, supervised by simulation ground truth. This auxiliary signal regularizes generation toward physically consistent motion and exposes an interpretable physical quantity that we further leverage as a reward for velocity-aware direct preference optimization. Our model produces substantially more realistic fluid dynamics sequences than strong video baselines and optimization-based methods. Project page: this https URL
2610.25660.abstract_zh: 视频生成模型能产生视觉上吸引人的运动，却系统性地难以表现烟雾、火焰和爆炸碎屑等流体现象：生成结果缺少连贯的涡旋结构，动力学趋于平淡并违背真实流体物理。经典求解器的物理保真度高，但要求详细的 3D 场景和精心调节的参数，难以用于野外图像和视频生成。作者把数据驱动的流体先验注入预训练视频模型，以带有配对速度场真值的高保真 Houdini 仿真数据和为外观多样性整理的真实流体视频混合训练。核心为双流架构，在预测 RGB 的同时预测逐帧速度场，并用仿真真值监督这一辅助信号，使生成更趋向物理一致的运动。速度场也是可解释的物理量，进一步用于感知速度的直接偏好优化奖励。与强视频基线和基于优化的方法相比，模型生成的流体动力学序列明显更真实。论文提供项目页。

2610.26585.abstract_en: Generating reusable driving environments requires both controllable future observations and an explicit representation that supports rendering from different viewpoints, yet existing methods still recover explicit scenes from generated RGB videos through optimization for each sequence. To overcome these limitations, we present Drive2Gauss, a feedforward framework that converts jointly generated RGB, metric depth, and dynamic flow into dynamic 4D Gaussian scenes. A Multimodal Video Generator predicts the three modalities from reference multiview images and future control signals. Furthermore, we introduce a Gaussian Query Decoder that uses depth to initialize sparse 3D queries and flow to associate the queries across time, and integrates appearance information through spatiotemporal feature aggregation and iterative query refinement. The reconstruction stage operates in a single feedforward pass without optimization for each scene. Extensive results on nuScenes demonstrate that our approach attains an FID of 6.38 and an FVD of 12.43 for future RGB generation, a PSNR of 29.91 dB when reconstructing its generated observations, and supports both direct rendering under lateral camera shifts and downstream video fixing. Code and more visualizations are available at https://zttt04. this http URL.
2610.26585.abstract_zh: 生成可复用的驾驶环境既需要可控的未来观测，也需要支持不同视点渲染的显式表示；现有方法却仍须对每段生成的 RGB 视频单独优化恢复显式场景。为此，作者提出 Drive2Gauss：将联合生成的 RGB、度量深度和动态流一次前向转成动态 4D Gaussian 场景。多模态视频生成器根据参考多视角图像与未来控制信号预测这三种模态。Gaussian Query Decoder 利用深度初始化稀疏 3D 查询，利用流跨时间关联查询，并通过时空特征聚合和迭代查询细化融合外观信息。重建阶段只需单次前向，无须逐场景优化。在 nuScenes 上，未来 RGB 生成的 FID 为 6.38、FVD 为 12.43；对自身生成观测的重建 PSNR 为 29.91 dB。框架还支持相机横向移动下的直接渲染和下游视频修复。作者提供代码与更多可视化。

2610.24512.abstract_en: Contact-rich manipulation is essential to everyday activities, yet evaluating robots' ability to perform these activities remains challenging because of their diverse contact behaviors and the difficulty of reproducing tasks across laboratories. Drawing on observations of everyday human manipulation, we identify eight recurring skill categories that provide a practical framework for studying these capabilities. We introduce ContactBench 1.0, an extensible benchmark that instantiates these skills through 36 reference tasks and more than 40 object assets. The assets capture task-relevant geometry and contact behavior, support reproducible fabrication using consumer-grade 3D printers, and are paired with simulation models with tunable resistance loads. Controlled task variations enable evaluation of policy generalization. We evaluate recent vision-based and vision-tactile policy learning methods on six benchmark tasks. The results reveal that the evaluated vision-only policies struggle to perceive or react to contact events, while the evaluated visual-tactile policies do not meaningfully improve performance. By providing shared tasks and physical and simulated assets, ContactBench 1.0 establishes a foundation for reproducible evaluation of contact-rich manipulation research. The benchmark is open-sourced at this https URL
2610.24512.abstract_zh: 富接触操作是日常活动的重要部分，但因接触行为多样、任务难以跨实验室复现，评估机器人能力仍具挑战。基于对日常人类操作的观察，作者归纳出八类反复出现的技能，作为研究这些能力的实用框架，并推出可扩展的 ContactBench 1.0：通过 36 个参考任务和超过 40 件物体资产实例化这些技能。资产保留任务相关的几何和接触行为，可用消费级 3D 打印机可复现地制造，并配有阻力负载可调的仿真模型。受控的任务变化用于评估策略泛化。作者在六个基准任务上评估近期视觉及视觉—触觉策略学习方法，发现所测纯视觉策略难以感知或回应接触事件，而所测视觉—触觉策略也未显著提高性能。通过共享任务、实体和仿真资产，ContactBench 1.0 为富接触操作研究建立可复现评测基础；基准已开源。

2610.26759.abstract_en: Continuous in-hand rotation requires coordinated contact maintenance and renewal, linking manipulation performance to both hand geometry and tactile feedback. We investigate these relationships through rotational progress, finger participation, and fingertip loading on two versions of the low-cost LEAP Hand with anthropomorphic and symmetric finger arrangements. Both hands are integrated with TacTip vision-based tactile sensors and use a shared reinforcement learning framework. Simulation evaluates full tactile, binary touch, and proprioception-only observations on 12 unseen objects; hardware experiments evaluate full tactile policies on ten objects under multiple hand orientations. In simulation, full tactile observations increase mean normalized rotation per episode over proprioception alone by 94.8% for the anthropomorphic hand and 66.9% for the symmetric hand, with longer mean episode durations and lower mean total fingertip loads. Hardware contact measurements reveal more differentiated finger participation in the anthropomorphic hand, while cumulative loading is more evenly distributed across the symmetric hand's fingers. Overall, the symmetric hand achieves a 32.0% higher mean rotation count and a 25.8% higher aggregate rotation rate, together with longer manipulation duration. Additional hardware force recordings show a 19.9% lower mean total fingertip load for this layout. These findings relate finger arrangement to contact organization and load sharing, and show that richer tactile information supports greater task progress at lower mean loading in both simulated embodiments.
2610.26759.abstract_zh: 连续的手内旋转需要协调维持和更新接触，因此操作表现与手部几何及触觉反馈均有关。本文用旋转进度、手指参与程度和指尖负载，研究两种低成本 LEAP Hand 形态：拟人手指排列与对称排列。两者均集成基于视觉的 TacTip 触觉传感器并使用同一强化学习框架。仿真在 12 个未见物体上比较完整触觉、二值接触和仅本体感知；硬件实验在十个物体及多种手部朝向下测试完整触觉策略。仿真中，与仅本体感知相比，完整触觉使每回合平均归一化旋转量在拟人手和对称手上分别提高 94.8% 和 66.9%，同时延长平均回合时长并降低平均总指尖负载。硬件接触测量显示，拟人手的手指参与更分化，对称手的累积负载分配更均匀。总体上，对称手的平均旋转次数高 32.0%、总旋转速率高 25.8%，操作持续时间更长；额外硬件力记录显示其平均总指尖负载低 19.9%。结果将手指排列与接触组织、负载分担联系起来，并显示在两种仿真手形中，更丰富的触觉信息能以更低平均负载支持更大任务进展。

2610.24301.abstract_en: We present Torch-DPhys, a Torch-native framework implemented in PyTorch for differentiable physics simulation and hybrid physics-machine learning. It implements selected thermal-hydraulic modeling concepts and discretizations from MOOSE's Thermal Hydraulics Module and the System Analysis Module (SAM), with a preliminary extension to continuum mechanics. Native tensor residuals support CPU and GPU execution, compilation of selected numerical kernels, and sparse direct linear solves. Sensitivities are obtained by differentiating executed numerical operations or through discrete adjoints of converged residual equations. Verification combines analytical solutions, reference-code comparisons, and derivative checks. Demonstrations cover plane-strain elasticity, one- and two-loop thermal-hydraulic transients, and an axisymmetric molten-salt fast reactor. For the reactor, comparison with SAM-Lite gives a maximum normalized field discrepancy of 1.13 x 10^-5 over 200 adaptive time steps, demonstrating agreement between the tested discrete implementations. Selected transient sensitivities are assessed using tangent-linear calculations and finite differences on fixed time schedules. Two applications illustrate the framework's connection between simulation and optimization. A residual-adjoint parameter-identification calculation recovers nominal pump head and heating power with relative errors below 0.06% from noiseless synthetic MOOSE observations. A separate three-loop plant demonstration uses solver-in-the-loop training of a predictive controller by differentiating trajectory-level objectives through the thermal-hydraulic simulation. These examples illustrate a foundation for gradient-based inference, control, and coupled physics-machine learning models in nuclear engineering.
2610.24301.abstract_zh: 本文提出 Torch-DPhys：用 PyTorch 实现的原生 Torch 框架，用于可微物理仿真与物理—机器学习混合建模。它实现了 MOOSE 热工水力模块和系统分析模块（SAM）中选定的建模概念与离散方法，并初步扩展到连续介质力学。原生张量残差支持 CPU、GPU 运行、部分数值核编译以及稀疏直接线性求解；灵敏度可通过对执行过的数值运算求导，或对收敛残差方程使用离散伴随得到。验证包括解析解、参考代码对照和导数检查。演示覆盖平面应变弹性、一环与两环热工水力瞬态，以及轴对称熔盐快堆。反应堆案例与 SAM-Lite 对比，在 200 个自适应时间步上的最大归一化场差异为 1.13×10^-5，说明所测离散实现一致。部分瞬态灵敏度在固定时间调度上由切线线性计算和有限差分评估。两个应用展示仿真与优化的连接：残差伴随参数辨识从无噪声合成 MOOSE 观测中恢复名义泵扬程与加热功率，相对误差低于 0.06%；另一三环装置演示通过热工水力仿真对轨迹级目标求导，进行求解器在环的预测控制器训练。这些案例为核工程中的梯度推断、控制及耦合物理—机器学习模型提供基础。

2610.23895.abstract_en: Feedforward 3D reconstruction has largely followed an {appearance-driven paradigm}: multi-view images are encoded into visual representations, cross-view correspondence is implicitly inferred from learned features, and 3D primitives are subsequently predicted from these representations. However, calibrated cameras and sparse metric measurements already provide explicit constraints on where the same physical point should appear across views. We propose a novel paradigm, \textbf{Geometry-Conditioned Feedforward Reconstruction}, in which metric geometry establishes cross-view correspondence before the 3D representation is formed, while learned visual features refine rather than discover this correspondence. Based on this paradigm, we introduce \textbf{GeoForward}. Sparse LiDAR points are unprojected into 3D and analytically projected across calibrated cameras to provide metric correspondence anchors. A bounded continuous local search then refines these anchors using visual features, and the resulting geometry-conditioned representation is fused with global multi-view context from VGGT. The shared representation drives separate metric-depth and Gaussian-attribute prediction, establishing a direct path from explicit geometry to both Gaussian centers and spatial attributes. A sparse 3D refinement module subsequently improves local attribute compatibility while preserving the geometrically determined centers. For temporal reconstruction, endpoint Gaussians are composed using vehicle masks and motion priors. On nuScenes, GeoForward achieves the lowest cross-camera depth-consistency error and Chamfer distance among the compared methods while maintaining competitive reconstruction quality. These results demonstrate that explicitly conditioning correspondence formation on metric geometry provides an effective alternative to purely appearance-driven feedforward 3D reconstruction.
2610.23895.abstract_zh: 前馈 3D 重建主要遵循外观驱动范式：把多视角图像编码成视觉表示，由学习特征隐式推断跨视角对应，再预测 3D 基元。然而，已标定的相机和稀疏度量测量已能明确约束同一物理点在不同视角的位置。作者提出“几何条件化前馈重建”范式：在形成 3D 表示前，先用度量几何建立跨视角对应，再由学习到的视觉特征细化，而非从头发现对应。基于此提出 GeoForward：把稀疏 LiDAR 点反投影到 3D，再解析投影到标定相机以提供度量对应锚点；随后用有界连续局部搜索和视觉特征细化这些锚点，并融合 VGGT 的全局多视角上下文。共享表示分别预测度量深度与 Gaussian 属性，使显式几何直接连接到 Gaussian 中心与空间属性。稀疏 3D 细化模块在保持几何确定中心的同时改善局部属性兼容性；时间重建则结合车辆掩码与运动先验合成端点 Gaussian。在 nuScenes 上，GeoForward 在比较方法中取得最低的跨相机深度一致性误差和 Chamfer 距离，同时维持有竞争力的重建质量。这表明显式度量几何条件化对应关系是纯外观驱动前馈 3D 重建的一种有效替代。

2610.23953.abstract_en: AI-based 3D generation models such as Hunyuan 3D and Meshy can produce visually appealing 3D shapes from an image or text this http URL, they typically focus on an object's external appearance, often producing incomplete or implausible interior geometry. Consequently, the generated shapes are not guaranteed to be functionally valid, limiting their direct use in downstream applications such as simulation and fabrication. In this paper, we present a computational approach to functionalize AI-generated 3D shapes through interior geometry construction. Our key observations are that a part's functional role defines its interior geometry, and such geometry is often smooth, relatively simple, and closely related to the part's external shape. Inspired by these observations, we introduce an interior-aware part graph to encode information necessary for constructing interior geometry within an AI-generated 3D shape, and build the graph via VLM-based shape segmentation and graph attribute inference. Guided by the graph, we model the interior geometry of each part as a generalized cylinder and infer its parameters from the part's external geometry through an optimization. The resulting 3D shapes are functionally valid while preserving their AI-generated external appearance. We demonstrate our approach on a variety of AI-generated 3D shapes, including vessels, containers, and storage furniture, and fabricate selected examples for functional validation.
2610.23953.abstract_zh: Hunyuan 3D、Meshy 等 AI 3D 生成模型能从图像或文本生成外观吸引人的形状，但通常关注物体外表，内部几何可能不完整或不合理，因此生成形状未必具备功能有效性，限制其用于仿真和制造。本文提出通过构造内部几何来使 AI 生成的 3D 形状具备功能的计算方法。核心观察是：部件的功能角色决定其内部几何，而这类几何通常平滑、相对简单，并与外部形状密切相关。据此，作者引入包含构造内部几何所需信息的“内部感知部件图”，通过基于 VLM 的形状分割与图属性推断建立该图。在图的引导下，每个部件的内部几何被建模为广义圆柱，并通过优化从部件外部几何推断参数。得到的 3D 形状在保留 AI 生成外观的同时具有功能有效性。作者在容器、储物家具等多种 AI 生成 3D 形状上展示方法，并制造部分实例验证功能。

2610.26711.abstract_en: Recent video generation models produce visually compelling outputs, yet their physical plausibility remains poorly measured. Physical plausibility asks whether generated objects obey geometry, kinematics, dynamics, and conservation laws. Existing benchmarks rely on coarse visual-language model judgments or target embodied world models rather than video generation itself. We introduce PVBench, a physical video benchmark that quantitatively measures the plausibility of generated videos across 46 dimensions organized into seven domains, spanning: i) instruction and semantic fidelity, ii) behavioral and causal consistency, iii) perceptual and temporal quality, iv) geometric and spatial consistency, v) material properties and field states, vi) kinematic and spatiotemporal persistence, vii) and mechanical plausibility with conservation laws. PVBench comprises 600 carefully crafted prompts, of which 30% involve physical embodied agents such as robot arms, humanoids, quadrupeds, and multi-agent systems. For challenging physically tractable dimensions, it pairs each with specialized vision models that derive verifiable, physically grounded measurements, such as object-level 6D pose, metric scale, surface normals, kinematics, and numerical conservation-law residuals. It thus avoids relying solely on subjective scoring, while supporting both text-to-video and image-to-video generation. Finally, we validate the agreement between automatic metrics and human judgments through human evaluation. Meanwhile, we evaluate mainstream open-source and closed-source models and present several insights. By releasing the benchmark, prompts, and calibration protocol, we aim to foster physically grounded video generation.
2610.26711.abstract_zh: 近期视频生成模型的画面很有吸引力，但其物理可信度仍缺乏充分测量。物理可信度涉及生成物体是否遵循几何、运动学、动力学和守恒律。现有基准依赖粗粒度视觉语言模型判断，或面向具身世界模型而非视频生成。作者提出 PVBench：在七个领域、46 个维度定量测量生成视频物理可信度，包括指令与语义保真、行为与因果一致、感知与时间质量、几何与空间一致、材料属性与场状态、运动学与时空持续性，以及带守恒律的机械可信度。基准含 600 条精心构造的提示，其中 30% 涉及机器人臂、人形机器人、四足机器人和多智能体等物理具身主体。对难以测量但可用物理方式处理的维度，基准配备专门视觉模型，提取物体级 6D 位姿、度量尺度、表面法向、运动学和数值守恒残差等可核验的物理测量，因此不只依赖主观评分，并同时支持文生视频与图生视频。作者通过人工评估验证自动指标与人类判断的一致性，评估主流开源和闭源模型并给出若干观察；发布基准、提示词和校准协议，以支持物理约束的视频生成研究。

2610.25276.abstract_en: Synthesizing a monocular video from a new camera trajectory requires preserving the observed scene geometry and motion while completing regions that become newly visible. Feed-forward 4D reconstructors recover the structure of the observed scene, whereas video diffusion models provide a generative prior for completing unseen content. We introduce Holo4D, a video reshooting framework that uses reconstructed 3D trajectories as a holistic source-view 4D scaffold. We project these trajectories into the requested views and encode their geometry and source appearance to guide a pretrained video diffusion model. Together with the source video and target cameras, the scaffold grounds generation in reconstructed observations while leaving unsupported regions to the generative prior. Experiments demonstrate the value of trajectory-based conditioning for camera control and novel-view synthesis. The framework accommodates different 4D reconstructors without retraining the video generator, allowing it to benefit from future advances in source reconstruction. More details can be found in our project page.
2610.25276.abstract_zh: 从新相机轨迹合成单目视频，需要在补全新显露区域的同时保留已观测场景几何与运动。前馈 4D 重建器能恢复观测区域结构，视频扩散模型则为未见内容提供生成先验。作者提出视频重拍框架 Holo4D：以重建的 3D 轨迹作为完整的源视角 4D 支架，把轨迹投影到指定新视角并编码其几何和源图像外观，以指导预训练视频扩散模型。结合源视频和目标相机，这一支架让生成受已重建观测约束，同时把缺乏支持的区域交给生成先验。实验展示基于轨迹的条件信息对相机控制和新视角合成的价值。框架可接入不同 4D 重建器，无需重训视频生成器，因此可受益于未来源重建技术的进步。更多细节见项目页。

2610.25960.abstract_en: Joint 4D reconstruction of a human and object from a monocular video is essential for understanding how people interact with their environment. While recent methods have made noticeable progress, capturing such human-object interactions remains difficult due to two main challenges. First, a video typically contains composite semantic context spanning multiple interaction phases, making it difficult to track the temporal changes of the interaction in the reconstruction. Second, under human-object occlusion, a single-view observation contains incomplete visual information about the interaction, resulting in geometrically inconsistent reconstructions. To address these challenges, we introduce HORIA, built upon two core designs. First, we decompose the entire input video into temporally grounded and semantically distinct interaction phases with motion-aware captioning, obtaining a specific text description for each phase. Second, conditioned on these text descriptions of the interaction, we propose an interaction-aware re-rendering that compensates for the limited single-view observation. Specifically, we render the initially reconstructed 4D human and object from novel viewpoints and refine the renderings with a text-to-video diffusion prior, which provides auxiliary novel-view supervision beyond single-view cues. As a result, our framework produces temporally coherent and accurate 4D reconstructions under diverse interaction scenarios, achieving state-of-the-art performance.
2610.25960.abstract_zh: 从单目视频联合重建人和物的 4D 形态，有助于理解人与环境的交互。虽然近期方法已有进展，捕捉人—物交互仍有两项主要难题：视频通常跨越语义不同的多个交互阶段，难以在重建中追踪交互随时间的变化；人和物相互遮挡时，单视角信息不全，容易得到几何不一致的重建。为此，作者提出 HORIA，包含两项设计。第一，用感知运动的描述生成，把整段视频分解成在时间上定位、语义上不同的交互阶段，并为每段得到特定文本描述。第二，以这些描述为条件进行交互感知重渲染，补偿单视角观测的不足：从新视角渲染初步重建的 4D 人与物，再以文本到视频扩散先验细化渲染，提供超出原单视角线索的辅助新视角监督。由此，框架在多种交互场景下产生时间连贯、准确的 4D 重建，并取得最先进性能。

2610.25261.abstract_en: In this letter, we present GOFusion, a real-time visual mapping system for autonomous robot navigation that anchors Gaussian primitives to local occupancy maps, providing both spatial awareness for path planning and high-fidelity appearance that enables information-driven robot navigation. GOFusion builds 3D Gaussian maps from pose estimates and local occupancy maps obtained via visual-inertial SLAM and enables pose corrections to maintain both geometric and visual consistency. Furthermore, it restricts the 3D Gaussian Splatting optimization to active submaps to bound GPU memory usage. Building on the appearance-rich Gaussian map, we introduce a rasterizer-integrated Fisher approximation that quantifies per-primitive sensitivity online, serving as an information-driven heuristic for Gaussian pruning and next-best-view planning. We evaluate GOFusion on public datasets and in real-world drone flights. It not only outperforms several baselines in mapping quality, but also achieves real-time, high-fidelity and uncertainty-aware mapping at scale. Finally, we demonstrate fully autonomous drone exploration for Gaussian map refinement using the proposed Fisher-informed heuristic. Code is available at this https URL. We provide a supplementary video demonstration at this https URL.
2610.25261.abstract_zh: 本文提出 GOFusion：用于自主机器人导航的实时视觉建图系统，把 Gaussian 基元锚定到局部占据图，既为路径规划提供空间信息，也提供支持信息驱动导航的高保真外观。GOFusion 从视觉—惯性 SLAM 得到的位姿估计和局部占据图建立 3D Gaussian 地图，允许位姿校正以保持几何与视觉一致。它把 3D Gaussian Splatting 优化限制在活动子图内，以控制 GPU 内存。基于外观丰富的 Gaussian 地图，作者引入集成于光栅器的 Fisher 近似，在线量化每个基元的敏感度，用作 Gaussian 裁剪和下一最佳视角规划的信息驱动启发式。公共数据集与真实无人机飞行的评估表明，它不仅在建图质量上优于多种基线，也能在大范围场景中实现实时、高保真且感知不确定性的建图。作者还演示了利用 Fisher 启发式改进 Gaussian 地图的完全自主无人机探索，并提供代码和补充视频。

2610.25687.abstract_en: Continuous vision-and-language navigation (VLN) is typically evaluated by goal-reaching success, assuming it reflects an agent's ability to execute language-grounded behavior. We show that this assumption can fail: permissive contact models in current simulators may mask physically infeasible actions, creating a physical executability gap between semantic competence and embodied realization. To bridge this gap, we introduce Visual-Semantic Traversability Alignment (VeSTA), a framework that aligns VLN policies with physically executable futures. We define visual-semantic traversability as the ability to predict instruction-conditioned trajectories that are semantically valid, geometrically feasible, and physically robust. VeSTA addresses this misalignment through two complementary mechanisms: improving executable support in trajectory generation and risk-aware selection among multimodal futures. Specifically, Trajectory Relative Group Policy Optimization uses strict-contact feedback to reshape the candidate distribution toward executable regions, while the Traversability Risk Critic learns a risk-adjusted scalar utility for candidate-wise future selection. Experiments on R2R and RxR reveal substantial dependence of existing VLN agents on simulator contact semantics. Under strict-contact evaluation, VeSTA substantially reduces collision-induced failures while preserving or improving goal-reaching performance, and controlled real-world robot experiments provide evidence that the learned preference transfers beyond simulation.
2610.25687.abstract_zh: 连续视觉—语言导航通常按是否抵达目标评估，并假定这反映智能体执行语言引导行为的能力。作者表明该假设可能失效：现有仿真器宽松的接触模型会掩盖物理上不可执行的动作，使语义能力与具身执行之间形成“物理可执行性差距”。为弥合差距，作者提出视觉—语义可通行性对齐框架 VeSTA，使 VLN 策略对齐物理可执行的未来。这里的可通行性指预测同时满足指令语义、几何可行与物理稳健的轨迹。VeSTA 通过两种互补机制处理错位：增加生成轨迹中的可执行候选，并在多模态未来中进行风险感知选择。具体地，Trajectory Relative Group Policy Optimization 使用严格接触反馈，把候选分布推向可执行区域；Traversability Risk Critic 则学习风险调整后的标量效用，逐候选选择未来。R2R 和 RxR 实验显示现有 VLN 智能体显著依赖仿真器接触语义。严格接触评测下，VeSTA 在保持或改善目标到达表现的同时，显著减少碰撞导致的失败；受控真实机器人实验提供了偏好能迁移到仿真之外的证据。

2610.25763.abstract_en: Dynamic object manipulation requires robots to anticipate target motion while replanning fast enough to avoid executing outdated actions. Existing approaches either rely on fast reactive control without an explicit future target state or encode anticipated motion only implicitly. World Action Models (WAMs) offer a promising alternative by coupling future visual prediction with action generation, but scene-level video objectives may underrepresent target dynamics that are critical for manipulation, while iterative video-action denoising introduces substantial latency. We present TrajWAM, a trajectory-guided world action model for efficient dynamic robotic manipulation. Our key insight is to explicitly ground future visual imagination in predicted target-object motion and use the resulting future representation to condition action generation, while preserving this anticipation pathway after acceleration. Given a short history of object masks, a history-conditioned motion predictor forecasts future masks encoding the target object's trajectory. A lightweight Trajectory ControlNet then steers a pretrained video model toward trajectory-consistent futures. The resulting future representation conditions an action expert to predict executable action chunks. To enable one-step inference without breaking this interface, we introduce a decoupled distillation scheme that combines distribution matching for the video backbone, Trajectory ControlNet realignment, and action rollout distillation to support accurate one-step action prediction conditioned on the compressed future representation. Comprehensive evaluations in simulation and the real world show that TrajWAM achieves state-of-the-art performance on dynamic object manipulation tasks while enabling efficient one-step video-action inference. Project page: this https URL.
2610.25763.abstract_zh: 动态物体操作要求机器人预判目标运动，并足够快地重规划，以免执行过时动作。现有方法或采用缺少显式目标未来状态的快速反应控制，或仅隐式编码预期运动。世界动作模型（WAM）把未来视觉预测与动作生成耦合，但场景级视频目标可能不足以表征操作关键的目标动力学，迭代式视频—动作去噪又有较大延迟。作者提出用于高效动态操作的轨迹引导世界动作模型 TrajWAM：显式以预测的目标物体运动约束未来视觉想象，再用该未来表示条件化动作生成，并在加速后保留预判路径。根据短时物体掩码历史，历史条件运动预测器输出编码目标轨迹的未来掩码；轻量 Trajectory ControlNet 引导预训练视频模型生成轨迹一致的未来；未来表示再条件化动作专家，预测可执行动作块。为在不破坏接口的前提下实现单步推理，作者提出解耦蒸馏，结合视频主干的分布匹配、Trajectory ControlNet 重新对齐和动作推演蒸馏，使压缩未来表示能支持准确的单步动作预测。仿真与真实世界的综合评估显示，TrajWAM 在动态物体操作中取得最先进性能，同时实现高效的单步视频—动作推理。论文提供项目页。

2610.25981.abstract_en: Integrating force awareness into Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models involves not merely encoding wrench measurements as an additional modality, but determining when and how strongly physical interaction should influence robot action generation. Existing VLAs that use force typically inject it through a fixed pathway, without explicitly determining when it is relevant to the current action. This calls for an intermediate force relevance mechanism inside the VLA, in which visual-language context estimates the relevance of physical feedback to the current task before force enters the action pathway. FR-VLA addresses this gap with a Vision-Language Force-Reasoning Model that uses learnable force query tokens to derive a force admission signal grounded in visual-language context, and uses this signal to modulate an external tokenized force pathway for action generation. In real-world experiments on five contact-rich tasks across two robotic platforms, FR-VLA achieves the highest mean success rate over six evaluated stages, and trajectory visualizations show that its force admission varies with the interaction phase.
2610.25981.abstract_zh: 把力感知纳入视觉—语言—动作模型（VLA），不只是增加一条力矩测量模态，还需要决定物理交互何时、以多大程度影响机器人动作生成。现有使用力信息的 VLA 常通过固定路径注入力信号，未显式判断该信号对当前动作的相关性。因此需要模型内部的力相关性机制：先由视觉—语言上下文估计物理反馈与当前任务的相关程度，再把力信息送入动作路径。FR-VLA 为此提出视觉—语言力推理模型，使用可学习的力查询 token 推导以视觉—语言上下文为基础的力准入信号，再用该信号调节外部 token 化力输入对动作生成的作用。在两个机器人平台、五项富接触任务的真实实验中，FR-VLA 在六个评估阶段取得最高平均成功率；轨迹可视化显示力准入随交互阶段变化。

2610.24579.abstract_en: Most simulation benchmarks for robotic manipulation keep target objects static and treat policy inference as instantaneous. These assumptions simplify evaluation but hide how a moving target evolves during computation and how stale an observation is when an action is executed. We introduce LIBERO-Dynamic, a dynamic extension of all 40 LIBERO tasks. It drives objects through contact friction along three trajectory families and speed tiers, while advancing the physical world according to calibrated, model-specific inference latency. The same mechanism supports training by replaying verified static demonstrations and compensating robot actions online for target displacement, producing 9,000 quality-filtered dynamic trajectories. We evaluate six pretrained policies on 1,800 dynamic conditions per configuration, compare execution strategies and action horizons with fixed checkpoints, and fine-tune three architectures using dynamic and mixed data. Faster motion degrades every policy but not uniformly; execution timing and horizon can change the behavior of the same policy; and asynchronous replanning benefits from frequent feedback only when the action queue avoids underflow. Dynamic demonstrations improve each architecture under at least one recipe, with gains varying by temporal conditioning, data composition, and training budget. A small-scale physical study shows task-dependent execution-strategy differences consistent with simulation. LIBERO-Dynamic makes object motion, inference latency, and action execution explicit and controllable for evaluating and improving robot policies in moving-target manipulation.
2610.24579.abstract_zh: 多数机器人操作仿真基准保持目标物体静止，并把策略推理视为瞬时完成。这些假设简化评测，却掩盖了计算期间目标如何运动，以及执行动作时观测已过时多久。作者提出 LIBERO-Dynamic，将全部 40 项 LIBERO 任务扩展到动态环境：物体在接触摩擦作用下沿三类轨迹和三个速度等级运动，物理世界按经过校准的模型专属推理延迟推进。同一机制也用于训练：重放经核验的静态示范，并在线补偿机器人动作中的目标位移，得到 9,000 条经过质量筛选的动态轨迹。作者在每种配置的 1,800 个动态条件下评估六种预训练策略；以固定检查点比较执行策略和动作时域，并用动态及混合数据微调三种架构。更快的目标运动降低所有策略的表现，但下降幅度不同；执行时机和动作时域会改变同一策略的行为；异步重规划只有在动作队列不断流时才能从频繁反馈中受益。动态示范在至少一种训练配方下改善每种架构，收益取决于时间条件、数据组成和训练预算。小规模实体实验呈现与仿真一致的任务相关执行策略差异。LIBERO-Dynamic 使目标运动、推理延迟和动作执行变得显式且可控制，便于评估和改善移动目标操作策略。

2610.26855.abstract_en: World models enable embodied agents to anticipate action consequences, yet jointly modeling locomotion and manipulation across diverse embodiments remains challenging due to heterogeneous action spaces and limited multimodal supervision. We present Ropedia W0, the first egocentric loco-manipulation world foundation model spanning humans and robots with diverse embodiments. We curate Xp-Data, comprising 10k hours of egocentric human data and 3k hours of robot data with unified multimodal annotations and systematic quality control. A unified kinematic representation encodes locomotion through camera poses and manipulation through projected skeletons, with robot skeletons combining embodiment-specific forward kinematics with extensive manual keypoint annotation and correction. We also introduce Xp-Teleop, a long-horizon loco-manipulation benchmark based on high-quality dexterous humanoid teleoperation data. Evaluations demonstrate state-of-the-art performance across five cross-embodiment benchmarks (DreamDojo, $\Psi_0$, $\omega$-HOME, Xp-Teleop, and AgiBot) and on held-out human egocentric video, from zero-shot inference to few-shot and full-data post-training. Scaling human pre-training data improves performance on both human and robot evaluations. After distillation, our model supports real-time, minute-long rollouts, enabling live VR interaction. Applications in policy evaluation, model-based planning, and world-action modeling further demonstrate the model's utility for embodied decision-making.
2610.26855.abstract_zh: 世界模型让具身智能体预测动作后果，但跨不同本体同时建模移动与操作，受到异构动作空间和多模态监督不足的限制。作者提出 Ropedia W0，称其为首个跨人类及多种机器人体态的第一视角移动操作基础世界模型。他们整理了 Xp-Data：1 万小时第一视角人类数据及 3,000 小时机器人数据，配有统一多模态标注和系统化质量控制。统一运动学表示以相机位姿编码移动，以投影骨架编码操作；机器人骨架结合本体专属前向运动学、大量人工关键点标注与修正。作者还引入基于高质量灵巧人形遥操作数据的长时移动操作基准 Xp-Teleop。从零样本推理到少样本及全数据后训练，模型在 DreamDojo、$\Psi_0$、$\omega$-HOME、Xp-Teleop 和 AgiBot 五个跨本体基准以及留出的人类第一视角视频上表现达到最先进水平。扩充人类预训练数据同时改善人类和机器人评估；蒸馏后模型支持实时、分钟级推演，可进行实时 VR 交互。策略评估、基于模型的规划和世界动作建模等应用进一步展示其用于具身决策的价值。

2610.23899.abstract_en: Reconstructing sub-millimeter detail of small objects underpins tasks such as circuit-board defect detection, specimen digitization, and archiving. 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) makes photorealistic reconstruction possible from posed images alone, but macro optics violate two conditions it depends on. The field of view (FOV) and the depth of field (DoF) shrink to millimeters, so viewpoint error can take a sample out of frame, and only a thin focal plane is sharp in frame. Existing automated macro-capture rigs handle the shallow DoF with per-view focus stacking, but typically rely on classical photogrammetry and offline, human-in-the-loop processing. We present MicroSplat, which generates a 3DGS using a low-cost consumer microscope on a manipulator arm. After a single up-front object-localization step, the system runs unattended. It performs calibration, plans collision-free viewpoints, captures and fuses a focal stack at each viewpoint, segments the object across all views, and optimizes a 3DGS model warm-started with the arm's own poses. We further compare against blur-aware 3DGS methods, which infer sharp scenes from defocused images, and find that measuring sharpness with a controlled focal sweep outperforms inferring it. We provide real and synthetic datasets (including robot and camera parameters) and the fitted 3DGS reconstructions.
2610.23899.abstract_zh: 重建小物体亚毫米细节有助于电路板缺陷检测、标本数字化和存档。3D Gaussian Splatting（3DGS）可仅从带位姿图像进行写实重建，但微距光学违反其依赖的两个条件：视场和景深缩至毫米量级，视角误差可能使样本出框，且单帧只有薄焦平面清晰。现有自动微距采集设备通过逐视角焦点堆叠处理浅景深，但一般仍依赖经典摄影测量和离线人工参与处理。作者提出 MicroSplat，使用机械臂上的低成本消费级显微镜生成 3DGS。只需一次初始物体定位，系统便无人值守地完成标定、规划无碰撞视角、在每个视角采集并融合焦点堆叠、跨视角分割物体，以及用机械臂自身位姿热启动 3DGS 优化。作者还与从失焦图像推断清晰场景的模糊感知 3DGS 方法比较，发现受控焦点扫描中测量清晰度比推断更有效。论文提供真实与合成数据集，包括机器人和相机参数及拟合的 3DGS 重建。

2610.24485.abstract_en: Visual imitation policies can organise task motion, yet contact-rich object use demands gripper adjustments beyond coarse opening and closing. We study fine-grained gripper control as a local feedback problem within ongoing task execution. Our approach assigns tactile feedback a dedicated control role during contact-rich task stages. We introduce ContactPolicy, a learned local controller that takes over the gripper while a visual base policy continues to control the arm. ContactPolicy combines tactile and force histories with current robot state to jointly predict gripper increments and their modulation, updating the gripper target from each new observation. An Intent policy manages control handover between the visual base policy and ContactPolicy. Real-world experiments on container opening, object handling, and tool operation show improved task success over both the Visuomotor Policy and Tactile-Force Policy baselines. Execution analysis illustrates how the gripper adjusts contact within an ongoing task, including periods of target retention and fine-grained changes as interaction conditions evolve. Arm-state ablations and failure analysis further examine how execution context supports local regulation. These results support task-local tactile policies for fine-grained gripper control within visual manipulation.
2610.24485.abstract_zh: 视觉模仿策略可以组织任务运动，但富接触的物体使用要求夹爪做超出粗粒度开合的调整。作者把精细夹爪控制研究为持续任务执行中的局部反馈问题，并让触觉在富接触阶段承担专门的控制角色。所提 ContactPolicy 是学习到的局部控制器：视觉基础策略继续控制机械臂，它则接管夹爪。ContactPolicy 结合触觉、力的历史和当前机器人状态，同时预测夹爪增量及其调制，并根据每次新观测更新夹爪目标。Intent 策略管理视觉基础策略与 ContactPolicy 间的控制权交接。开容器、处理物体和使用工具的真实实验显示，相对 Visuomotor Policy 和 Tactile-Force Policy 基线，任务成功率均有改善。执行分析展示夹爪如何在任务进行中调整接触，包括保持目标和随交互条件变化进行细微调整的阶段。机械臂状态消融与失败分析进一步检验执行上下文如何支持局部调节。结果支持在视觉操作中使用任务局部触觉策略进行精细夹爪控制。

2610.27690.abstract_en: Simulation-ready world reconstruction demands physical interactivity beyond visual realism, which existing black-box 3D generation fails to deliver. We present NeoWorld-3, a coding-agent framework that reconstructs interactive 3D worlds from visual observations via tunable, executable programs. At its core, NeoSDK provides the underlying computational engine for low-level geometries, part composition, differentiable parameter refinement, and physics validation. At the same time, NeoMCP exposes these capabilities as structured, tool-callable APIs for vision-language agents to visually inspect, edit code, and iteratively refine programs. Through a hierarchical coordinator-worker architecture, the framework scales seamlessly from standalone articulated objects to complex compositional scenes. Evaluations across object-level and scene-level reconstruction benchmarks demonstrate that NeoWorld-3 achieves state-of-the-art geometric fidelity and physical readiness. Crucially, manipulation trajectories planned within our reconstructed twins achieve successful zero-shot execution on a physical dual-arm robot, completing the Real-Sim-Real loop.
2610.27690.abstract_zh: 可用于仿真的世界重建需要超越视觉真实感、具备物理交互能力，而现有黑箱式 3D 生成难以做到。本文提出 NeoWorld-3：一个通过可调、可执行程序从视觉观测重建交互式 3D 世界的编码智能体框架。其核心 NeoSDK 提供底层几何、部件组合、可微参数细化和物理验证的计算引擎；NeoMCP 则把这些能力作为结构化、可调用工具的 API 暴露给视觉语言智能体，使其能够视觉检查、编辑代码并迭代细化程序。分层的协调者—工作者架构使框架能从单个关节物体扩展到复杂的组合场景。在物体级与场景级重建基准上，NeoWorld-3 在几何保真度和物理可用性方面达到作者报告的最先进水平。更关键的是，在重建数字孪生体中规划的操作轨迹可在实体双臂机器人上零样本成功执行，完成 Real-Sim-Real 闭环。

2610.28613.abstract_en: Evaluating and post-training robot policies through physical interaction is costly and difficult to scale, motivating action-conditioned world models as interactive simulators. However, visually plausible predictions can misrepresent contact dynamics, providing unreliable feedback for policy evaluation and learning. We introduce PhysCanvas, a state-consistent visuo-tactile world model for contact-rich robot manipulation. PhysCanvas unifies multi-view RGB, tactile images, marker displacement, task state, and actions within a unified vision space. All modalities share a video VAE and pretrained generative backbone, allowing optical touch to reuse visual and temporal priors. Motion images derived through forward kinematics and camera projection provide spatially aligned action conditioning, while an initial RGB anchor and updated reference observations guide sequential generation. Our consistency-aware post-training uses the frozen Scene Reward Model, Modality Reward Model, and State Reward Model to supervise scene preservation, visual-tactile compatibility, and agreement with real task outcomes. The resulting world model supports closed-loop policy rollouts for evaluation and provides imagined interactions and rewards for GRPO policy updates. Across four real-world manipulation tasks, when policies are rolled out in the world model, State Reward Model supervision increases the arithmetic mean of task-wise Pearson correlations between world-model and real-world success rates from 0.602 to 0.885. Policy post-training in the reward-guided world model further increases $\pi_{0.5}$'s mean real-world success rate from a 59.1% SFT baseline to 70.8%. These results demonstrate the value of unified multimodal modeling and consistency-aware post-training for robot policy evaluation and learning. Project page: this https URL.
2610.28613.abstract_zh: 通过物理交互评估和后训练机器人策略成本高、难以扩展，因此动作条件世界模型被用作交互式模拟器。然而，视觉上可信的预测可能错误刻画接触动力学，从而为策略评估和学习提供不可靠反馈。本文提出 PhysCanvas，一种面向富接触机器人操作、保持状态一致的视触觉世界模型。PhysCanvas 在统一视觉空间内整合多视角 RGB、触觉图像、标记点位移、任务状态和动作；所有模态共用视频 VAE 与预训练生成主干，使光学触觉可复用视觉与时间先验。由正向运动学和相机投影得到的运动图像提供空间对齐的动作条件，初始 RGB 锚点与更新后的参考观测引导序列生成。其一致性感知后训练使用冻结的场景奖励模型、模态奖励模型和状态奖励模型，监督场景保持、视触觉兼容性及与真实任务结果的一致性。所得世界模型支持闭环策略推演以进行评估，也为 GRPO 策略更新提供想象交互和奖励。在四项真实操作任务中，状态奖励模型监督把世界模型与真实世界成功率的逐任务 Pearson 相关系数算术平均值从 0.602 提高到 0.885。在奖励引导的世界模型中进行策略后训练，还将 $\pi_{0.5}$ 的真实世界平均成功率从 59.1% 的 SFT 基线提高到 70.8%。这些结果展示了统一多模态建模和一致性感知后训练对机器人策略评估与学习的价值。

2610.27671.abstract_en: Solving dynamical systems in complex and diverse geometries remains challenging for both numerical solvers and learning-based surrogate models. We propose Neural Operator Splitting, a framework for learning fluid dynamics while preserving the physical structure of fractional-step numerical schemes. Instead of learning the full-step evolution monolithically, we decompose each time step into physically interpretable steps, and learn each operator separately using intermediate states from the underlying numerical solver. Guided by the linearity properties of the fractional steps, we introduce a conditional-linear Fourier neural operator (CL-FNO) whose linear state mappings are modulated by nonlinear conditioning on inputs such as boundary geometry. We further introduce two complementary strategies, symmetry sampling and corrective cycling, to mitigate error accumulation during autoregressive rollout. Experiments on 2D and 3D fluid flows with varying geometries and initial conditions show that our full model reduces mean relative $L^2$ rollout error by 68\% in 2D and 40\% in 3D compared with a single full-step neural operator. At comparable error levels, neural-operator inference is approximately $10^3$ times faster per step than the Monte Carlo solver.
2610.27671.abstract_zh: 在复杂且多样的几何域中求解动力系统，对数值求解器和学习型代理模型都仍有挑战。本文提出 Neural Operator Splitting：一种在学习流体动力学时保留分数步数值格式物理结构的框架。它不整体学习完整时间步的演化，而是把每一步拆为物理上可解释的步骤，并利用底层数值求解器产生的中间状态分别学习各个算子。依据分数步骤的线性性质，作者提出条件线性傅里叶神经算子 CL-FNO，其线性状态映射由边界几何等输入的非线性条件调制。作者还提出对称性采样与校正循环两种互补策略，以减轻自回归推演中的误差累积。在几何与初始条件各异的 2D 和 3D 流动实验中，相比单个整步神经算子，完整模型使平均相对 $L^2$ 推演误差分别降低 68% 和 40%。在相近误差水平下，神经算子每步推理约比蒙特卡洛求解器快 $10^3$ 倍。

2610.28351.abstract_en: Reconstructing dynamic 3D scenes from monocular video requires inferring motion from noisy and intermittently visible observations. Long-range tracks provide valuable geometric constraints, but integrating their fragmented temporal coverage into shared, continuous motion remains challenging. We introduce RayCo4D, a ray-conditioned continuous motion model for monocular 4D reconstruction that explicitly separates visual measurements from latent 3D motion states. Each track is associated with a reference-time 3D query constrained to its camera ray, and its image and depth observations constrain shared latent motion nodes through local many-to-many associations. Each node maintains an $\mathrm{SE}(3)$ pose and body-frame velocity at sparse support times. A white-noise-on-acceleration process prior couples neighboring states and defines continuous-time interpolation, allowing observations across visibility intervals to jointly constrain the same latent state sequence. The inferred shared motion is transferred to Gaussian primitives through dual-quaternion blending, while reference-anchored local $\mathrm{SE}(3)$ residuals capture fine-scale non-rigid deformation beyond the shared scaffold. Experiments on diverse monocular dynamic scenes show that RayCo4D achieves competitive novel-view synthesis quality, improves structural and temporal consistency under rapid motion and incomplete tracks, and supports continuous-time rendering.
2610.28351.abstract_zh: 从单目视频重建动态 3D 场景，需要从有噪声且间歇可见的观测中推断运动。长程轨迹提供有价值的几何约束，但把分段的时间覆盖整合成共享连续运动仍很困难。本文提出 RayCo4D，一种用于单目 4D 重建的射线条件连续运动模型，显式区分视觉测量与潜在 3D 运动状态。每条轨迹对应一个受相机射线约束的参考时刻 3D 查询，其图像和深度观测通过局部多对多关联约束共享潜在运动节点。每个节点在稀疏支撑时刻维护一个 $\mathrm{SE}(3)$ 位姿和本体系速度。白噪声加速度过程先验耦合相邻状态并定义连续时间插值，使跨可见区间的观测共同约束同一潜在状态序列。推断出的共享运动通过双四元数混合传递给 Gaussian 基元，而参考锚定的局部 $\mathrm{SE}(3)$ 残差表示共享骨架之外的细尺度非刚性形变。多种单目动态场景实验显示，RayCo4D 具有有竞争力的新视角合成质量，在快速运动和不完整轨迹下改善结构及时间一致性，并支持连续时间渲染。

2610.26918.abstract_en: Temperature-field reconstruction and prediction are important for condition monitoring, process analysis, and state assessment in industrial and dynamic environments. This work aims to recover a four-dimensional spatio-temporal thermal state field directly from two-dimensional observations, without requiring a predefined 3D model, prescribed thermodynamic equation, or predefined heating/cooling trajectory. To this end, we propose the Gaussian Thermal State-Space Model (GTSM), which represents thermal evolution through a shared scene-level latent process and Gaussian-specific local thermal states. The resulting continuous dynamics are propagated using differentiable RK2 integration, allowing thermal evolution to be inferred from multi-view and multi-temporal observations and continuously extrapolated beyond the observed interval. GTSM is designed as a backbone-agnostic thermal dynamics module for Gaussian representations and can be integrated with both static 3D Gaussian Splatting and dynamic 4D Gaussian Splatting, supporting thermal reconstruction and prediction under both static and time-varying target geometry. The reconstructed representation further enables novel-view thermal rendering and future-time thermal-state prediction. Experiments on real infrared sequences and synthetic dynamic thermal data demonstrate improved reconstruction accuracy and substantially stronger temporal extrapolation than representative baselines, while also validating the applicability of GTSM to deforming targets.
2610.26918.abstract_zh: 温度场重建和预测对工业及动态环境中的状态监测、过程分析与状态评估很重要。本文旨在直接从 2D 观测恢复四维时空热状态场，无需预设 3D 模型、指定热力学方程或预定义加热／冷却轨迹。为此，作者提出 Gaussian Thermal State-Space Model（GTSM），以共享的场景级潜在过程和 Gaussian 专属局部热状态表示热演化。所得连续动力学通过可微 RK2 积分传播，使模型能从多视角、多时刻观测推断热演化，并连续外推至观测区间之外。GTSM 被设计为与主干无关的 Gaussian 表示热动力学模块，可接入静态 3D Gaussian Splatting 和动态 4D Gaussian Splatting，支持静态与随时间变化的目标几何下的热重建和预测。重建表示还支持新视角热渲染与未来热状态预测。真实红外序列和合成动态热数据实验表明，它比代表性基线具有更高重建精度及明显更强的时间外推能力，并验证了对形变目标的适用性。

2610.27066.abstract_en: Generating human-object interactions (HOIs) with multiple objects is challenging because the resulting motions arise from different underlying causes. Human motion reflects semantic intent, intentionally manipulated objects must remain coordinated with the human, while surrounding objects move primarily as physical consequences of contact and collision. We present BUMP, a text-driven framework for multi-object HOI generation based on a simple principle: learn intentional motion and simulate physical consequences. Our method first generates full-body human motion from text and scene context, then predicts trajectories for a small number of intentionally manipulated driver objects conditioned on the human motion. We then obtain responder object motions through physics simulation, allowing the framework to handle varying numbers and configurations of surrounding objects without expanding the learned trajectory output space. To address the scarcity of paired full-body multi-object HOI data, we combine heterogeneous supervision from human-only motion, full-body HOI, and hand-centric manipulation data augmented with plausible body motion. We further introduce outcome-conditioned interaction editing, which infers a local modification of the causal driver object trajectory from a desired responder object behavior without requiring an explicit target driver object trajectory. Experiments demonstrate strong performance on both single-object and multi-object HOI benchmarks. Qualitative results showcase diverse scenarios involving inter-object relationships and edits, highlighting the advantage of our unified model formulation.
2610.27066.abstract_zh: 生成涉及多个物体的人物—物体交互（HOI）具有挑战，因为产生的运动有不同原因：人体运动体现语义意图，被有意操作的物体须与人体协调，周围物体则主要因接触和碰撞而运动。本文提出 BUMP，一种基于“学习有意运动、模拟物理后果”原则的文本驱动多物体 HOI 生成框架。方法先根据文本与场景上下文生成全身人体运动，再以人体运动为条件预测少数被有意操作的驱动物体轨迹；随后通过物理仿真得到响应物体的运动，从而无需扩大所学习轨迹的输出空间，就能处理不同数量与配置的周围物体。针对全身多物体 HOI 配对数据稀缺，作者结合仅有人体运动、全身 HOI，以及经合理身体运动增强的手部操作数据等异质监督。作者还提出结果条件交互编辑：从期望的响应物体行为推断驱动物体轨迹的局部修改，而不要求显式给出驱动物体目标轨迹。实验在单物体和多物体 HOI 基准上取得较强表现；定性结果展示涉及物体间关系与编辑的多种场景，体现统一模型形式的优势。

2610.28480.abstract_en: Tracking large human-motion datasets has become the dominant route to general, expressive humanoid whole-body control, but scaling across many motions is expensive. Current pipelines use model-free reinforcement learning, either merging per-motion specialists through lossy distillation, or brute-forcing a single policy with cluster-scale compute. SuperMimic amortizes learning across all motions with one differentiable world model of their shared dynamics, fit from logged transitions of a standard rigid-body simulator. The world model and the tracking policy train together in one loop, and backpropagation-through-time over short imagined rollouts gives the policy analytic gradients. Fast imagined rollouts and analytic gradients make policy learning efficient. In 3 hours on a single GPU, SuperMimic surpasses the return of a state-of-the-art motion tracker baseline trained for 7 days on 128 GPUs. It reduces GPU-hours by more than $1000\times$ and fails on only 25 of 129,514 benchmark motions, versus 179 failures for the baseline. After 9.8 hours on two GPUs, SuperMimic achieves zero failures. From 1 to 264 hours of motion, the world model's prediction error stays stable, and GPU-hours to a target return grow slowly. Our policy transfers to a physical Unitree G1 across diverse and acrobatic motions. SuperMimic removes compute as the bottleneck to scaling humanoid whole-body control, making it practical to measure motion-tracking scaling laws.
2610.28480.abstract_zh: 追踪大规模人体运动数据已成为获得通用、表现丰富的人形机器人全身控制的主要路径，但跨大量运动扩展成本很高。现有流程采用无模型强化学习，要么把针对单个运动的专家经有损蒸馏合并，要么用集群算力暴力训练单一策略。SuperMimic 使用从标准刚体模拟器记录的状态转移拟合一个共享动力学的可微世界模型，把学习成本分摊到所有运动。世界模型与追踪策略在同一循环中训练，短程想象推演上的时间反向传播为策略提供解析梯度；快速想象推演与解析梯度提高学习效率。仅用单块 GPU 训练 3 小时，SuperMimic 的回报超过在 128 块 GPU 上训练 7 天的最先进运动追踪基线。其 GPU 小时数降低超过 $1000\times$；在 129,514 段基准运动中仅有 25 段失败，而基线失败 179 段。在两块 GPU 上训练 9.8 小时后，SuperMimic 达到零失败。当运动数据规模从 1 小时扩至 264 小时时，世界模型预测误差保持稳定，达到目标回报所需 GPU 小时数增长缓慢。策略还在实体 Unitree G1 上迁移到多种运动及杂技动作。作者据此认为，SuperMimic 消除了扩展人形全身控制时的算力瓶颈，使测量运动追踪缩放规律成为可行。

2610.27284.abstract_en: The multiscale nature of turbulent reacting flows and the importance of fine-scale structures pose challenges for super-resolution. We investigate a 3D super-resolution framework inspired by Neural Radiance Fields (NeRF), called Neural Field Super-Resolution (NFSR), to reconstruct fine-resolution fields from coarsened reacting-flow fields. The proposed formulation adapts the continuous coordinate-conditioned representation of NeRF to physical flow-field reconstruction by conditioning spatial coordinates with local coarse-grid thermochemical information, while eliminating radiance prediction and volume rendering. Principal component analysis is used to provide a compact and low-dimensional representation of the thermochemical state, and a hierarchical extension, H-NFSR, progressively reconstructs the solution through intermediate resolution levels. The framework is evaluated using three-dimensional direct numerical simulation data for a turbulent premixed hydrogen-air flame, with an overall spatial coarsening factor of eight in each coordinate direction. The results demonstrate consistently better prediction measures and a higher ability to reconstruct fine-scale information than tricubic interpolation on the unseen test realization. The hierarchical formulation reduces visible coarse-cell imprinting. In contrast, biased sampling mainly benefits the most localized structures. Three-dimensional isosurface comparisons further show that H-NFSR recovers much of the small and intermediate features of the flow, including surface wrinkling and local flame curvature effects. These results highlight the potential of coordinate-conditioned neural fields as a flexible framework for three-dimensional coarse-to-fine reconstruction of reacting-flow simulations.
2610.27284.abstract_zh: 湍流反应流的多尺度性质以及细尺度结构的重要性给超分辨率带来挑战。本文研究一种受 Neural Radiance Fields（NeRF）启发的 3D 超分辨率框架 Neural Field Super-Resolution（NFSR），从降采样的反应流场重建高分辨率场。该方法把 NeRF 的连续坐标条件表示用于物理流场重建，以局部粗网格热化学信息为条件处理空间坐标，同时去掉辐射预测与体渲染。主成分分析提供紧凑的低维热化学状态表示；分层扩展 H-NFSR 则经中间分辨率逐级重建解。作者在湍流预混氢—空气火焰的三维直接数值模拟数据上评估，三个坐标方向各采用八倍空间粗化。结果显示，在未见过的测试实现上，该方法的预测指标及细尺度信息重建能力持续优于三次插值。分层形式减少可见的粗网格单元印痕，而偏置采样主要有利于最局部的结构。三维等值面比较进一步显示，H-NFSR 恢复了流场中许多小尺度和中尺度特征，包括表面褶皱与局部火焰曲率效应。这些结果表明坐标条件神经场有望作为反应流仿真三维由粗到细重建的灵活框架。

2610.28585.abstract_en: Simulation is a powerful tool for robotics, but building diverse, simulation-ready scenes at scale remains difficult. Reconstructing scenes from single images is a promising alternative, but visual similarity alone is insufficient: objects must also be recovered, accurately placed, and physically grounded. Existing methods that rely on post-hoc physics settling often misplace objects, producing scenes that look correct but behave poorly under manipulation. We present SceneRig, an agentic system that turns a single image into an editable, simulation-ready scene. SceneRig combines geometric, visual, and physical tools to reconstruct a faithful 3D scene. An agent then performs edit-and-validate loops inside a physics simulator to achieve physical stability. Across diverse inputs, SceneRig improves instance segmentation, object-centric appearance, and 3D placement while keeping the reconstructed scenes physically stable. Furthermore, SceneRig is effective for downstream robotics: its scenes predict real-robot policy outcomes more accurately than the baseline method and more reliably support replay of recorded manipulations without trajectory adaptation.
