2610.28585.abstract_zh: 仿真是机器人研究的有力工具，但大规模构建多样、可用于仿真的场景仍很困难。从单张图像重建场景是一种有前景的替代方案，不过视觉相似性不足以满足要求：还必须恢复物体、准确放置并赋予物理基础。依靠事后物理沉降的现有方法常把物体放错位置，导致场景看起来正确，却在操作时表现不佳。本文提出 SceneRig，一种把单张图像转成可编辑、可用于仿真的场景的智能体系统。SceneRig 结合几何、视觉与物理工具重建保真的 3D 场景，随后让智能体在物理模拟器中反复编辑和验证，以获得物理稳定性。在多样输入上，SceneRig 改善实例分割、以物体为中心的外观和 3D 放置，同时保持重建场景物理稳定。它对下游机器人任务也有效：与基线方法相比，其场景能更准确预测真实机器人策略结果，并更可靠地支持在不调整轨迹的情况下重放记录的操作。

2610.26962.abstract_en: Differences in hand geometry, joint parameterization, and kinematic topology pose challenges for cross-embodiment dexterous grasp generation. However, spatial relations among links alone are insufficient to fully capture the hand's kinematic topology. We propose DexGraspFlow, a conditional link-level $\mathrm{SE}(3)$ flow-matching framework integrating geometric relations and kinematic topology. The framework encodes local object geometry, link geometry, and current poses. A dual-stream DiT models link--link coordination and link--object interaction, while attention biases derived from kinematic-tree distances provide explicit structural information for modeling evolving geometric interactions. The model jointly learns translational and rotational velocity fields, integrates them to generate link poses, and recovers joint configurations through inverse kinematics. Additionally, inference-time palm-orientation guidance enables controllable grasp generation without retraining. Across three robotic hands and 30 object--hand pairs, DexGraspFlow achieves a 95.33\% average simulation success rate, with an average generation latency, including inverse kinematics, approximately 49\% lower than that of a state-of-the-art baseline. Further experiments demonstrate zero-shot adaptability to seven finger-removal variants and palm-orientation control. A model trained on demonstrations for the deployed hand achieves a 91\% success rate over 100 real-robot grasping trials, supporting the framework's applicability to physical grasp execution.
2610.26962.abstract_zh: 手部几何、关节参数化和运动学拓扑的差异给跨本体灵巧抓取生成带来挑战，而仅利用连杆间空间关系不足以充分表示手的运动学拓扑。本文提出 DexGraspFlow：一种融合几何关系与运动学拓扑、以连杆为单位的条件 $\mathrm{SE}(3)$ 流匹配框架。它编码局部物体几何、连杆几何和当前位姿；双流 DiT 建模连杆—连杆协调及连杆—物体交互，并用源自运动学树距离的注意力偏置，显式提供演化中几何交互的结构信息。模型联合学习平移和旋转速度场，积分得到连杆位姿，再通过逆运动学恢复关节配置。推理时的掌心朝向引导还能在无需重训的情况下实现可控抓取生成。在三种机器人手和 30 个物体—手组合上，DexGraspFlow 的平均仿真成功率为 95.33%，包含逆运动学的平均生成延迟比最先进基线约低 49%。其他实验展示了对七种去手指变体的零样本适应及掌心朝向控制。在部署用手的示范数据上训练的模型，经 100 次真实机器人抓取试验取得 91% 成功率，支持其物理抓取执行的适用性。

2610.28523.abstract_en: Humanoid-human interaction requires robots to operate under severe partial observability: during close physical contact, the human partner is occluded, truncated, or outside the robot's field of view, causing pose estimation to fail and often necessitating external tracking or privileged human state. At the same time, heavy mutual occlusions introduce errors into the human-human motion-capture data used for learning. We present REACT, a framework for learning deployable humanoid-human interaction policies from human-human demonstrations. REACT treats semantic contact structure as the key supervisory signal connecting demonstration processing, interaction learning, and onboard control. First, a VLM-guided contact modeling and retargeting pipeline identifies semantically meaningful contacts and transfers them onto humanoid-human geometry while preserving interaction structure. Using these annotations, privileged interaction policies learn physically grounded behaviors through interaction-aware contact rewards and are then distilled into deployable egocentric depth policies trained entirely from onboard sensing using photorealistic human depth rendering. To address severe partial observability, we introduce generative partner-state modeling objectives that predict partner motion from occluded egocentric views. We evaluate REACT in simulation and on a real Unitree G1 humanoid across five contact-rich interactions. Semantic contact modeling substantially improves preservation of demonstrated interactions, while generative partner-state modeling improves contact recall on four of five interactions, most under heavy occlusion. On real hardware, REACT performs all five interactions using onboard sensing alone.
2610.28523.abstract_zh: 人形机器人与人近身交互时面临严重的部分可观测性：发生近距离身体接触时，人类伙伴可能被遮挡、截断或处于机器人视野之外，使姿态估计失效，往往需要外部追踪或特权人体状态；严重的相互遮挡也会给学习用的人—人动作捕捉数据带来误差。本文提出 REACT，一种从人—人示范学习可部署的人形机器人—人交互策略的框架，把语义接触结构作为连接示范处理、交互学习和机载控制的关键监督信号。首先，VLM 引导的接触建模与重定向流程识别有语义意义的接触，并将其转移至人形机器人—人几何，同时保留交互结构。利用这些标注，特权交互策略通过交互感知接触奖励学习有物理基础的行为；再借助逼真的人体深度渲染，将其蒸馏为完全依靠机载感知训练的可部署第一视角深度策略。为应对严重部分可观测性，作者提出生成式伙伴状态建模目标，从被遮挡的第一视角预测伙伴运动。在仿真及真实 Unitree G1 上的五种富接触交互中，语义接触建模显著改善示范交互的保留程度；生成式伙伴状态建模在五项中的四项提高接触召回率，重遮挡条件下尤为明显。实体实验中，REACT 仅用机载感知完成全部五种交互。

2610.28519.abstract_en: Understanding contact and tactile magnitude in hand-object interaction is a key step toward physically intelligent systems, yet learning such representations is limited by the cost and restricted coverage of tactile measurements. We present Touch-JEPA, a framework for learning tactile representations from hand-object videos with limited tactile supervision. We first introduce a self-supervised pretraining objective that learns from video alone without tactile supervision. Using video-derived hand geometry, Touch-JEPA predicts masked visual features at corresponding hand-surface locations from spatial and temporal context, encouraging the representation to capture latent contact dynamics. We then extend this formulation to joint representation learning, where masked prediction is applied to all videos while tactile supervision is available only for a labeled subset, grounding the shared representation in measured contact and magnitude. With self-supervised pretraining alone, simple supervised readouts on frozen Touch-JEPA features outperform supervised baselines in contact discrimination and tactile magnitude estimation across three human-hand benchmarks, and transfer to robotic hands without robot tactile training data. Joint learning with limited tactile supervision further improves contact and magnitude estimation on the human-hand benchmarks. Together, these results show that hand-object video can provide scalable self-supervision for tactile representation learning, while limited tactile measurements provide complementary physical grounding.
2610.28519.abstract_zh: 理解手—物交互中的接触和触觉幅值，是构建具备物理智能系统的关键一步；但触觉测量成本高且覆盖范围有限，限制了相关表示学习。本文提出 Touch-JEPA，通过有限的触觉监督从手—物视频学习触觉表示。作者先引入仅从视频学习、无需触觉监督的自监督预训练目标：利用视频推得的手部几何，从空间与时间上下文预测对应手表面位置被遮蔽的视觉特征，促使表示捕捉潜在接触动力学。随后把它扩展为联合表示学习，对所有视频应用遮蔽预测，只对有标注的子集使用触觉监督，使共享表示锚定到实测接触及幅值。仅进行自监督预训练时，在三个真人手部基准上，冻结 Touch-JEPA 特征的简单监督读出在接触判别和触觉幅值估计方面优于监督基线，并能在没有机器人触觉训练数据的情况下迁移至机器人手。有限触觉监督的联合学习进一步改善真人手部基准上的接触和幅值估计。结果表明，手—物视频可以提供可扩展的触觉表示自监督，而少量触觉测量提供互补的物理锚定。

2610.27242.abstract_en: Humanoid dexterous manipulation needs reference motions that are both semantically rich and kinematically feasible for the target robot. Text-conditioned hand-object interaction (HOI) generators supply diverse, language-specified demonstrations, but they synthesize motion in human (MANO) space. The embodiment gap is therefore deferred to post-hoc retargeting, where trajectories deployed on the robot can fail to maintain contact with objects and also degrade policy learning. Our key idea is that robot reachability should constrain the interaction trajectories while they are being generated. We present EmbodyHOI, which runs a differentiable inverse-kinematics (IK) solver for a specific humanoid embodiment inside the sampling loop of a frozen flow-matching HOI trajectory generator. We feed back gradients from the embodiment-aware IK solver into the HOI sampler and jointly optimize the position of the humanoid with respect to the object. Because guidance acts only at inference, one HOI trajectory generator trained on human hand poses transfers across humanoid embodiments without retraining. On ARCTIC trajectories with two contrasting humanoids (Unitree G1 and H1-2), our proposed guidance-based method cuts the retargeted wrist error from 8.9 cm to 0.6 cm while leaving text-to-HOI generation quality intact, and raises task success from 68% to 79% on 50 random G1 tasks and from 62% to 76% on a four-task H1-2 suite. Critically, cheaper alternatives for bridging the embodiment gap fail to beat EmbodyHOI. Post-hoc wrist refinement and compute-matched best-of-N selection both reach lower IK energy than our guidance yet train worse policies. For simulation results, see our website: this https URL
2610.27242.abstract_zh: 人形机器人灵巧操作需要语义丰富、且对目标机器人在运动学上可行的参考运动。文本条件手—物交互（HOI）生成器虽提供多样的语言指定示范，但在人体 MANO 空间合成运动，把本体差距留给事后重定向；部署到机器人后，轨迹可能无法维持物体接触，并损害策略学习。本文的关键想法是在生成交互轨迹时就施加机器人可达性约束。作者提出 EmbodyHOI，在冻结的流匹配 HOI 轨迹生成器采样循环中运行面向特定人形机器人本体的可微逆运动学（IK）求解器，把该求解器的梯度反馈给 HOI 采样器，并联合优化人形机器人相对于物体的位置。由于引导仅在推理时生效，一个在人手姿态上训练的 HOI 轨迹生成器无需重训即可跨人形机器人本体迁移。在采用 Unitree G1 与 H1-2 两种不同人形机器人的 ARCTIC 轨迹上，该引导方法把重定向手腕误差从 8.9 cm 降至 0.6 cm，保持文本到 HOI 生成质量，并在 50 个随机 G1 任务上把成功率从 68% 提高至 79%，在四任务 H1-2 套件上从 62% 提高至 76%。值得注意的是，更便宜的本体差距处理方法没有超过 EmbodyHOI：事后手腕细化和计算量匹配的 best-of-N 选择虽达到更低的 IK 能量，却训练出更差的策略。仿真结果见作者网站。

2610.28594.abstract_en: Reliable multi-view forecasting requires videos from different cameras to describe the same evolving 3D scene. To this end, we introduce Video-Point Model (VPM), a world model that conditions on multi-view video histories and a language instruction to jointly forecast future videos from arbitrary viewpoints and the 3D trajectories of persistent scene points. We extend a pretrained world model with camera-conditioned multi-view processing that integrates complementary observations across cameras, and add a trajectory head that predicts how physical points move through time. Each trajectory tracks a single point across all views, and supervising these trajectories alongside video generation therefore anchors appearance changes in every camera to a shared description of 3D motion. To support training and evaluation, we build VPM-Data, a simulation corpus pairing synchronized multi-view videos with persistent point trajectories, and VP-WorldBench, a forecasting benchmark spanning simulated and real environments. We further extend VPM to robot control by adding robot actions as a token modality in the generator. Action tokens share the point-supervised backbone and are denoised jointly with future videos, thereby grounding the policy in the same 3D-aware representation. On VP-WorldBench and existing 4D generation benchmarks, point supervision improves both video fidelity and 3D motion accuracy over a video-only counterpart, and in simulated and real-robot experiments, it also raises the manipulation success of the action-enabled model.
2610.28594.abstract_zh: 可靠的多视角预测要求不同相机的视频描述同一个演化中的 3D 场景。为此，作者提出 Video-Point Model（VPM）：以多视角视频历史和语言指令为条件，联合预测任意视角的未来视频以及持久场景点的 3D 轨迹。作者为预训练世界模型加入相机条件的多视角处理，以融合不同相机的互补观测，并添加预测物理点随时间运动的轨迹头。每条轨迹跨所有视角追踪同一个点；与视频生成一起监督这些轨迹，使每个相机中的外观变化锚定到共享的 3D 运动描述。为支持训练与评估，作者建立配对同步多视角视频和持久点轨迹的仿真语料 VPM-Data，以及覆盖仿真和真实环境的预测基准 VP-WorldBench。作者还把机器人动作作为生成器的一种 token 模态来扩展 VPM 的机器人控制能力；动作 token 与点监督主干共享表示，并与未来视频联合去噪，从而把策略锚定在同一具备 3D 感知的表示上。在 VP-WorldBench 和已有 4D 生成基准上，与仅有视频的对应模型相比，点监督提高视频保真度与 3D 运动精度；在仿真和真实机器人实验中，也提高了带动作模型的操作成功率。

2610.27594.abstract_en: While feed-forward models excel in static 3D geometry estimation, extending them to dynamic 4D scenes requires modeling visual geometry as a causally evolving state. Current methods typically rely on unordered temporal aggregation, which lacks the directional structure of physical time. Furthermore, existing supervision often treats geometry and motion as disjoint objectives, failing to exploit their inherent physical coupling. Consequently, they lack a unified constraint to effectively supervise temporal state transitions, leading to inconsistent 4D scene representations. To address this, we propose a feed-forward framework for causal 4D visual geometry learning from monocular videos. At its core, Causal Spatiotemporal Mamba augments temporal aggregation with directional state propagation. Through complementary Temporal-Spatial and Spatial-Temporal Scans, CSM continuously propagates geometry-aware states across frames to model spatiotemporal evolution. To align this causal state evolution with observable dynamics, we introduce Unified Motion Supervision. Rather than treating motion as an independent objective, UMS leverages geometry-aware predictions from the camera and depth heads to construct a unified forward motion field that is consistent with the underlying 3D structure. This geometry-grounded supervision explicitly constrains inter-frame state transitions, enabling stable states propagation across frames. Extensive evaluations on dynamic benchmarks demonstrate state-of-the-art performance across video depth, camera pose, and optical flow estimation. These results validate that the synergy between the directional state propagation of Causal Spatiotemporal Mamba and Unified Motion Supervision effectively captures continuous scene evolution, significantly reducing temporal drift and reinforcing spatial-temporal consistency in 4D representation learning.
2610.27594.abstract_zh: 前馈模型擅长估计静态 3D 几何，但扩展到动态 4D 场景需要把视觉几何建模为因果演化的状态。现有方法通常依赖无序时间聚合，缺少物理时间的方向结构；监督又常把几何和运动当作独立目标，没有利用两者固有的物理耦合，因此缺少有效监督时间状态转移的统一约束，易导致 4D 场景表示不一致。本文提出从单目视频学习因果 4D 视觉几何的前馈框架。核心模块 Causal Spatiotemporal Mamba（CSM）用有方向性的状态传播增强时间聚合；通过互补的 Temporal-Spatial 与 Spatial-Temporal 扫描，CSM 跨帧持续传播几何感知状态，以建模时空演化。为使因果状态演化与可观测动力学对齐，作者提出 Unified Motion Supervision（UMS）：不把运动视为独立目标，而是利用相机与深度预测头的几何感知结果，构造符合底层 3D 结构的统一前向运动场。这种基于几何的监督显式约束帧间状态转移，使状态能够稳定跨帧传播。动态基准上的广泛评估显示，方法在视频深度、相机位姿和光流估计上达到作者报告的最先进表现。结果支持 CSM 的有方向状态传播与 UMS 的协同作用能够捕捉连续场景演化、明显减少时间漂移并增强 4D 表示的时空一致性。

2610.28257.abstract_en: This work presents SplatFlux, a feed-forward latent-to-4DGS framework for both video-based 4D reconstruction and conditional 4D generation. Our key observation is that observed videos and conditionally generated content can be represented in the same pretrained video latent space, allowing both tasks to be formulated as latent-to-4DGS decoding. To construct compact and temporally coherent 4D scenes, SplatFlux introduces a static-dynamic decoupled 4D Gaussian representation that explicitly predicts dynamic probabilities for Gaussian primitives. This representation separates static scene structures from moving regions, enabling complete 4D scene construction in a feed-forward manner through static aggregation and dynamic motion interpolation. To learn static-dynamic decomposition and dynamic Gaussian motion without costly annotations, we further develop an auxiliary distillation strategy that provides pseudo dynamic masks and optical-flow cues. Extensive experiments across 3D and 4D reconstruction and generation demonstrate that SplatFlux achieves state-of-the-art performance.
2610.28257.abstract_zh: 本文提出 SplatFlux，一种前馈式潜表示到 4D Gaussian Splatting（4DGS）的框架，同时用于基于视频的 4D 重建和条件 4D 生成。关键观察是，观测视频与有条件生成的内容可以表示在同一个预训练视频潜空间中，因而两项任务都可表述为从潜表示解码到 4DGS。为构建紧凑且时间连贯的 4D 场景，SplatFlux 引入静态—动态解耦的 4D Gaussian 表示，显式预测 Gaussian 基元的动态概率。该表示把静态场景结构与运动区域分开，通过静态聚合及动态运动插值以前馈方式构建完整 4D 场景。为在没有昂贵标注的情况下学习静动分解和动态 Gaussian 运动，作者还提出辅助蒸馏策略，提供伪动态掩码和光流线索。覆盖 3D 与 4D 重建、生成的广泛实验显示，SplatFlux 达到作者报告的最先进表现。

2610.28631.abstract_en: Current world models for explicit world simulation typically follow two distinct pathways: (1) video generative models (e.g., Sora), which simulate realistic appearances but fail to preserve 3D consistency; and (2) 3D generative models (e.g., Marble), which generate geometrically consistent scenes but often yield static, less realistic observations. We present AEON, a unified framework that bridges video-based and 3D-based world models and combines the benefits of both. The key insight of AEON lies in a generative model that operates within the text- or image-conditioned video latent space while producing renderable 4D graphics primitives---specifically, 4D Gaussian Splatting (4DGS)---as the explicit world representation. We train a 4D reconstruction model to predict both 4DGS and camera poses from monocular videos, serving as our initialized 4D decoder. Furthermore, we design a domain adapter that translates generative video latents into reconstructive 4D latents through a distillation process on the video VAE. AEON naturally supports video-based world modeling by rendering 4DGS at predicted camera trajectories, and constructs a persistent 4D environment with scene dynamics for realistic world simulation. Consequently, AEON empowers a diverse range of world modeling applications and achieves state-of-the-art performance on standard benchmarks. Project Page: this https URL
2610.28631.abstract_zh: 用于显式世界仿真的现有世界模型通常走两条不同路线：（1）Sora 等视频生成模型可模拟逼真的外观，但难以保持 3D 一致性；（2）Marble 等 3D 生成模型可产生几何一致的场景，但观测往往静态且真实感较低。本文提出 AEON，统一视频与 3D 世界模型并结合两者优势。其关键是一个在文本或图像条件视频潜空间中运行、同时输出可渲染 4D 图形基元的生成模型；显式世界表示具体为 4D Gaussian Splatting（4DGS）。作者训练一个从单目视频同时预测 4DGS 和相机位姿的 4D 重建模型，作为初始化的 4D 解码器；又设计域适配器，通过视频 VAE 上的蒸馏，把生成式视频潜表示转换为重建式 4D 潜表示。AEON 沿预测相机轨迹渲染 4DGS 来支持基于视频的世界建模，也构建具有场景动力学的持久 4D 环境以进行真实感世界仿真。因此它支持多种世界建模应用，并在标准基准上达到作者报告的最先进表现。

2610.27317.abstract_en: Sparse regression methods for discovering governing partial differential equations (PDEs) from data are sensitive to observation noise and are not constrained to reproduce the data under forward integration. We address both limitations by performing weak-form discovery in the spatial discretization in which the PDE is solved, learned by differentiating through multistep rollouts anchored at the observed states. The new method, Weak-form Anchored Rollout for PDEs (WARP), produces a machine-learned PDE solver. In this work, we focus on systems amenable to a spectral Galerkin solver. Across eight benchmark fluid and plasma systems, including high-dimensional turbulent simulations, WARP produces numerically stable rollouts from new random initial conditions and substantially improves coefficient recovery, rollout accuracy, and statistical measures compared with a single-step weak-form SINDy baseline.
2610.27317.abstract_zh: 从数据发现控制方程的稀疏回归方法对观测噪声敏感，且不受正向积分时复现数据的约束。作者在求解偏微分方程（PDE）所用的空间离散形式中进行弱形式发现，并通过锚定于观测状态的多步推演求导，同时处理这两个局限。新方法 Weak-form Anchored Rollout for PDEs（WARP）得到一个由机器学习获得的 PDE 求解器。本文聚焦适合谱 Galerkin 求解器的系统。在包括高维湍流仿真的八个流体和等离子体基准系统上，WARP 从新的随机初始条件出发产生数值稳定的推演；相比单步弱形式 SINDy 基线，系数恢复、推演精度和统计量均明显改善。

2610.28362.abstract_en: Navigation Among Movable Obstacles (NAMO) requires a robot to rearrange objects that block access to its goal. For a pushing robot, progress may depend on a setup push that enables a later opening without itself clearing a passage. The number of candidate sequences can grow exponentially with sequence length, making physics-based search costly. We introduce the Search-trained Push Action Ranker (SPAR), which learns to prioritize push primitives from simulated search outcomes. Searches over sequences of up to two pushes per object provide supervision that distinguishes immediate openings from setup pushes. A transformer trained with regression and ranking losses scores primitives using contact tokens conditioned on scene geometry and reachability regions. The same model guides simulator evaluations in SPAR Search and selects actions for direct execution in SPAR Policy. Both modes solve successive keyhole problems that open access to neighboring free-space regions within a NAMO planner. Across successful runs on $300$ simulated two-push keyhole problems, SPAR Search reduces median simulator calls by $7.0\times$, leading to a $3.8\times$ reduction in planning time relative to Random Search. Without retraining, the same ranker guides search on $600$ keyhole problems which have no solution within two pushes. At a depth limit of five pushes, SPAR Search achieves $50.7\%$ success within $100$ simulator calls, compared with $20.2\%$ for Random Search. These gains carry over to NAMO planning: on hard simulated scenes, SPAR Search achieves $47\%$ success within $100$ simulator calls, compared with $21\%$ for Random Search. In real-robot experiments, SPAR Policy succeeds in $37/40$ trials without a physics-based digital twin, compared with $33/40$ for SPAR Search and $27/40$ for Random Search.
2610.28362.abstract_zh: 可移动障碍物间导航（NAMO）要求机器人重新摆放阻挡目标路径的物体。对推物机器人而言，进展可能依赖于一个本身尚未打开通道、却为后续开口创造条件的准备性推动；候选序列数量随长度指数增长，使基于物理的搜索代价高。本文提出 Search-trained Push Action Ranker（SPAR），从仿真搜索结果学习推动原语的优先顺序。对每个物体最多两次推动的序列搜索提供监督，区分立即开口和准备性推动。一个用回归与排序损失训练的 Transformer 依据场景几何及可达区域条件下的接触 token 对原语打分。同一模型既在 SPAR Search 中引导模拟器评估，也在 SPAR Policy 中直接选择执行动作；两者都在 NAMO 规划器中求解逐次钥匙孔问题，打开通往相邻自由空间区域的路径。在 300 个成功的仿真双推动钥匙孔问题上，SPAR Search 的模拟器调用中位数比随机搜索少 7.0 倍，规划时间减少 3.8 倍。无需重训，同一排序器还可引导 600 个两次推动内无解的问题：深度上限为五次推动时，在 100 次模拟器调用内达到 50.7% 成功率，而随机搜索为 20.2%。在困难仿真 NAMO 场景中，100 次调用内成功率为 47%，随机搜索为 21%。真实机器人实验里，不依赖物理数字孪生的 SPAR Policy 在 40 次中成功 37 次，SPAR Search 为 33 次，随机搜索为 27 次。

2610.27613.abstract_en: Can embodied task agents use tactile experience to perform fine manipulation without task-specific model training? We investigate this capability through Tactile-ETA, a system that incorporates tactile experience into an embodied task agent through in-context learning. Successful expert demonstrations show how contact changes during manipulation. We pair each recorded robot movement with its camera views and bilateral tactile observations. We keep tactile observations at the start and end of each movement and add two neighboring time points when the tactile images change markedly in between. The agent combines these demonstrations with current vision, tactile observations, and proprioception to select actions through general-purpose robot tools, without updating model parameters. Across four simulated manipulation tasks, adding tactile observations to the same two expert demonstrations increases average success from 15.75% to 24.00%, with current sensing and execution interfaces held fixed. Further experiments show that performance depends on the sensory content and representation of demonstrations, while comparing agent models on Lift Bottle reveals substantial differences under the same system configuration. On the real-robot tasks, demonstrations with aligned visual and tactile observations increase the task success rate from 0% to 60%. These findings demonstrate the feasibility of using tactile experience in context for fine manipulation and suggest a path toward extending embodied task agents to additional sensory inputs.
2610.27613.abstract_zh: 具身任务智能体能否不经特定任务模型训练，仅凭触觉经验完成精细操作？本文通过 Tactile-ETA 研究这一能力：系统借助上下文学习，把触觉经验纳入具身任务智能体。成功的专家示范展示操作中接触如何变化。作者把每段记录的机器人运动与对应相机视角和双侧触觉观测配对；保留运动起点与终点的触觉观测，并在中途触觉图像明显变化时增加两个相邻时间点。智能体结合这些示范与当前视觉、触觉和本体感知，通过通用机器人工具选择动作，不更新模型参数。在四项仿真操作任务中，保持当前感知与执行接口不变，向相同的两个专家示范加入触觉观测，使平均成功率从 15.75% 提高到 24.00%。进一步实验表明性能取决于示范的感知内容和表示；在 Lift Bottle 上比较智能体模型，即使系统配置相同也有显著差异。在真实机器人任务中，对齐视觉与触觉观测的示范将任务成功率从 0% 提高到 60%。结果显示，在上下文中利用触觉经验完成精细操作是可行的，并提示可把具身任务智能体扩展到更多感知输入。

2610.27995.abstract_en: Tactile representation learning for dexterous manipulation often requires substantial robot-side data collection, limiting its scalability across different hands and sensors. We explore whether large-scale human hand-object interaction (HOI) data can provide a useful prior for robotic tactile learning. To this end, we propose HuTact, a framework that pretrains tactile-aware hand representations from human HOI data without requiring real tactile signals during pretraining. HuTact transfers the interaction structure learned from human hand motions to robotic tactile observations and can be further adapted with a small amount of unlabeled robot interaction data. We evaluate HuTact on tactile perception and manipulation tasks, including grasp prediction, slip detection, object classification, and tactile-conditioned policy learning. Across these tasks, human HOI pretraining improves data efficiency and provides a strong initialization for downstream learning. Notably, with HOI pretraining followed by midtraining on unlabeled robot play data, HuTact achieves 88.26% Macro-F1 on grasp prediction using only 25\% of the labeled downstream data, comparable to training from scratch on the full labeled dataset (88.23%). These results suggest that human interaction data can serve as a scalable complementary source for robotic tactile representation learning.
2610.27995.abstract_zh: 灵巧操作的触觉表示学习常需要大量机器人端采集数据，限制其跨手型和传感器扩展。作者研究大规模人手—物体交互（HOI）数据能否为机器人触觉学习提供有用先验。为此提出 HuTact：在预训练期间无需真实触觉信号，即可从人类 HOI 数据预训练触觉感知的手部表示。HuTact 把从人手运动学到的交互结构迁移至机器人触觉观测，还可用少量未标注的机器人交互数据适配。作者在抓取预测、滑移检测、物体分类和触觉条件策略学习等触觉感知与操作任务上评估。在这些任务中，人类 HOI 预训练提高数据效率，并为下游学习提供较强初始化。尤其在 HOI 预训练后再以未标注机器人探索数据进行中期训练时，HuTact 只用下游 25% 的标注数据，就在抓取预测上达到 88.26% Macro-F1，与用全部标注数据从零训练的 88.23% 相当。这些结果表明，人类交互数据可成为机器人触觉表示学习的一种可扩展互补来源。

2610.27794.abstract_en: Action-free videos are an appealing substitute for costly teleoperated data. Latent action models (LAMs) turn videos into a supervision signal by inferring abstract actions between frames. Existing LAMs observe a single camera view, which resolves 6D robot actions only ambiguously missing out-of-plane movements and potential occlusions. We propose a LAM that ingests synchronized multi-camera views using cross-attention to resolve depth and occlusions before compressing them into latent actions. The latent actions are fed into a policy in which a latent expert and an action expert are coupled by sequential flow matching around a frozen VLM backbone. We further evaluate in strict cross-embodiment settings where task-specific demonstrations come from other embodiments. We show that dual-view LAM pretraining improves the decodability of ground-truth 6D actions by 17% compared to single-view, while scaling single-view data by two orders of magnitude is not sufficient to fully recover out-of-plane motions. The downstream policy improves success rate by +13.5% compared to +6.2% for single-view LAM. A single cross-embodiment is sufficient for skill transfer, and adding a second viewpoint outperforms adding up to four further embodiments. The results transfer to hardware where demonstrations come from a human hand improving success rate by +20% over action-only policies in 850 rollouts. We show that video and robot data are complementary, and that benefits of learning from video are task-dependent. Website: this https URL
2610.27794.abstract_zh: 无动作标注视频可望替代昂贵的遥操作数据。潜在动作模型（LAM）通过推断帧间抽象动作，把视频转化为监督信号。现有 LAM 仅观察单个相机视角，因而对 6D 机器人动作的解析存在歧义，难以捕捉画面平面外运动和潜在遮挡。作者提出使用同步多相机视角的 LAM，以跨注意力消解深度和遮挡歧义，再压缩成潜在动作。潜在动作输入一个策略，其中潜在专家与动作专家围绕冻结 VLM 主干通过顺序流匹配耦合。作者还在任务特定示范来自其他本体的严格跨本体设置中评估。结果显示，与单视角相比，双视角 LAM 预训练使真实 6D 动作的可解码性提高 17%；把单视角数据扩大两个数量级，仍不足以完全恢复画面平面外运动。下游策略的成功率提升为 +13.5%，而单视角 LAM 为 +6.2%。单个跨本体来源足以实现技能迁移；增加第二视角的效果超过额外增加至多四种本体。该效果还迁移到由人手提供示范的实体平台：在 850 次推演中，相比只用动作数据的策略，成功率提高 +20%。作者指出视频与机器人数据具有互补性，视频学习收益随任务而异。

2610.28164.abstract_en: Effective manipulation requires a policy to capture not only about the current scene geometry, but also about how that geometry will evolve under interaction. Existing approaches either augment policies with geometric information from current observations or introduce future prediction as auxiliary supervision, leaving open how predictive geometry should be represented for action generation. Therefore, we propose a two-stage framework, which learns complementary predictive representations from multi-view video clips. During pretraining, a frozen 3D foundation model provides dense geometric features that are compressed into predictive geometric representations and optimized to preserve scene structure and its temporal evolution. Action supervision is then applied to geometric transitions to extract a complementary motor representation that emphasizes action-relevant transitions. During downstream post-training, predictive geometry is transferred through geometry queries, while the motor representation guides intermediate features along the action-generation pathway. Future observations are used only as privileged supervision during training and are not required at inference time. Across LIBERO, LIBERO-Plus, SimplerEnv, and real-world bimanual and single-arm tasks, our approach consistently improves downstream policies, including an absolute gain of 10.4 percentage points on the WidowX evaluation. We further demonstrate transfer across multiple VLA architectures and WAMs, with improvements in both future-world and action prediction. The code will be available at this https URL.
2610.28164.abstract_zh: 有效操作要求策略不仅理解当前场景几何，还要理解几何在交互中如何演化。现有方法或以当前观测的几何信息增强策略，或把未来预测用作辅助监督，尚未解决如何为动作生成表示预测性几何。本文提出从多视角视频片段学习互补预测表示的两阶段框架。预训练时，冻结的 3D 基础模型提供稠密几何特征；这些特征被压缩为预测性几何表示，并优化以保留场景结构及其时间演化。随后对几何转变施加动作监督，提取强调动作相关转变的互补运动表示。下游后训练阶段，预测性几何通过几何查询迁移，运动表示则引导动作生成路径中的中间特征。未来观测只作为训练时的特权监督，推理时不需要。在 LIBERO、LIBERO-Plus、SimplerEnv 以及真实双臂和单臂任务上，方法持续改进下游策略，其中 WidowX 评估获得 10.4 个百分点的绝对提升。作者还展示了跨多种 VLA 架构和世界动作模型的迁移，未来世界预测与动作预测均有改善；代码将于作者所列网址提供。

2610.27861.abstract_en: Vision-language-action (VLA) robustness is commonly summarized by aggregate task success, which obscures how individual executions change under distribution shifts and where failures emerge in long-horizon tasks. We introduce \textbf{RoboCasa-Shift}, a diagnostic robustness benchmark built on RoboCasa365 that combines controlled single-factor shifts, matched clean-perturbed rollouts in which each pair shares the same underlying settings and differs only in the target shift, and simulator-grounded stage-aware diagnostics. We evaluate GR00T N1.5 on four long-horizon tasks that pass a predefined clean-performance gate under four perturbation factors and three calibrated severity levels, including conditions that drive the evaluated policy to complete task failure, totaling 1,040 formal rollouts. Robustness responses vary substantially across factors and tasks, and increasing severity does not always produce monotonic degradation. For example, one camera condition yields $\Delta\mathrm{SR}=0$ despite 8 of 80 matched episodes changing outcome. Stage-aware analysis further shows that the same end-to-end degradation can correspond to different execution-depth profiles. Camera $L_2$ and Gaussian blur $L_1$ both yield $\Delta\mathrm{SR}=0.188$, yet their first-stage failure rates are 19.0\% and 36.4\%, respectively. Our findings suggest that VLA robustness should be viewed as a multi-dimensional property of execution rather than a single end-to-end performance measure, motivating evaluation protocols that jointly capture outcome degradation, paired outcome sensitivity, and failure progression. The code is publicly available at this https URL.
2610.27861.abstract_zh: 视觉语言动作（VLA）策略的鲁棒性通常由总体任务成功率概括，掩盖了单次执行在分布偏移下如何变化，以及长时任务中故障何时出现。本文提出基于 RoboCasa365 的诊断性鲁棒基准 RoboCasa-Shift，结合受控单因素偏移、基础设置相同且仅目标扰动不同的成对干净／扰动推演，以及由模拟器状态支持的阶段感知诊断。作者在四项通过预设干净表现门槛的长时任务上评估 GR00T N1.5，覆盖四类扰动因素和三个校准严重程度等级，包括能使该策略完全失败的条件，共进行 1,040 次正式推演。鲁棒反应随因素和任务显著变化，严重程度增加也不总产生单调退化。例如，某相机条件下 $\Delta\mathrm{SR}=0$，但 80 对匹配 episode 中有 8 对结果发生变化。阶段分析还表明，相同的端到端退化可能对应不同执行深度的故障分布。相机 $L_2$ 与高斯模糊 $L_1$ 的 $\Delta\mathrm{SR}$ 都是 0.188，但首阶段故障率分别为 19.0% 和 36.4%。作者认为 VLA 鲁棒性应被视为执行过程中的多维性质，而不是单个端到端性能数值，因而评估协议应同时刻画结果退化、配对结果敏感性和故障进展；代码已公开。

2610.27039.abstract_en: Foundation models offer a promising basis for robotic agents, but long-horizon tasks require them to sustain coherent reasoning and reliable physical execution across interdependent stages. We introduce Embodied Playground, a benchmark for evaluating how foundation-model agents coordinate physical, strategic, and spatial reasoning throughout such tasks. Agents must track task progress, satisfy intermediate constraints, and revise their plans using execution feedback as earlier actions shape subsequent decisions. The playground comprises 410 task environments spanning basic manipulation, sequential puzzles, and multi-stage household activities, with variations in planning depth, geometric constraints, and physical execution demands. We curate EP-100, a representative selection of 100 tasks across five suites and 16 task types, together with the EP-Easy and EP-Hard difficulty splits and the compact EP-20 selection. A shared protocol specifies observation and tool access, resource budgets, repeated trials, and independent checks of goal completion, task-rule compliance, and physical validity. Embodied Playground provides a unified framework for studying whether foundation-model agents can sustain effective reasoning and action over extended task horizons. this https URL
2610.27039.abstract_zh: 基础模型为机器人智能体提供了有前景的基础，但长时任务要求模型在相互依赖的阶段中保持连贯推理和可靠物理执行。本文提出 Embodied Playground，用于评估基础模型智能体如何在这类任务中协调物理、策略和空间推理。智能体必须追踪任务进展、满足中间约束，并利用执行反馈修订计划，因为先前动作会改变后续决策。该平台包含 410 个任务环境，覆盖基础操作、序列谜题和多阶段家务活动，并在规划深度、几何约束及物理执行要求上变化。作者整理出 EP-100：跨五个套件和 16 种任务类型的 100 个代表性任务，并提供 EP-Easy、EP-Hard 难度划分和紧凑的 EP-20 子集。统一协议规定观测与工具访问、资源预算、重复试验，以及独立检查目标完成、任务规则遵守和物理有效性。Embodied Playground 为研究基础模型智能体能否在较长任务时域内持续有效推理和行动提供统一框架。

2610.28120.abstract_en: Feedforward reconstruction of dynamic driving scenes requires integrating observations across multiple views and time steps into a coherent 3D representation. PointForward established state-of-the-art feedforward driving reconstruction by lifting image observations into sparse 3D queries, demonstrating the effectiveness of point-aligned scene representations. However, these queries are largely processed independently, limiting information exchange across space and time, while direct global attention among tens of thousands of point queries is computationally prohibitive. In this work, we present \textbf{PointForward V2}, which advances point-aligned representation to point-aligned interaction. Our key idea is to mediate query interaction through compact, scene-structured registers. For the static background, frame-wise Static Scene Registers compress point information, communicate across frames, and propagate the aggregated context back to the queries. For each dynamic instance, queries from different frames are aligned in an object-centric canonical space and interact through instance-specific Dynamic Instance Registers. We further employ 4D positional encoding that combines aligned spatial coordinates with original timestamps, enabling spatially aligned yet temporally distinguishable interactions. In this way, PointForward V2 enables scalable spatio-temporal reasoning directly among lifted 3D queries without dense global attention. Experiments on Waymo, nuScenes, and Argoverse 2 demonstrate state-of-the-art performance across large-scale driving benchmarks.
2610.28120.abstract_zh: 动态驾驶场景的前馈重建需要整合跨视角和跨时刻观测，形成连贯的 3D 表示。PointForward 先前通过把图像观测提升为稀疏 3D 查询，在前馈驾驶重建中达到作者报告的最先进水平，显示点对齐场景表示的效果。然而，这些查询基本独立处理，限制时空信息交换；在数万个点查询间直接进行全局注意力又计算代价过高。本文提出 PointForward V2，从点对齐表示推进到点对齐交互。关键是用紧凑的场景结构化寄存器作为查询交互媒介：对静态背景，逐帧 Static Scene Registers 压缩点信息、跨帧通信并把聚合上下文回传给查询；对每个动态实例，不同帧的查询在以物体为中心的规范空间对齐，并通过实例专属 Dynamic Instance Registers 交互。作者还使用结合对齐空间坐标与原始时间戳的 4D 位置编码，使信息在空间对齐的同时保留时间差异。由此，PointForward V2 无需稠密全局注意力，就能直接在提升后的 3D 查询间进行可扩展时空推理。Waymo、nuScenes 与 Argoverse 2 上的实验显示，在大规模驾驶基准中达到作者报告的最先进表现。

2610.28018.abstract_en: Examining existing benchmarks for grounding in 3D VLMs reveals a pervasive "semantic leakage" in the evaluation and prompting protocols: a heavy reliance on bounding boxes as spatial prompts or representation primitives. Because bounding boxes are highly informative of object categories, they introduce a shortcut for the models to neglect visual information during 3D VLM training. We demonstrate this with a "blind" LLM that, prompted only with the box coordinates, can perform surprisingly well. To further analyze this shortcut, we propose point-based grounding prompting - querying models with a single 3D point instead of a box. Under this protocol, the accuracy of the blind LLM drops from 36.4% to 18.0% on ScanNet's Nr3D, and similarly degrades for 3D VLMs (e.g. LL3DA). Building on this insight, we introduce P$^3$-VLM, a novel tri-pathway 3D VLM that supports point-based prompts and achieves 52.1% state-of-the-art accuracy on location-grounded captioning under this setting. To achieve this, we redesign the architecture while keeping it detector-free, scene-centric, and suitable for 3D GS inputs. P$^3$-VLM utilizes three complementary pathways (location-, task-, and context-aware), enabling strong reasoning about scenes without any bounding box dependencies. The key benefit of point-based learning is a consistent improvement across settings: P$^3$-VLM achieves state-of-the-art performance under point-based grounding while also improving robustness, OOD generalization, and performance on ungrounded scene-centric 3D VQA benchmarks, reflecting its reduced reliance on bounding-box shortcuts and resulting stronger visual-spatial reasoning.
2610.28018.abstract_zh: 检查现有 3D VLM 定位基准发现，评估和提示协议中普遍存在“语义泄漏”：大量使用包围盒作为空间提示或表示基元。包围盒高度暗示物体类别，会给模型提供忽略视觉信息的捷径。作者展示，只接受包围盒坐标提示的“盲”LLM 也能表现得出乎意料地好。为进一步分析这一捷径，作者提出基于点的定位提示，以单个 3D 点而非包围盒查询模型。在该协议下，盲 LLM 在 ScanNet Nr3D 上的准确率从 36.4% 降到 18.0%，3D VLM（如 LL3DA）的表现也下降。基于此，作者提出支持点提示的三路径 3D VLM P$^3$-VLM，在这一设置的位置定位描述任务上达到 52.1% 的作者报告的最先进准确率。为实现这一点，作者重设计架构，同时保持无需检测器、以场景为中心且适用于 3D GS 输入。三条互补路径分别感知位置、任务与上下文，使模型不依赖包围盒也能推理场景。点式学习的主要收益是在多种设置下持续改善：P$^3$-VLM 在点式定位上达到作者报告的最先进表现，也改善鲁棒性、分布外泛化和无需定位的场景级 3D VQA 表现，体现其对包围盒捷径依赖减少及视觉空间推理增强。

2610.28632.abstract_en: Video generation models can now depict remarkably realistic motion. Yet it is unclear how to use this motion beyond pixels: to animate a specific 3D asset and replay the animation in its 3D scene. For instance, a video model can show a monkey jumping over a crossbar, but it cannot return that jump as replayable 3D motion placed in the 3D scene. Here we present a model that directly co-generates the video and 3D motion for any supplied rig, along with a camera that registers this motion to the scene. Prior video-motion models either handle only human skeletons, often adding billions of parameters, or triangulate 3D motion from generated 2D pose maps. We instead keep 3D motion in a separate model that supports arbitrary skeletons, and connect it to a pretrained video model through a small set of cross-attention layers. This separation lets the motion model first learn how skeletons move from motion-only data, which is easier to obtain and augment than paired video. Additionally, our model learns to locate each joint in the video frames, which lets us recover the camera and place the 3D motion in the scene. To train across many skeletons, we use a generative video editor to place animated 3D assets in scenes suited to their actions, curating the edits so their known motion remains valid. Together with human and robot video, this yields nearly 200K training pairs. Our evaluations demonstrate that our model animates diverse rigs from text more faithfully than video-first pipelines, and its motion responds to the surrounding scene. It also turns video into rig motion, rig motion into video, and enables keyframe-based control of the 3D motion. Videos and additional results are available on our project page: this https URL.
2610.28632.abstract_zh: 视频生成模型如今可描绘十分逼真的运动，但如何把这种运动用于像素之外，例如驱动指定 3D 资产并在其 3D 场景中重放动画，仍不清楚。视频模型能展示猴子跃过横杆，却无法返回可在场景中重放的 3D 跳跃运动。本文提出一个模型，为任意给定的骨架绑定资产直接联合生成视频、3D 运动及用于把运动配准到场景中的相机。此前的视频—运动模型或只处理人体骨架且常增加数十亿参数，或从生成的 2D 姿态图三角化 3D 运动。作者改为把 3D 运动放在支持任意骨架的独立模型中，仅通过少量交叉注意力层连接预训练视频模型。这样，运动模型可先从比配对视频更容易获得和增强的纯运动数据学习骨架如何运动。模型还学习在视频帧中定位各关节，以恢复相机并把 3D 运动放入场景。为跨多种骨架训练，作者用生成式视频编辑器把已动画化的 3D 资产放入适合其动作的场景，并筛选编辑结果，以确保已知运动仍有效。加上人类和机器人视频，总计得到近 20 万训练对。评估显示，模型从文本驱动多样骨架的动画比先视频后运动的流程更忠实，运动也会响应周围场景；它还能把视频转成骨架运动、把骨架运动转成视频，并支持通过关键帧控制 3D 运动。视频和更多结果见作者项目页。

2610.29107.abstract_en: Recovering dynamic 3D scene geometry, appearance, and the physical motion states that govern scene evolution from multi-view videos is important yet challenging. A key difficulty is that appearance can be deceptive. Under rendering supervision alone, a model may fit the observed images by changing color or opacity to compensate for inaccurate deformation, rather than recovering the true evolving geometry and motion. This issue is especially severe in scenes with fast or locally complex motion, where inaccurate trajectories can still produce plausible images over the observed frames, but lead to unreliable reconstruction and discontinuous future prediction. In this paper, we propose PhyMo, a framework for learning evolving dynamics from multi-view videos. We introduce a Motion-Aware Trajectory Representation that drives the model to recover accurate motion from deformation, rather than relying on appearance shortcuts to explain observed motion. On top of this, we propose a Continuous Motion Evolution module with bidirectional kinematic continuity constraint to promote temporally consistent evolution of displacement, velocity, and acceleration. Together, these designs yield geometrically faithful interpolation and continuous motion extrapolation. Experiments on four dynamic scene benchmarks demonstrate state-of-the-art performance.
2610.29107.abstract_zh: 从多视角视频恢复动态三维场景的几何、外观及支配场景演化的物理运动状态，重要但困难。关键难点在于外观可能具有欺骗性：仅靠渲染监督，模型可能改变颜色或不透明度以补偿错误形变，使观测图像拟合良好，却未恢复真实的演化几何和运动。在快速或局部复杂运动场景中，这尤其严重：错误轨迹在已观测帧上仍可能生成看似合理的图像，却导致不可靠的重建和不连续的未来预测。本文提出 PhyMo，从多视角视频学习演化动力学。其运动感知轨迹表示驱动模型从形变中恢复准确运动，而非依赖外观捷径解释观测运动；连续运动演化模块加入双向运动学连续性约束，促进位移、速度和加速度在时间上的一致演化。两者共同实现几何忠实的插值和连续的运动外推。四个动态场景基准的实验显示，作者报告的方法达到最先进表现。

2610.30117.abstract_en: Force-sensitive manipulation requires contact and load information that is not provided explicitly by visual observations. We present CW-WAM, a world action model that jointly predicts video, motion, and contact wrench. Inspired by hybrid motion-force control, it contains a unified interaction module that treats both motion and contact wrench as modeling targets and predicts time-aligned motion-wrench chunks as control references. A pair-causal attention mechanism structures the motion-wrench dependencies, while a long fixed-length wrench memory retains past interaction information. The predicted wrench chunk acts as a force reference for a 20-Hz outer-loop admittance controller within a slow-fast control system that maintains force feedback and smooth motion between model queries. CW-WAM improves contact prediction and increases the insertion success rate from 25% to 70% for square pegs with 1-mm clearance per side and from 40% to 95% for power adapters, compared with WAM without wrench input. It also improves lifting-height accuracy across different loads. Our framework with an admittance controller reduces force-reference RMSE from 4.8 to 2.7 N for peg insertion and from 2.0 to 1.3 N for wiping, respectively, with smaller force fluctuations during successful execution. Project website: this https URL
2610.30117.abstract_zh: 力敏感操作需要视觉观测无法直接提供的接触与载荷信息。本文提出 CW-WAM：联合预测视频、运动和接触力矩的世界动作模型。受运动—力混合控制启发，模型包含统一交互模块，把运动和接触力矩都作为建模目标，并预测时间对齐的运动—力矩片段作为控制参考。成对因果注意力组织运动与力矩依赖关系，固定长度的长时力矩记忆保留既往交互信息。预测的力矩片段在慢—快控制系统中充当 20 Hz 外环导纳控制器的力参考，使两次模型查询之间仍有力反馈和平滑运动。相比不输入力矩的 WAM，CW-WAM 改善接触预测，并把单侧间隙 1 mm 的方形插销插入成功率从 25% 提高到 70%，电源适配器插入从 40% 提高到 95%；不同载荷下的提升高度准确性也改善。结合导纳控制器后，插销插入的力参考 RMSE 从 4.8 N 降至 2.7 N，擦拭任务从 2.0 N 降至 1.3 N，成功执行时的力波动也较小。论文提供项目网站。

2610.30781.abstract_en: Before acting on an object, a robot needs to anticipate how its hand motion will change the physical world and what the resulting scene will look like. Existing approaches typically entangle action-conditioned dynamics, camera motion, and visual synthesis within a video generation model, or represent dynamics as point trajectories without explicit object structure. We introduce DeXplicit, a dexterous manipulation world model that instead predicts how the world evolves explicitly in metric 3D before rendering its visual consequences. Given an initial scene and a future hand trajectory, a lightweight 3D dynamics network predicts object-centric motion and deformation, providing structured and geometrically grounded future world states. These predictions then serve as a strong scaffold for video generation: appearance is transported through the predicted 3D motion and projected into future views, allowing the renderer to focus on completing uncertain and newly visible content rather than implicitly learning world dynamics from pixels. This explicit-3D-first decomposition also enables efficient causal generation, requiring only two denoising steps per block while conditioning on generated history. Across HOT3D, OakInk2, and PhysTwin, DeXplicit reduces moved-point error by 27-40% relative to PointWorld and improves object fidelity IoU+ by 47% on HOT3D under a shared renderer. Our design with two-step causal generation achieves a 57x speedup from our 14B bi-directional configuration in video synthesis.
2610.30781.abstract_zh: 机器人在作用于物体前，需要预见手部运动将如何改变物理世界，以及随后场景的外观。现有方法通常在视频生成模型中混合动作条件动力学、相机运动和视觉合成，或以缺少明确物体结构的点轨迹表示动力学。本文提出灵巧操作世界模型 DeXplicit，先在度量三维空间中显式预测世界演化，再渲染视觉结果。给定初始场景与未来手部轨迹，轻量级三维动力学网络预测以物体为中心的运动和形变，提供结构化、有几何依据的未来世界状态。这些预测为视频生成提供支架：外观沿预测的三维运动传递并投影到未来视角，使渲染器专注于补全不确定和新显露的内容，而无需从像素隐式学习动力学。这种显式三维优先的分解还支持高效的因果生成：每个块仅需两步去噪，并以已生成历史为条件。在 HOT3D、OakInk2 和 PhysTwin 上，相比 PointWorld，DeXplicit 将运动点误差降低 27–40%；在共用渲染器条件下，将 HOT3D 上的物体保真指标 IoU+ 提高 47%。两步因果生成设计相较作者的 14B 双向视频合成配置实现 57 倍加速。

2610.30991.abstract_en: Robot demonstrations record what the robot saw and what it did. They do not specify how the 3D world changed in between. Scene-level 3D flow describes it by tracking 3D scene points, providing the world representation with 4D geometry. Prior work has used flow to improve robot policies. Flow served as an intermediate prediction that a separate model converts into actions, as a prior injected at inference time, or as an extra output learned together with the action. In all of these designs, flow stays outside the policy, as a separate module or as an extra prediction head. We introduce UniFlowWAM, a Unified World-Action Model that makes 3D scene flow a third modality on par with vision and action. Its world representation therefore covers both visual semantics, through future visual features, and 4D geometry, through 3D flow, and flow receives its own supervision. UniFlowWAM is a diffusion transformer with one expert per modality, and the three experts exchange information through joint attention. We train UniFlowWAM under a ten-objective role grid, where each objective assigns every modality exactly one of three roles, namely target, condition, or absent. The same model thus serves as a policy, as forward and inverse dynamics, and as a predictor of future visual features or 3D flow. We evaluate UniFlowWAM on RoboCasa-GR1, LIBERO, and LIBERO-Plus in simulation, and on four real-world bimanual manipulation tasks. On RoboCasa-GR1, UniFlowWAM raises the success rate of its base model without flow from 52.1% to 56.4%. It preserves in-distribution success on LIBERO at 98.1% and reaches 87.7% zero-shot on LIBERO-Plus. On the real robot, it achieves 87.0% average success, compared with 68.5% for the strongest baseline.
2610.30991.abstract_zh: 机器人示教记录了机器人所见与所做，却没有说明期间三维世界如何变化。场景级三维流通过追踪三维场景点描述这种变化，使世界表示具有四维几何。此前的流被用作由另一模型转成动作的中间预测、推理时注入的先验，或与动作共同学习的额外输出；在这些设计中，它始终位于策略之外。本文提出 UniFlowWAM，把三维场景流作为与视觉和动作并列的第三模态。其世界表示同时覆盖未来视觉特征中的语义与三维流中的四维几何，并对流施加独立监督。UniFlowWAM 是每种模态各有一个专家、通过联合注意力交换信息的扩散 Transformer；训练采用含十个目标的角色网格，每个目标将每种模态指定为目标、条件或缺席之一。同一模型因此可充当策略、前向与逆向动力学模型，以及未来视觉特征或三维流预测器。作者在仿真的 RoboCasa-GR1、LIBERO、LIBERO-Plus 和四项真实双臂操作任务中评估：RoboCasa-GR1 成功率由无流基础模型的 52.1% 提高至 56.4%；LIBERO 分布内成功率保持 98.1%，LIBERO-Plus 零样本成功率为 87.7%；真实机器人平均成功率为 87.0%，最强基线为 68.5%。

2610.30125.abstract_en: Existing world models typically perceive a scene through current visual frame or a narrow history window. However, these observations may not reveal the physics properties that determine transition dynamics, such as an object's mass distribution, joint damping, or surface friction. Without calibrating these physics factors for world models, predictions tend to regress toward an empirical prior and induce severe drift in novel test scenes. To this end, we propose PhysiCalWorld, which calibrates action-conditioned world models to the instance-specific dynamics via in-context prompting, without fine-tuning or analytical physics modeling. Our method encodes an exploratory interaction clip collected within the test scene into a compact physics descriptor token, which grounds subsequent predictions in the scene's actual physical behavior. PhysiCalWorld is trained end-to-end with the latent prediction loss alone, without physics labels. At inference time, the descriptor token is extracted once and can be reused across rollouts with negligible compute overhead. We evaluate PhysiCalWorld across four environments covering diverse physics variations and show that it substantially improves rollout prediction accuracy and visual planning success rate. The learned descriptors also form a physically structured latent space and generalize beyond the physics ranges seen during training.
2610.30125.abstract_zh: 现有世界模型通常只通过当前图像帧或狭窄的历史窗口感知场景，但这些观测未必显露决定状态转移的物理属性，例如物体的质量分布、关节阻尼或表面摩擦。不为世界模型校准这些因素，预测就容易退回经验先验，在新测试场景中产生严重漂移。本文提出 PhysiCalWorld：通过上下文提示，把动作条件世界模型校准到具体实例的动力学，而无需微调或解析物理建模。方法将测试场景内采集的一段探索性交互视频编码为紧凑的物理描述 token，使后续预测立足于该场景的实际物理行为。PhysiCalWorld 仅用潜空间预测损失端到端训练，不需要物理标签。推理时，描述 token 提取一次即可在多次展开中复用，计算开销可忽略。作者在涵盖多样物理变化的四种环境中评估，显示展开预测准确率和视觉规划成功率显著提高；学得的描述符还形成具有物理结构的潜空间，并能泛化到训练时未见的物理参数范围。

2610.30679.abstract_en: We propose AgentDreamer, an agent-guided optimization framework that aligns text instructions with simulated motion through explicit 3D motion planning. Given a text instruction and scene geometry, an off-the-shelf agent translates the instruction into a structured semantic motion prior, specifying what should move, in which direction, and in what temporal order. The agent represents this prior using parametric functions over a series of temporal chunks, yielding dense 3D trajectories. We then optimize the parameters of a differentiable MPM simulator such that its rollout best matches the prior while remaining constrained by the scene dynamics. This allows the agent to provide semantic guidance from language, while the simulator grounds it in physically feasible motion. We further introduce Motion-IG, an information-theoretic metric for text-motion alignment based on masked text recovery. By comparing the likelihood of recovering masked motion-related content with and without the simulated motion, Motion-IG measures the information contributed by the motion beyond that available from the remaining text and scene context. Experiments show that AgentDreamer improves text alignment over video-based guidance, producing simulations that more closely follow the requested physical behavior.
2610.30679.abstract_zh: 本文提出 AgentDreamer，一种通过显式三维运动规划使文本指令与仿真运动对齐的智能体引导优化框架。给定文本指令和场景几何，现成智能体把指令转换为结构化的语义运动先验，指定什么应当移动、向哪个方向移动以及时间顺序。智能体在一系列时间片上用参数函数表示该先验，生成密集三维轨迹。随后优化可微 MPM 仿真器的参数，使其展开尽可能匹配先验，同时遵守场景动力学约束。这让智能体提供来自语言的语义指导，由仿真器将其落实为物理可行的运动。作者还提出 Motion-IG：一种基于遮蔽文本恢复的信息论文本—运动对齐指标。它比较有无仿真运动时恢复被遮蔽的运动相关内容的概率，测量该运动在其余文本和场景上下文之外提供的信息。实验显示，相比基于视频的引导，AgentDreamer 改善文本对齐，使仿真更接近所要求的物理行为。

2610.29517.abstract_en: High-fidelity 4D physical simulation requires accurate physical parameter assignments that align with diverse material properties. Previous methods struggle with critical bottlenecks: they either rely on computationally intensive per-scene optimization or predict parameters from purely visual inputs. The latter suffers from inherent ambiguity, e.g., the inability to distinguish the stiffness of rubber from its appearance alone. To bridge this gap, we propose AutoPhyX, a text-conditioned framework for predicting spatially-varying physical properties. Since training robust feed-forward models requires fine-grained supervision, we first introduce a novel part-controllable data generation pipeline that decomposes complex 3D assets into semantically distinct components and pairs them with physically plausible, diverse parameters and corresponding text descriptions. Leveraging this dataset, AutoPhyX employs a cross-modal modulation mechanism where text features dynamically modulate visual features for precise physical grounding. By formulating property prediction within a voxel field, AutoPhyX ensures compatibility with diverse 3D representations, including meshes, point clouds, Gaussian Splatting, and NeRF. Experiments demonstrate that our method enables physically plausible, text-driven parameter assignment in a single forward pass. It achieves high accuracy and robust generalization to in-the-wild objects, paving the way for future physics-intensive embodied and robotic applications.
2610.29517.abstract_zh: 高保真的四维物理仿真，需要与不同材料属性相符的准确物理参数。已有方法或依赖计算昂贵的逐场景优化，或仅从视觉输入预测参数；后者存在内在歧义，例如无法只凭外观辨别橡胶的刚度。为此，本文提出 AutoPhyX：根据文本条件预测空间变化物理属性的框架。为获得训练稳健前馈模型所需的细粒度监督，作者先提出部件可控数据生成流程，把复杂三维资产分解为语义不同的组件，并配对物理上合理且多样的参数及相应文本描述。基于该数据集，AutoPhyX 用跨模态调制机制，让文本特征动态调制视觉特征，以实现精确的物理对应。物理属性预测在体素场中表述，因而兼容网格、点云、高斯泼溅和 NeRF 等多种三维表示。实验显示，方法可通过一次前向传播完成物理合理、由文本驱动的参数赋值，在真实场景物体上具有较高准确率和稳健泛化，为未来物理密集的具身及机器人应用奠定基础。

2610.29088.abstract_en: World models predict how embodied systems evolve under actions, but their accuracy can degrade when physical conditions move outside the training distribution. We study two components of causal modeling: which inputs a predictor may use, and how its mechanism computes their effects. In a synthetic benchmark with shortcut features, a frozen dependency mask derived from paired interventions reduces mean out-of-distribution (OOD) RMSE from 1.769 for a fully connected predictor to 0.697, close to the generator-oracle mask (0.694). For robot link-mass extrapolation in CausalWorld, with disjoint training and test mass ranges, we develop finger-local world models in which link masses enter inertia and dynamics-bias terms through explicit affine coefficients, actions act through either a learned torque network or the known PD controller, and learned residuals capture contact-related effects. Compared with a separately trained control whose mass inputs are fixed at training means, the known-PD model turns out-of-range masses into a consistent predictive gain: median time-averaged joint R2 over 150-step rollouts rises from 0.609 to 0.727, with improvement in all ten task-seed runs (exact two-sided sign test, p = 0.002). In a shared 100-step forecast, the learned-torque model is competitive with the strongest recurrent robotic world model (RWM) configuration (median joint R2 of 0.755 - 0.768 versus 0.752), whereas supplying out-of-range masses sharply degrades the MLP and recurrent predictors. These results indicate that how a physical parameter enters the dynamics mechanism determines whether its out-of-range value helps or harms prediction.
2610.29088.abstract_zh: 世界模型预测具身系统在动作下如何演化，但物理条件超出训练分布时准确率可能下降。本文研究因果建模的两个方面：预测器可使用哪些输入，以及机制如何计算其影响。在带捷径特征的合成基准上，由成对干预得到的冻结依赖掩码，把完全连接预测器的平均分布外 RMSE 从 1.769 降到 0.697，接近生成器真值掩码的 0.694。对于 CausalWorld 中训练和测试质量范围不重叠的机器人连杆质量外推，作者构建按手指局部建模的世界模型：连杆质量通过显式仿射系数进入惯性和动力学偏置项，动作通过学习型力矩网络或已知 PD 控制器发挥作用，学习型残差捕捉接触相关影响。相比单独训练、质量输入固定在训练均值的对照模型，已知 PD 模型把超范围质量变成稳定的预测增益：150 步展开中，关节时间平均 R² 的中位数从 0.609 升至 0.727，十个任务—种子运行均有改善（双侧精确符号检验 p = 0.002）。在共享的 100 步预测中，学习型力矩模型与最强循环式机器人世界模型配置具有竞争力（关节 R² 中位数 0.755–0.768 对 0.752），而提供超范围质量会使 MLP 和循环预测器显著恶化。结果表明，物理参数进入动力学机制的方式，决定其超范围值帮助还是损害预测。

2610.28908.abstract_en: Bubble size, depth, and spatial distribution govern transport and uniformity in multiphase flows. A single shadowgraphic view cannot separate bubble diameter from focal-plane displacement, as image signatures depend on both, while multicamera systems add optical access, calibration, and cost. We develop a single-camera physics-guided framework combining direct numerical simulation (DNS), validated Monte Carlo ray tracing, preprocessing, and focus-conditioned multitask deep learning to recover three-dimensional bubble position and physical-equivalent diameter from two-dimensional shadowgraphs. DNS-resolved bubble label images rendered at multiple focal-plane settings. The ray tracer reproduces shadowgraphic signatures with errors below $3\%$ (intensity), $1\%$ (apparent size), $15\%$ (blur), $6\%$ (numerical aperture), and $4\%$ (edge-spread-function shape), running $\sim30\times$ faster than the CPU implementation. The dataset has $900$ frames and $87{,}728$ labeled instances, partitioned by DNS timestamp to prevent leakage and expanded to over $10^{5}$ crops by broad-depth controlled-density rendering. A multitask network predicts signed depth and diameter from crops and focal-plane coordinates, achieving $\sim97.6\%$ normalized depth accuracy on held-out data; a closed-loop DNS-to-image-to-reconstruction test of $180$ bubbles gives diameter error below $9.71\%$ ($\sim90.29\%$ accuracy). On experimental images at four radial planes ($142$--$971$ bubbles each), PDF overlap is $68\%$--$92\%$ and log-PDF correlation is $0.72$--$0.87$. At the focal reference plane ($11{,}679$ bubbles), overlap is $\sim86\%$, correlation is $0.93$, and full-distribution, $D_{99.8}$, and composite errors are below $7.7\%$, increasing with focal-plane distance and defining a recoverability limit. Without stereoscopic hardware, the framework offers a scalable diagnostic for dense bubbly flows.
2610.28908.abstract_zh: 气泡尺寸、深度和空间分布影响多相流中的传输与均匀性。单一阴影成像视角无法区分气泡直径与相对焦平面的位移，因为图像特征同时依赖两者；多相机系统又增加光学通道、标定与成本。本文开发单相机、物理引导框架，结合直接数值模拟（DNS）、经验证的蒙特卡罗光线追踪、预处理与焦点条件多任务深度学习，从二维阴影图恢复气泡三维位置及物理等效直径。DNS 解析的气泡标签图在多个焦平面设置下渲染。光线追踪器的阴影成像误差分别低于 3%（强度）、1%（表观尺寸）、15%（模糊）、6%（数值孔径）和 4%（边缘扩散函数形状），运行速度约为 CPU 实现的 30 倍。数据集包含 900 帧和 87,728 个标注实例，按 DNS 时间戳分割以防泄漏，并通过宽深度、受控密度渲染扩展到超过 10⁵ 个裁剪图。多任务网络从裁剪图和焦平面坐标预测带符号深度与直径，在留出数据上达到约 97.6% 的归一化深度准确率；180 个气泡的 DNS—图像—重建闭环测试中，直径误差低于 9.71%（约 90.29% 准确率）。在四个径向平面的实验图像中，每平面有 142–971 个气泡，概率密度函数重叠度为 68–92%，对数概率密度相关系数为 0.72–0.87。在参考焦平面的 11,679 个气泡上，重叠度约 86%，相关系数 0.93，完整分布、D₉₉.₈ 及综合误差均低于 7.7%；这些误差随焦平面距离增大，界定了可恢复性边界。该框架无需立体成像硬件，为密集含气流提供可扩展诊断手段。

2610.31299.abstract_en: Synthesizing physically grounded dexterous hand-object interactions is important for VR/AR, gaming, and robotics, yet remains challenging because subtle contact dynamics, diverse object geometries, and target trajectories must be jointly respected while maintaining natural grasps. Existing methods either track mocap trajectories with limited transfer to novel objects, or rely on hand-only generative priors that fail to capture coupled hand-object motion, sacrificing contact fidelity and sample efficiency. To tackle these challenges, we introduce PiHand, a Physically grounded Interaction-aware Hand motion synthesis framework. PiHand first trains expert policies that track mocap demonstrations in simulation, distills them into a unified hand-object interaction prior using a goal-conditioned VAE, and finally solve diverse dexterous manipulation tasks through bounded residual exploration in its latent space. With only a single reward and no complex curriculum training, this yields general tabletop manipulation policies that generalize to unseen objects and trajectories on GRAB and DexYCB. The same prior transfers to object catching and bimanual handover, two tasks that are rarely seen in its training data. Across all tasks, PiHand consistently outperforms baselines in all metrics. We will release the processed data and model checkpoints.
2610.31299.abstract_zh: 合成具有物理依据的灵巧手—物交互，对 VR/AR、游戏和机器人很重要，但细微接触动力学、多样物体几何与目标轨迹需要同时满足，并保持自然抓握，因此仍具挑战。已有方法要么追踪动作捕捉轨迹而难迁移到新物体，要么只使用手部生成先验，无法刻画手与物体的耦合运动，牺牲接触保真度和样本效率。本文提出 PiHand，一种具有物理依据、感知交互的手部运动合成框架。它先在仿真中训练追踪动作捕捉示范的专家策略，再通过目标条件 VAE 将其蒸馏为统一的手—物交互先验，最后在该先验的潜空间内进行有界残差探索以求解多样灵巧操作任务。仅用单一奖励且无需复杂课程训练，即可得到在 GRAB 和 DexYCB 上泛化至未见物体与轨迹的桌面操作策略。同一先验还迁移到训练数据中很少见的接物和双手交接任务。作者报告 PiHand 在所有任务的所有指标上持续优于基线，并计划发布处理后的数据和模型检查点。

2610.30988.abstract_en: Robust manipulation of soft objects, such as garments, is a critical skill for service and household robots to adopt, but remains challenging due to its high-dimensional state space, and material-dependent deformations. Humans address this challenge by using mental world models that "imagine" the shape and material properties from partial observations, which enables them to predict how actions affect future states. As such, embedding such world models in robots allows for better generalization in manipulating a wide variety of garments in the real world. However, learned world models typically require large amounts of real world data that is strenuous to collect, and a mechanism to infer latent properties that govern dynamics. We present a Soft-Object World Model that performs generative full-state estimation and action-conditioned dynamics prediction using a transformer backbone trained on large-scale simulated soft object interactions, with measures to mitigate the sim-to-real gap. By learning to infer latent shape and material cues through in-context learning over a variable-length partial point-cloud history, the model generalizes across robot embodiments, material parameters, garment types and shapes, and manipulation coordination modes without weight updates. The world model is then integrated with a Goal-Conditioned action planner for motion synthesis. We validate the approach in simulation and real world for bimanual garment folding, reporting improvements in reconstruction fidelity, prediction accuracy, and task success.
2610.30988.abstract_zh: 稳健操作衣物等软物体是服务及家用机器人所需的重要技能，但高维状态空间与材料相关形变使其困难。人类可根据局部观测在脑中“想象”形状和材料属性，从而预测动作对未来状态的影响；让机器人拥有这类世界模型有望增强其在真实世界中操作不同衣物的泛化能力。然而，学习型世界模型通常需要大量难以采集的真实数据，还须推断支配动力学的潜在属性。本文提出 Soft-Object World Model：以 Transformer 为主干，在大规模仿真软物体交互上训练，执行生成式完整状态估计与动作条件动力学预测，并采取措施减轻 sim-to-real 差距。模型通过对长度可变的局部点云历史进行上下文学习，推断潜在形状与材料线索；无需更新权重，即可跨机器人形态、材料参数、衣物类型与形状及操作协调模式泛化。世界模型还与目标条件动作规划器结合以生成运动。作者在仿真和真实双臂衣物折叠中验证，报告重建保真度、预测准确性和任务成功率的提升。

2610.31617.abstract_en: Tasks such as quadrotor dynamic-gate racing require agents to anticipate external motion while maintaining precise high-frequency control. World-model-based reinforcement learning provides a natural solution by learning latent dynamics for future imagination, yet it often entangles environmental evolution and the robot's own dynamics in a single learned rollout, where model bias can affect policy optimization efficiency. We propose DiffDreamer, a differentiable reinforcement learning framework that tightly couples a learned world model with differentiable simulation for actor optimization. In one optimization step, the learned world model propagates latent states that capture external dynamics and history-dependent features, while the differentiable simulator propagates the robot's explicit physical state. We further decompose the actor objective into a critic-driven pathway for non-differentiable task rewards and a simulator-driven pathway for differentiable motion rewards. Experiments on aggressive tracking and dynamic-gate racing show that DiffDreamer improves training convergence over the model-free, model-based, and differentiable-RL baselines, and final performance over these baselines and classical planning and control methods. Additional experiments assess reward decomposition and the odometry-conditioned relative-state representation through ablations. We also provide proof-of-concept real-world flight experiments for validation.
2610.31617.abstract_zh: 四旋翼动态门竞速等任务要求智能体预测外部运动，同时保持精确的高频控制。基于世界模型的强化学习可学习潜在动力学并想象未来，但常把环境演化与机器人自身动力学混在同一次学习型展开中，模型偏差会影响策略优化效率。本文提出 DiffDreamer，将学习型世界模型与可微仿真紧密耦合，用于 actor 优化的可微强化学习框架。在每个优化步骤中，学习型世界模型传播捕捉外部动力学和历史相关特征的潜状态，可微仿真器则传播机器人的显式物理状态。作者还把 actor 目标分为面向不可微任务奖励的 critic 路径和面向可微运动奖励的仿真器路径。在激烈跟踪和动态门竞速实验中，相比无模型、基于模型及可微强化学习基线，DiffDreamer 改善训练收敛，最终性能也优于这些基线及经典规划控制方法。消融实验检查奖励分解与里程计条件相对状态表示；作者还提供概念验证性质的真实飞行实验。

2610.29692.abstract_en: During steady pouring, images and robot pose may remain nearly unchanged while transferred mass accumulates, making the return decision ambiguous for a whole-task vision-language-action (VLA) policy. We present FlowVLA, which separates motor generation from physical-completion estimation. A shared $\pi_{0.5}$ action expert learns approach, pour, and return with boundary-aware supervision. A target-independent estimator fuses visual, joint, wrist-wrench, and recurrent force-belief histories to maintain an estimate of transferred mass. The controller initiates return when this estimate plus predicted residual outflow reaches the requested mass. In coffee-pot/water experiments, FlowVLA achieves 13.1 g goal-balanced mean absolute error (MacroMAE), lower than all tested VLA baselines. Across all attempts, 53.7% both complete the task and finish within +/-10% of the requested mass. The same model interpolates to held-out 150/250-g targets without retraining. Independently trained models further evaluate the formulation in three additional container-fluid settings.
2610.29692.abstract_zh: 稳定倾倒时，图像和机器人姿态可能几乎不变，但转移的质量持续累积，使覆盖整项任务的视觉—语言—动作（VLA）策略难以判断何时回收容器。本文提出 FlowVLA，将运动生成与物理完成度估计分离。共享的 π₀.₅ 动作专家通过边界感知监督学习接近、倾倒和回收；与目标无关的估计器融合视觉、关节、腕部力矩和循环式力信念历史，持续估计已转移质量。当该估计加上预测的余流达到目标质量时，控制器开始回收。在咖啡壶倒水实验中，FlowVLA 的目标均衡平均绝对误差（MacroMAE）为 13.1 g，低于所有受测 VLA 基线。全部尝试中，53.7% 既完成任务又在目标质量的 ±10% 以内结束。同一模型无需重训即可插值到留出的 150 g 和 250 g 目标；作者还用独立训练的模型，在另外三种容器—流体设置下评估这一表述。

2610.28814.abstract_en: In contact-rich manipulation, contact conditions can change before a visual policy updates its action plan. Recomputing the plan through the visual policy adds latency, while tactile feedback alone does not specify how the ongoing motion should be revised for the task. We introduce T-WLA, a world-language-action architecture that uses shared visual memory to guide both action generation and tactile correction. At each visual update, the visual branch integrates the current image, task instruction, and retrieved history into a visual memory that conditions base-action generation. The same memory is cached for a lightweight tactile editor, which combines it with the active action chunk and incoming touch to predict residual corrections to unexecuted actions without rerunning the visual branch. Future-image and future-pressure prediction provide training-only supervision, encouraging the visual memory and tactile features to capture interaction dynamics relevant to action generation and correction. We evaluate T-WLA on tactile-conditioned hand-motion prediction using EgoTouch and Tachin, and on four real-world dexterous manipulation tasks. T-WLA reduces finger-joint MPJPE by 30% relative to the strongest reported baseline and achieves an average success rate of approximately 50.0% across real-robot manipulation tasks. Videos and code are available at this https URL.
2610.28814.abstract_zh: 在富接触操作中，视觉策略更新动作计划之前，接触条件就可能变化。通过视觉策略重新计算计划会增加延迟，而单靠触觉反馈也无法说明应如何根据任务修正正在执行的运动。本文提出 T-WLA：用共享视觉记忆同时引导动作生成和触觉修正的世界—语言—动作架构。每次视觉更新时，视觉分支整合当前图像、任务指令与检索历史，得到用于生成基础动作的视觉记忆。同一记忆被缓存给轻量触觉编辑器，后者结合当前动作片段和新触觉输入，对尚未执行的动作预测残差修正，无需再次运行视觉分支。未来图像和未来压力预测只用于训练监督，鼓励视觉记忆和触觉特征捕捉对动作生成及修正有用的交互动力学。作者在 EgoTouch、Tachin 的触觉条件手部运动预测以及四项真实灵巧操作任务上评估。相比报告中最强基线，T-WLA 将手指关节 MPJPE 降低 30%，真实机器人操作任务平均成功率约 50.0%。论文提供视频与代码链接。

2610.29866.abstract_en: Geometric structure is essential for robotic manipulation and understanding the 3D world. Most VLA models rely on 2D representations of current observations, while geometry-aware approaches often require additional 3D information. However, geometry inferred independently from individual observations is often discarded rather than accumulated into a persistent task representation. Our key insight is that action generation needs a compact, task-relevant geometric abstraction that can be continuously updated, rather than a complete, renderable 3D reconstruction at every step. We introduce GeoMem-VLA, a VLA framework that internalizes explicit 3D supervision into dedicated geometric tokens and maintains them as temporal memory for action generation, without directly aligning the VLM's native visual embeddings with the teacher feature space. During training, a frozen geometry foundation model supervises learnable GeoPlan tokens through a geometric flow-matching objective over the current scene point map and future end-effector tracks. These tokens are integrated with the memory of observation representations, where historical information is retrieved, adaptively fused with current observations, and consolidated to retain event frames as the task progresses. At inference, the policy retrieves historical representations and fuses them with the current working representation to predict actions, without invoking the 3D teacher or explicitly reconstructing the scene. After benchmark-specific downstream adaptation, GeoMem-VLA achieves 98.9% average success on LIBERO and 91.10% / 91.24% on RoboTwin's clean/randomized settings. Across five real-world tasks, GeoMem-VLA achieves 78.0% average success. These results suggest that internalizing and remembering 3D scene understanding is a promising approach to robot control.
2610.29866.abstract_zh: 几何结构对机器人操作和理解三维世界至关重要。多数 VLA 模型依赖当前观测的二维表示；几何感知方法常要求额外三维信息，而从单次观测独立推断的几何又往往被丢弃，无法累积为持久任务表示。作者的核心见解是，动作生成需要持续更新、与任务相关的紧凑几何抽象，而不必每一步都完整重建可渲染的三维场景。本文提出 GeoMem-VLA：把显式三维监督内化到专用几何 token，并将其作为生成动作的时间记忆，且不直接把 VLM 原有视觉嵌入对齐到教师特征空间。训练时，冻结的几何基础模型通过对当前场景点图和未来末端轨迹的几何流匹配目标监督可学习 GeoPlan token。这些 token 与观测表示记忆整合，历史信息被检索、与当前观测自适应融合，并随着任务推进压缩保留事件帧。推理时，策略检索历史表示并与当前工作表示融合来预测动作，不调用三维教师，也不显式重建场景。在针对基准的下游适配后，GeoMem-VLA 在 LIBERO 的平均成功率为 98.9%，在 RoboTwin 清洁／随机设置分别为 91.10%／91.24%；五项真实任务的平均成功率为 78.0%。结果提示，把三维场景理解内化并记住，可能是机器人控制的有效路径。

2610.29716.abstract_en: We present SpatialDex, a framework that learns 3D-grounded bimanual dexterity from RGB-only human videos through reconstruction-augmented visuomotor pre-training. The central idea is to learn human behavior together with its spatial context. From each video, we reconstruct the scene geometry and estimate the hand motion, align them at a shared video-level scale using the hand-size prior of 3D hand estimates. We retain the reconstructed geometry as both a policy input and a prediction target. The policy grounds the token grid of a pre-trained vision-language model in this geometry through gated residual fusion, is trained to predict future scene geometry alongside wrist and finger actions, and generates finger motion conditioned on the predicted trajectories of both wrists. Pre-trained on 1M human-video clips and fine-tuned with a small number of robot demonstrations, SpatialDex outperforms the state-of-the-art methods by 16.5 points on nine simulated dexterous tasks across two embodiments and by 38.3 points on six real-world bimanual dexterous tasks. Under a matched comparison, pre-training with reconstructed geometry improves success by 14.2 points over pre-training on hand motion alone.
2610.29716.abstract_zh: 本文提出 SpatialDex：通过重建增强的视觉运动预训练，从仅有 RGB 的人类视频学习具有三维依据的双臂灵巧能力。核心思想是把人类行为与其空间上下文共同学习。方法从每段视频重建场景几何并估计手部运动，再用三维手部估计的手尺寸先验，在视频层面把两者对齐到共同尺度；重建几何既作为策略输入，也作为预测目标。策略通过门控残差融合把预训练视觉语言模型的 token 网格与几何联系起来，同时预测未来场景几何、手腕和手指动作，并根据两只手腕的预测轨迹生成手指运动。方法先在 100 万段人类视频上预训练，再用少量机器人示教微调；在两种机器人形态、九项仿真灵巧任务上比最先进方法高 16.5 个百分点，在六项真实双臂灵巧任务上高 38.3 个百分点。在匹配条件的比较中，使用重建几何预训练，比仅用手部运动预训练的成功率高 14.2 个百分点。

2610.29282.abstract_en: World Action Models (WAMs) have shown strong potential for robot manipulation by jointly learning visual dynamics and executable actions. However, their video and action objectives do not explicitly constrain the 3D geometry that is crucial for precise manipulation. Recently, geometry-aware WAMs introduce depth or 4D prediction branches, whereas representation alignment methods supervise intermediate WAM features with pretrained 3D foundation models. Yet we find that such pointwise alignment benefits the video features but degrades action learning, since dense geometric feature targets overly restrict compact action features. To address this limitation, we propose Relational Geometry Forcing (RGF), which transfers geometric priors from a frozen 3D foundation model by aligning pairwise feature relations instead of pointwise features. Specifically, RGF applies three complementary relational objectives, where intra-frame and cross-view relations transfer scene geometry and multi-view correspondence to the video features, while action-temporal relations couple action dynamics to geometric scene evolution. Applied only during training, RGF requires no explicit geometry branch or extra inference module. Extensive experiments in simulation and the real world demonstrate the effectiveness of Relational Geometry Forcing, showing consistent gains across diverse manipulation scenarios and WAM paradigms.
2610.29282.abstract_zh: 世界动作模型（WAM）联合学习视觉动力学与可执行动作，在机器人操作中显示潜力，但其视频与动作目标并未显式约束精细操作所需的三维几何。近期几何感知 WAM 增加深度或四维预测分支；表示对齐方法则用预训练三维基础模型监督中间 WAM 特征。作者发现，逐点特征对齐虽然有利于视频特征，却会损害动作学习，因为密集几何特征目标对紧凑动作特征限制过强。为解决这一问题，本文提出关系几何强制（RGF）：不对齐逐点特征，而是对齐成对特征关系，把冻结三维基础模型的几何先验传给 WAM。具体包括三个互补的关系目标：帧内和跨视角关系将场景几何与多视角对应传给视频特征；动作—时间关系把动作动力学与场景几何演化耦合起来。RGF 仅在训练时使用，无需显式几何分支或额外推理模块。作者在仿真和真实实验中报告，RGF 对多种操作场景和 WAM 范式带来持续增益。

2610.29432.abstract_en: Real-world physical sensing exhibits complex, heterogeneous noise patterns that deviate significantly from idealized simulation, posing a fundamental bottleneck for sim-to-real transfer. Existing sensor modelings typically treat depth noise as a monolithic black-box process, overlooking the distinct physical mechanisms that govern different error modalities. In this work, we introduce a physics-grounded paradigm that disentangles monolithic noise into two complementary modalities: \textbf{sensing invalidation} and \textbf{measurement inaccuracy}, enabling a tailored treatment of noise sources based on their physical origins. Building on this insight, we propose \textbf{PRISM}, a tripartite framework that distills 3D Visual Foundation Model features as rich spatial-semantic priors for physics-based reasoning. To address the inherent sparsity and class imbalance of invalidation regions, we develop Hierarchical Positive-Prioritized Supervision, integrating multi-scale positive-weighted objectives with a positive-preserving dynamic hard mining strategy to enforce precise artifact delineation. Extensive benchmarks demonstrate that PRISM achieves state-of-the-art fidelity in noisy depth synthesis. Furthermore, downstream robotic experiments show that PRISM facilitates a \textbf{92.1\%} average success rate in the real world, marking a significant improvement over monolithic baselines. Our project page is available at: \resizebox{\linewidth}{!}{\href{this https URL}{this https URL}.}
2610.29432.abstract_zh: 真实物理传感具有复杂、异质的噪声模式，显著偏离理想仿真，成为 sim-to-real 迁移的关键瓶颈。已有传感器模型通常把深度噪声视为整体黑箱过程，忽略支配不同错误模态的物理机制。本文提出物理引导范式，把整体噪声分解为互补的两类：感测失效与测量不准确，从而按物理来源分别处理。基于此，作者提出三部分框架 PRISM，蒸馏三维视觉基础模型特征作为丰富的空间语义先验，用于物理推理。针对失效区域固有的稀疏和类别不平衡，方法设计分层正样本优先监督，把多尺度正样本加权目标与保留正样本的动态难例挖掘结合，以准确描绘伪影。多项基准显示 PRISM 在含噪深度合成保真度方面达到作者报告的最先进水平。下游机器人实验进一步显示其真实世界平均成功率为 92.1%，显著高于整体黑箱基线。论文提供项目页链接。

2610.30033.abstract_en: Body deformation caused by muscle contraction plays a vital role in the visual realism of character animation, yet in most 3D animation pipelines artists have to manually specify muscle activations, which is time-consuming and gives no guarantee of physical realism. To address this, we propose a new method in which a reinforcement learning (RL) controller discovers per-muscle activations that track reference motions without manual tuning. Existing RL muscle controllers stop at 1D muscles; we go one step further, keeping the 1D model inside the RL control loop as a fast surrogate, and using a 3D volumetric simulation to produce the final deformation. Because both stages share the very same constitutive law, the muscle deformation is produced by the same activations that generated the motion. We further add a measured electromyography (EMG) prior that steers the redundant activation solution toward real human muscle recruitment. To achieve stable, efficient, and realistic simulation, we propose a novel geometric multigrid for Extended Position-Based Dynamics (XPBD) that is built on a coarse tetrahedral cage with barycentric-coordinate prolongation and closes a V-cycle on tetrahedral meshes. Within this GPU-parallelized solver, we inject the same Hill-type force-length law as an energy-based fiber constraint that turns per-fiber activation into realistic muscle contraction and bulging. We demonstrate volumetric muscle simulation on a 194-muscle human body with a diverse set of motions (walk, kick, swim, overhead-squat, etc.), simulating the full-body model at 18 ms per frame on a single RTX 4090. Our work takes a step toward character animation that is not only visually convincing but also biomechanically grounded. The website with code and videos is at this https URL.
2610.30033.abstract_zh: 肌肉收缩引起的身体形变对角色动画的视觉真实感很重要，但多数三维动画流程需要艺术家手动指定肌肉激活，耗时且无法保证物理真实性。本文提出方法，让强化学习控制器发现逐肌肉激活，从而追踪参考运动，无需手工调节。已有强化学习肌肉控制器止步于一维肌肉模型；本文在强化学习控制循环内保留一维模型作为快速替代，并用三维体积仿真生成最终形变。由于两个阶段共享完全相同的本构定律，肌肉形变由生成运动的同一组激活产生。作者还加入实测肌电图（EMG）先验，把冗余激活解引向真实人类肌肉募集。为获得稳定、高效、真实的仿真，方法为扩展位置动力学（XPBD）提出新型几何多重网格：它建立在粗四面体笼上，通过重心坐标延拓，在四面体网格上闭合 V 循环。GPU 并行求解器把相同的 Hill 型力—长度定律作为基于能量的纤维约束，使逐纤维激活产生真实的肌肉收缩与隆起。作者展示了含 194 块肌肉的人体体积仿真，覆盖行走、踢腿、游泳、过顶深蹲等多种运动，单块 RTX 4090 上整身模型每帧仿真用时 18 ms。工作旨在迈向既视觉可信又有生物力学依据的角色动画，论文提供代码和视频网站。

2610.30500.abstract_en: Motion Diffusion Models (MDMs) can generate diverse and visually appealing human motion; yet, the resulting trajectories frequently violate physical constraints, limiting their downstream use in simulation and control. We present PhysibleMDM, a framework that promotes physical feasibility of MDM output by optimizing at inference time the diffusion noise without retraining the generative model. We introduce a set of surrogate feasibility constraints that can be evaluated without full trajectory simulation. These constraints combine kinematic checks (e.g., ground penetration, slip, and self-collision) with dynamic feasibility tests computed via an inverse-dynamics inner loop formulated as a cone program. We solve the resulting black-box noise optimization problem using the Separable Covariance Matrix Adaptation Evolution Strategy (Sep-CMA-ES), thereby avoiding reliance on computationally expensive and discontinuous gradients. An autoregressive scheme then chains optimized segments to synthesize long motion sequences. Across 100 motion styles on an SMPL humanoid, PhysibleMDM reduces mean ground penetration, self-collision penetration, and ground slip by 75%, 92%, and 74%, respectively, relative to unoptimized diffusion output. Across 11 sequences for a custom bipedal robot, it achieves median reductions of 89.5% in per-sequence mean acceleration-reconstruction error and 79.5% in the mean inverse-dynamics residual.
2610.30500.abstract_zh: 运动扩散模型能生成多样且视觉上吸引人的人体运动，但轨迹常违反物理约束，限制其在仿真和控制中的应用。本文提出 PhysibleMDM：在推理时优化扩散噪声以提高输出的物理可行性，无需重训生成模型。作者设计无需完整轨迹仿真即可评估的替代性可行性约束，结合地面穿透、滑动和自碰撞等运动学检查，以及以锥规划形式的逆动力学内循环计算出的动力学可行性测试。所得黑箱噪声优化问题由可分离协方差矩阵自适应进化策略 Sep-CMA-ES 求解，避免依赖昂贵且不连续的梯度；自回归方案串联优化后的片段以合成长运动。在 SMPL 类人模型的 100 种运动风格上，相比未优化的扩散输出，平均地面穿透、自碰撞穿透和地面滑动分别降低 75%、92% 和 74%。在自定义双足机器人 11 段序列上，每序列平均加速度重建误差与平均逆动力学残差的中位降幅分别为 89.5% 和 79.5%。

2610.31661.abstract_en: We present OpenTac, a novel sensor and a full-stack ecosystem for tactile skins that are highly customizable, scalable, and readily deployed in downstream robot control and learning applications. Our core contribution is twofold. First, we develop a scalable resistive tactile skin with a structured deformable overlay that converts tangential loading into spatially varying pressure. Differential responses across neighboring "taxels" support decoding of local shear vectors, and the common-mode response encodes normal force. Second, we provide a highly customizable sensor design tool that is able to automatically generate fabrication files for these tactile skins from 2D outlines and developable 3D surfaces, including from abstract descriptions such as text (e.g., "design a sensor for a size 9 shoe insole"). We develop an ecosystem around the OpenTac sensor, including the CAD design tool, a sensor simulator, cross-sensor transfer, and fast/adaptive data acquisition. We demonstrate the broad applicability of the OpenTac-CAD sensor design tool by designing and fabricating more than 30 sensors across a variety of robot embodiments. We characterize the three-dimensional tactile fields produced by OpenTac with a commercial, high-precision force/torque sensor. We demonstrate the broad applicability of 3D tactile sensing across contact-rich feedback control and manipulation policy learning on four real-world robot embodiments. Additionally, adaptive acquisition enables kilohertz-rate partial readouts, exceeding full-array raster scanning on the same sensor by 19.2X at 16 sampled taxels per update for a 1024-taxel skin.
