We provide all hardware, software, and result videos are at this http URL
2610.31661.abstract_zh: 本文提出 OpenTac，一种新型传感器及全栈生态，用于高度可定制、可扩展且易于部署在机器人控制与学习中的触觉皮肤。核心贡献有两方面。首先，作者开发具有结构化可形变覆盖层的可扩展电阻式触觉皮肤，把切向载荷转为随空间变化的压力；相邻触觉单元的差分响应可解码局部剪切向量，共模响应则编码法向力。其次，作者提供高度可定制的传感器设计工具，能根据二维轮廓和可展三维表面、甚至文本等抽象描述（如“为 9 码鞋垫设计传感器”）自动生成制造文件。围绕传感器还建立了 CAD 设计工具、仿真器、跨传感器迁移与快速自适应数据采集。作者在多种机器人形态上设计并制造了 30 多种传感器，使用商用高精度力／力矩传感器表征其三维触觉场，并在四种真实机器人形态的富接触反馈控制与操作策略学习中展示应用。对于 1024 单元皮肤，每次更新采样 16 个单元时，自适应采集实现千赫兹级局部读数，比同一传感器的全阵列光栅扫描快 19.2 倍。论文提供硬件、软件和结果视频的链接。

2610.30411.abstract_en: Recent work in additive manufacturing and neural inverse design enables the creation of complex three-dimensional structures to manipulate physical fields, yet these designs must also adhere to discrete, non-differentiable fabrication constraints. Current methods limit the design space by imposing differentiable soft manufacturability loss penalties, or by fixing structures through post-processing, causing a discrepancy between the geometry optimized by the physics model and the final fabricated result. Thus, we present AcoustiPrint, a physics-informed neural architecture for constrained inverse design that represents three-dimensional geometries with an implicit neural representation (INR) and passes each candidate through a printability operator before evaluating its final response. The printability operator executes layer-wise self-support, discrete material selection, and whole-body connectivity, assuring fabrication feasibility. To allow for backpropagation through the discrete non-differentiable operations, we use surrogate gradients for the backward pass and a self-supervised printability objective that progressively drives the INR toward a valid design domain. We demonstrate AcoustiPrint for personalized transcranial focused ultrasound, where inter-patient differences in acoustic properties and head geometry deform wave propagation and requires patient-specific acoustic focusing. AcoustiPrint jointly optimizes three-dimensional geometry and material composition through differentiable wave physics while ensuring manufacturability. Experiments show manufacturable acoustic structures with enhanced focal accuracy and over density-based and phase-based baselines, demonstrating a generalized methodology for neural design through non-differentiable manufacturing constraints and differentiable physics.
2610.30411.abstract_zh: 增材制造与神经逆向设计使人们能创建操控物理场的复杂三维结构，但设计还须满足离散、不可微的制造约束。现有方法以可微软制造性损失限制设计空间，或在后处理中修正结构，造成物理模型优化的几何与最终制品不一致。本文提出 AcoustiPrint：以隐式神经表示（INR）表示三维几何，并在评估最终响应前让每个候选经过可打印性算子。该算子执行逐层自支撑、离散材料选择和整体连通性检查，保证制造可行。为穿过不可微离散操作反向传播，方法使用替代梯度，并通过自监督可打印性目标逐步把 INR 推向有效设计域。作者将其用于个性化经颅聚焦超声：患者声学属性和头部几何差异会改变波传播，需要患者专属的声聚焦结构。AcoustiPrint 在保证可制造性的同时，通过可微波动物理联合优化三维几何与材料组成。实验显示所得可制造声学结构在聚焦准确性等方面优于密度式和相位式基线，展示了在不可微制造约束与可微物理下进行神经设计的通用方法。

2610.30337.abstract_en: Generating an articulated object from a single image requires recovering both its appearance and the mechanism governing its parts. A compact encoding of joint attributes does not by itself ensure that reconstruction preserves the resulting motion. We present MoRE, Motion-Regularized Encoding for articulated 3D generation. MoRE represents coordinate-aligned joint lines with axis classification and two axis-orthogonal Plücker moment coefficients, removing the arbitrary choice of an origin along the axis. During representation learning, decoded joint hypotheses are used to move corresponding three-dimensional anchors, and their motions are compared with those of annotated joints. A differentiable expectation over joint types and axis directions couples attribute reconstruction to the motion it induces. An image-conditioned flow learns the resulting functional latents, while a multi-state-adapted Gaussian model supplies appearance. At inference, recovered part assignments and joints articulate a single set of rest-pose Gaussians without regenerating the object for each state. Experiments on PartNet-Mobility and ACD show stronger part-box agreement, articulated-state geometry and visual similarity than the compared baselines, while joint prediction reduces axis, origin and range errors relative to ArtiLatent. Controlled ablations support the joint-line encoding and show that motion supervision reduces anchor-motion error. Code and pretrained checkpoints will be released in the future.
2610.30337.abstract_zh: 从单张图像生成可关节运动的物体，需要恢复其外观及支配部件运动的机构；仅对关节属性进行紧凑编码，并不能保证重建保留由此产生的运动。本文提出 MoRE，即面向关节式三维生成的运动正则编码。MoRE 用轴分类和两个与轴正交的 Plücker 矩系数表示与坐标对齐的关节轴线，消除沿轴选择任意原点的问题。在表示学习中，解码得到的关节假设用于移动相应的三维锚点，其运动与标注关节的运动比较。对关节类型和轴方向的可微期望，将属性重建与其诱发的运动耦合起来。图像条件流学习所得功能潜变量，多状态适配的高斯模型提供外观。推理时，恢复的部件分配与关节使同一组静止姿态高斯发生关节运动，无需对每个状态重新生成物体。在 PartNet-Mobility 和 ACD 上，作者报告相比基线具有更好的部件包围盒一致性、关节状态几何与视觉相似度；关节预测相较 ArtiLatent 降低轴、原点和运动范围误差。受控消融支持关节轴线编码，并显示运动监督可降低锚点运动误差。代码和预训练检查点计划以后发布。

2610.30910.abstract_en: Neurosurgical navigation commonly presents magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) as 2D slices, making it difficult to relate the anatomy in those slices to the cortical surface observed through the surgical microscope. We seek a common 3D visualization that combines a photorealistic reconstruction of the exposed cortex during tumor surgery with whole-brain MRI context and diffusion tractography pathways. This requires the reconstructed cortex to form a clear boundary around the brain anatomy rather than a diffuse volume that obscures internal structures. Conventional 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) can reproduce observed views but, under limited surgical view coverage, may distribute opacity through a thick and geometrically ambiguous band. We introduce height-field 2D Gaussian Splatting (H-2DGS), a three-stage pipeline that concentrates a robust 3DGS reconstruction, fuses its depth into a shared truncated signed distance field (TSDF) surface, and represents that surface with curved, surface-oriented Gaussian primitives. Separate height, color, and opacity bases provide local geometry and appearance, while a neighbor-transition objective coordinates overlapping patches. The explicit surface further supports postoperative alignment: MRI-derived depth deforms the reconstruction, and tracked-color supervision with alternating optimization preserves its appearance. Across five real neurosurgical cases, H-2DGS gives low multi-view depth inconsistency, a compact 7.97MB representation, and interactive rendering at 29--42ms per frame. The resulting sharp, deformable surface integrates clearly with tractography and MRI anatomy, including a postoperative resection cavity.
2610.30910.abstract_zh: 神经外科导航常把 MRI 显示为二维切片，使切片中的解剖结构难以与手术显微镜下的皮质表面对应。作者希望建立共同的三维可视化，把肿瘤手术中暴露皮质的照片级重建与全脑 MRI 背景及扩散纤维束成像路径结合。这要求皮质重建成为脑组织周围清晰的边界，而不是遮蔽内部结构的弥散体积。传统三维高斯泼溅（3DGS）能重现观测视角，但在手术视角有限时，不透明度可能分布于厚而几何含糊的带状区域。本文提出高度场二维高斯泼溅 H-2DGS：三阶段流程先聚合稳健的 3DGS 重建，再将深度融合成共享截断符号距离场（TSDF）表面，最后用弯曲、面向表面的高斯基元表示该表面。分离的高度、颜色与不透明度基提供局部几何和外观，邻域过渡目标协调重叠图块。显式表面还支持术后对齐：由 MRI 得到的深度使重建形变，追踪颜色监督与交替优化保持外观。在五例真实神经外科病例上，H-2DGS 实现低多视角深度不一致性、7.97 MB 的紧凑表示及每帧 29–42 ms 的交互式渲染。清晰、可形变的表面可与纤维束成像和 MRI 解剖结构明确整合，包括术后切除腔。

2610.30313.abstract_en: Existing 3D generative approaches are typically developed for individual imaging modalities, requiring substantial modality-specific data and limiting their ability to exploit shared structure across scientific imaging domains. We present SciFusion, a multimodal framework for unified 3D scientific image generation built on a latent diffusion backbone, with two key contributions. First, we introduce a compositional conditioning scheme that factorizes each modality into domain, object, and contrast representations. Sharing these factors across related modalities enables knowledge transfer across heterogeneous imaging domains and allows the factors to be recombined at inference time to synthesize unseen domain-object-contrast compositions in a zero-shot manner. Second, we incorporate domain-specific physics-informed objectives: Fourier spectral consistency for MRI, Radon projection consistency for CT, and multislice diffraction consistency for electron microscopy, to encourage generated samples to respect modality-dependent image formation processes. Extensive experiments across 15 medical and scientific imaging modalities demonstrate that SciFusion improves generation fidelity and cross-domain generalization over modality-specific and flattened multimodal conditioning strategies, while enabling zero-shot synthesis of unseen compositions without training on those target compositions. These results demonstrate that compositional, physics-guided conditioning provides a scalable framework for unified 3D scientific image generation, particularly for emerging modalities where large-scale training data are difficult to obtain.
2610.30313.abstract_zh: 现有三维生成方法通常面向单一成像模态开发，需要大量模态专属数据，也难利用不同科学成像领域之间的共享结构。本文提出 SciFusion：基于潜扩散主干的统一三维科学图像生成多模态框架，包含两项主要贡献。其一，组合式条件方案将每种模态分解为领域、对象和对比度表示；在相关模态之间共享这些因子，既可跨异质成像领域迁移知识，也可在推理时重新组合，零样本合成未见过的领域—对象—对比度组合。其二，加入领域专属的物理信息目标：用于 MRI 的傅里叶频谱一致性、用于 CT 的 Radon 投影一致性，以及用于电子显微镜的多切片衍射一致性，以鼓励生成样本遵循各模态的成像机制。跨 15 种医学与科学成像模态的实验表明，相比模态专属策略和扁平化多模态条件策略，SciFusion 提升生成保真度及跨领域泛化，并能在未对目标组合训练的情况下零样本合成新组合。结果表明，组合式、物理引导的条件方法可成为统一三维科学图像生成的可扩展框架，尤其适合难以收集大规模训练数据的新兴模态。

2610.30969.abstract_en: Stable grasping under task-specific disturbances is important for robotic manipulation. However, most dexterous grasp synthesis methods are developed for highly actuated hands in free space, and low-DoF hands may not be able to realize the contact topologies required by these grasps. Meanwhile, support surfaces can provide useful contact forces, but are often treated only as geometric constraints. We present a support-aware grasp synthesis framework for object immobilization with low-DoF coupled hands. Given irregular object geometry, our method represents both hand and object local surface regions as graphs and searches for kinematically feasible matchings between them. We then refine the wrist pose and motor state for geometric contact feasibility and validates the refined grasps through physical rollouts. Starting from the validated grasp pose, an optional task-guided local search explores nearby grasp configurations by varying the wrist pose and motor state, and selects one according to the specified task condition. Experiments on diverse objects show that our method generates various grasp configurations that achieve high grasp success and strong disturbance resistance. Real-world experiments further demonstrate physically executable grasps which enable object immobilization in cooking scenario.
2610.30969.abstract_zh: 面向任务特定扰动的稳定抓握是机器人操作的重要能力，但多数灵巧抓握合成方法为自由空间中高度驱动的手设计，低自由度手未必能实现所需接触拓扑。另一方面，支撑表面能提供有用的接触力，却通常只被当成几何约束。本文提出面向低自由度耦合手的支撑感知物体固定抓握合成框架。给定不规则物体几何，方法把手和物体的局部表面区域表示为图，并搜索运动学上可行的匹配；随后细化腕部姿态和电机状态以满足几何接触可行性，并通过物理展开验证抓握。以验证过的抓握姿态为起点，可选的任务引导局部搜索改变腕部姿态与电机状态，在附近抓握配置中按指定任务条件选择。多样物体实验显示，该方法生成多种具有高抓握成功率和较强抗扰性的配置；真实实验进一步展示了能在烹饪场景固定物体的、物理上可执行的抓握。

2610.31334.abstract_en: Vision and touch provide complementary cues for object pose and local contact geometry, but external cameras are often occluded at the contact site. We present GelSlim 5.0, a fingertip sensor that acquires visual and tactile observations with one fixed camera and a continuous UV-responsive contact layer. By switching illumination, the camera sequentially acquires through-membrane visual images and contact-sensitive tactile images from a shared viewpoint, avoiding inter-camera extrinsic calibration. To combine these observations, we introduce VisTacFusion, a multimodal transformer with separate prediction paths for planar object pose and contact geometry. Asymmetric bottleneck fusion incorporates visual context while preserving tactile spatial features for depth and surface-normal estimation. Modality dropout enables inference with paired inputs or either modality alone. On real validation data from 12 known objects, paired inputs reduce depth MSE, angular error, and translation $L_1$ by 61.2%, 72.3%, and 61.3%, respectively, relative to tactile-only inference with the same model. Relative to visual-only inference, the corresponding reductions are 93.7%, 6.1%, and 8.6%.
2610.31334.abstract_zh: 视觉和触觉分别提供物体姿态与局部接触几何的互补线索，但外置相机常在接触处被遮挡。本文提出 GelSlim 5.0：一种以单台固定相机和连续紫外响应接触层同时获取视觉与触觉观测的指尖传感器。通过切换照明，相机从共享视角依次获取透过薄膜的视觉图像与对接触敏感的触觉图像，避免相机间外参标定。为融合两种观测，作者提出 VisTacFusion：针对平面物体姿态和接触几何设置独立预测路径的多模态 Transformer。非对称瓶颈融合引入视觉上下文，同时保留用于深度和表面法线估计的触觉空间特征；模态 dropout 允许成对输入或仅用任一模态推理。在来自 12 个已知物体的真实验证数据上，相比同一模型仅用触觉推理，成对输入的深度均方误差、角度误差和位移 L1 误差分别降低 61.2%、72.3% 和 61.3%；相比仅用视觉推理，三个指标分别降低 93.7%、6.1% 和 8.6%。

2610.31472.abstract_en: Tactile sensing provides robots with contact information difficult to obtain from vision alone. Shear force is particularly important for understanding tangential contact, guiding corrective motions, and maintaining grasp stability, yet flexible and low-cost tactile arrays often measure only normal force. We introduce VecTile, a low-cost, 6 mm thin, flexible tactile array capable of three-axis force sensing. VecTile combines a piezoresistive layer with passive silicone nubs that convert normal and shear forces into distinguishable pressure patterns. The sensor can be fabricated in-house without specialized equipment. The complete system costs less than 35 USD for a 4x4 array. We validate the sensing mechanism through finite element analysis and hardware experiments. In controlled single-taxel tests over 1-5 N normal force and up to 1.5 N shear force, VecTile achieves root-mean-square errors of 0.39 N and 0.16 N for normal and shear forces. A VecTile calibrated while flat retains accuracy when curved, while a five-minute manual calibration is sufficient for practical use. Two applications demonstrate its utility. First, shear readings are sensitive enough to stop a sharp scalpel from puncturing a balloon after contact. Second, the sensor substantially improves Diffusion Policy-guided power-plug insertion. All designs and code will be released upon paper acceptance. Project website: this https URL.
2610.31472.abstract_zh: 触觉让机器人获得仅靠视觉难以获取的接触信息。剪切力尤其影响切向接触理解、修正运动和抓握稳定性，但柔性、低成本触觉阵列常只能测法向力。本文提出 VecTile：厚 6 mm、低成本、柔性的三轴力传感阵列。它把压阻层与无源硅胶凸点结合，将法向力和剪切力转化为可区分的压力图案，无需专用设备即可在内部制造；完整的 4×4 阵列系统成本低于 35 美元。作者用有限元分析及硬件实验验证传感机制。在法向力 1–5 N、剪切力最高 1.5 N 的受控单单元测试中，法向与剪切力的均方根误差分别为 0.39 N 和 0.16 N。平面状态下标定的 VecTile 在弯曲时仍保持准确性，五分钟手动标定足以实用。两个应用展示其价值：剪切读数足以在接触后阻止锋利手术刀刺破气球；该传感器还显著改善由 Diffusion Policy 引导的电源插头插入。所有设计与代码计划在论文被接收后发布。

2610.30340.abstract_en: We introduce Foundation4D, a unified feed-forward model for geometry estimation, 3D detection, semantic occupancy, and Gaussian reconstruction from multi-camera driving video. A shared backbone uses factorized spatiotemporal attention to efficiently combine observations across cameras and time. Our video inference pipeline uses pose graph optimization to refine camera trajectories and assembles object tracks across input windows. We also develop a data annotation pipeline and release PAI-Foundation4D, a benchmark with dense depth and semantic occupancy labels for 1,253 driving clips. With benchmark-specific fine-tuning, Foundation4D achieves the lowest depth AbsRel on Waymo and nuScenes, the highest detection mAP on nuScenes, and the highest occupancy mIoU on OpenOccupancy among the compared methods. Our task-combination study shows benefits for both detection and geometry: co-training detection with geometry and occupancy improves top-class mAP by 1.2 points over detection-only training, while co-training geometry with detection reduces camera-to-rig translation error by $13.4\%$ relative to geometry-only training. We further use the predicted geometry and trajectories as priors for lidarless NuRec, supporting reconstruction of driving scenes for simulation.
2610.30340.abstract_zh: 本文提出 Foundation4D：一种从多相机驾驶视频统一执行几何估计、三维检测、语义占据与高斯重建的前馈模型。共享主干使用分解式时空注意力，高效整合不同相机和时间的观测。视频推理流程通过姿态图优化细化相机轨迹，并跨输入窗口拼接物体轨迹。作者还开发数据标注流程并发布 PAI-Foundation4D 基准，其中 1,253 段驾驶视频具有稠密深度和语义占据标注。在针对各基准微调后，Foundation4D 在所比较方法中取得 Waymo 和 nuScenes 上最低的深度 AbsRel、nuScenes 上最高的检测 mAP，以及 OpenOccupancy 上最高的占据 mIoU。任务组合研究显示检测与几何均获益：将检测与几何和占据联合训练，相较仅训练检测，最高类别的 mAP 提高 1.2 个点；将几何与检测联合训练，相较仅训练几何，相机到车体的平移误差降低 13.4%。作者还把预测的几何和轨迹作为无激光雷达 NuRec 的先验，以支持用于仿真的驾驶场景重建。

2610.30326.abstract_en: Dynamic representations based on 4D Gaussian Splatting (4DGS) have shown strong capabilities in reconstruction and rendering, yet current methods remain limited in supporting complex natural-language referring in dynamic scenes. Existing 4D Gaussian methods are primarily designed for rendering-oriented dynamic modeling, while current semantic extensions often rely on scene-specific semantic optimization or are evaluated on relatively simple query settings. In this paper, we study Referring 4D Gaussian Splatting (R4DGS), a task for grounding temporally varying, multi-target or reasoning-intensive, and zero-target or distractor expressions in dynamic 4D scenes. To support this task, we introduce R4D-Bench-QA, a benchmark with structured query annotations. We further present ReferGaussian, a unified framework built upon 4DGS that converts low-level dynamic Gaussians into persistent, language-addressable entities for training-free referring inference. ReferGaussian organizes mask-supported Gaussian entities in an EntityBank, uses Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) to decompose complex queries into trackable object phrases and structured referring constraints, and performs constraint-aware grounding without scene-specific semantic optimization. Experiments on R4D-Bench-QA and the 4D LangSplat protocol demonstrate improved temporal target selection and competitive spatiotemporal grounding without scene-specific semantic training. Project resources are available at this https URL.
2610.30326.abstract_zh: 基于四维高斯泼溅（4DGS）的动态表示已具有较强重建与渲染能力，但对动态场景中复杂自然语言指代的支持仍有限。既有四维高斯方法主要面向渲染动态建模，语义扩展则常依赖针对具体场景的语义优化，或仅在较简单查询上评估。本文研究指代式四维高斯泼溅（R4DGS）任务：在动态四维场景中定位随时间变化、多目标或推理密集的指代表达，以及无目标或含干扰项的表达。作者提出带结构化查询标注的 R4D-Bench-QA 基准，并提出基于 4DGS 的统一框架 ReferGaussian，把底层动态高斯转为持久、可由语言寻址的实体，以免训练方式执行指代推理。它将有掩码支撑的高斯实体组织于 EntityBank，借助多模态大语言模型把复杂查询分解为可追踪的物体短语与结构化指代约束，并在无需针对场景进行语义优化的情况下完成约束感知定位。在 R4D-Bench-QA 与 4D LangSplat 协议上的实验显示，时间目标选择得到改善，时空定位具有竞争力，且无需针对场景的语义训练。论文提供项目资源链接。

2610.30974.abstract_en: Generative modeling for Computer-Aided Design (CAD) remains fundamentally challenged by the need to capture the intricate interplay between discrete topological connectivity and precise spatial geometry inherent in Boundary Representations (B-reps). Existing generative approaches largely formulate CAD construction as a sequence modeling problem, but consequently lack an explicit topological inductive bias. In this work, we present GraphCAD, a geometry-aware generative framework that centers modeling on the Edge-Adjacency Graph (EAG), a novel graph-based CAD representation tailored for generative tasks. GraphCAD adopts a hybrid graph diffusion formulation to jointly model the discrete and continuous components of EAG and introduces a geometry-aware denoising mechanism that renders node attributes into spatial point sets. These point sets are encoded by an SE(3)-equivariant backbone and fused into the node representations, thereby grounding the generative process in physical geometry. To support this study, we construct EAGBench, a large-scale dataset of engineering CAD models. Extensive experiments show that GraphCAD can generate complex CAD models with more than 50 faces and achieves state-of-the-art performance in geometric fidelity and distributional alignment compared with sequence-based baselines.
2610.30974.abstract_zh: 计算机辅助设计（CAD）的生成建模，仍面临边界表示（B-rep）中离散拓扑连接与精确空间几何复杂耦合的挑战。既有生成方法多把 CAD 构造表述为序列建模，因此缺乏显式拓扑归纳偏置。本文提出 GraphCAD：以边邻接图（EAG）为中心的几何感知生成框架，EAG 是面向生成任务的新型图式 CAD 表示。GraphCAD 采用混合图扩散联合建模 EAG 的离散与连续成分；几何感知去噪机制把节点属性渲染为空间点集，再由 SE(3) 等变主干编码并融合回节点表示，使生成过程植根于物理空间几何。作者还构建大规模工程 CAD 模型数据集 EAGBench。实验显示 GraphCAD 可生成超过 50 个面的复杂 CAD 模型，在几何保真度及分布对齐方面相较序列式基线达到作者报告的最先进水平。

2610.31429.abstract_en: World action models increasingly rely on pretrained video models assumed to capture physical dynamics for prediction, planning, and action generation. Existing evaluations assess plausibility, probe representations, or measure predictive surprise, but rarely identify which history-conditioned physical expectations conflict with observations. We introduce PhysTrace, a training-free framework aligning MLLM-generated, history-conditioned expectations with observed video windows to temporally localize physical violations and provide interpretable descriptions without task-specific probes or classifiers. We also introduce IntPhys2-Timing, adding violation intervals to IntPhys2. PhysTrace achieves a Hit Rate of up to 70.7% across physical principles on IntPhys2-Timing and outperforms the compared methods in overall possible-impossible discrimination accuracy on IntPhys2. Applied to reconstructed videos along the trajectories of pretrained diffusion/flow-based video models, PhysTrace reveals attribute- and noise-dependent patterns in physical violation localization, enabling interpretable physical consistency analysis across timesteps.
2610.31429.abstract_zh: 世界动作模型越来越依赖预训练视频模型，假设它们掌握了可用于预测、规划和动作生成的物理动力学。现有评估检查合理性、探测表示或测量预测意外，却很少指出哪些以历史为条件的物理预期与观测冲突。本文提出 PhysTrace：一种免训练框架，把多模态大语言模型生成的历史条件预期与观测视频窗口对齐，以在时间上定位物理违规并给出可解释描述，无需任务专属探针或分类器。作者还提出 IntPhys2-Timing，为 IntPhys2 增添违规时间区间。PhysTrace 在 IntPhys2-Timing 上跨物理原则取得最高 70.7% 的 Hit Rate，在 IntPhys2 的整体可能／不可能判别准确率上优于所比较方法。将其用于沿预训练扩散／流式视频模型轨迹重建的视频，PhysTrace 揭示物理违规定位中随属性和噪声变化的模式，从而能跨时间步分析物理一致性并提供解释。

2610.31651.abstract_en: Frontier coding agents are becoming increasingly adept at 3D modeling. Yet, they still face challenges when building objects meant to be assembled in the physical world, often creating invalid assemblies with floating, colliding, or disconnected parts. We argue that providing agents with tools for assembling builds and verifying their physical feasibility is sufficient for them to produce physically valid assemblies that still adhere to input prompts. Focusing on the domain of LEGO brick builds, we present BrickWright, a framework for generating physically feasible brick builds from text or image prompts using pre-trained agents, where a build is physically feasible if it uses only real parts, has no colliding or floating parts, and forms a connected structure if possible. BrickWright guides agents to create builds by writing code with BrickLayer, a Python toolkit with two main components: an ergonomic brick assembly API that halves inference cost compared to working in raw LDraw, and a validator that provides feedback on physical feasibility. Whereas baseline agents achieve physical validity rates ranging from only 9% (GPT-6 Luna) to 69% (GPT-6 Astra), BrickWright-guided agents achieve 100% validity on a sample of 512 prompts, while improving prompt adherence for lightweight agents and maintaining it for stronger agents. Additionally, they outperform specialized models on the text-to-brick task. Code is available on our project page: this https URL
2610.31651.abstract_zh: 前沿编码智能体愈发擅长三维建模，但在创建要在现实世界中组装的物体时，仍常产生悬空、碰撞或断开的无效组件。作者认为，提供组装工具和物理可行性验证，足以帮助智能体在遵循输入提示的同时生成物理有效的组件。聚焦乐高积木，本文提出 BrickWright：利用预训练智能体从文本或图像提示生成物理可行积木结构的框架。所谓可行，是指仅使用真实零件、无碰撞或悬空部件，并在可能时形成连通结构。BrickWright 引导智能体使用 BrickLayer Python 工具包编写代码；工具包的易用积木组装 API 相比直接使用原始 LDraw 将推理成本减半，验证器则反馈物理可行性。在 512 个提示样本上，基线智能体的物理有效率从 9%（GPT-6 Luna）到 69%（GPT-6 Astra）不等，使用 BrickWright 后达到 100%；轻量级智能体的提示遵循度提高，较强智能体的遵循度得以保持。方法在文生积木任务上也超过专门模型。代码位于项目页。

2610.31064.abstract_en: Capturing a loose object inside a spacecraft requires a robot to approach a target that can translate and rotate, and whose motion changes when contact is made. These conditions motivate evaluation beyond manipulation of supported objects. We introduce AstroBench, an open benchmark for free-floating capture and space robotic manipulation with a fixed-base arm. The task suite combines four initial-motion tracks with sample-storage operations based on MELFI hardware and cap and captive-screw servicing based on the Robotic Refueling Mission. The two workcells provide nine task definitions and 29 task-target combinations. A metadata-filtered Objaverse inventory supplies 8,414 object instances for asset expansion, alongside five cabin visual contexts and versioned task instructions. We report two acquisition-focused experiments using existing checkpoints. A frozen $\pi_{0.5}$ DROID joint-position policy captures 2 of 200 static targets and 4 of 200 moving targets across twenty object identities. A cube-specific ACT policy captures 8 of 10 static targets and 6 of 10 moving targets in a separate experiment. Each experiment retains its recorded observation, action and capture configuration. The results document difficult direct transfer for the tested generalist checkpoint and successful task-specific capture behavior, while identifying concrete settings for studying motion-aware perception and contact-sensitive control. Code, task definitions and editable workcell assets are available at this https URL.
2610.31064.abstract_zh: 在航天器内部抓取自由漂浮物体时，机器人须接近会平移、旋转且在接触后改变运动的目标，因此需要超越有支撑物体操作的评测。本文提出 AstroBench：使用固定基座机械臂评估自由漂浮捕获和空间机器人操作的开放基准。任务集结合四种初始运动轨道、基于 MELFI 硬件的样本存放操作，以及基于 Robotic Refueling Mission 的盖子和系留螺钉维护；两个工作单元提供九种任务定义和 29 种任务—目标组合。经过元数据筛选的 Objaverse 资产库提供 8,414 个物体实例以扩展资产，另有五种舱内视觉背景和带版本的任务指令。作者报告两组使用现有检查点、聚焦获取目标的实验：冻结的 π₀.₅ DROID 关节位置策略在 20 种物体身份上，分别捕获 200 个静态目标中的 2 个和 200 个运动目标中的 4 个；另一个实验中，特定于立方体的 ACT 策略分别捕获 10 个静态目标中的 8 个和 10 个运动目标中的 6 个。每组实验保留所记录的观测、动作和捕获配置。结果记录了所测通用检查点的直接迁移困难，以及任务专属的成功捕获行为，并给出研究运动感知与接触敏感控制的具体设置。代码、任务定义和可编辑工作单元资产可获取。

2610.30814.abstract_en: World models are increasingly used to reduce environment interaction when post-training vision-language-action (VLA) policies with reinforcement learning. Yet they are typically trained to predict pixels one step ahead, even though their role here is not merely to render visually faithful videos but to produce learning signals from imagined rollouts that improve the policy. We show that this mismatch is substantial: lower pixel MSE can produce worse policy gradients, and a world model trained for policy utility can yield better downstream policies despite 17% higher pixel MSE on the next frame. We propose the Downstream-Return Imagination Learning Loop (DRILL), a bilevel framework that updates the world model to maximize the policy's return after an inner GRPO update on imagined rollouts. DRILL has two instantiations. DRILL-VWI is a closed-form surrogate, requiring no additional simulator rollouts, that reweights prediction errors by policy visitation, the group-relative GRPO advantage, and model confidence. DRILL-IMG is a full meta-gradient method that differentiates through the inner update using truncated Hessian-vector products. We show that DRILL-VWI recovers the local one-step component of the DRILL-IMG meta-gradient under score-compatibility and small-residual assumptions. Across five manipulation simulators and two VLA backbones, DRILL-IMG raises mean success rate by 13.1 points over WMPO and 7.9 points over RLVR-World, and complements RLVR pretraining rather than competing with it. More broadly, we believe video world models for VLA reinforcement learning can be productively trained by the policy gradients they produce, not only by pixel-level prediction.
2610.30814.abstract_zh: 在利用强化学习对视觉—语言—动作（VLA）策略进行后训练时，世界模型越来越常用于减少环境交互，但通常仍以单步像素预测来训练。这里世界模型的职责并非仅渲染视觉逼真的视频，而是从想象展开中产生能改善策略的学习信号；作者表明两者存在显著不匹配：更低的像素 MSE 可能带来更差的策略梯度，而面向策略效用训练的世界模型即使下一帧像素 MSE 高出 17%，仍可得到更好的下游策略。本文提出 Downstream-Return Imagination Learning Loop（DRILL），通过双层优化，在想象展开上的内层 GRPO 更新之后最大化策略回报来更新世界模型。DRILL 有两个实现：DRILL-VWI 是无需额外仿真器展开的闭式替代方法，按照策略访问、组相对 GRPO 优势及模型置信度重加权预测误差；DRILL-IMG 是通过截断 Hessian—向量积对内层更新求导的完整元梯度方法。作者在分数兼容和小残差假设下证明，DRILL-VWI 可恢复 DRILL-IMG 元梯度的局部单步分量。在五个操作仿真器和两个 VLA 主干上，DRILL-IMG 的平均成功率比 WMPO 高 13.1 个百分点、比 RLVR-World 高 7.9 个百分点，并可补充而非取代 RLVR 预训练。作者认为，用于 VLA 强化学习的视频世界模型也可按其产生的策略梯度训练，而不只按像素预测训练。

2610.31474.abstract_en: Robot world models simulate how environments evolve in response to robot actions. Latent action models enable learning dynamics from videos by encoding visual transitions as proxy actions. However, reconstruction-driven latent actions mix robot motion with object responses and other scene changes, complicating their correspondence with robot controls. We propose SkeLAM, a skeleton-guided latent action model for controllable robot world modeling. SkeLAM decomposes latent actions into a kinematic component grounded by robot skeleton supervision and a residual component retaining complementary visual dynamics. Cross-modal swap reconstruction encourages RGB-derived and skeleton-derived kinematic representations to be interchangeable during video reconstruction. The world model incorporates both components through separate conditioning pathways, while branch dropout reduces its dependence on future-derived residual information. A lightweight adapter maps robot actions to the kinematic space, and subsequent world-model fine-tuning adapts generation to these predicted conditions. At inference, the model generates future observations from the current observation and robot actions. On DROID, SkeLAM reduces end-effector ADE by 19.5% and LPIPS by 11.1% compared with DreamDojo. Motion probing supports kinematic specialization, while qualitative results demonstrate zero-shot human-to-robot motion transfer in generated rollouts. Policy evaluation shows agreement between predicted success rates and those measured in real robot executions.
2610.31474.abstract_zh: 机器人世界模型模拟环境如何随机器人动作演化。潜动作模型通过把视觉变化编码为代理动作，从视频中学习动力学；然而，以重建为目标的潜动作会混合机器人运动、物体反应和其他场景变化，削弱其与机器人控制的对应。本文提出 SkeLAM：用于可控机器人世界建模的骨架引导潜动作模型。SkeLAM 将潜动作分解为受机器人骨架监督约束的运动学分量，以及保留互补视觉动力学的残差分量。跨模态交换重建促使从 RGB 与骨架导出的运动学表示在视频重建时可互换。世界模型通过独立条件路径纳入两种分量，并用分支 dropout 减少对未来导出残差信息的依赖。轻量适配器将机器人动作映射到运动学空间，随后通过世界模型微调，使生成适配预测条件。推理时，模型由当前观测和机器人动作生成未来观测。在 DROID 上，相比 DreamDojo，SkeLAM 的末端执行器平均位移误差（ADE）降低 19.5%，LPIPS 降低 11.1%。运动探测支持运动学专门化，定性结果显示生成展开中的零样本人到机器人运动迁移；策略评估中预测成功率与真实机器人执行测得的成功率一致。

2610.28827.abstract_en: We present WorldStream, an open-ended 3D world model with three simultaneous capabilities: it extends playable terrain beyond any pre-specified map, acts on open-ended language in the running world, and restores visited places with their edits. A hierarchical planner over a typed decision model emits structured decision state: Macro fixes settlement, ecology, transport, and hydrological structure across a group of tiles; Micro specializes that contract into tile semantics under measured terrain and accepted neighbor commitments. Deterministic local code compiles accepted plans into terrain, roads, settlements, vegetation, and entities. Streaming separates their reach: plans run ahead along the predicted corridor, compilation only where movement will soon need it, geometry behind the user released. One world record retains plans, seeds, object identities and mutable state, boundary commitments, and edits by attribute, revised as the user advances and edits; returning tiles recompile from it. The same record grounds interaction: the model acts on existing entities, including stateful NPCs that update as they act, edits the present region, or attaches intent to unplanned regions. Together they yield a world expanding under bounded budgets, connected across independently planned tiles, and interactive.
2610.28827.abstract_zh: 本文提出 WorldStream，一种开放式三维世界模型，同时具有三项能力：把可游玩的地形扩展到任何预设地图之外；在运行中的世界里根据开放式语言执行动作；恢复曾到访地点及其编辑。基于类型化决策模型的分层规划器输出结构化决策状态：宏观层在一组地图片上固定聚落、生态、交通和水文结构；微观层依据实测地形和已接受的邻接承诺，将该约定细化为单片语义。确定性的本地代码把已接受规划编译成地形、道路、聚落、植被和实体。流式系统将规划、编译和几何的作用范围分开：沿预测路线提前规划，只在即将移动到的区域编译，并释放用户身后的几何。一个世界记录保留规划、种子、物体身份与可变状态、边界承诺以及按属性组织的编辑，随用户前进和修改而修订；返回旧片时从该记录重编译。交互也以同一记录为依据：模型可以作用于已有实体，包括随行动更新状态的 NPC，编辑当前区域，或给未规划区域附加意图。这些机制共同使世界在有界预算下扩展、跨独立规划的地图片保持连接并可交互。

2610.31645.abstract_en: Monocular models recover 3D geometry from a single image in one pass, but most assume a pinhole camera and produce distorted geometry on the wide-angle imagery produced by fisheye and panoramic lenses. Camera-aware models remove this assumption by predicting a per-pixel ray field. However, they represent different camera geometries using a single fixed basis to capture both the overall camera projection and its finer variations. We argue that camera geometry can be viewed as having a hierarchy of complexity for representing rays. We present OmniRay, a feed-forward model whose Ray Module is composed of three components: a monotone radial base that captures radially symmetric structure, a spherical-harmonic residual for smooth deviations from it, and a free-form residual for remaining local variation. These components are composed as successive rotations on the sphere, allowing the representation to accommodate diverse camera geometries. Given a single image, OmniRay predicts a ray direction and an up-to-scale radial distance for every pixel, from which a 3D point cloud is recovered without needing camera information at inference time. Extensive experiments across different camera configurations demonstrate that OmniRay establishes a new state-of-the-art in camera-agnostic monocular 3D reconstruction.
2610.31645.abstract_zh: 单目模型可一次从单张图像恢复三维几何，但大多假设针孔相机，对鱼眼和全景镜头产生的广角图像会生成扭曲几何。相机感知模型通过预测逐像素射线场消除此假设，但通常用单一固定基表示总体投影和更细的变化。作者认为，相机几何具有层次复杂性，可用于表示射线。本文提出 OmniRay：一种前馈模型，其射线模块由捕捉径向对称结构的单调径向基、表示平滑偏离的球谐残差及描述剩余局部变化的自由形态残差组成。这些成分作为球面上的连续旋转组合，以适应多样相机几何。给定单张图像，OmniRay 对每个像素预测射线方向与仅差一个尺度的径向距离，从而无需推理时提供相机信息即可恢复三维点云。跨不同相机配置的广泛实验显示，OmniRay 在相机无关的单目三维重建中达到作者报告的最先进水平。

2610.31635.abstract_en: Feed-forward models accurately estimate camera motion and 3D geometry from short video windows. However, computational and memory costs prevent direct inference on sequences containing thousands of frames. Long videos must therefore be processed as overlapping chunks. This division produces independent local reconstructions with inconsistent coordinate frames and duplicate estimates of shared cameras. Achieving global consistency requires propagating constraints from adjacent overlaps and distant revisits across the sequence. This requirement naturally motivates pose graph optimization. However, the choice of graph level creates a trade-off. Chunk-level graphs efficiently resolve scale drift and close large loops. Yet, their rigid transformations cannot correct internal errors or conflicting frame predictions. Conversely, frame-level optimization offers local flexibility, but scaling it globally is computationally expensive and can break metric scale. HiP3R resolves this trade-off using a hierarchical pose graph. HiP3R first optimizes a robust chunk-level $\mathrm{Sim}(3)$ graph to establish the global layout and scale. It then holds this layout fixed and estimates one shared $\mathrm{SE}(3)$ camera per frame, turning overlapping window predictions into a single trajectory. Experiments across multiple benchmarks demonstrate the effectiveness of HiP3R in improving camera trajectories and 3D reconstruction. Our method applies to both chunk-based and streaming backends without additional training or fine-tuning. The codes are available at this https URL.
2610.31635.abstract_zh: 前馈模型能从短视频窗口准确估计相机运动和三维几何，但计算与内存成本使其难以直接处理数千帧序列，长视频须分为重叠片段。这会产生坐标系不一致、共享相机重复估计的独立局部重建；全局一致性要求在整段视频中传播相邻重叠和远距离重访带来的约束，因此自然需要姿态图优化。图层级选择存在权衡：片段级图可高效解决尺度漂移和大环闭合，但刚性变换无法修正内部误差或冲突帧预测；帧级优化更灵活，却难以在全局扩展，也可能破坏度量尺度。HiP3R 以分层姿态图解决该权衡：先优化稳健的片段级 Sim(3) 图，建立全局布局与尺度；再固定布局，为每帧估计一个共享 SE(3) 相机，把重叠窗口预测合并为单条轨迹。多项基准实验表明 HiP3R 可改善相机轨迹和三维重建。方法无需额外训练或微调，适用于基于片段与流式处理的后端。论文提供代码链接。

2610.30293.abstract_en: We introduce EgoHand, a monocular 3D hand reconstruction model that achieves state-of-the-art performance on egocentric video. Central to our approach is the curation of a high-quality training corpus of 14 million images, combining synthetic data, in-the-wild video, and multi-camera motion capture to balance scene diversity and supervision quality. The model adopts SOMA-Hand as its parametric representation and processes 2D hand crops with a transformer encoder, incorporating camera cues and an auxiliary 2D branch to improve geometric consistency and image alignment. Zero-shot evaluations on HOT3D, ARCTIC, and H2O demonstrate strong out-of-domain generalization, with lower joint-position, root-translation, and acceleration errors than competing baselines at an inference latency of approximately 9.69 ms. A blinded user preference study further shows that participants favor EgoHand's reconstructed hand poses over those from Apple EgoDex and Ropedia Xperience-10M. We release the EgoHand model and source code under the OpenMDW license, allowing free commercial use of the model.
2610.30293.abstract_zh: 本文提出 EgoHand：一种面向第一视角视频的单目三维手部重建模型，取得作者报告的最先进表现。方法核心是整理包含 1,400 万张图像的高质量训练语料，结合合成数据、野外视频和多相机动作捕捉，在场景多样性与监督质量之间平衡。模型采用 SOMA-Hand 参数化表示，使用 Transformer 编码器处理二维手部裁剪，并加入相机线索和辅助二维分支，以改善几何一致性及图像对齐。在 HOT3D、ARCTIC 和 H2O 上的零样本评估显示较强的域外泛化：关节位置、根部平移和加速度误差均低于所比较基线，推理延迟约为 9.69 ms。盲测用户偏好研究还显示，参与者更偏好 EgoHand 重建的手部姿态，而非 Apple EgoDex 和 Ropedia Xperience-10M 的结果。作者以允许模型免费商业使用的 OpenMDW 许可证发布 EgoHand 模型和源代码。
